title: Enroll into JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE offered by Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/241223/0001 (12/23/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31-December- 2024. Classes will start from January and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll: 31st December 2024 Enrollment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in/Details/553/JudiciaryExamPreparationCourse For queries: Dr. Amandeep Singh –Block 29-203D

title: L'Oréal India For Young Women In Science Scholarships 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/241223/0001 (12/23/2024)
body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/9YmzaYFSEn5E5yVg7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

Last Date to Register : - 15-Jan-2025 Rewards :- 1. title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. Detail of the event is as following: - Application Dead Line Date: 20th December 2024 Result Announcement:31st December 2024 Final Expo:31st January 2025 in Ludhiana Participants: Students in UG and PG programs. Fees: Nil Prize: The Shikhar Program has a *prize pool of 5 lakhs*. Top-performing teams will receive recognition, awards, and may also have opportunities to further develop their projects with support for implementation on a larger scale. Workshop and Mentorship: Top selected teams will participate in a 15 Days residential workshop at IITs and AICs (under AIM,NITI Aayog) to refine their projects, focusing on innovation, product development and business feasibility. Note: Participants can use any tools, technology, or materials suitable for their project, provided they adhere to safety and ethical guidelines. The weblink for applying the program is :https://shikharprogram.com/ For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. No., 9814818964, Email: - innovation.studio@lpu.co.in

body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. title: L'Oréal India For Young Women In Science Scholarships 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/241223/0001 (12/23/2024)
body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/9YmzaYFSEn5E5yVg7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship. title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. Detail of the event is as following: - Application Dead Line Date: 20th December 2024 Result Announcement:31st December 2024 Final Expo:31st January 2025 in Ludhiana Participants: Students in UG and PG programs. Fees: Nil Prize: The Shikhar Program has a *prize pool of 5 lakhs*. Top-performing teams will receive recognition, awards, and may also have opportunities to further develop their projects with support for implementation on a larger scale. Workshop and Mentorship: Top selected teams will participate in a 15 Days residential workshop at IITs and AICs (under AIM,NITI Aayog) to refine their projects, focusing on innovation, product development and business feasibility. Note: Participants can use any tools, technology, or materials suitable for their project, provided they adhere to safety and ethical guidelines. The weblink for applying the program is :https://shikharprogram.com/ For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. Detail of the event is as following: - Application Dead Line Date: 20th December 2024 Result Announcement:31st December 2024 Final Expo:31st January 2025 in Ludhiana Participants: Students in UG and PG programs. Fees: Nil Prize: The Shikhar Program has a *prize pool of 5 lakhs*. Top-performing teams will receive recognition, awards, and may also have opportunities to further develop their projects with support for implementation on a larger scale. Workshop and Mentorship: Top selected teams will participate in a 15 Days residential workshop at IITs and AICs (under AIM,NITI Aayog) to refine their projects, focusing on innovation, product development and business feasibility. Note: Participants can use any tools, technology, or materials suitable for their project, provided they adhere to safety and ethical guidelines. The weblink for applying the program is :https://shikharprogram.com/ For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). Last Date to Register : - 15-Jan-2025 Rewards :- 1. title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. Detail of the event is as following: - Application Dead Line Date: 20th December 2024 Result Announcement:31st December 2024 Final Expo:31st January 2025 in Ludhiana Participants: Students in UG and PG programs. Fees: Nil Prize: The Shikhar Program has a *prize pool of 5 lakhs*. Top-performing teams will receive recognition, awards, and may also have opportunities to further develop their projects with support for implementation on a larger scale. Workshop and Mentorship: Top selected teams will participate in a 15 Days residential workshop at IITs and AICs (under AIM,NITI Aayog) to refine their projects, focusing on innovation, product development and business feasibility. Note: Participants can use any tools, technology, or materials suitable for their project, provided they adhere to safety and ethical guidelines. The weblink for applying the program is :https://shikharprogram.com/ For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/9YmzaYFSEn5E5yVg7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship. body: Description:- This globally popular IMA® (Institute of Management Accountants) Student Case Competition invites college or university students from all over the world to think strategically and stretch their analytical skills to solve the business case. Eligibility Criteria : - • Each campus of any college or university in India is eligible to select a team(s) of three to five members. • Eligible students must be enrolled in full-time undergraduate or postgraduate programs. • No more than 50% of team members may be master’s degree candidates, and no doctoral degree candidates may be included. • Team members may be from different academic programs but must all be from the same university/college. • Each team must appoint a team leader. • Each team may have a faculty advisor from the same university/college. • Although faculty members are encouraged to promote this competition on their campus, NO faculty or other professional assistance is allowed in solving the case. Last Date to Register : - 15-Jan-2025 Rewards :- 1. title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). title: IMA India Student Case Competition 2025 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/241221/0001 (12/21/2024)
body: Description:- This globally popular IMA® (Institute of Management Accountants) Student Case Competition invites college or university students from all over the world to think strategically and stretch their analytical skills to solve the business case. Eligibility Criteria : - • Each campus of any college or university in India is eligible to select a team(s) of three to five members. • Eligible students must be enrolled in full-time undergraduate or postgraduate programs. • No more than 50% of team members may be master’s degree candidates, and no doctoral degree candidates may be included. • Team members may be from different academic programs but must all be from the same university/college. • Each team must appoint a team leader. • Each team may have a faculty advisor from the same university/college. • Although faculty members are encouraged to promote this competition on their campus, NO faculty or other professional assistance is allowed in solving the case. Last Date to Register : - 15-Jan-2025 Rewards :- 1. Each team member and faculty advisor will receive a certificate of participation. 2. 1st Prize:- • The first-place team will receive up to INR 1,00,000* and a plaque for their college/university. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. (Active CMA candidates are not eligible for the CMA scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 20,000)3. 3. 2nd Prize:- • The second-place team will receive up to INR 50,000*. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. (Active CMA candidates are not eligible for the CMA scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 10,000)4. 4. 3rd Prize:- • The third-place team will receive up to INR 25,000*. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. (Active CMA candidates are not eligible for the CMA scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 5,000) Registration Details:- How to Register:- Link1 - https://tinyurl.com/IMACOMP2025 Link2 - https://forms.gle/6HGvXu44t6tXg3yG8 Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest. 2. The submissions received via IMASCC INDIA official website will be considered for the competition. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Hitesh Kumar Arora at hitesh.26482@lpu.co.in.

The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. title: L'Oréal India For Young Women In Science Scholarships 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/241223/0001 (12/23/2024)
body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. body: Description:- This globally popular IMA® (Institute of Management Accountants) Student Case Competition invites college or university students from all over the world to think strategically and stretch their analytical skills to solve the business case. Eligibility Criteria : - • Each campus of any college or university in India is eligible to select a team(s) of three to five members. • Eligible students must be enrolled in full-time undergraduate or postgraduate programs. • No more than 50% of team members may be master’s degree candidates, and no doctoral degree candidates may be included. • Team members may be from different academic programs but must all be from the same university/college. • Each team must appoint a team leader. • Each team may have a faculty advisor from the same university/college. • Although faculty members are encouraged to promote this competition on their campus, NO faculty or other professional assistance is allowed in solving the case. Last Date to Register : - 15-Jan-2025 Rewards :- 1. Each team member and faculty advisor will receive a certificate of participation. 2. 1st Prize:- • The first-place team will receive up to INR 1,00,000* and a plaque for their college/university. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. (Active CMA candidates are not eligible for the CMA scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 20,000)3. 3. 2nd Prize:- • The second-place team will receive up to INR 50,000*. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. (Active CMA candidates are not eligible for the CMA scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 10,000)4. 4. 3rd Prize:- • The third-place team will receive up to INR 25,000*. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31-December- 2024. title: L'Oréal India For Young Women In Science Scholarships 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/241223/0001 (12/23/2024)
body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/9YmzaYFSEn5E5yVg7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: IMA India Student Case Competition 2025 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/241221/0001 (12/21/2024)
body: Description:- This globally popular IMA® (Institute of Management Accountants) Student Case Competition invites college or university students from all over the world to think strategically and stretch their analytical skills to solve the business case. Eligibility Criteria : - • Each campus of any college or university in India is eligible to select a team(s) of three to five members. • Eligible students must be enrolled in full-time undergraduate or postgraduate programs. • No more than 50% of team members may be master’s degree candidates, and no doctoral degree candidates may be included. • Team members may be from different academic programs but must all be from the same university/college. • Each team must appoint a team leader. • Each team may have a faculty advisor from the same university/college. • Although faculty members are encouraged to promote this competition on their campus, NO faculty or other professional assistance is allowed in solving the case. Last Date to Register : - 15-Jan-2025 Rewards :- 1. Each team member and faculty advisor will receive a certificate of participation. 2. 1st Prize:- • The first-place team will receive up to INR 1,00,000* and a plaque for their college/university. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 20,000)3. 3. 2nd Prize:- • The second-place team will receive up to INR 50,000*. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. (Active CMA candidates are not eligible for the CMA scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 10,000)4. 4. 3rd Prize:- • The third-place team will receive up to INR 25,000*. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 5,000) Registration Details:- How to Register:- Link1 - https://tinyurl.com/IMACOMP2025 Link2 - https://forms.gle/6HGvXu44t6tXg3yG8 Note:- 1. title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. Detail of the event is as following: - Application Dead Line Date: 20th December 2024 Result Announcement:31st December 2024 Final Expo:31st January 2025 in Ludhiana Participants: Students in UG and PG programs. Fees: Nil Prize: The Shikhar Program has a *prize pool of 5 lakhs*. Top-performing teams will receive recognition, awards, and may also have opportunities to further develop their projects with support for implementation on a larger scale. Workshop and Mentorship: Top selected teams will participate in a 15 Days residential workshop at IITs and AICs (under AIM,NITI Aayog) to refine their projects, focusing on innovation, product development and business feasibility. Note: Participants can use any tools, technology, or materials suitable for their project, provided they adhere to safety and ethical guidelines. The weblink for applying the program is :https://shikharprogram.com/ For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31-December- 2024. Classes will start from January and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. title: L'Oréal India For Young Women In Science Scholarships 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/241223/0001 (12/23/2024)
body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/9YmzaYFSEn5E5yVg7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31-December- 2024. Classes will start from January and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/9YmzaYFSEn5E5yVg7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship. title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. Detail of the event is as following: - Application Dead Line Date: 20th December 2024 Result Announcement:31st December 2024 Final Expo:31st January 2025 in Ludhiana Participants: Students in UG and PG programs. Fees: Nil Prize: The Shikhar Program has a *prize pool of 5 lakhs*. Top-performing teams will receive recognition, awards, and may also have opportunities to further develop their projects with support for implementation on a larger scale. Workshop and Mentorship: Top selected teams will participate in a 15 Days residential workshop at IITs and AICs (under AIM,NITI Aayog) to refine their projects, focusing on innovation, product development and business feasibility. Note: Participants can use any tools, technology, or materials suitable for their project, provided they adhere to safety and ethical guidelines. The weblink for applying the program is :https://shikharprogram.com/ For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. body: Dear All, Urinary Tract Infections (UTIs) are a common health concern, but if left untreated, they can lead to serious complications affecting multiple organs and systems in the body. To raise awareness about the potential risks and to equip everyone with essential knowledge, LPU NSS, under the aegis of the Division of Youth Affairs, Student Welfare Wing, Lovely Professional University, has organized an informative Medical Camp on the Complications of UTIs. The camp will focus on the following key complications arising from UTIs including Abdominal Infections, Respiratory Infections, Nervous System Infections, Myocardial Issues, Liver and Pancreatic Infections, Anemia along with Male & Female related Health Issues. Event Details : Date: 24th December 2024 Time: 9:00 AM onwards Venue: 25-201 Registration Link : Click here to Register So, register yourself now on the above given link to be a part of this medical camp. We encourage all to attend and take advantage of the expert medical guidance and insights that will be shared during this informative camp. For any queries, feel free to contact: +91 9592333800.Stay informed, stay healthy!

title: Enroll into JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE offered by Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/241223/0001 (12/23/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31-December- 2024. Classes will start from January and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll: 31st December 2024 Enrollment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in/Details/553/JudiciaryExamPreparationCourse For queries: Dr. Amandeep Singh –Block 29-203D

title: L'Oréal India For Young Women In Science Scholarships 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/241223/0001 (12/23/2024)
body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/9YmzaYFSEn5E5yVg7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: IMA India Student Case Competition 2025 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/241221/0001 (12/21/2024)
body: Description:- This globally popular IMA® (Institute of Management Accountants) Student Case Competition invites college or university students from all over the world to think strategically and stretch their analytical skills to solve the business case. Eligibility Criteria : - • Each campus of any college or university in India is eligible to select a team(s) of three to five members. • Eligible students must be enrolled in full-time undergraduate or postgraduate programs. • No more than 50% of team members may be master’s degree candidates, and no doctoral degree candidates may be included. • Team members may be from different academic programs but must all be from the same university/college. • Each team must appoint a team leader. • Each team may have a faculty advisor from the same university/college. • Although faculty members are encouraged to promote this competition on their campus, NO faculty or other professional assistance is allowed in solving the case. Last Date to Register : - 15-Jan-2025 Rewards :- 1. Each team member and faculty advisor will receive a certificate of participation. 2. 1st Prize:- • The first-place team will receive up to INR 1,00,000* and a plaque for their college/university. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 20,000)3. 3. 2nd Prize:- • The second-place team will receive up to INR 50,000*. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. (Active CMA candidates are not eligible for the CMA scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 10,000)4. 4. 3rd Prize:- • The third-place team will receive up to INR 25,000*. • The team members will receive a CMA Scholarship. (Active CMA candidates are not eligible for the CMA scholarship. Those deemed eligible, need to apply within a month of SCC results) (*Each participant will receive 5,000) Registration Details:- How to Register:- Link1 - https://tinyurl.com/IMACOMP2025 Link2 - https://forms.gle/6HGvXu44t6tXg3yG8 Note:- 1. The submissions received via IMASCC INDIA official website will be considered for the competition. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Hitesh Kumar Arora at hitesh.26482@lpu.co.in.

title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. Detail of the event is as following: - Application Dead Line Date: 20th December 2024 Result Announcement:31st December 2024 Final Expo:31st January 2025 in Ludhiana Participants: Students in UG and PG programs. Fees: Nil Prize: The Shikhar Program has a *prize pool of 5 lakhs*. Top-performing teams will receive recognition, awards, and may also have opportunities to further develop their projects with support for implementation on a larger scale. Workshop and Mentorship: Top selected teams will participate in a 15 Days residential workshop at IITs and AICs (under AIM,NITI Aayog) to refine their projects, focusing on innovation, product development and business feasibility. Note: Participants can use any tools, technology, or materials suitable for their project, provided they adhere to safety and ethical guidelines. The weblink for applying the program is :https://shikharprogram.com/ For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. title: Enroll into JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE offered by Centre for Professional Enhancement : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/241223/0001 (12/23/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31-December- 2024. Classes will start from January and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll: 31st December 2024 Enrollment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in/Details/553/JudiciaryExamPreparationCourse For queries: Dr. Amandeep Singh –Block 29-203D

title: L'Oréal India For Young Women In Science Scholarships 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/241223/0001 (12/23/2024)
body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/9YmzaYFSEn5E5yVg7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. Detail of the event is as following: - Application Dead Line Date: 20th December 2024 Result Announcement:31st December 2024 Final Expo:31st January 2025 in Ludhiana Participants: Students in UG and PG programs. Fees: Nil Prize: The Shikhar Program has a *prize pool of 5 lakhs*. Top-performing teams will receive recognition, awards, and may also have opportunities to further develop their projects with support for implementation on a larger scale. Workshop and Mentorship: Top selected teams will participate in a 15 Days residential workshop at IITs and AICs (under AIM,NITI Aayog) to refine their projects, focusing on innovation, product development and business feasibility. Note: Participants can use any tools, technology, or materials suitable for their project, provided they adhere to safety and ethical guidelines. The weblink for applying the program is :https://shikharprogram.com/ For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. No., 9814818964, Email: - innovation.studio@lpu.co.in

body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31-December- 2024. body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. Detail of the event is as following: - Application Dead Line Date: 20th December 2024 Result Announcement:31st December 2024 Final Expo:31st January 2025 in Ludhiana Participants: Students in UG and PG programs. Fees: Nil Prize: The Shikhar Program has a *prize pool of 5 lakhs*. Top-performing teams will receive recognition, awards, and may also have opportunities to further develop their projects with support for implementation on a larger scale. Workshop and Mentorship: Top selected teams will participate in a 15 Days residential workshop at IITs and AICs (under AIM,NITI Aayog) to refine their projects, focusing on innovation, product development and business feasibility. Note: Participants can use any tools, technology, or materials suitable for their project, provided they adhere to safety and ethical guidelines. The weblink for applying the program is :https://shikharprogram.com/ For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. No., 9814818964, Email: - innovation.studio@lpu.co.in

body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31-December- 2024. body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount). title: Invitation of applications from students for Shikhar Program-North Idia Hackathon-Inter State Innovation Competition : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/241219/0002 (12/19/2024)
body: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is happy to inform you that - Punjab State Council for Science and Technology is going to organise the Shikhar Program in collaboration and partnership with Munjal Birmingham City University Centre of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Atal Innovation Mission-NITI Aayog. SHIKHAR Program is an inter-state, inter-college initiative that empowers students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills by developing practical, technical and innovative solutions to everyday challenges faced by masses. The program nurtures young minds by providing a common organic platform for young innovators to turn their ideas into impactful products. The goal of the Shikhar Program is to empower students by giving them a platform to showcase their innovative ideas and problem-solving skills, focusing on developing practical, technical, and creative solutions to everyday challenges faced by the masses. Detail of the event is as following: - Application Dead Line Date: 20th December 2024 Result Announcement:31st December 2024 Final Expo:31st January 2025 in Ludhiana Participants: Students in UG and PG programs. Fees: Nil Prize: The Shikhar Program has a *prize pool of 5 lakhs*. Top-performing teams will receive recognition, awards, and may also have opportunities to further develop their projects with support for implementation on a larger scale. Workshop and Mentorship: Top selected teams will participate in a 15 Days residential workshop at IITs and AICs (under AIM,NITI Aayog) to refine their projects, focusing on innovation, product development and business feasibility. Note: Participants can use any tools, technology, or materials suitable for their project, provided they adhere to safety and ethical guidelines. The weblink for applying the program is :https://shikharprogram.com/ For any query please contact: - Kapil Kaushal-Department of Student Research and Project, Ph. No., 9814818964, Email: - innovation.studio@lpu.co.in

body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. body: About The Program:- L'Oréal India invites applications for the L'Oréal India for Young Women in Science Scholarships 2024-25 from young women who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in science. The scholarships will be awarded to promising young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Selected scholars will receive financial aid to cover college fees for UG, PG, and PhD in any scientific field, including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more, at a recognized college or university in India. L'Oréal India offers this scholarship to support and encourage young women to pursue higher education in science. Established in 2003, the program has consistently helped young women pursue studies in various scientific fields. Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the Science stream. Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Applicants:- Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. Open to female students only. Applicants’ annual family income should be less than INR 6,00,000. Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: - Final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last of Registration:- 31-Dec-24 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- For Undergraduates:- Rs 62,500 (Fixed Amount). For Post-graduates:- Rs 1,00,000 (Fixed Amount).
