title: Session on Career Planning in Adversities by CRADLEWISEE (9/6/2024)
body: Division of Career Services, in collaboration with CRADLEWISEE, will host a highly insightful “Session on Career Planning in Adversities by CRADLEWISEE”. CRADLEWISEE, a pioneering organization dedicated to career development and mental wellness, works to empower individuals to navigate career challenges with resilience and confidence. The session will provide students with valuable strategies to maintain focus, adapt, and succeed despite adversities. In todays fast-paced world, career paths are rarely linear, and challenges such as economic downturns, personal setbacks, or unexpected career shifts can be overwhelming. Through this event, students will learn how to pivot, manage stress, and build long-term success despite such obstacles. CRADLEWISEEs team of experts will share real-world examples and psychological strategies to help students stay resilient in the face of career adversity. The session will emphasize the importance of continuous learning, self-reflection, and maintaining a positive mindset for professional growth. The main objectives of the event are: To help students understand how to overcome career setbacks and adversity. To build resilience and adaptability in the face of career challenges. To provide students with practical career planning strategies for uncertain times. To emphasize the importance of mental wellness and self-care in professional development. To guide students in developing a long-term career vision despite immediate obstacles. To highlight the role of continuous learning in overcoming career adversity. title: ONGC Scholarship to Meritorious SC, ST, OBC and General Category students for the session 2024-25. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)/IC/240905/0006 (9/5/2024)
body: Registration process for applying for ONGC Scholarship for the academic session 2024-25 has been started on ONGC Foundation Scholarship Portal. This scholarship offers financial assistance of Rs. 48,000/- per annum to meritorious students from Schedule Caste, Schedule Tribe, OBC, and General-EWS categories to pursue UG courses in Engineering, MBBS, and PG courses in Management, Geology, and Geophysics.The category wise details are as under:- a. 1000 scholarships worth Rs. 48,000/- per annum each ONGC Foundation offers scholarships to meritorious SC/ST category students pursuing professional courses in Engineering, Medical stream and Master’s degree course in Business Administration, Geology and geophysics. b. 500 scholarships worth Rs. 48,000/- per annum each ONGC Foundation offers scholarships to meritorious OBC category students pursuing professional courses in Engineering, Medical stream and Master’s degree course in Business Administration, Geology and geophysics. c. 500 scholarships worth Rs. 48,000/- per annum each ONGC Foundation offers scholarships to meritorious economically weaker General category students pursuing professional courses in Engineering, Medical stream and Master’s degree course in Business Administration, Geology and geophysics. Link: - https://ongcscholar.org/#/ The Last date for the scholarship is 18th September 2024 The Poster issued by ONGC for scholarship is enclosed for your reference. (Refer Annexure – 1) Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Maximum age limit of the students is 30 years for all the categories 2. Income limit for Gen/OBC is Rs. 2 Lakh per annum. Income limit for SC/ST is Rs. 4.5 Lakh per annum. 3. Only full time regular students are eligible to apply for the scholarship. 4. At least 60% marks in qualifying examination. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Admission Receipts 2. Applicant’s photograph (passport size) 3. Certified copy of Caste Certificate in Hindi/English. (In case of SC/ST/OBC) 4. Certified copy of annual income certificate of the family in Hindi/English language. 5. Copy of Birth Certificate/Class 10 Mark sheet as proof of age. 6. Copy of Class 12th mark sheet in case of Engineering/MBBS students. 7. Copy of consolidated Graduation mark sheet in case of MBA/Master's in Geology/Geophysics students. 8. Bank Passbook & Bank details of the applicant in the ECS form attested by the bank as prescribed. 9. Copy of Adhaar Card 10. Declaration From College/Institute (Refer Annexure – 2) 11. Copy of Student ID card 12. Copy of student undertaking HOW TO APPLY: The candidate fulfilling the above criteria may submit their application in just one click by ‘Apply Now’ option which can be seen top right corner in this website www.ongcscholar.org Note: Complete application with all the supporting documents as mentioned in the application form duly certified and attested by their Head/Principal/ Dean of the Institute/ College/University need to be uploaded and same required to be shared in hard copies, should reach the designated office of ONGC before the due date. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria as mentioned above must submit their application online. For receiving scholarship benefits, an individual shall furnish proof of possession of required documents of enrolled college/ University. Selection Procedure: a. Selection of candidate will be made on the basis of aggregate marks obtained in the qualifying examination prescribed for each eligible course of study. In case of students having equal marks in the qualifying examination students with lower family income will be selected. b. Preference shall be given to students from below poverty line (BPL) families and other students shall be considered only if sufficient number of students from BPL families fulfilling the eligibility criteria is not available. Disbursement of Scholarship: a. The scholarship will cover lump sum amount of Rs 4000/- (Four Thousand) per month i.e. Rs 48000/- Per Annum. b. The amount shall be paid on yearly basis after completion of the academic year. The amount of scholarship will be deposited directly in the bank account of students through ECS facility. c. Once awarded, the scholarship shall be continued every year till the completion of the course subject to promotion of the student to the next year of his/her course. Scholarship shall be discontinued if the candidate is not promoted to the next year by their respective Institute/College/University. For the continuation of the scholarship, the students will have to send an online ‘Application for renewal’. d. In case the student opts for any different scholarship subsequently after award of ONGC Scholarship, he/she should have to refund the entire scholarship amount received from ONGC Foundation. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2024-25 -------->ONGC Scholarship 2024-205. All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

body: Dear Students, This is to inform you that the IAEC meeting for the pre-clinical study will be held shortly. Please note that the IAEC meetings are conducted only three times in a year (October, December, and February). Important Instructions for Form B Submission, Presentation, and Animal Work: 1. Submission Protocol: Form B must be submitted by the guide only. 3. Correction Process: If corrections are suggested, the corrected Form B must be resubmitted along with the earlier version within 1-3 days. Late submissions will not be accepted. 4. Meeting Attendance: Attendance at the pre-IAEC (if held) and IAEC meetings is mandatory for both guides and students. Non-attendance will result in the non-approval of Form B, which will then be deferred to the next meeting. 5. IAEC Certification: Certificates will be issued upon submission of Form D and the summary report, duly signed by guides and authorized personnel. 6. Faculty Involvement: Faculty/Guides must visit the animal house to assist their respective students. 7. Instructions Review: Please read the instructions for the invigilator in Form B before signing. 8. Personnel Responsibility: Ensure that only the names of the concerned persons responsible for work in the animal house (research scholar/co-guide, if any) are listed in Form B, as they will be the only ones permitted to work with the animals. 9. Form Integrity: Do not alter the format of Form B. Any tampering will result in the form being rejected for presentation. body: Dear Students, The Student Centric Revenue Generation Model (SCRGM) is designed to empower students who are eager to explore knowledge beyond the confines of traditional classrooms. The Student-Centric Revenue Generation Model (SCRGM) offers students an opportunity to: · Explore Revenue-Generating Ideas: Students can bring forward their innovative ideas and learn how to turn them into viable revenue streams. · Put Curriculum Skills into Practice: Implement and enhance skills learned from their academic courses in real-world scenarios to bridge the gap between theory and practice. · Develop Entrepreneurial Skills: Through practical experience, students can build essential skills in entrepreneurship, such as problem-solving, financial management, and strategic planning. · Craft Their Career Path: Students can tailor their career trajectory by aligning their passions and skills with real-world opportunities. · Gain Practical Experience: By working on projects and initiatives, students gain hands-on experience that enhances their understanding and prepares them for future careers. · Spearhead Ongoing Entrepreneurial Projects: Initiate and manage ventures that create job opportunities for others, driving economic growth and employment. Who Can Participate? All students across all schools can register for SCRGM, either individually or in team Registration Categories: Students can register in the following categories based on their interests and ideas: i. Freelancer ii. Part-time Job iii. Startup iv. Self-Employed v. Ongoing entrepreneurial project (Generating employment for others) With regard to the above it is for your information that the interface for the registration of SCRGM is open and you can register at the following link UMS Navigation----- LMS--------- Student Centric Revenue Generation Model In addition to gaining invaluable entrepreneurial experience, students who participate in SCRGM shall be provided with approved academic benefits. Student-submitted ideas and projects will be evaluated by an academic committee. Based on the committee's evaluation and recommendations, appropriate academic credit or equivalence will be granted to the students. Submit your entry and register now! Last Date to Register: 20th September 2024 Don’t miss this opportunity to turn your ideas into reality and gain valuable entrepreneurial experience. For more details on SCRGM, Kindly contact Mr. Sanchit Singla in 29-404 or you can also RMS on UMS Navigation -------- > RMS --------- > MOOC/ Hackathon.

title: Registrations open for Medical Hackathon- MEDHA by BETIC- IIT Bombay : LPU/18.4/CAPB(ENGB)/2024/001(1.1)/IC/240826/0001 (8/26/2024)
body: We are thrilled to announce MEDHA 2024, a premier hackathon dedicated to driving innovation in medical devices. This exciting event is organized by BETIC(Biomedical Engineering and Technology Innovation Centre), IIT Bombay and aims to bring together diverse talents to create impactful solutions in the medical field. ABOUT BETIC- BETIC is a multi-disciplinary and multi-institution translational R&D network with 14 partner institutes (engineering and medical) across Maharashtra State, each of them connected to local institutes and industry. The core vision is to create global success stories of indigenous medical devices by providing the necessary guidance and support to med-tech innovators. They face four ‘valleys of death’ between concept, proof-of-concept, prototype, product and market. Crossing them requires expert inputs from multiple disciplines including medical, mechanical, materials, manufacturing and management. Required skill set and background: 1.Medical: Biomedical, Medicine, Physiotherapy, Pharma 2.Design: Industrial Design, Product Design 3.Engineering-I: Mechanical, Manufacturing, Materials, Chemical 4.Engineering-II: Electronics, Communication, Instrumentation, Software 5.Management/ marketing- Optional Each team must include at least one member from each of the above backgrounds and have at least one member with professional industry or entrepreneurship experience. Eligibility: 1. Minimum CGPA-6 2. Regular student of Lovely Professional University 3. Must fulfill the skill set requirement as mentioned above Team formation: A team must comprise of minimum 4 members and not more than 5 members.If any student unable to form the team as requirement kindly register individually, the organizing committee will form a team. The hackathon will be conducted in 4 phases: Phase Date venue Agenda Phase 1 28th August, 2024 Innovation studio, block 39 Team formation as per required skill set Phase 2 3rd September, 2024 Innovation studio, block 39 Orientation session of the problem statement and the target outcomes/achievement during the hackathon Phase 3 5,6th September, 2024 Innovation studio, block 39 24 hours internal hackathon Phase 4 In October BETIC, IIT Bombay Top 2-3 performers will participate in finals Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/MEDHA-LPU Last Date of Registration: 28th August , 2024. No Registration Fee Benefits: 1. Top 3 teams will be awarded with trophies and Certificates. 2. Top 2 teams will be nominated for IIT Bombay MEDHA-Finale 3. Participants will be provided with e-certificates. 4. Duty leaves will be provided for all the participants Note: Participation teams will bring their own identified hardware as per the problem statement. All the tools will be made available on the site during the hackathon.

title: The Power of Presence: A Workshop on Non-Verbal Communication Skills : LPU/20.2/ST/2024/001/IC/240823/0008 (8/23/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “The Power of Presence: A Workshop on Non-Verbal Communication Skills”. There is no doubt that Non-Verbal Communication complements verbal communication still nonverbal cues are frequently ignored in communication that can make or break your interview effectiveness. Therefore, students will explore these clues in this lively and informative workshop. Although words are important in an interview, body language, gestures, and unconscious facial emotions can convey important information about a person to the interviewer. The goal of this session is to provide students with the knowledge and abilities to use nonverbal communication to project authenticity, professionalism, and confidence—a combination that will increase their chances of winning their dream job during the interview process. The main objectives of the event are: To project confidence, professionalism, and authenticity To understand the impact of body language and facial expressions To use gestures effectively to enhance your verbal communication To increase your chances of acing the interview and landing your dream job. title: Session on UNOOSA, COPUOS, Treaties and National Space Law (8/22/2024)
body: Division of Career Services in collaboration with the United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (UNOOSA) will host an enlightening “Session on UNOOSA, COPUOS, Treaties and National Space Law. UNOOSA, established by the United Nations, works to promote international cooperation in the peaceful use and exploration of outer space. UNOOSAs efforts are pivotal in developing space law and policy through various international treaties, including the Outer Space Treaty, and in facilitating discussions on space governance under the Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space (COPUOS). This session will aim to introduce students to the importance of space law, covering international agreements, national space laws, and their implications on global space activities. The event will emphasize how international cooperation, legal frameworks, and national regulations shape the governance of space exploration, satellite communication, and space resource utilization. The main objectives of the event are: To familiarize students with the role of UNOOSA in space governance. To explore the structure and function of COPUOS in space law. To introduce key international treaties related to outer space. To explain the relationship between international treaties and national space laws. To highlight emerging issues in space law and policy. To provide career insights into the field of space law. Target audience: The students of School of Law, School of Political Science, School of Education. body: We are thrilled to announce that Lovely Professional University is inviting applications for student participation and representing India in the prestigious NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge, (NHERC)- 2025, set to take place in the United States of America. This exciting opportunity allows you to be part of a team representing LPU on an international platform. This annual event, part of the Artemis Student Challenge, engages students worldwide in the next phase of human space exploration. Lovely Professional University is participating in this event from last 5 years and this year also, we are ready to participate with full throttle. About the Challenge: The NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge is an annual competition that challenges students to design, build, and test human-powered rovers capable of traversing simulated extraterrestrial terrains. This event encourages teamwork, problem-solving, and practical application of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) concepts. HERC draws inspiration from both the Apollo and Artemis missions, emphasizing the design, construction, and testing of technologies to traverse unique environmental terrains. As an Artemis Student Challenge, it emphasizes innovation in designing and testing technologies for various environmental terrains. This year, the competition is going to be held in 2 categories: i.Human powered ii.RC controlled No. Of Seats: 40( 20 for each team) Eligibility Criteria: Age: 18 or older Student must be a regular student of Lovely Professional University CGPA: Student must have minimum CGPA of 6.5 (not applicable for freshers students). Passport: Should have a valid passport with at least 2 years of validity considering 30th november as final date of submission of documents. Language Skills: Good proficiency in English communication. Technical Skills: Expertise in any of the following Designing- CAD and CAM software Fabrication Coding Robotics and Automation Content writing Video creation, editing and promotion Sponsorship STEM engagement Selection criteria: I. Students will be selected on the basis of eligibility criteria, previous experience, skill set followed by personal interview/interaction through an expert committee. II. After selection, only 20 students will be shortlisted for final participation and representation at USA. Previous Experience: ? At least 1 year of domain experience in the relevant skill. We encourage all eligible and interested students to take advantage of this incredible opportunity. For more information and to apply, click on the following link: Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/NASA-HERC-LPU Email- innovation.studio@lpu.co.in About Kaizel Industries: Kaizel Industries is a young and innovative startup that was founded with the goal of revolutionizing the way we use technology. The main focus of Kaizel Industries is on developing cutting-edge technologies that can solve some of the most pressing problems facing society today. The company prioritizes sustainability and scalability, aiming to transform healthcare systems globally.Presently it is now working at our Preincubation Centre in Innovation Studio. TOP 8 students will be sponsored air ticket by team KAIZEL incubated at Innovation Studio, Lovely Professional University. For any further information, please contact us at Department of Student Research and Project, Innovation Studio, Block 39- Room no-111B

title: 2024 Call for Code Global Challenge : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/240821/0001 (8/21/2024)
body: Description:- Basic necessities like clean water and safe, affordable housing, or opportunities in education and fair government representation are not equally accessible to all people. Climate change exacerbates the challenges that many people but especially women and historically underserved communities face as resources are strained and climate change protections are often inadequate. Generative AI has great potential to address these issues and reduce inequality, improving people’s lives. Be a part of a new era in responsible AI. For the 2024 Call for Code Global Challenge, we’re calling on students, developers, and problem-solvers from universities and companies around the world to build innovative AI tech solutions with IBM watsonx that address specific challenges of equitable access to essential needs. Help show the world that AI can be trusted and used responsibly. Eligibility Criteria:- • Full-time students from all disciplines of any under-graduation degree. • The most successful teams often bring together diverse skill sets to design unique and impactful solutions, so, consider problem-solvers with varied experience when assembling your team. Moreover, team pattern can be as mentioned below; Builders: - The tech mastermind of your team. The builder is the methodical, digital-obsessed teammate who brings the technical know-how to help ground your solution in what’s possible. Designer: - Your UX expert who ensures the solution is user-friendly and visually appealing. Designers bring creative vision to technical problem solving, making what you build sleek and easy-to-consume. Communicators: - Good communicators make complex ideas simple and inspiring. Your team’s calculating hustler is essential in articulating the problem and succinctly defining how the solution can make a difference in a profound, unique, consumable way. Humanitarians: - Altruistic thinkers who understand the complex problems at hand in a truly human way and are committed to finding a solution to make a demonstrable difference. This inspirational lead of your team considers the communities in need, while also thinking like the individual user • Any number of individuals from a campus can take part in the competition. • Further rules are available on the IBM website. Last Date to Register:- 17-Oct-24 at 23:59 PM Rewards:- Grand prize winners:- 1. Winners: Grand prize• $50,000 USD 2. First runner-up:• $25,000 USD 3. Second runner-up:• $10,000 USD 4. University grant:• $30,000 USD In addition to prizes, participants can grow their AI, cloud, and other emerging tech skills through access to expert technical mentors, training resources, and events. Registration Details:- How to Register:- Link1 - https://tinyurl.com/4ah4ew45 Link2 - https://forms.gle/qRhy2ARGS8BuavJ28 Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the competition. 2. The submissions received via the IBM official website will be considered for the competition. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in.

title: Registration for R grade ETP viva of project, dissertation and similar courses. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)/IC/240821/0106 (8/21/2024)
body: This is for the information of all students who have been awarded with R grade in Capstone Projects, Dissertations, and similar courses (List attached as Attachment I) in Spring term 23242 and summer term 2324W that the interface for the registration in R grade is active now. The students can register for the R grade by following the below mentioned steps: Step-I- Filling of the Online Registration Form: All students having R grade in the attached list of courses are required to apply online for the registration in R grade and pay the R grade registration fee online via following UMS Path: - UMS Navigation----> Examination System------> Exam Registration------> R grade courses Registration The Last date for R grade registration and fee payment is 26th August (without any late fee) and 31st August 2024 (with a late fee of Rs.2000/-). Important points- i) The detailed process (along with the screen shots) of registering and paying the R grade fee is also attached with this announcement as Attachment No- 2. ii) No request of R grade registration shall be entertained after 31st August 2024. Step-II- Uploading Soft Copy of Report After the online registration and paying the requisite fee for the R grade, the students shall be required to upload the soft copy of final report as per the requirement of the course (see attachment 1) by visiting the following UMS path: - UMS Navigation-->LMS-------> Upload Research Project/Internship certificate details->Upload Project Report/Internship certificate The last date to upload soft copies of the report on UMS is 31st August 2024. Step-III- Uploading of Publication details Students can upload their publications in either of SCOPUS/ SCI /WOS/NAAS (rating greater than 5) indexed journals for the courses as per Attachment-1. The publication details can be uploaded by visiting following UMS path: - UMS Navigation -->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details--->Upload Research Project Publication/Copyright details The last date to upload publication details on UMS is 31st August 2024. Important points i) It is expected that the students upload the soft copies of their final report as well as publication details well in advance so that the respective supervisors can recommend the same within the timelines. ii) Mere proof of submission of publication or publication without LPU affiliation will not be considered. iii) Only Published paper or proof of acceptance of the paper (with LPU affiliation) will be considered. ‘ Step-IV- Recommendation of the uploaded soft copy of reports and publication details through respective supervisors The students are also required to get their soft copies of the final reports/publication details recommended by their respective supervisors. The last date to recommend the soft copies of the reports is 1st September 2024. Important points- a) Registration for the R grade shall be considered only after completion of all the above-mentioned steps or else the registration shall be assumed incomplete and F grade shall be awarded. b) R Grade viva schedule shall be communicated to the students via UMS my messages and UMS seating plan at least 7 days in advance from the ETP viva date. c) In case a student does not register for R grade or misses the report submission as per UMS timelines then R grade viva shall not be conducted and grade would be converted to F grade. d) All the respective supervisors are required to ensure the timely uploading of the soft copies of the final reports/publication details by their students and recommendation of the same within the timelines In case of any query, student may log an RMS using the below mentioned path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Category: Examinations Sub-Category: Seating Plan and Viva-Capstone/Dissertation/Thesis/CDP/Summer Training

body: This is in continuation to the UMS announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/240427/002 dated 27/4/2024 wherein, the students were informed to complete their Community Development Project Courses for Autumn Term 24251 latest by 20th July 2024. All eligible students who are registered in such courses (list attached) are now required to upload their final reports along with the certificate as per the following details for eligibility to appear in the final ETP viva which shall be conducted tentatively from September 2024 onwards. The screenshots of the interface along with the CDP guidelines and report format are also attached with the announcement for reference. The last date for uploading of final CDP report with certificate on UMS is 31st August 2024. The UMS path to upload the documents is as follows: UMS Navigation---> LMS---> Upload Research Project---> Project Report/Internship certificate---> Internship Report with Certificate---> Upload File Important Note- 1. The schedule of the ETP viva shall be soon visible in the students’ UMS login under the ‘my messages’ tab and in UMS seating plan, and the viva shall tentatively be scheduled from September 2024 onwards. 2. No extension for uploading of documents after the last date shall be given. 3. The CDP certificates to be uploaded by the students must be authenticated by the respective organization. 4. If the required documents are not uploaded by the student as per timelines, or are uploaded under the wrong course code then the final ETP Viva for all such students shall not be conducted. Further, they will be marked as absent and will be awarded R grade. 5. In case the certificate produced at the time of viva is found to be different from the one uploaded on the UMS, the student’s result may be cancelled and all such students may be awarded R grade. 6. In case the first page of uploaded document does not contain the CDP certificate, the final ETP Viva for all such students can be cancelled and R grade shall be applicable. 7. Student were already advised to refrain from any unethical practices (like joining fake NGO’s, getting certificates in lieu of money, copied reports etc.) during their CDP. If any such case is reported then the same shall lead to disciplinary action in terms of Unfair Means Case (UMC) and further action shall also be applicable including cancellation of scholarship etc. In case of any query, students may log an RMS request through the following UMS path: - UMS Navigation---> Relationship Management System (RMS)---> Log Request Category: Examinations Sub-Category: Seating Plan and Viva-Capstone/Dissertation/Thesis/CDP/Summer Training

title: Registrations open for medical hackathon- MEDHA by BETIC- IIT Bombay : LPU/18.4/CAPB(ENGB)/2024/001(1.1)/IC/240819/0001 (8/19/2024)
body: We are thrilled to announce MEDHA 2024, a premier hackathon dedicated to driving innovation in medical devices. This exciting event is organized by BETIC(Biomedical Engineering and Technology Innovation Centre), IIT Bombay and aims to bring together diverse talents to create impactful solutions in the medical field. ABOUT BETIC- BETIC is a multi-disciplinary and multi-institution translational R&D network with 14 partner institutes (engineering and medical) across Maharashtra State, each of them connected to local institutes and industry. The core vision is to create global success stories of indigenous medical devices by providing the necessary guidance and support to med-tech innovators. They face four ‘valleys of death’ between concept, proof-of-concept, prototype, product and market. Crossing them requires expert inputs from multiple disciplines including medical, mechanical, materials, manufacturing and management. Required skill set and background: 1.Medical: Biomedical, Medicine, Physiotherapy, Pharma 2.Design: Industrial Design, Product Design 3.Engineering-I: Mechanical, Manufacturing, Materials, Chemical 4.Engineering-II: Electronics, Communication, Instrumentation, Software 5.Management/ marketing- Optional Each team must include at least one member from each of the above backgrounds and have at least one member with professional industry or entrepreneurship experience. title: Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/240817/0003 (8/17/2024)
body: About The Program:- Reliance has been providing scholarships to meritorious students for over 25 years, inspired by Reliance Founder-Chairman Shri Dhirubhai Ambani’s belief that the best way to ensure the nation’s progress is to invest in its youth. Over the years, Reliance Foundation scholarship programmes have impacted the lives of 23,000 youth across India. Since 2022-2023, Reliance Foundation has been supporting 5,100 students annually, including 5,000 meritorious undergraduate students from underprivileged sections of society studying any stream of their choice through the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships, and 100 of India's brightest postgraduate students studying eligible subjects in select future ready courses from Engineering, Technology, Energy & Life Sciences through the Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships. Both the Reliance Foundation Scholarships aim to nurture and empower meritorious students and will work together to generate robust, vibrant and engaged alumni networks, enabling scholars to pursue higher education, emerge as young professionals, and drive India’s growth. Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships:- The Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships seek to enable students to become successful professionals and realise their dreams, unlocking their potential to lift themselves and their communities up and contribute towards India’s future socio-economic development. Students with a household income of under INR 15 lakhs per year who are enrolled in the first year of their undergraduate studies pursuing any subject/stream can apply. The programme also encourages applications from girls and specially-abled students. Selected scholars will receive a scholarship of up to INR 2 lakhs over the duration of their degree programme. In addition to the scholarship grant, the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships will provide scholars an opportunity to be part of a vibrant alumni network and an enabling support system that will create a long-term impact on their lives and career trajectories. Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships:- The Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships aim to enable and propel India’s future leaders who can think big, think green, and think digital for the benefit of society. Through this scholarship, Reliance Foundation will identify and support 100 of India's brightest postgraduate students pursuing select future-ready courses in Engineering, Technology, Energy and Life-Sciences on the basis of merit through a competitive selection process. The Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships will support students with a generous grant and a holistic development programme, including expert interactions, industry exposure and volunteering opportunities, creating a cohort of excellent innovation for social good each year. About Reliance Foundation:- Reliance Foundation, the philanthropic arm of Reliance Industries Limited, aims to play a catalytic role in addressing India’s development challenges through innovative and sustainable solutions. Led by Smt. Nita M Ambani, Founder and Chairperson, Reliance Foundation is relentlessly working for the overall well-being and enhanced quality of life for all, focusing on rural transformation, education, health, sports for development, disaster management, women empowerment, urban renewal and arts, culture and heritage, and has touched the lives of over 7.77 crore people across India, in over 55,550 villages and urban locations. Eligibility of Undergraduates:- Be a resident Indian citizen. Have passed Class 12 with minimum 60% marks and is attending a regular full-time undergraduate degree programme in India. Have household income less than INR 15 lakhs per year (preference given to income less than INR 2.5 lakhs). Answer the mandatory Aptitude Test Eligibility of Post-graduates:- Only students who are enrolled in the first-year of a full-time regular postgraduate degree programme pursuing select future-ready courses in Engineering, Technology, Energy and Life-Sciences. Must have secured 550 to 1,000 in the GATE examination OR Must have scored 7.5 or above in their undergraduate CGPA (or % normalised to CGPA) [If students have not attempted GATE] Open for resident Indian citizens. Last of Registration:- 06 October 2024 at 11:59pm Rewards for Undergraduates:- Up to INR 2,00,000 over the duration of the degree programme. Rewards for Post-graduates:-Up to INR 6,00,000 over the duration of the degree programme. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/reliance-foundation-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/bCLAxRqe2h2mDAEU9 Note:- 1. It is mandatory for the candidates to register on both the links for scholarship. 2. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship. For any query, call/whatsapp- Mr. Inderjeet Singh (6280681179).

title: Rolls-Royce Wings4Her Scholarship for Women Engineering Students. : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/240816/0001 (8/16/2024)
body: About The Program:- Rolls-Royce Wings4Her Scholarship for Women Engineering Students is an initiative by Rolls-Royce India Pvt. Ltd. to offer financial aid to deserving female students pursuing their engineering degrees. This scholarship aims to support female students enrolled in the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd year of undergraduate engineering programs at AICTE-recognised institutions in India. Under this scholarship program, students will receive INR 35,000 to cover their academic expenses throughout their engineering studies. Furthermore, the program includes mentorship opportunities provided by leading professionals at Rolls-Royce India, enhancing the overall support system for eligible applicants. About Rolls-Royce India:- Rolls-Royce India, in line with its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives, is offering this scholarship to support and encourage students interested in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) disciplines. Additionally, the company actively operates various initiatives to advocate for STEM education programs and nurture skill development. Eligibility:- Girl students enrolled in the 1st/2nd/3rd year of an engineering degree program (in fields like aerospace, marine, electronics, computers, etc.) at AICTE-recognized institutions are eligible. The applicants must have scored more than 60% in their Class 10 and 12 board exams. Annual family income must not exceed INR 4 lakh per annum.. Open to Pan-India students. Last of Registration:-05 September 2024 at 11:59pm Rewards:- Scholarship amount of INR INR 35,000. Note:- Selected scholars will also receive one-to-one and one-to-many mentorship sessions and webinars/workshops from industry experts at Rolls-Royce India. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://tinyurl.com/4e7s3bu8 Link 2 : https://forms.gle/zTsr5aAu2Lqi6dMZA Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest. 2. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the competition. For any query, call/whatsapp- Mr. Inderjeet Singh (6280681179).

title: Conduct of Remedial Classes for students Autumn Term - 2024. : LPU/10.2/ANN(DSR)/2024/023(23.1)/IC/240815/0001 (8/15/2024)
body: In an endeavour to help and support students who are facing some academic challenges and were not able to perform well in their previous examinations, Division of Student Relationship makes continuous efforts to initiate support programs and classes. One such academic support initiative is being introduced for the students who were not able to score well in the end term exams due to any valid reason. They are now being given an opportunity to brush up their concepts and bridge the gap in learning through scheduled Remedial Classes. In these classes, the students shall be extended academic guidance on all the important topics of the courses. The registration for courses for remedial classes offered in this term is available on UMS. The students are required to choose the courses for which remedial classes are required. In this regard the students are required to follow the below stated points:- 1. A student has to choose the course/courses on the interface using the link mentioned below: UMS Navigation ---- Examination System --- Exam Registration---- Recoup/Remedial Class Registration 2. Remedial classes for a course will be planned in a span of 10 Lectures before the scheduled reappear exam and fee per course code is Rs 300 which will be made due in student’s account subject to the availability of registered course for remedial classes. 3. Students are advised to ensure their participation in the registration process so that the remedial classes required by them can be made available for preparation for their pending “E” grades. 4. The interface shall remain available to students till 22nd August, 2024. 5. Depending on the count of student registration, these classes shall be conducted in OFFLINE mode by the faculty according to a pre-informed schedule. Classes shall be conducted either from 8 to 9 am or from 5:00 to 6:00 pm. Note: Student has to complete the registration by paying the fee before the start of remedial classes. . Course registration will be confirmed based on the number of students registered. . After the finalization of course registration, the fee for the course will be due in your account. . Once registered, student will not be allowed to deregister from the remedial classes. In Case of any query, student may log RMS at UMS Navigation---- RMS--- Log Request--- Student Relationship (DSR) ---- Academic Support--- Recoup/Remedial classes or contact us at 01824-520150.

title: Voice of Freedom- Poetry/Rap Reel Contest : LPU/18.2/CULA/2024/001/IC/240814/0004 (8/14/2024)
body: LPU Voice of Freedom - A Poetry/Rap Reel Contest Student Welfare Wing brings to you “The Voice of Freedom” – Poetry/Rap Reel contest on the occasion of Independence Day. Patriotism Theme: Your poetry/rap reel should capture the essence of patriotism, celebrating freedom, national pride, or any aspect of India's journey. 2. Video Specifications: Quality: Ensure the reel is clear with good audio quality. Any background music should not overpower your voice. 3. Language: Poems can be in either English/ Hindi or any of the regional languages, but the meaning should be clear and impactful. 4. Submission and Social Media Posting: Platform: Post your video on your Instagram Account. Tagging: Tag @divisionofstudentwelfare, @lpu.artandculture, @theliterarytape and collaborate with @lpu_literary_society in your post. Hashtags: Use relevant hashtags #LPUVoiceofFreedom, #IndependenceDayatLPU #lovelyprofessionaluniversity #LPU. Share the link: Participants have to share the link of their reel with us before 19th August, 2024 on https://tinyurl.com/poetryreelcontest 5. Engagement: Challenge Friends: Mention three of your friends in the caption to challenge them to participate. Sharing: Encourage your friends and followers to view and share your video to increase your chances of winning. 6. Judging Criteria: Views: The reel with more than 20k views by the end of the contest period will be declared as winners Deadline: The contest starts from 13th August and runs till 19th August, 2024, 3:00 PM. Ensure your video is posted and views are counted within this period. Results would be announced on 25th August, 2024, 3:00 PM on the social media handles of @divisionofstudentwelfare, @lpu.artandculture, @lpu_literary_society 7. Prize: Winners above 20k views will receive attractive goodies

body: Dear Aspirants, This is for your information that University has scheduled renowned Industry grade assessments“Career Suggestor Assessment” and “SVAR” for you on 17th August for all 2026 passing out students of MBA program. Both Assessments will be conducted in University premises in offline mode. A career suggestor assessment is an important scientific tool that helps to diagnose the interest, personality and aptitude of the candidate and suggest suitable career options. The results of this assessment are useful for aligning an individual's career according to his talents and personal goals. It is crucial for getting started on the right career path. It also helps assess the natural inclinations of students, providing insights into their preferences and strengths. This information can be valuable for further studies, specialization choices, and skill development. About SVAR: IVR Based, Spoken English Test to assess Student's Fluency, Pronunciation, Active Listening, Spoken English Understanding, Grammar, Vocabulary & more. A crucial test essential for Interviews or Client based Interaction Profiles. Based on CEFR Levels. IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS: 1) Both Assessments are mandatory to attempt for every student as per the attached list. 2) It is mandatory to bring a laptop, Headphone with mic enabled and charger in order to appear in the assessment. 3) The Seating Plan of both assessments will be shared with you via UMS My messages on 16th August. 4) You will be enrolled in industry specific inputs based on your performance in these assessments. Therefore participate in both assessments with full enthusiasm. 5) SVAR Assessment Details - No of Questions - 38 Duration - 15-20 minutes 6) Career Assessment Details- No of Questions - 178 Duration - 95 Minutes

title: Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program 2024-25 : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/240814/0004 (8/14/2024)
body: About The Program:- The Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program 2024-25, a Social Initiative of Group Legrand India, aims to provide financial support to meritorious girls, differently-abled girls, Covid-affected students, LGBTQ+ students and students with single parents or orphans for their higher education. Under this program, academically promising girl students pursuing B.Tech., B.E., B.Arch., or other undergraduate degrees in Finance or Science (such as B.Sc., B.Com., B.B.A., etc.) will receive 60% of the annual course fee, up to INR 60,000 per year. Students in the special category* will receive 80% of the annual course fee, up to INR 1,00,000 per year, until they complete their course, based on their academic performance. Special category:- Differently-abled girl students, LGBTQ+ students, Covid-affected students, and students with single parents or orphans. About Legrand:- Legrand, a global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructure, has been illuminating millions of Indian homes while empowering female students to pursue higher education and become future leaders in Engineering, Architecture, Finance and Science. As part of Group Legrand India commitment to promote diversity, Equity, and Inclusion the scholarship support is extended to differently-abled girl children and LGBTQ+ communities. Till date, over 500 students have benefited from this scholarship program. Key Highlights:- Scholarship benefit is given till the end of the course based on the student’s performance. Mentoring support is provided to the selected scholarship beneficiaries by Legrand India. Industrial experts and subject matter experts to build women’s future leaders. A bi-annual Student Connect Program is organized for all the beneficiaries of this scholarship program to connect with Leaders of Group Legrand India and to build a network for development. Eligibility:- Open for girl students across India only. Applicants must have secured admission in B.Tech., B.E., B.Arch., B.B.A., B.Com., or B.Sc. degrees in India. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the year 2023–24. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 70% and above marks in Classes 10 and 12 examinations. Annual family income of the applicant from all sources must be less than INR 5,00,000. Last Date to Register : 18-Aug-24 at 23:59 PM Rewards:- 60% of annual course fees up to INR 60,000 per year (whichever is less) till the completion of the course will be provided to girl students based on their academic performance. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://tinyurl.com/legrandempow Link 2 : https://forms.gle/6VQLbBAwL9Q519KU8 Note:- 1. It is mandatory to register on both the links. 2. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the competition. For any query Call/Whatsapp- Mr. Inderjeet Singh (6280681179)

title: Rolls-Royce Wings4Her Scholarship for Women Engineering Students : LPU/20.4/ICL/2024/020/IC/240814/0001 (8/14/2024)
body: Announcement Ref. No. -LPU/DII/IC/240813/002 About The Program:- Rolls-Royce Wings4Her Scholarship for Women Engineering Students is an initiative by Rolls-Royce India Pvt. Ltd. to offer financial aid to deserving female students pursuing their engineering degrees. This scholarship aims to support female students enrolled in the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd year of undergraduate engineering programs at AICTE-recognised institutions in India. Under this scholarship program, students will receive INR 35,000 to cover their academic expenses throughout their engineering studies. Furthermore, the program includes mentorship opportunities provided by leading professionals at Rolls-Royce India, enhancing the overall support system for eligible applicants. About Rolls-Royce India:- Rolls-Royce India, in line with its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives, is offering this scholarship to support and encourage students interested in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) disciplines. Additionally, the company actively operates various initiatives to advocate for STEM education programs and nurture skill development. Eligibility:- Girl students enrolled in the 1st/2nd/3rd year of an engineering degree program (in fields like aerospace, marine, electronics, computers, etc.) at AICTE-recognised institutions are eligible. The applicants must have scored more than 60% in their Class 10 and 12 board exams. Annual family income must not exceed INR 4 lakh per annum.Open to Pan-India students. Note:- Preference will be given to individuals belonging to special categories, such as those with physical disabilities, single parents, and orphans. Girls who have been part of Wings4Her (formally known as the Unnati project) and now pursuing their Engineering are encouraged to apply and shall be given preference. Applications are also open for female scholars who have previously received the Rolls-Royce Unnati Scholarship for Women Engineering Students 2023-24 in 2023 and are currently in their 4th year of an engineering degree program. Rewards:- Under this scholarship program, students will receive INR 35,000 to cover their academic expenses throughout their engineering studies. Selected scholars will also receive one-to-one and one-to-many mentorship sessions and webinars/workshops from industry experts at Rolls-Royce India. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://tinyurl.com/2s426m4a Link 2 : https://forms.gle/FEgFDXuCYWxSLWPV9 Note:- It is mandatory to registered on both the links. title: Registration for Backlog Courses for Autumn Term 2024-25. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)/IC/240812/0066 (8/12/2024)
body: To facilitate the students to clear their F/M/G/FAIL grade courses in the Autumn Term, Session 2024-25, the registration for backlog courses will start from 12th Aug 2024. The classes for courses registered as backlog courses by the students shall be held along with the regular students in offline mode. The interface for Backlog registration shall remain active till 19th Aug 2024. Important points regarding the Backlog Registration Process: 1. UMS path to be followed for registration of backlog courses: UMS Navigation→ Examination system→ Backlog Registration → Backlog Course Registration 2. Grade conversion will be applicable as per table 1 for those courses which have been offered in this Term 2024-25. Table 1 Permissibility of conversions of grades S. No. Existing grade Grade Change permissible Conversion 1 E G Allowed 2 E F Allowed 3 G F Allowed 3. Registration of M grade courses: Students receives a "M" grade in a course if they haven't studied the same before or course could not mapped because of program changes, term or year off, rejoining or migration. Students can register for these "M" grade courses through the online backlog registration interface, subject to the availability of the courses. 4. Conditions applicable for backlog registration: Students can register for backlog courses under the following conditions for courses registering with F/M/Fail grades: a. Continuing students should have minimum 2.5 CGPA or equivalent percentage (in case of marks-based programme). CGPA condition is not applicable for non-promoted and passout students. b. It is advised that you register backlog courses with clash free timetable. However, registration with minimal clashes is permitted under following conditions: i. Weekly contact hours with clashes should not exceed 10% of total weekly regular contact hours and clash-free backlog contact hours taken together. AND ii. No Backlog course should have a 100% clash with regular/registered backlog courses. For Example: Example 1: If a student has a weekly load of 30 hours and he/she registers one course with 3 contact hours in backlog out of which 2 hours are clashing with regular timetable then his % clash with regular and clash free backlog load taken together is = 2/(30+1) = 2/31 = 6.4% < 10% Hence the student is allowed to register the course. Example 2: If a student has a weekly load of 30 hours and he/she registers one course with 3 contact hours in backlog out of which all 3 hours are clashing with regular timetable i.e 100% timetable of registered course is clashing. Then although the total clash percentage is 10%, student still not be allowed according to 2nd condition mentioned above. If a student has a weekly load of 30 hours and he/she registers one course with 3 contact hours in backlog out of which all 3 hours are clashing with regular timetable i.e 100% timetable of registered course is clashing. Then although the total clash percentage is 10%, student still not be allowed according to 2nd condition mentioned above. 5. Number of courses allowed for backlog registration: a. For Continuing students: i. If a student wants to register for only F/M/Fail grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of four F/M/Fail grade courses subject to the fulfilment of conditions mentioned in point 4. ii. If a student wants to register only G grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of nine G grade courses. iii. A student wants to register both F/M/Fail and G grade courses, he/she can register maximum of nine courses of which maximum of four F/M/Fail grade courses can be registered courses subject to the fulfilment of conditions mentioned in point b. For non-promoted and passout students: i. If a student wants to register for only F/M/Fail grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of nine F/M/Fail grade courses subject to the fulfilment of conditions mentioned in point 4. ii. If a student wants to register only G grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of thirteen G grade courses. iii. A student wants to register both F/M/Fail and G grade courses, he/she can register maximum of thirteen courses of which maximum of nine F/M/Fail grade courses can be registered subject to the fulfilment of conditions mentioned in point 4. iv. If a student has studied more than nine courses in a single term according to program scheme, then student may apply for additional backlog courses by visiting 32-102 window 5. 6. Fee for backlog registration: The student Registration will be confirmed subject to payment of the backlog fee. The backlog fee shall be payable online through the fee payment gateway. a. For National Students including “Asia”: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee (without scholarship) plus Rs.350/- as examination fee and should be paid at time of registration through online mode only. b. For International Students: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee (without scholarship) and USD 7 as examination fee and should be paid within 48 hours through University Website as per link: https://www.lpu.in/frmloginaccounts.aspx c. For scholarship holders or students for whom the fee has been waived off (fully or partly) by the University, the backlog fee will be 1/10th of the standard tuition fee plus examination fee and not the fee after scholarship or waiver. d. Once a student has paid the backlog courses fee, courses cannot be de-registered. 7. Timetable and Attendance Marking: a. Attendance in backlog courses (excluding courses registered with G grade) will be included in the aggregate attendance of the student for the purpose of determining his/her eligibility for appearing in the ETE and for calculating the detention list. b. Timetable and Attendance will be applicable/counted from very next day of your registration confirmation i.e. after confirmation of your fee payment. Students are advised to attend classes as per the timetable visible on the UMS. c. Students should verify the backlog registered courses using the tab “View Receipt” button available on backlog registration interface (Refer step by step instructions for details). 8. Equivalency of Courses: Students are required to ensure that the equivalent course allotted and/or offered to them have not been previously studied by them. If equivalence course has already been studied by them, then they are required to report the same immediately through RMS using the link shared in the end of this notification. Also, for equivalent courses, the credits of the new course will be applicable. Note: 1. Ensure clash free registration as no change in timetable shall be permissible later on. 2. If you're interested in enrolling in a course that is currently unavailable, please be informed that you can submit your course preferences. Use "Not offered courses" button accessible on the backlog registration interface for your convenience. Submitted preference shall be considered subject to student strength and/or equivalent course availability. 3. In case you are unable to register any course due to timetable clash or section strength of that course is full and wish to register the course in this backlog term then you may submit such request while selecting the backlog courses by selecting valid reason from the dropdown list. 4. Step by Step guide for using the interface for backlog registration is attached along with these guidelines. 5. In case a student wants to register for any extra or additional courses already running in this term, they may submit their request by visiting window 5 in room 32-102. All students are advised to go through the FAQs attached herewith. For further assistance, please: 1. Approach Academic Operations Help Window at 32-102 Window No: 05 (Timing 09 AM - 06 PM) 2. Log a request in the Relationship Management System (RMS) using the path: UMS Navigation ----> Relationship Management System (RMS) ----> Log Request Select Master Category: Academics Category: Academics Subcategory: Backlog / Summer term Registration

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (8/12/2024)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : -Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

Innovation PrizeThe prize is designed to reach across all relevant disciplines and fields. body: Announcement Ref No:- LPU/DII/IC/240809/007 Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT (Phase I) was launched in 2014 with the objective of increasing the number of PhDs in Electronic Systems Design and Manufacturing as well as IT/ITES fields in the country. During Phase I of the scheme, 746 full-time and 148 part-time candidates completed their PhDs, 66 full-time & 10 part-time PhD candidates submitted their thesis and 81 full-time and 115 part-time candidates are currently pursuing their doctoral studies. Research has been undertaken under the scheme in emerging research areas viz. Image Processing, DSP, Pattern Recognition, 3D Printing, 5G Communications, AI, Big Data, Blockchain, Distributed Computing, Cyber Security, Green and Sustainable ICT, Quantum computing and communication, Semiconductor Design etc. To further support research and academic pursuits, the second phase of the scheme was initiated in 2021. This phase aims to assist with 1000 full-time and 150 part-time PhD seats. It also includes support for 225 Post-Doctoral Fellowships and 50 YFRFs. Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics & IT, in collaboration with MyGov, invites the citizens to submit entries to provide a visual identity to the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, comprising of a creative and original Logo that depicts the essence of the Scheme. Eligibility Criteria : 1. Participants should upload the logo in JPEG/PNG format only. 2. The logo should be designed on a digital platform. 3. Participants should not imprint or watermark the logo design. 4. A small description should be provided to explain the concept of the logo. 5. The logo should be designed in colour. The size of the logo may vary from 4 cms X 4 cms to 60 X 60 cms. 6. The logo should be usable on the website/social media (such as Twitter and Facebook), and printed material (such as b/w print material, stationery, and signage). Last Date to Register : 31-Aug-24 - 11:45 PM IST Rewards : The best entry for the Logo will be rewarded with a cash prize of INR. 21,000/- How to Register:- Link1 - https://tinyurl.com/logodesignphd Link2 - https://forms.gle/oiBhvCg1QwqNQJ3q6 Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest. 2. The submissions received via the MyGov website will be considered for the competition. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Hitesh Kumar Arora at hitesh.26482@lpu.co.in

title: ISRO In association with IIRS offers free 5-day AI, ML course for students, certificate on completion : (8/9/2024)
body: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is going to hold a free 5-day online course to equip students with essential skills in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) from August 19 to 23. This free 5-day course on 'Ais part of the IIRS outreach programme, which aims to drive innovation within the space sector and beyond. There is no fee for attending this programme. The free Isro course is designed for professionals, students, and researchers in fields like civil engineering, computer science, and geoinformatics. Those interested in exploring AI, ML, and deep learning (DL) for geospatial applications are encouraged to apply. COURSE CONTENT: The following broad topics will be covered in the Isro course: Introduction to AI/ML and DL Methods in Machine Learning: Supervised, Unsupervised and Reinforcement Deep Learning concepts through CNN, RNN, R-CNN, Faster RCNN, SSD, YOLO etc. and their applications Spaceborne Lidar Systems Machine learning through Google Earth engine Python for Machine/Deep Learning Models The course, scheduled from August 19-23, 2024, will provide lecture slides, video-recorded lectures, open-source software, and demonstration handouts through the e-class platform. COURSE SCHEDULE Online lectures in this Isro course will be held every day from 4 pm to 5:30 pm. Aug 19: Introduction to AI/ML and DL - Dr. Poonam Seth Tiwari Aug 20: Methods in Machine Learning: Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement - Dr. Hina Pande Aug 21: Deep Learning Concepts: CNN, RNN, R-CNN, Faster RCNN, SSD, YOLO, etc., and Their Applications - Dr. Poonam Seth Tiwari Aug 22: Machine Learning Through Google Earth Engine - Dr. Kamal Pandey Aug 23: Python for Machine/Deep Learning Models - Ravi Bhandari Course updates and other details will be available on IIRS website. Participants can register for this ISRO course and check their application status through the following link. https://elearning.iirs.gov.in/edusatregistration/ Registration is on a first-come, first-served basis. Students will receive a 'Course Participation Certificate' upon completing the course with a minimum attendance of 70%. This certificate will be available for download on the ISRO Learning Management System (LMS).

title: Session on Careers in Air, Aviation, and Space Law by INSPACE ISRO (8/9/2024)
body: Division of Career Services at LPU, in collaboration with INSPACE, ISRO, will organize a session on Careers in Air, Aviation, and Space Law. INSPACE (Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Center) is an initiative by ISRO aimed at promoting and facilitating the participation of private players in the Indian space sector. By providing regulatory frameworks and support for emerging technologies, INSPACE plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of space exploration and aviation in India. As these industries evolve, the need for legal experts who understand the complexities of national and international regulations, compliance, and the ethical implications of aerospace activities is becoming increasingly critical. The main objectives of the event are: To enhance students understanding of the legal aspects surrounding air travel and space exploration, preparing them for specialized careers in this field. To provide insights from industry experts regarding current trends, challenges, and opportunities within aviation and space law. To facilitate networking opportunities between students and legal professionals, fostering relationships that may lead to internships and job placements in the legal sectors of aviation and space. Target audience: The students of School of LAW Date: 12th August, 2024 Time: 10:00 AM Onwards Venue: Online Resource Person: Dr. Vinod Kumar Head Division of Career Services

body: The Division of International Affairs (Relations Cell) brings this unique opportunity for 3rd & 4th Year engineering students (Mechanical, Mechatronics, Automobile, Industrial Engineering, CSE, ECE, EEE & IT) of LPU to provide an intensive, enriching educational experience during their academics in Germany. The students will take several workshops and receive certificates in cutting-edge technologies. Trainings at prestigious research centres and universities in Germany. Visits to Germany's Top Industries (Mercedes, Porsche etc.). Students will also get exposure to international culture. Eligibility: Applicable 3rd & Final year students of B.Tech. (CSE, EEE, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Automobile) and B.Sc. (CS/IT). Duration of the Program: 15 days (14th October 2024 to 28st October 2024) Application Deadline: 20th August 2024 Program Cost: 1.50 Lakh INR Registration fee: Rs. 15000 (included in the program fee). Highlights: · Exploration and comprehension of European - Automotive / IT / Manufacturing / Automation /Industrial Markets. · The chance to identify yourself at the world's largest car show and make invaluable contacts. · Seminars are the finest way to connect with guest presenters and gain insight from European Experts. · Renowned German academicians and industry professionals in each vertical would hold seminars / technology upgrade to provide in-depth information on current and future market situations. · Assistance for Higher Studies and Job in Germany. · A one-day industrial excursion to the Volkswagen Manufacturing Factory/ Porsche / Mercedes Benz is also planned to provide participants an overview of Germany's largest vehicle manufacturing plant with the designated faculties. · Visit to Top Universities in Germany & France. · Visit to Top German Industries. · Visit to 2 different countries & 4 Cities - Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Aachen & Paris. · 4 Credit Equivalent Program and German Certification. title: Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program-An opportunity for aspiring Engineering students in Tech-Based Programmes for 2024 Batch Students – reg. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)/IC/240807/0080 (8/7/2024)
body: 1. About the Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program Bharti Airtel Foundation aims to support deserving students from diverse socio-economic backgrounds with a focus on girl students, to become future technology leaders. To achieve this goal, a merit-cum-means scholarship program has been designed for students enrolled in technology-based engineering undergraduate (UG) courses and 5-year integrated programs (as per the scholarship criteria mentioned below) in the top 50 NIRF Engineering institutes including IITs. The students receiving the scholarship shall be called Bharti Scholars. The fully funded scholarship is envisaged to eliminate financial barriers that hinder access to quality education to meritorious students. It covers 100% annual fees over the duration of the course, including meal & accommodation charges. A laptop will also be provided to all Bharti Scholars in the first year. Application URL Link: - https://bhartifoundation.org/bharti-airtel-scholarship/. Application Deadlines to apply for the scholarship: - 31-08-2024 2. Award of Scholarship (I) Scholarships are for the full duration of the UG courses including integrated courses of up to 5 years (subject to meeting the renewal criteria). (II) Each scholarship covers 100% of annual fees as per the fee structure of the respective institute. (III) The hostel and mess fees shall be given to all selected scholars who apply for it. (IV) For scholars staying in PG/outside hostel, the support shall be extended as per the hostel/mess charges of the institute. (V) A laptop for all Bharti Scholars. (VI) Once the Bharti Scholars graduate & are subsequently gainfully employed, they will undertake to voluntarily extend financial support to at least 1 student at a school or college level at any point of time, to the extent they can. (VII) Total 250 number of scholarships will be given to the students for the batch year 2024. 3. Eligibility & Selection Criteria: (I) Confirmed admission in the first year (starting with the 2024 cohort) of the UG/5 year integrated courses in fields of Electronics & Communication, Telecom, Information Technology, Computer Sciences, Data Sciences, Aerospace and Emerging Technologies (AI, IoT, AR/VR, Machine Learning, Robotics) at the top 50 NIRF Engineering universities/institutes. (II) Must be a citizen and resident of India. (III) Family annual income from all sources should not exceed INR 8.5 Lakh. (IV) Preference shall be given to girl students. (V) Should not be a recipient of any other scholarships/grants for the same purposes as those supported by Bharti Airtel Foundation. (VI) Candidates will be shortlisted for the final selection on varied aspects such as merit-cum-means, a Statement of Purpose (SOP) detailing the candidate’s aspirations and leadership qualities etc. (VII) Annual renewal of the scholarship shall be conditional on a minimum CGPA expectation (6 out of 10), attendance & conduct etc. 3. Process To Apply for the Scholarship is as under: (I) Details of the process, documents required, timelines etc. are also available on the following link: Link: - https://bhartifoundation.org/bharti-airtel-scholarship/. (II) The Foundation has on boarded Buddy4Study as the implementation agency to coordinate and undertake necessary procedures under the guidance of Bharti Airtel Foundation for shortlisting of scholars. (III) The fees, hostel and mess charges of selected Bharti Scholars shall be paid directly to the university/institute. 3. List of the Documents to be Submitted by the Students are as under: · Proof of identity (Aadhaar card) · Current year admission proof (admission letter, fee letter from the institution) · Marksheet of class 12th · JEE scorecard or university entrance exam scorecard (wherever applicable) · Income certificate/copy of income tax returns of parents · Affidavit confirming income if parents are self-employed · Bank account details (account number, IFSC, branch address) and bank statement of the applicant and parent · Bank account details of the institution (account name, account number, IFSC, branch address) · Recent passport-sized photograph · Documents related to extracurricular activities, achievements, part-time jobs, projects, innovations, etc. · Expense receipts/rent agreement (if staying in PG/rented accommodation), if applicable · Statement of purpose (SOP) from the applicant. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2024-25 --------> Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program. All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (8/6/2024)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : -Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Infosys Foundation STEM Stars Scholarship Program 2024-25 : (8/5/2024)
body: Announcement Ref. No. -LPU/DII/IC/240805/001 About The Program The Infosys Foundation STEM Stars Scholarship Program 2024-25 is an initiative by the Infosys Foundation to support first-year female students in India who aspire to pursue undergraduate degrees in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) subjects. The scholarship provides comprehensive financial coverage of up to ?1 lakh per annum for female students in a 4-year STEM course, subject to meeting the eligibility criteria. This includes tuition fees, living expenses, and costs incurred for study materials. About Infosys Foundation Established in 1996, the Infosys Foundation supports programs primarily in the areas of Education, Healthcare, Women Empowerment and Environmental Sustainability. In addition, it also has a focus on areas such as Art and Culture, Rural Development, Destitute Care, and Disaster Relief. Its mission is to work with the underprivileged across the country and strive towards a more equitable society. Infosys Foundation takes pride in working with all sections of society, selecting projects with infinite care, and working in areas that are traditionally overlooked by society at large. Eligibility Applicants must be female students who are citizens of India. Students must be enrolled in the first year of their 4-year undergraduate course in engineering, medicine (MBBS), and other related STEM fields at institutes of repute (NIRF accredited). Candidates must have obtained admission into the identified colleges and completed their Class 12. Applicants must fulfil the below-specified academic criteria: A minimum CGPA of 7 in engineering and related courses until course completion. A pass qualification in all subjects for the year in MBBS for continuous enrolment until course completion. Applicants must have an annual family income of less than or equal to ?8 lakh. Candidates must not have availed other scholarships for the same expenses. Rewards The selected candidates will receive a scholarship of up to ?1 lakh per annum, covering tuition, living expenses, and study materials, for the duration of the course against paid receipts.
