title: Design a Logo for iAEX (Agritech Accelerator) : (8/2/2024)
body: Announcement Ref. No. -LPU/DII/IC/240802/001 The Department of Agriculture, in collaboration with MyGov, is holding a logo design competition in which people are encouraged to submit creative and unique logo designs for. The project is to design a logo for the Department’s groundbreaking Agri Accelerator Fund. This initiative aims to use patient government capital and support and propel innovation in the agricultural technology sector with a focus on farmer’s income, sustainability, and economic growth. Success in the agritech landscape depends on the startup/company ability to innovate in the agriculture value chain without disrupting traditional channels, and their ability to establish partnerships with wide stakeholders such as FPOs, distributors, and food processing organizations etc. The initiative, which will be known as Innovation for Agriculture Excellence (iAEX), will provide readiness funding to support planning, design and development for scaling up the technology or product activities in the startups. Evaluation Criteria: 1. The entries will be judged will be selected on the basis following criteria: 1.1 Alignment to overall theme of iAEX (farmer income, innovation, government support, professionalism and inclusivity) 1.2 Alignment to colours associated with the national flag or emblem 1.3 Creativity 1.4 Simplicity 1.5 Inspirational element 2. In case of more than the required winners in any category, further selection shall be done with the help of a draw. 3. The decision of the Selection Committee would be final and binding on all the contestants and no clarifications would be issued to any participants or any decision of the Selection Committee. Technical Parameters: 1. Participants should upload the logo in JPEG/ JPG/ PNG format only. 2. The winner of the competition shall be required to submit the design in an editable and open file format. 3. Participants should ensure that the original designs are submitted. 4. Each entry should submit a detailed logic and explanation of rational and creative thoughts (not more than 100 words) on the designed logo in a soft copy. 5. The logo should be designed in a coloured format. The size of the logo may vary from 5cm*5cm to 30cm*30cm in either portrait or landscape mode. 6. The logo should be usable on the website/ social media such as Twitter/ Facebook, press releases, and on printable such as stationery, signage, labels, etc., magazines, commercials, holdings, standees, brochures, leaflets, pamphlets, souvenirs, and other publicity and marketing material for the promotion of iAEX. 7. The logo image should be in high resolution with a minimum of 300 DPI. 8. Entries should not be submitted in compressed or self-extracting formats. 9. The logo design should not be imprinted or watermarked. Awards: The Selected Entry shall be rewarded with a cash prize worth Rs. 25,000. Registration Details: Link 1 : https://tinyurl.com/2fp7ku5j Link 2 : https://forms.gle/MZJr2kJoMP7Kw8VV8 Note-It is mandatory to register on both the links For any query contact Ms. Nayan Pandey at nayan.31167@lpu.co.in

title: HDFC Bank Parivartan's ECSS Programme 2024-25 : (8/1/2024)
body: Announcement Ref. No. - LPU/DII/IC/24801/003 HDFC Bank Parivartan's ECSS Programme 2024-25 is an initiative of HDFC Bank that aims to support meritorious and needy students belonging to underprivileged sections of society. The scholarship programme is meant for school students from Classes 1 to 12 and those pursuing diploma, ITI, polytechnic, UG, and PG (general and professional) programmes. Under the ECSS programme, the students who are unable to bear the cost of education due to personal/family crises or any other financial problems and are at risk of dropping out are provided with monetary assistance of up to INR 75,000 for their studies. HDFC Bank’s social initiative ‘Parivartan’ has been a catalyst in making a difference in the lives of people through its interventions in the areas of rural development, education, skill development and livelihood enhancement, healthcare & hygiene and financial literacy. Eligibility Criteria:- [1] For Postgraduates Students:- The students must be pursuing postgraduate courses (general courses such as M.Com., M.A., etc., and professional courses such as M.Tech., M.B.A., etc.) in recognized colleges or universities in India. The applicants must have passed the previous qualifying examination with at least 55% marks. The annual family income must be less than or equal to INR 2.5 Lakh. Preference will be given to those applicants who have experienced personal or family crises that have occurred during the past three years due to which they are unable to continue bearing the cost of education and are at risk of dropping out.Open to Indian nationals only [2] For Graduates Students:- The students must be pursuing graduation courses (general courses such as B.Com., B.Sc., B.A., B.C.A., etc., and professional courses such as B.Tech., M.B.B.S., L.L.B., B.Arch., Nursing) in recognized colleges or universities in India. The applicants must have passed the previous qualifying examination with at least 55% marks. The annual family income must be less than or equal to INR 2.5 lakh. Preference will be given to those applicants who have experienced personal or family crises that have occurred during the past three years due to which they are unable to continue bearing the cost of education and are at risk of dropping out.Open to Indian nationals only. Rewards for Postgraduates Students :- For general postgraduate students: INR 35,000 For professional postgraduate students: INR 75,000 Rewards for Graduates Students :- For general undergraduate students: INR 30,000 For professional undergraduate students: INR 50,000 How to Register:- 1. Link for Graduate students: https://www.buddy4study.com/application/HDFC53/instruction 2. Link for Post graduate students: https://www.buddy4study.com/application/HDFC52/instruction 3. Link for Google Form : https://forms.gle/zPm5Wk6K4xKz1K1t7 Note:- 1. It is mandatory to register on the official website link along with the google form link. The students need to register on the link for graduates/post graduates link as per their recent qualification. 2. The registrations through the official website will only be considered for the scholarship. For any query Call/Whatsapp- Mr. Inderjeet Singh (6280681179)

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (7/27/2024)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : -Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Employability Diagnostic Assessment for 2024 Freshmen : (7/23/2024)
body: Dear Students, Welcome to Lovely Professional University ! As we say that the best way to get something done is to begin. So working on the mantra of Why Wait, University has taken an innovative step to introduce a Diagnostic Assessment right at the beginning of your academic journey to ensure overall skill enhancement and to make you industry ready. Diagnostic Assessment helps you to know your strengths, areas to fill the gaps, building capacity, stand out amongst your peers, and have a clear road map ahead and finally you will be an inch closer to get your dream job. This Assessment assesses you on critical areas like communication skills, logical reasoning and quantitative skills. These skills play a pivotal role in the entire placement process and help the recruiter to identify the suitability of a candidate. This methodology is rapidly emerging as an industry benchmark with companies like Cognizant, Capgemini, Amazon, TCS, Infosys, and Microsoft for recruitment at entry level roles. The diagnostic assessment will also help the University to plan appropriate activities and training initiatives for your future endeavours. Based on this Diagnostic Assessment, your placement specific credited, non-credited and language lab inputs will be planned. On the whole, the Diagnostic Assessment will act as a Gateway to Placements. KEY POINTERS* :-For general instructions and guidelines, Kindly visit at : https://tinyurl.com/2024freshmenassessment :-For benefit and step by step pathway video of assessment, Kindly visit at : https://youtu.be/mgmK1_wSaTQ :-Assessment credentials will be shared with you through UMS my messages.

title: Instructions for Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation (Summer term Only). (Ref. No. LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024-25/023(23.4)/IC/240722/003) : (7/22/2024)
body: This is in reference to the Summer Term Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from August 2024 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for the summer term classes in May-June 2024 and have successfully completed their attendance criteria are required to appear for Summer Term Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation. The main aim of the Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation is as follows: a) Title of the proposed research work. b) Objectives of the proposed research work. c) Research methodology of the proposed research work. I. The research scholars must take the following three steps to register and appear for SAS evaluation. 1. Registration for SAS evaluation All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for summer term SAS evaluation) are required to register for summer term SAS evaluation through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation ---> Examination System---> Research Degree Evaluation ---> Registration of Upcoming Activity---> SAS Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 22nd July 2024 to 26th July 2024. 2. Uploading of SAS Synopsis All registered research scholars are required to upload their synopsis (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation --->Examination System---> Research Degree Evaluation ---> Registration of Upcoming Activity---> Submit SAS synopsis All the research scholars are required to completely register for SAS evaluation. The registration will only be considered as complete if the scholars will upload the synopsis followed by the verification of synopsis by their supervisors. Note: The link for uploading of SAS synopsis will remain active from 22nd July 2024 to 26th July 2024. 3. Recommendation of SAS synopsis by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their SAS synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation ---> Division of Examination ---> Research Degree Evaluation --->Ph.D. Seminar File Verification ---> SAS If the supervisor does not verify the synopsis of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the SAS evaluation. Note: The last date for the recommendation of the SAS synopsis by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 28th July 2024. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of SAS synopsis: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension in the timelines as mentioned in the announcements will be allowed. c) The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so through a request application forwarded to Department of Ph.D. Evaluation duly recommended by supervisor no later than 28th July 2024, failing which the scholar will be marked absent during the SAS evaluation and will have to pay INR 5000/- as fee for registering in the next SAS d) If a research scholar registers for the summer term SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from Dec 2024 onwards) only after the clearance of all pending dues. e) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for SAS synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for SAS) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. f) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. g) The SAS synopsis must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for SAS beyond the last date. h) Research scholars are also required to submit a hard copy of the synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation. Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of SAS synopsis will not be considered. It is mandatory to submit the hard copy of SAS synopsis, as the result will be shared only after the submission of hard copy of SAS synopsis. i) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. j) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the SAS registration interface) before registration and uploading the SAS synopsis at the interface. k) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI &VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of SAS synopsis: 1. The research scholar must upload the SAS synopsis well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. 2. Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of SAS report, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) -->Sub Category: SAS. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes).

body: This is in reference to the Summer Term Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from August 2024 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for the summer term classes in May-June 2024 and have successfully completed their attendance criteria are required to appear for Summer Term Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation. The main aim of the End Term Presentation is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present the work done or progress made since the last evaluation I. The research scholars must take the following three steps to register and appear for ETP evaluation. 1. title: IDFC FIRST Bank scholarship for MBA Students for academic session 2024-2025. (Ref. No. LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024-25/023(23.4)/IC/240722/002) : (7/22/2024)
body: IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship is a need-based scholarship program by IDFC FIRST Bank that financially supports students with family incomes of less than INR 6 lakh per annum. The purpose of this scholarship is to make postgraduate studies in business management accessible to meritorious students who are unable to pursue higher studies due to financial constraints. Under this scholarship, students enrolled in the first year of a two-year full-time MBA course in the academic session 2024-2025 will receive INR 2 lakh for two years of their MBA program (INR 1 lakh/year). Application URL Link: http://www.b4s.in/a/em_IFBMS5_20240702_1 Application Deadline to Apply for the Scholarship: July 31, 2024 Helpline Email for the Queries: mbascholarshipsupport@idfcfirstbank.com Eligibility Criteria: · Open to Indian nationals residing in India only. · Students must be enrolled in the first year of a 2-year full-time MBA program or its equivalent for the class of 2024. · Applicants must be enrolled in one of the MBA colleges listed in the list. (List Enclosed) · The gross annual family income from all sources should be less than or equal to INR 6 lakh. · Applicants must have a valid mobile number linked to their Aadhaar number. Award of Scholarship: The selected MBA students will be awarded a scholarship sum of INR 2,00,000 for two years of full-time MBA studies (INR 1 lakh per annum, subject to terms and conditions*) Documents Required for Apply of Scholarship: Below is the list of documents that need to be uploaded before the final submission of the application form: Admission Related Documents: . Admission proof (including the name of the institution, admission year, and batch) . Copy of fee receipt Academic Record Documents: . Copy of graduation marksheet/passing certificate Income Proof (any one): . Income certificate issued by a relevant government authority (Tehsildar or Magistrate) . Copy of Income Tax Returns (Form 16A) . Copy of salary slip Other Documents (if applicable): . Disability certificate . Sanctioned loan letter . Death certificate, if there is a death of the sole earning member of the immediate family . Documents of any other scholarships received for pursuing an MBA Process to Apply for the Scholarship is as under: · Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. · Login to Buddy4Study using a registered ID to land on the ‘Online Application Form Page’. o If not registered on Buddy4Study, register at Buddy4Study with your email, mobile, Facebook, or Gmail account. · You will now be redirected to the ‘IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship 2024-26’ official website. · Read all the details carefully and click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. · Check your eligibility and get your Aadhaar card and mobile number verified. · A welcome communication containing login URL, user ID, and password will be sent to the applicants. · Log in to the application portal and fill in all the required details in the online scholarship application form. · Upload the necessary documents. · Finally, submit the application form. NOTE: To ensure an uninterrupted experience on the student portal, the applicants are advised to use Google Chrome. For any assistance, please refer to the help section. Terms and Conditions · Students admitted to the 1st year of a 2-year full-time MBA or equivalent program at selected institutions/colleges are eligible for this scholarship. · Students pursuing a 1-year executive program, integrated MBA program, or any MBA program other than a 2-year full-time MBA/PGDM program are not eligible for this scholarship. · The final grant of scholarships will occur only after the documents are verified and the shortlisted applicants are screened on the ground. Failure to comply with these stages or meet the requirements within the stipulated time frame will result in the candidature being rejected. · Applicants need to provide the necessary details for on-ground verification to the bank representatives as mentioned in the form. · The scholarship amount is meant to cover tuition fees and will be disbursed directly to the account of the institution/college of admission. Final disbursement will take place after the student submits the fee receipt. · IDFC FIRST Bank will make the final selection of awardees at its absolute and sole discretion. Submission of the application does not guarantee a scholarship grant. · Awardees must attend all IDFC FIRST Bank events related to the IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship. · Students must pass their first year and be promoted to the second year to remain eligible for the second year of the scholarship. · Children of IDFC FIRST Bank employees are not eligible for the scholarship. If found, their candidature will be rejected at any stage of the scholarship process. · If an applicant indicates interest in exploring the possibility of a student loan with the bank during the application submission stage, it will be deemed as authorization for the bank and/or its representatives or agents to communicate with them via email, call, or SMS regarding their application or other promotional activities. Note: The IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship application process is hosted exclusively on its official website, the only channel through which one can apply for the scholarship. We do not charge any application fees at any stage of the process. If you have been asked to pay application fees, have been contacted by anyone other than IDFC FIRST Bank’s authorized representatives, or have encountered any suspicious activity, please report it to mbascholarship@idfcfirstbank.com. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2024-25 --------> IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship 2024-25 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378.

title: Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program 2024-25 : (7/22/2024)
body: Announcement Ref. No. -LPU/DII/IC/240722/001 Airtel Foundation, the philanthropic arm of Bharti Enterprises was set up in the year 2000 with a vision, ‘To help underprivileged children and youth of our country realize their potential.’ The Foundation works in the space of holistic quality education in rural India with a special focus on the girl child; and also supports Higher Education programs in partnership with premier institutions. Since 2006, the flagship, Satya Bharti School Program has been providing free quality education to thousands of underprivileged children in 164 schools in rural India across four states. At present nearly 36,000 children are enrolled in Satya Bharti Schools of which over 50% are girl students. The impact of quality education has been widened by transferring the learning and good practices of this program to more than 3.7 lakh students studying in 888 partnering government schools across 12 States/UTs, through Quality Support Program (QSP), since 2013. In addition, Bharti Airtel Foundation was invited by several education officers at district and state level to scale up some of the initiatives through QSP State Partnerships. The Foundation has been able to impact over 3 million children in a meaningful manner through its education programs since inception. (Basis the latest list available). Must be a citizen and resident of India Family annual income from all sources should not exceed INR 8.5 Lakh applicants should not be recipients of any other scholarships or grants for the same purposes supported by the Bharti Airtel Foundation. title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (7/22/2024)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can .-All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Explore the World with a 100% Scholarship Opportunity! (Ref. No.: LPU/11.2/AS(IOS)/2024-2025/005(5.2)/IC/240719/001) : (7/19/2024)
body: Dear student, Are you eager for an international exposure backed by a 100% scholarship benefit? Here is an incredible opportunity that promises an unmatched experience. At LPU, we are offering exceptional opportunities for students to obtain a 100% scholarship on tuition fees. Imagine a full semester abroad, a chance to get international exposure during your academic journey. Our extensive network spans more than 130 Universities across 41 countries, providing an array of options. 100% scholarship on tuition fees. Imagine a full semester abroad, a chance to get international exposure during your academic journey. Our extensive network spans more than 130 Universities across 41 countries, providing an array of options. Seize this opportunity to elevate your academic and personal growth while creating a standout profile for your future endeavours. This is a golden opportunity to experience, learn, and adjust to a foreign culture, acquire valuable cross-country communication skills, and demonstrate your ability to adapt to challenging environments. Some of the many benefits of the study abroad program: Academic Enrichment: Exposing students to new areas of study, diverse teaching methodologies and research opportunities. International Transcript & Internationalized CV: Students who study at a foreign university receive an official transcript from the host university that can be used as an advantage in the Curriculum Vitae (CV). 100% scholarship on tuition fee: Students will receive a 100% scholarship on the tuition fee from the foreign University. International Network and Exposure: The connections you establish during semester exchange will create a global network of professionals, and potential collaborators, enhancing your professional network. Internship opportunities along with higher studies: Higher studies may lead to wonderful future internship opportunities with the partner University. Better opportunities for future jobs abroad: Students with a prior international exposure are preferred both at home country or abroad. Personal Growth: You’ll develop a global mindset, be more adaptive to global challenges, improve self-confidence, and interpersonal skills. Cultural Immersion: Living and studying in a foreign country will allow you to embrace new customs, traditions, and language. Eligibility and other requirements: CGPA above 6.5, no backlog or reappear. A valid passport with more than 6 months of expiry remaining. Good attendance record. English Proficiency test (if required) Capacity to sustain himself/herself overseas while studying (Estimated budget 2.5 lakh to 5 lakh) Application deadline: 20th August 2024 To know more register here: https://forms.gle/3EVVEmAEwfvsmbS96 REGISTER SOON!!! title: Registration Invited for Short Term Course on Qualitative Research Methodology : (7/18/2024)
body: Qualitative research methodology involves in-depth exploration of complex phenomena, using techniques such as interviews, focus groups, and observations to gather rich, detailed data. It emphasizes the context and meaning of human experiences, allowing researchers to understand the nuances and subtleties of social phenomena. Qualitative methods are particularly useful for studying phenomena where the variables are not easily quantifiable, such as cultural practices, social interactions, and personal experiences. By focusing on the subjective experiences of participants, qualitative research provides a deeper understanding of the human condition and can inform more effective interventions and policies. In this context, Human Resource Development Center organizes a short term course as per details appended below: Title Short Term Course on Qualitative Research Methodology Course Outcome After completion of the course, participants will be able to: 1) Identify different types of qualitative research methods. 2) Explain and interpret the process of grounded theory analysis. 3) Apply coding and categorization techniques in qualitative research. 4) Analyze and interpret qualitative data using tools like N-Vivo. 5) Synthesize and present qualitative research findings in a coherent manner For Course Content: Please refer to the attached Brochure Resource Persons Dr. Dhaval Maheta, Professor, Department of Business and Industrial Management, Veer Narmad University, Gujrat Dr. Sakshi Thakur, Assistant Professor, Mittal School of Business, LPU Program Schedule Date: August 19, 2024 to September 02, 2024 (Selected 06 days) Time: 07:00 pm to 09:00 pm Platform https://myclass.lpu.in/ Registration Fee Rs. 2000/- for LPU Associates Rs. 2500/-for External Participants Online Payment or Cash to be deposited in Accounts Department Registration Link Registration Closes https://www.lpu.in/HRD/ August 16, 2024 Since there are limited seats, selection will be on a first-come-first-served basis. Looking forward to your active participation

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (7/15/2024)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Find and Correct: A competition on identifying grammatical errors : (7/9/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to organize a competition “Find and Correct: A competition on identifying grammatical errors”. The event emphasizes on giving students a platform to solve the various errors in the questions that are generally asked in Placement Assessment Tests. Not only the error detection in a sentence, but the manipulation of sentences to form better sentences will be one of the focusing areas. The basic purpose of organizing this competition will be o teach students valuable tips and tricks so that they can easily overcome such mistake that might hamper the meaning and context of the sentence. They will develop their language skills. This will help them to build their confidence. The main objectives of the event are: · To help them to identify the grammatical errors in the statements. · To make them understand how to rectify the identified errors. · To improve their sentence formation skills. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 11th July, 2024 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 36-502A Resource Person: Ms. Rajni Arora Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/FindAndCorrectCompetition

title: Thought Leaders Talk Series (TLTS) - a unique webinar : (7/9/2024)
body: Announcement Ref. No. - LPU/DII/IC/240709/001 There is immense potential for market growth and innovation in the areas of (Electronic System Design and Manufacturing) ESDM, Animation, Visual Effects, Gaming, and Comics (AVGC), Smart Manufacturing and Life Sciences, driven by advancements in technology, changing consumer preferences, and supportive government policies. To create awareness of the recent advancements in these sectors and to disseminate the wealth of information throughout Industry and Academia, ICT Academy organizes the Thought Leaders Talk Series (TLTS). This exclusive webinar series aims to deliver insightful sessions from industry experts and bureaucrats on emerging trends, new technologies, far-sighted information, and roadmaps in the ESDM, AVGC, Smart Manufacturing and Life Sciences sectors. The TLTS directly benefits Academic Leaders, Corporate Executives, Entrepreneurs and Students from across the country. Webinars will be presented by Industry Speakers and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). The TLTS offers a convenient and educative way to stay updated on industry happenings. The webinars will be interactive with Q&A sessions. The sessions will also range from beginner to expert level, covering topics in ESDM, AVGC, Smart Manufacturing, and Life Sciences. Webinar Topic : Open Source - Future Prospects Open Source is poised for significant growth, driven by its collaborative nature, cost-effectiveness, and flexibility. Future prospects include increased adoption in enterprise solutions, innovation in AI and cloud computing, and enhanced security through community-driven improvements. Timings for session: July 10, 2024, 10:00AM-12:00PM Registration Details: Link 1: https://ictacademy.in/tlts/ Link 2 : https://forms.gle/7yZYzgTG49k1XZHc8 Note:-It is mandatory to register on both the links. For any query, kindly contact Dr. Tanuj Mishra at tanuj.12948@lpu.co.in.

title: Talk Tactics: A Workshop on Elevating Your Conversational Competence : (7/6/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Talk Tactics: A Workshop on Elevating Your Conversational Competence”. In this workshop, students will learn to communicate effectively across social, personal, and professional settings. The workshop will emphasize the importance of active listening and understanding verbal and non-verbal cues, ensuring participants’ engagement in meaningful and respectful dialogue. Through building rapport and employing effective questioning techniques, students will gain the skills to foster strong, positive relationships. The workshop will cover conflict resolution strategies, helping participants navigate disagreements with empathy and composure. Additionally, students will learn to articulate their ideas clearly and persuasively, a crucial skill for professional success. The main objectives of the event are: · To equip participants with the ability to listen actively, understand, and respond effectively in various social, personal, and professional contexts. · To provide strategies for managing disagreements constructively and articulating ideas persuasively. · To foster an understanding and respect for diverse communication styles. Target audience: The students of Boys Hostel-4 will participate in the event. title: LPU Global: Great opportunity for LPU students to learn about diverse opportunities in Japan : (7/5/2024)
body: Japan External Trade Organization (JETRO) started Japan Career Promotion Forum (JCPF) series focusing on India. This series aims to provide information about various opportunities in Japan for Indian students and professionals. After their successful two editions JCPF has announced their third online edition. In this forum the students will come to know about the following: · Career growth and opportunities at Indian and foreign-affiliated companies in Japan · Research and higher education opportunities at Japanese universities · Working environment in Japanese companies and cultural differences · Effective strategies for advancing one's career in Japan · Information on JETRO's HR-related activities Date: 12th July 2024 Timings: 4 PM to 5:05 PM Interested students must register on the link given below to attend the forum. The registration of the forum is free of cost. https://www.jetro.go.jp/en/events/jcpf_in3rd.html For further information kindly contact Division of International Affairs at block 32-310 or email at studyabroad@lpu.co.in

title: Present to Win: A Competition on Public Speaking Excellence : (7/2/2024)
body: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “The Codebreakers” is going to conduct “Present to Win: A Competition on Public Speaking Excellence”. The session will offer valuable tips and strategies on effective communication, from structuring a compelling presentation to delivering it with confidence and clarity. Participants will learn to engage their audience, convey their message persuasively. This interactive event provides students with the opportunity to practice their skills in real-time, receive constructive feedback, and overcome public speaking challenges. Certificates will be awarded to participants, recognizing their efforts and achievements. By the end of the session, students will be better prepared to present their ideas clearly and confidently, paving the way for their future endeavours. The main objectives of the event are: · To improve students’ presentation and communication skills. · To provide tips on structuring presentation, delivering with confidence, and engaging the audience. · To offer real-time practice and feedback to help students overcome public speaking challenges and present their ideas clearly and confidently. title: Reserve Bank of India Third Global Hackathon – HaRBInger 2024 : (7/2/2024)
body: Announcement Ref No:- LPU/DII/IC/240702/005 With the successful completion of two editions of HaRBInger, it is time for the next edition of the RBI global hackathon – ‘HaRBInger 2024 – Innovation for Transformation’ with new themes and a new set of problem statements. India’s journey in FinTech underscores a commitment to responsible innovation, inclusivity, trust, and confidence in the digital finance landscape. The digitalisation of finance has transformed the payments landscape with near-instantaneous settlements, facilitating convenience and efficiency. Significant efforts continue on an ongoing basis to fortify the financial sector against fraudulent activities. Some of these include, fostering innovation for fraud mitigation by establishing dedicated cohorts in Regulatory Sandboxes for fraud detection, under which innovative products are tested, highlighting the risks of cyber threats through public awareness campaigns like “RBI Kehta Hai”, e-BAAT programmes, etc. One of the problem statements of the first edition of HaRBInger was “Social Media Analysis Monitoring tool for detection of digital payment fraud and disruption”. Entities also use fraud detection techniques to detect and curb various kinds of frauds. However, this journey has also seen increase in the potential for new types of fraud, with fraudsters deploying more sophisticated techniques to target customers. It is, therefore, crucial to address the challenges effectively and prevent fraudulent activities by promptly detecting suspicious behaviour and effectively countering fraudulent attempts. To encourage innovation and new thinking in these areas, Reserve Bank of India is organising its third global hackathon – HaRBInger 2024 with two themes across four problem statements. HaRBInger 2024 invites your innovative ideas for the problem statements as detailed below: Theme 1: “Zero Financial Frauds” • Real time prediction, detection and prevention of frauds in financial transactions using alternate sources of data including publicly available information. • Ensuring transaction anonymity in token-based (CBDC) transactions while maintaining financial system integrity. • Identifying mule bank accounts/ payment wallets. Theme 2:“Being Divyang Friendly” • Accurately identifying banknotes by visually impaired. Eligibility Criteria: • All entities, teams or individuals (eighteen years and above) who are eligible to enter into a contractual agreement are eligible to apply. Further, the product/solution should have an element of innovation or novel application of technology serving common good. • Participants from all backgrounds and geographies are welcome, albeit knowledge about the Indian financial services market and consumers is preferred. title: NHRC Human Rights Photography Competition 2024 : (7/2/2024)
body: Announcement Ref No:- LPU/DII/IC/240702/001 The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), India was established on 12th October, 1993 under the Protection of Human Rights Act (PHRA), 1993 as a statutory body for the promotion and protection of human rights as well as generate awareness in the country. The Commission comprises of Chairperson and five Members including a woman Member. It is supported in its functioning by the five substantive divisions of law, investigation, research, training and administration having specialist officers as part of the secretariat headed by the Secretary General and Chief Executive Officer. The Commission also engages with people in general for human rights advocacy. Its annual short film competition on human rights since 2015, moot court competitions in law colleges and universities, painting, quiz and debate competitions are some of such important events. This online photography competition on human rights is also an effort in that direction. The Commission will have the right to use award-winning photographs on various aspects of human rights for awareness purposes. These will be uploaded on the website of the Commission. body: Announcement Ref No:- LPU/DII/IC/240702/003 The Gurugram Metro Rail Limited (GMRL) is a Joint Venture (JV) Company of Government of India (GoI) and Government of Haryana (GoH) which has been recently incorporated to implement Mass Rapid Transport Projects to be undertaken with 50:50 equity contributions by GoI & GoH in the State of Haryana. Presently, GMRL is implementing the project of metro connectivity from Millennium City Center Gurugram to Cyber City Gurugram with a spur to Dwarka Expressway. Gurugram Metro Rail Limited (GMRL), in collaboration with MyGov, invites the citizens to submit entries to provide visual identity to GMRL comprising of creative and original Logo and a catchy Tagline that communicates the essence of the Company. Technical Parameters:- 1. Participants should upload the logo in JPEG/PNG format only. 2. The logo should be designed on a digital platform. The winner of the competition shall be required to submit the design in an “editable and open file format”. The winner would be asked to submit various adaptations of the logo (eg. in black & white, color, reverse print, etc.). 3. Participants should not imprint or watermark the logo design. 4. A small description should be provided to explain the concept of the logo and the suggested tagline. 5. The logo should be designed in colour. The size of the logo may vary from 4 cms X 4 cms to 60 X 60 cms. 6. The tagline should be catchy and should not be more than one line. 7. The tagline should be less than 10 words in Hindi or in English.8. The logo should be usable on the website/social media such as Twitter/Facebook and on printed material such as b/w print material, stationery and signage. Evaluation Criteria: 1. All the entries received by GMRL would be assessed for award by the Selection Committee. 2. Entries would be judged on the basis of elements of creativity, originality, composition, technical excellence, simplicity, artistic merit and visual impact and how well they communicate the essence of GMRL. 3. The decision of the Selection Committee would be final and binding on all the contestants and no clarifications would be issued to any participants for any of their decisions. 4. GMRL would have the right over the winning entry for registration as trademark and usage in a way felt appropriate by it. Winning participant would have no right or claim on the submitted design once the prize is handed over. GMRL shall not use the disqualified entries for any purpose and shall have no intellectual rights over the same. 5. Any legal proceedings arising out of the competition/ its entries/ winners shall be subject to local jurisdiction of Panchkula. Last Date to Register: 21-July-24 - 11:45 PM IST Rewards: The best entry for Logo will be rewarded a cash prize of Rs. 40,000/- and the best entry for Tagline (slogan) will be rewarded a cash prize of Rs. 10,000/-. title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (6/25/2024)
body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. In order to join these Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 15th July, 2024. Classes will start in August and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll: 15th July, 2024. title: Registration Open for IN-SPACe Model Rocketry India Student Competition and IN-SPACe CANSAT India Student Competition : (6/19/2024)
body: IN-SPACe, along with ASI and ISRO, has launched the two Competition titled “ IN-SPACe Model Rockery India Student Competition 2024-25” and “IN-SPACe CANSAT India Student competition 2024-25, 2nd edition”. IN-SPACe Model Rockery India Student Competition: The competition is aimed to provide Undergraduate Student teams comprising of Engineering / Science Streams in India, a realistic experience in designing and launching an amateur rocket that meets a specified set of mission and performance requirements. The competition involves the design, development & launch of a Model Rocket carrying a CAN-Size Satellite of 1 Kg mass provided by the organizers to an altitude of 1000 meter above the launch site, along with safe ejection of the CANSAT and safe landing of the rocket. Over a period of several months, the participants shall experience the engineering processes for realizing a launch vehicle, and compete with peers from all across the country, with an opportunity to participate in a national level final expected to happen between March – June 2025, at a place to be finalized by Organizers. IN-SPACe CANSAT India Student Competition: As earlier this competition is being organized by Astronautical Society of India, to inculcate the space science and technology temperament among the student community. This competition involves the design, development & launch of a CAN sized satellite of 1 Kg mass to an altitude of 1000 meters above the launch site. The competition will also help to create a wide scale ecosystem for Swadeshi Space activities in the country and bridge the industry academia skillset gap thereby enabling the future space force creation for the AatmaNirbhar Bharat. For further details, visit website: https://www.inspace.gov.in/inspace?id=inspace_model_rocketry_cansat Selection Process: The registered teams will be shortlisted and selected on the basis of proposal submitted and online PPT in front of selection committee. Tentative date of PPT presentation is 26/27th June. As, only 1 team for each competition has to be selected for final competition as per the norms, the proposal of the submitted team will undergo review by the selection committee and the selected 1 team under each category will be nominated for the event. Registration Link for University Nomination: https://tinyurl.com/InSpace-Competition Last Date of Registration and submission of Preliminary Report and PPT: 25th June , 2024

title: Career Success - A Workshop on Top Skills for Campus Placement Interviews : (6/18/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Career Success - A Workshop on Top Skills for Campus Placement Interviews”. The event emphasizes on empowering students with interview skills needed during placement drives. This event will also cover 21st-century competencies that are connected with Sustainable Development Goal 4: Quality Education. It combines communication, teamwork, and ICT to improve presentations, calm anxieties, and personalize content to academic audiences. Students will learn how to tailor their style and content to various campus placement interviews. By the end of the workshop, students will have a solid understanding of the key skills and attributes needed for career success in campus placement interviews, along with increased confidence to present themselves as ideal candidates to potential employers. The main objectives of the event are: · To develop students' ability to effectively communicate their ideas and experiences during interviews. · To improve interpersonal skills, focusing on building rapport with interviewers and showcasing emotional intelligence. · To foster leadership qualities and the ability to work collaboratively as a team player. · To provide strategies to highlight these attributes through real-life examples and experiences during the interview process. · To enhance students' proficiency in applying their subject knowledge in practical scenarios. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. title: A Workshop on the use of punctuation in writing : (6/13/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “A Workshop on the use of punctuation in writing”. This empowering workshop envisions individuals conquering their doubts and confusion regarding the use of correct punctuation in writing. It will aim to help students understand the importance of punctuation in writing in order to bring clarity and precision to their writing. The activity-based workshop will include sentence-based exercise with deliberate mistakes in the sentences for the students to correct and understand the difference between different punctuation marks. The main objectives of the event are: · To guide the students how to structure their ideas by making use of correct punctuation marks. · To improve their writing skills as even if a student has command over English language, incorrect use of punctuation can alter the meaning of a sentence. · To teach the students when to stop, pause, or give emphasis to certain parts of the sentences. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 15th June, 2024 Time: 3:00 PM Onwards Venue: Girls Hostel - 3 Resource Person: Ms. Gurpreet Virdi Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/WorkshopOnTheUseOfPunctuation

title: Write it Right : A Workshop on Achieving Coherence and Cohesion in Writing : (6/10/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Write it Right: A Workshop on Achieving Coherence and Cohesion in Writing”. The workshop focuses on structuring one’s writing in a coherent and cohesive manner, so that one can ensure that the ideas are conveyed clearly, engagingly, and persuasively. Coherence and cohesion are vital elements in writing as they enhance clarity and comprehension for the reader. In this event, the students will learn to organize thoughts in a logical sequence, ensuring that each part of the text serves a purpose and contributes to the overall meaning. The main objectives of the event are: · To encourage individuals maintain smooth transitions between sentences and paragraphs in their writing. · To ensure that ideas flow logically from one sentence or paragraph to the next avoiding confusion or misinterpretation. · To teach students how coherent and cohesive writing reflects the author's competence and credibility. · To foreground areas with scope of improvement for an advanced language employment. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 19th June, 2024 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 34-408 Resource Person: Ms. Suchismita Sur Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/WriteItRightWorkshop

title: Grammar Visionaries League: A competition to upgrade grammar skills : (6/6/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Grammar Visionaries League: A competition to upgrade grammar skills”. The event aims to give students a learning edge by teaching them about parts of speech, essential for effective communication. This quiz will offer an interactive platform for students to showcase their knowledge of English grammar, vocabulary, and comprehension. Grasping speech and grammar concepts helps learners understand how words fit into sentences and, ultimately, form correct sentences. The primary goal of this event is to highlight the significance of English grammar. Consequently, the quiz competition will focus on encouraging students to use all grammar components correctly. The main objectives of the event are: To motivate students to become familiar with different parts of speech. To evaluate students' comprehension and knowledge of grammar concepts. To boost students' confidence in applying correct grammar in both written and spoken communication. To foster a deep appreciation for language among participants while assessing and improving their abilities. Target audience: The students of all schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 10th June, 2024 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 29-402 Resource Person: Ms.Tamanna Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/GrammarVisionariesLeagueCPE

title: Python Toolkit for Data Science: A Short-Term Course on Machine Learning and Deep Learning : (6/4/2024)
body: Registration is invited for Python Toolkit for Data Science: A Short-Term Course on Machine Learning and Deep Learning. A six-day workshop which provides a comprehensive toolkit for harnessing the power of Python in the field of data science, including its 2 core pillars machine learning, and deep learning. Participants will explore the principles and applications of various machine learning algorithms including supervised and unsupervised learning using Python libraries such as scikit-learn. The details of this workshop are appended below: Title Python Toolkit for Data Science: A Short-Term Course on Machine Learning and Deep Learning Course Outcome The Program aims at capacity building in: · 1. Participants will acquire a robust foundation in Python programming tailored specifically for data science applications for machine learning, and deep learning tasks. · 2. Participants will develop practical skills in deploying a range of supervised machine learning algorithms including regression and classification using Python libraries such as scikit-learn. · 3. Participants will gain proficiency in implementing and evaluating unsupervised approaches such as clustering and its real-world applications. · 4. Participants will develop a solid understanding of neural network architectures by exploring deep learning concepts and frameworks using Python’s TensorFlow and Keras libraries. Resource Person(s) 1. If not, audio quality problems might arise. Important points · Perform the audio quality check mentioned above as part of your system readiness check and any required installation / configuration. This check is only an audio device test & not the actual assessment. The audio device used for the audio quality check is recommended to be used for the final assessment as well. · Ensure that the voice through microphone is detected very clearly through the desktop / laptop. · Take the assessment in a quiet, noise-free and well-lit environment. · Ensure to have consistent and uninterrupted high speed internet connectivity – as the assessment has audio listening questions that can be played only once, beyond which it would be disabled. · Do not press F5 or refresh during the assessment – as it would auto-submit and end the assessment. · Hit "Start Test" link only at the specified test commencement time as it will be enabled only then. · Use "Check System Compatibility" link at the top to perform system readiness check and any required installation / configuration. · Assessment has more than 1 section, so do not click ‘Finish Test’ button until all the sections are completed. Upon clicking ‘Finish Test’, a summary of the completed sections and pending sections will be shown. Please review it. · Complete each section within the allocated time as they are time bound. It will automatically move to next section when the time is up. · Only one attempt is available. Ensure laptop battery is fully charged / desktop is powered throughout the assessment duration and you have uninterrupted internet connection. Install MSB and perform all system checks well in advance. · You are allowed to resume the assessment only once within a time frame of 10 minutes from the point of leaving the assessment. Any further attempts at resumption will invalidate the attempt. Do’s ü Take the assessment in a quiet and well-lit space. ü Speak loudly and clearly following on-screen instructions. ü Place the mic 2-3 inches away to one side of the mouth. If you are using the inline mic, then please hold the mouthpiece using chord. ü Conduct assessment fairly. Please note that toggling between screens will be considered malpractice. ü If you observe any malpractice, then report to GenCHRComplianceIND@cognizant.com. ü Test your webcam beforehand and adjust as needed. ü Adjust indoor lighting and camera angle to make sure your face is clearly visible at all times. The background should be plain (preferably white). Avoid photos, pictures, curtains, clothes, and decorations as a backdrop. ü Complete the assessment in one sitting. Don’ts × Sit in a location with any background noise or echo. × Have a third person present during the test, to avoid being reported under malpractice. × Use the computer mic or touch the headphone mic while answering questions. × Change the mic position & settings like volume control while speaking. × Click F5 or try to refresh the screen, doing this will auto-submit and end the assessment. × Click ‘Print Screen’ or try to copy the content while the assessment is in progress. × Cover the webcam at any point during the assessment or move away from the webcam range. × Use AI platforms like Chat GPT for any of the hiring rounds. Zero tolerance for malpractice · The assessment platform uses AI mechanisms to track malpractice. Any candidate found to be using unfair means (like telegram) will be disqualified from the hiring process, without notice. · Cognizant has a zero-tolerance policy for malpractice. A disqualification may be issued at any stage of the process, as and when malpractice is detected and is solely at the discretion of Cognizant. Resources for general troubleshooting Please note that MSB must be downloaded and tested well in advance of the scheduled assessment date to avoid any complications at the time of launch of the assessment. For any technical support you can reach out on the details mentioned below. Ensure to check the resources below before the assessment. For technical queries, call +91-8047189190 (India) (please dial in +91/0), 18002656038 (United States) or drop an email to mettl-support@mercer.com. Please mention specifically that you are a part of a Cognizant drive. High Priority Number: +91-8047190902 (please dial in +91/0) Note · At any point in time, if the self-profile declared by the student during the registration process is found to be false or if the student is found to have indulged in any sort of malpractice at any stage, the application will be withdrawn. · The final decision on the candidate screening, eligibility for assessment, interview and final selection will be at the sole discretion of Cognizant. · If selected, candidates will be subject to internal audit process. title: Registration invited for Short Term Course on Learning coding and problem solving with MATLAB : (5/27/2024)
body: Registration is invited for Short Term Course on Learning Coding and Problem Solving with MATLAB by School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences with Human Resource Development Center, LPU. The course shall orient the participants with matrices, data visualization, and numerical computing using problem-based discussion. By incorporating real-world mathematical problem-solving through coding, participants will be able to transform data into insights and tackle challenges with confidence. Details of the course are appended below: Title Short Term Course on Learning Coding and Problem Solving with MATLAB Course Outcomes · Understand the basic concepts of MATLAB programming. · Learn inbuilt MATLAB function to perform mathematical and scientific calculations. · Write simple MATLAB programs to solve mathematical problems · Create programs for the mathematical concepts like solving a matrix system, obtaining solution to a differential equation. · Create graphs in two and three dimensions from the data in hand or to get from the coding of problem. Resource Person Dr. Geeta Arora, Professor, School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences Program Date June 10-15, 2024 Time 02:30 PM-04:30 PM Platform https://myclass.lpu.in/ Participants LPU Associate: Research Scholar / Faculty / Alumni, External Participants of related fields or any person interested in the topic Program Fee LPU Associate: Research Scholar / Faculty / Alumni - Rs. 1000/- External Participants- Rs. 1200/- Registration Link https://www.lpu.in/hrd/ Registration Closes 09 June, 2024 Note: As there are limited seats, registration will be on first come first served basis. title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (5/25/2024)
body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. In order to join these Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31st May, 2024. Classes will start from 2nd week of June and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll: 31st May, 2024. Enrolment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in For more information contact Dr. Amandeep Singh (Associate Professor) Block 29 - 203D

title: Worry Tree - A simple tool to help you decide what to focus on and what to let go. (Ref. No. LPU/10.2/ANN(DSR)/2024-25/023(23.1)/IC/240520/002) : (5/20/2024)
body: The Department of Counseling and Happiness is excited to introduce the worry tree, a practical tool designed to help you tackle your concerns effectively. The worry tree guides you through a simple process: first, identify your concern; then, determine if it is within your control. If it is, take immediate action or plan a specific time to address it. If it is not, learn to let it go. By using the worry tree, you can manage your stress better, focus on what you can control, and cultivate a calmer, more focused mind. title: Registration for Industrial LIVE Projects at Innovation Studio : (5/20/2024)
body: Are you eager to gain practical industry experience and enhance your skills during the summer break? Here's an exciting opportunity for you to work on Industrial projects. The University is inviting applications for Industrial Live Projects, where selected students will have the chance to work on real-world projects of various industries. Students have to work on Industrial problem statements and have to provide solutions to them. Project Details: 1.Improving heat retention of thermal liquids possibly by eutectic solutions/any other method. 2.Extraction of Minerals/proteins and other valuable components from vegetable used in Industries. 3.Analysis of teeth Bite marks through Computer vision and AI/ML. Other projects: 1.Website Development 2.Documentary and film making/videos/reels Duration: 45 days (after the conclusion of exams) Date of Project: June 1st to July 15 Students from preferably following School will be considered: 1.School of Biotechnology and Bio Sciences 2. School of Mechanical Engineering(Material Sciences) 3.School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences(Material Sciences) 4. School of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) 5. School of Journalism and Film Making 6. School of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) Note: For the Documentary/Video Making and REEL Making, student from any school can register Benefits: 1.Opportunity of working on real time Industrial Problem statements 2.Certificate of Recognition upon successful completion of project 3. Academic benefits based on project evaluation i.e. 1 CA of 1 subject to be evaluated on the basis of project done for the next semester 4. Free accommodation during the project duration 5. Foster industry-academia collaboration and knowledge exchange Eligibility: 1. Minimum 6.5 CGPA required to register 2. Regular student of from school of Biotechnology and Biosciences, CSE, Chemical engineering and Physical Sciences, Journalism and film making(may be from other schools also), Electronics and Communication Engineering. 3.No UMC/ In disciplinary Case 4. Proficiency in relevant programming language, software, tool or technologies Skill Set: Biotechnology: Knowledge of extraction of valuable components (proteins/minerals) etc. out of Industrial Vegetation waste. CSE: Knowledge of software development, website development, data analysis, cyber security projects, Computer Vision, Machine Learning. Journalism and Film Making: Should have experience in media production, journalism, video making, documentary, reels, digital lecture video making and storytelling. ECE: Expertise in projects related to electronics, telecommunications, and embedded systems. Should have knowledge of programming software. Selection Criteria: The registered students will be selected through a Technical Interview followed by personal Interview. How to Apply: Interested students can register on Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/DSRP-Industrial-Projects Last Date of Registration: 20th May, 2024. For more Information Contact Mr. Ruhul Choudhury:6284626764or visit: Department of Student Research and Project, Innovation Studio, Block 39

title: Important Information regarding Summer Term classes for Ph.D. scholars - 2024. (Ref. No. LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024-25/023(23.4)/IC/240518/003) : (5/18/2024)
body: In order to assist the Ph.D. scholars in maintaining continuity in their Ph.D. evaluations, Centre of Research Degree Programmes (CRDP) has initiated special opportunity for Ph.D. scholars in form of Summer Term-2024 which will commence from 02nd June 2024. a) Who is eligible to apply : All Ph.D. scholars who could not participate/register in SAS/ETP evaluations scheduled during Spring Term 2023-2024 [Jan-May 2024] for whatsoever reason will be eligible to register for Summer Term- 2024. The Summer Term would be of immense benefit to the Ph.D. scholars who have been unable to register for SAS/ETP during spring term 2023-2024 and would have been otherwise eligible for SAS/ETP registration which are tentatively planned to commence from Dec 2024. b) Scholar-Supervisor Interaction : During the Summer Term, the scholar-supervisor interaction will held in online mode through LPU-My Class platform. Each scholar will be required to attend at least 4 interactions out of 6 in order to be eligible to appear for Summer Term SAS/ETP evaluation 2024. c) Fee and Registration process : The fee to register for Summer Term will be Rs 10,000/-. Eligible and interested candidates will be required to register online through UMS by visiting the following path: Academics >> Examination System >> Ph.D. Re-Evaluation Fees. The step wise details regarding registration of Summer Term are attached with this announcement. d) Important Dates Registration commencement date – 18th May 2024 Closure of Registration – 25th May 2024 Start of Summer Term Interaction – 02nd June 2024 End of Summer Term Interaction – 20th July 2024 SAS/ETP Evaluation – Aug-Sept 2024 Important Note: The scholars who have registered for SAS/ETP during Spring Term 2023-2024 as per announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/240417/001 dated 17th April 2024 and Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/240416/001 dated 16th April 2024 will not be eligible to register for Summer Term-2024. In case of any query regarding the Summer Term Registration, please submit your RMS request through the following path or may reach us at 01824-444594. title: Ink to Internet: A webinar on formal writing tips for online exams : (5/18/2024)
body: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club, “Language Boosters” is going to conduct a session “Ink to Internet: A webinar on formal writing tips for online exams”. In today's digital age, the transition from traditional pen-and-paper exams to online assessments will become inevitable. As students navigate this shift, mastering the art of formal writing in the online realm will be more crucial than ever. Therefore, learning effective writing techniques will be essential for students to excel in assignments, exams, and other academic tasks conducted virtually. Hence, this webinar will aim to equip participants with essential strategies and techniques for excelling in written online exams. The main objectives of the event are: · To equip learners with a comprehensive understanding of the nuances of formal writing in the context of online exams. · To empower participants to enhance their language proficiency and expand their vocabulary, thereby improving the quality of their written communication. · To provide participants with actionable strategies for achieving clarity, coherence, and conciseness in their written responses. · To educate participants on how to identify and avoid common pitfalls. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. title: 8th Edition of IET India Scholarship Award : (5/16/2024)
body: Greetings from the Institution of Engineering and Technology, India! We are pleased to announce the 8th edition of India's most prestigious scholarship for undergraduate engineers - the IET India Scholarship Award. The hunt for problem solvers, innovators, and creative thinkers who have the potential to become the engineering leaders of tomorrow is on and is open to all undergraduate students, from any year, pursuing any stream of engineering. The Scholarship Award 2024 is guided by an esteemed advisory board consisting of prominent academicians and nationally recognized corporate leaders. The committee is chaired by Prof Abhijit Chakrabarti, Former Vice Chancellor (Jadavpur University, Kolkata). The Award evaluates participants through four rigorous rounds across multiple parameters including academic performance, extracurricular activities, range of outreach activities and their ability to come up with creative engineering solutions to solve societal challenges. This year, we are back with a combined prize of ?10,00,000 which will be distributed among the winners at Regional and National levels. The students applying for the IET India Scholarship Award will have the opportunity to be mentored by industry experts during the process adding tremendous value to their career. Our past winners have gone on to join industry stalwarts like Google, Apple, Boeing, Deloitte, and MIT, and few have even become entrepreneurs themselves. You can read more about the past winners, eligibility, important dates, the award process and more on our website: https://scholarships.theietevents.com Over the past decade, the Scholarship Award has benefitted many young engineering students from the top engineering institutes, like yours, across the country. We would once again like to invite your students to participate. The application deadline is 31 May 2024.

title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (5/16/2024)
body: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. In order to join these Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31st May, 2024. Classes will start from 2nd week of June and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll: 31st May, 2024.
