title: Registration for Industrial LIVE Projects at Innovation Studio : (5/15/2024)
body: Are you eager to gain practical industry experience and enhance your skills during the summer break? Here's an exciting opportunity for you to work on Industrial projects. The University is inviting applications for Industrial Live Projects, where selected students will have the chance to work on real-world projects of various industries. Students have to work on Industrial problem statements and have to provide solutions to them. Project Details: 1.Improving heat retention of thermal liquids possibly by eutectic solutions/any other method. 2.Extraction of Minerals/proteins and other valuable components from vegetable used in Industries. 3.Analysis of teeth Bite marks through Computer vision and AI/ML. Other projects: 1.Website Development 2.Documentary and film making/videos/reels Duration: 45 days (after the conclusion of exams) Date of Project: June 1st to July 15 Students from preferably following School will be considered: 1.School of Biotechnology and Bio Sciences 2. School of Mechanical Engineering(Material Sciences) 3.School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences(Material Sciences) 4. School of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) 5. School of Journalism and Film Making6. School of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) Note: For the Documentary/Video Making and REEL Making, student from any school can register Benefits: 1.Opportunity of working on real time Industrial Problem statements 2.Certificate of Recognition upon successful completion of project 3. Academic benefits based on project evaluation i.e. 1 CA of 1 subject to be evaluated on the basis of project done for the next semester 4. Free accommodation during the project duration 5. Foster industry-academia collaboration and knowledge exchange Eligibility: 1. Minimum 6.5 CGPA required to register 2. Regular student of from school of Biotechnology and biosciences, CSE, Chemical engineering and Physical Sciences, Journalism and film making(may be from other schools also), Electronics and Communication Engineering. 3.No UMC/ Indisciplinary Case 4. Proficiency in relevant programming language, software, tool or technologies Skill Set: Biotechnology: Knowledge of extraction of valuable components (proteins/minerals) etc. out of Industrial Vegetation waste. CSE: Knowledge of software development, website development, data analysis, cyber security projects, Computer Vision, Machine Learning. Journalism and Film Making: Should have experience in media production, journalism, video making, documentary, reels, digital lecture video making and storytelling. ECE: Expertise in projects related to electronics, telecommunications, and embedded systems. Should have knowledge of programming software. Selection Criteria: The registered students will be selected through a Technical Interview followed by personal Interview. How to Apply: Interested students can register on Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/DSRP-Industrial-Projects Last Date of Registration: 20th May, 2024. For more Information Contact Mr. Ruhul Choudhury:6284626764 or visit: Department of Student Research and Project, Innovation Studio, Block 39

title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (5/9/2024)
body: Dear Aspirants Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. In order to join these Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 15th May, 2024. title: Turn exam stress into your secret weapon: A Stress-Busting Exam Workshop : (5/7/2024)
body: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “Oratech” is going to conduct “Turn exam stress into your secret weapon: A Stress-Busting Exam Workshop”, a question-answer-based workshop on coping with exam stress. The event emphasizes using stress levels to improve performance and eliminate unnecessary and harmful stress during exams. This workshop isn't about who's the "best" student, it's about the student. Students will learn to ditch the competition and focus on proven strategies to manage their stress and turn it into an advantage. Students will learn how the body's natural response can fuel their performance and discover techniques to eliminate the unhelpful anxiety that holds them back. title: The Fine Art of Rewording: A Paraphrasing Workshop : (5/4/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct a Workshop on "The Fine Art of Rewording: A Paraphrasing Workshop". The workshop emphasizes on giving students training about the Paraphrasing - the process of rephrasing a text in own words while retaining the original meaning and steps that can be followed to paraphrase effectively and its application in Academic Writing. This workshop will help the students in strengthening their writing skills. This will increase their confidence to write scientific content and by using synonyms, converting voices and citation. The workshop will also give hands-on experience about paraphrasing where students will learn and know it’s implementation. The main objectives of the event are: · To develop a clear understanding of what paraphrasing is and its importance in academic and professional writing. · To emphasize the importance of paraphrasing as a tool for avoiding plagiarism and maintaining academic and professional integrity. · To provide strategies for varying sentence structures to create paraphrased content that is distinct from the original. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 6th May, 2024 Time: 01:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 55A-502 Resource Person: Dr.Sadaf Jan Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/TheFineArtofRewording

title: IET India Scholarship Award 2024 : (4/30/2024)
body: Announcement Ref. No. - LPU/DII/IC/240430/001 IET India Scholarship Award 2024 The Institution of Engineering and Technology (The IET) is one of the world’s largest professional societies for engineers, headquartered in the UK, with over 154,000 members in 148 countries. The India chapter of the IET started operations in India in 2006, from Bengaluru and works closely with industry, academia, and government towards its global mission, and conducts wide-ranging activities that focus on areas such as Future technologies, the Future of Mobility, and Transport, as well as the Future of Work. Shri Ratan Tata, Former Chairman, Tata Sons, N R Narayana Murthy, Chairman Emeritus, Infosys and T V Ramachandran, President, Broadband India Forum (Ex-Resident Director, Vodafone) are Honorary Fellows of the IET. The IET India Scholarship Award recognises and nurtures future engineering leaders of India. The 8th edition of the IET India Scholarship Award is accepting applications now. In our previous edition, we received phenomenal response from engineering students across the country! 43,136 entries 2000 cities 2260 colleges 5 regional rounds 1 national winner,5 regional winners From all these participants, this year, Ms Pragati Bhattad emerged as the national winner and was awarded the scholarship worth ?3,00,000. She was recognised for her innovative solution to help improve healthcare with the help of a Remote Medical Procedures (RMP) framework which emphasises fortifying the network and storage security that is used to facilitate remote healthcare. Last Date To Participate : May 31, 2024 at 11:59pm Eligibility: (1) Any first, second, third year and fourth year full time regular UG Engineering student from an AICTE/UGC approved institution. (Open to students across all engineering branches as recognised by the AICTE/UGC.) (2) All regular credit courses must have been cleared in a single attempt by the applicant. (3) UG marks should be at least 60% in aggregate for the semesters cleared so far or corresponding to CGPA of at least 6.0 in a 10 point scale (4) There is no age limit for the applicant.Application is open to IET members, as well as non-members. (5) Students from AICTE/UGC approved Institutions and national institutes are eligible to apply for scholarship. Rewards: The scholarship awarded for the regional rounds will be as follows: • Regional Round: Winner – Rs 60,000 + Certificate + IET Membership • Runner Up – Rs 40,000 + Certificate + IET Membership • Winners of the regional round will compete in the national finals: • Winner: Rs 3,00,000 + Certificate + IET Membership • 1st Runner Up: Rs 1,70,000 + Certificate + IET Membership • 2nd Runner Up: Rs 1,50,000 + Certificate + IET Membership Note: If a student wins the scholarship both in Regional and National level he/she will be awarded Certificate for both the levels and the prize money for national level only. Registration Details: Link 1 :https://tinyurl.com/yr6wc4ry Link 2 : https://forms.gle/8NehUGwVJLi8yskf6 Note:- It is mandatory to register on both the links For any query Call/Whatsapp- Mr. Inderjeet Singh (6280681179)

title: Important information related to Community Development Project (CDP) (Autumn Term-24251). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/240427/001) : (4/27/2024)
body: Community Development Project aims toward understanding the society related issues/problems and then working towards the solutions to these problems for betterment of the society. Thus, community development project is included as a core course in the curriculum of the students. All students who are required to undergo a community development project (CDP) during June-July 2024 as per their program scheme (tentative list of students is attached as Annexure I) are hereby informed that the students can complete their CDP by choosing any NGO/local organizations involved in community development tasks allowing physical reporting so that student can work on real time problems existing in the society. Important Points: 1. Minimum duration required to complete the community development project should be at least 30 hours or at least 4 weeks. 2. Student should identify at least two societal problems specific to the area/domain wherein, the student is doing his/her project. Further these problems/issues can be taken forward in the final year of capstone project work for idea generation and solution. Although utilization of these problems in capstone can be optional but identification and inclusion in final CDP report is mandatory. 3. It is mandatory for students to include day wise “GEO-TAGGED PICTURES” in their final report and presentation demonstrating the live work done by students related to CDP (for 30 hours or for 4 weeks). No Presentation/Report shall be acceptable without “Geo Tagged Pictures”. i.e. Every report should have minimum 6 Geo Tagged pictures. 4. The students are required to obtain the certificate from the NGO/ local organizations involved in community development areas describing the topic and number of hours the student has worked with the NGO/local organization to complete the project. The certificate should be included in the final report, to be eligible for appearing in the ETP. 5. For evaluation parameters and report submission details, kindly go through the guidelines for Community Development Project (Annexure-II). 6. The final ETP viva voce for Community Development Project shall be tentatively scheduled after commencement of classes of Upcoming Autumn Term 24251. The final schedule shall be communicated to students at least 7-10 days prior to the date of ETP evaluation. 7. Lastly all the students are required to submit the name and address of their finalized NGO to the university latest till 5th June 2024 for the verification purpose. For the same soon UMS link shall be shared with all the students via UMS my message. title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (4/26/2024)
body: Dear Aspirants Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. title: Recall Rumble: A competition on memory mapping and art of storytelling : (4/20/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Recall Rumble: A competition on memory mapping and art of storytelling”. The event emphasizes on giving students a competitive platform to showcase their sense of creativity and presentation skills with a focus on language. The students will gain confidence, creativity, and communication skills from this event, as well as an understanding of the value of public speaking. This will improve their self-assurance and presentation abilities while also boosting their ability to understand and articulate their own points of view. The event will be presentation based, where students will showcase their confidence, art of creating story with unrelated things and their public speaking skills. title: International Conference on Recent Advances in Health Sciences (ICRAHS-2024) : (4/19/2024)
body: Dear Sir/Madam, We are delighted to invite you to the *International Conference on Recent Advances in Health Sciences (ICRAHS-2024)* A hybrid mode conference, which will be held from *27th April 2024* at Lovely Professional University, Phagwara, Punjab , INDIA. The conference is being organized to provide an elite platform for students, scholars, researchers, and experts to exchange ideas and share their latest research findings in the field of health sciences. Our Speaker gallery includes renowned scientists and Professors from Premiere national and international institutes. Event will be presided by Chief Guest Dr. Montu Kumar Patel, President, Pharmacy Council of India. Theme: Innovations in Sustainable Health Sciences and Research SDG 3 – Good Health and Well-Being We believe that this theme will help in the dissemination of new knowledge, best practices, and research innovations in the health sciences field. The conference will feature keynote speeches, plenary sessions, and poster presentations by National and Internationally renowned researchers and experts in the field of health sciences. We cordially invite you to join us at *ICRAHS-2024* to present your research findings and share your knowledge and expertise. Your participation will not only enrich the conference but also help in the advancement of the health sciences field. Please find attached the flyer and Web link, which contains more information about the conference, including the registration details and the guidelines for submitting an abstract. We would appreciate it if you could circulate this invitation to your colleagues and peers who may be interested in attending the conference. Papers will be called in following disciplines: Pharmaceutical and allied health sciences that includes · Biosciences · Life Sciences · Chemical Sciences · Food tech · Agriculture · Forensic Science Authors are invited to submit original, unpublished research and reviews papers that address the conference theme. All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous double-blind peer-review process to ensure the quality and relevance of the conference program. Selected papers will also have the opportunity to be considered for publication in reputable journals. Best Selected full length papers will be published in different journals (Scopus). Conference Website link- https://conferences.lpu.in/icrahs/ Abstract submission Link https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoOMp6cK4IN7zOTKrCaAE5LqLlyp7VF1GVgs5YCZA1FzBJrg/viewform?pli=1 Registration Form submission Link https://conferences.lpu.in/icrahs/RegistrationForm.aspx Last date of registration/abstract submission extended till 24/4/2024(Wednesday) Email: icrahs@lpu.co.in We look forward to your participation in ICRAHS-2024 at LPU For any information, please contact the following: Dr. Vikas Sharma Organizing Secretary, ICRAHS-2024 Email: gc.icrahs@lpu.co.in Mob: +91 9050892540

title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/240417/001) : (4/17/2024)
body: This is for the information of all PhD scholars and their supervisors that the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) will be conducted tentatively from June 2024 onwards. The aim of the SAS evaluation is to finalize the title and objectives of the research work based on research methodology and literature review. 1. Eligibility for the SAS evaluation: a. The Scholar must have cleared the course work or must be exempted for the same due to M. Phil. b. The Scholar should meet the attendance criteria as per university policy c. The Scholar must have completed the term registration. 2. Pathway for SAS registration: a. UMS Navigation ---> Examination system ---> Research Degree Evaluation ---> Registration for upcoming activity---> SAS b. Select the Domain and school c. Click on submit button Note: The interface for registration and file uploading will remain active from 15th April 2024 to 15th May 2024. The SAS evaluation shall be tentatively scheduled in June 2024 and the research scholars appearing for the SAS must have the recommendation of the same from their concerned Supervisor/Co-supervisor/administrative supervisor. 2. Uploading of synopsis: After registration, the research scholar must upload the synopsis of their research work which shall be evaluated by a panel of experts. The UMS path to upload the synopsis of SAS along with the other relevant documents is as follows: a. UMS Navigation ---> Examination system---> Research Degree Evaluation ---> Registration for upcoming activity ---> SAS b. Submit the proposed title and objective for the research work c. Scholar must agree to the declaration and then click on ‘Save’. 3. Recommendation of the synopsis by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded the synopsis for the SAS evaluation, the same must be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor through the following the UMS path: UMS navigation ---> Division of Examination ---> Research Degree Evaluation ---> Ph.D. Seminar File Verification ---> SAS ---> Reg. No.---> Download Note: The last date for the recommendation of the synopsis by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 20th May 2024. Important Note: For Registration: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt their domain and school for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so through a request application forwarded to RDEC duly recommended by supervisor no later than 20th May 2024, failing which the scholar will be marked absent during the SAS evaluation and will have to pay INR 5000/- as fee for registering in the next SAS c) If a research scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS only after the clearance of all pending dues. d) All research scholars who have the last chance to appear in the SAS evaluation in June 2024 are advised strongly to register for the same. e) It is mandatory for all research scholars to clear SAS within two years from the date of registration otherwise their admission may be deemed as cancelled. All the scholars who have already completed two years from date of registration are required to get the extension through CRDP via RMS by following the below mentioned path. UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System ---> Log Request Select the following: Category Type- Academic and Administrative Issues Department- Ph.D. - Centre for Research Degree Programmes Category- Any other Subcategory- Any other Ph. D Queries For Uploading Synopsis: a) The research scholars are strongly advised that the synopsis file must be uploaded only after the thorough discussion with the Supervisor. The same should be defended during the presentation on the day of SAS evaluation. For preparing the presentation, the research scholar should refer to the format for SAS presentation (Attachment) b) No extension shall be given for registering and uploading synopsis report beyond the last date. c) Read the attached guidelines very carefully before uploading the synopsis. d) All research scholars must upload a single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I as per the attached guidelines or else, their SAS registration may be cancelled. No second chance shall be given to upload the synopsis. e) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using SAS registration interface) before registering and uploading the synopsis at the interface. f) The research scholar must upload the synopsis well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. In case of any query regarding the SAS registration and evaluation, please submit your RMS request through the following path: UMS Navigation ---> Relationship Management System (RMS) ---> Log Request Select the following: Category Type- Academic and Administrative Issues Department- Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell Category- Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell Subcategory- SAS

title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for End Term Presentation. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/240416/001) : (4/16/2024)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from May 2024 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after every 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. Aim of the End Term Presentation a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. To present the work done or progress made since the last evaluation The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for registration process: The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 1 and ETP 2 a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per university policy The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 3 and onwards a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per university policy c. At least one research paper submitted/communicated in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP3 evaluation. d. At least one research paper accepted/published in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP4 and onwards evaluations. Note: All the scholars eligible for ETP 3 and above are required to registered and upload the ETP report irrespective of their publication status. If the publication condition is not fulfilled, the scholar will not be allowed to appear for the ETP presentation in front of Research Advisory Committee rather and the case will be forwarded to administrative panel for evaluation of the progress for which a separate schedule will be shared with such scholars. Steps for ETP Registration:- The research scholars must complete the following steps to register for ETP evaluation. 1. Registration for ETP reports All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation --> Examination System---> Research Degree Evaluation ---> Registration of Upcoming Activity--->ETP Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 15th April 2024 to 10th May 2024 (snapshots for using the interface for registration is attached along with the announcement). 2. Uploading of ETP reports All registered research scholars are required to upload their files (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation --->Examination System---> Research Degree Evaluation---> Registration of Upcoming Activity--> upload synopsis Note: The link for uploading of synopsis will remain active from 15th April 2024 to 10th May 2024 3. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination---> Research Degree Evaluation --> Ph.D. Seminar File Verification --> ETP Note: The last date for the recommendation of the ETP report by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 15th May 2024. If the supervisor does not verify the report of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the ETP evaluation. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of ETP report: a) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who were either absent or not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such research scholars who have either missed or have been awarded “Unsatisfactory” in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the ETP evaluation. b) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. c) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. d) The ETP report must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. e) Research scholars are also required to submit a hard copy of the report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation. Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of ETP report will not be considered. It is mandatory to submit the hard copy of ETP report, as the result will be shared only after the submission of hard copy of ETP report. f) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. g) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the ETP registration interface) before registration and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. h) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who are eligible for ETP evaluation as per the attached list but do not complete the registration process will be marked absent for the ETP evaluation, and the result of the evaluation will stand as "Unsatisfactory". i) In case the research scholar has registered for the ETP evaluation and he/she does not appear for the same, then he/ she will be marked absent and the result shall stand as 'Unsatisfactory' j) The ETP evaluation will be scheduled in offline mode only. Thus, if the scholar fails to appear in the offline mode, he/she will be considered as absent and the result will be declared as “Unsatisfactory”. No request for online mode will be entertained. k) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI &VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of the End Term Presentation Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of ETP report, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) -->Sub Category: ETP. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor / Extension / Term off/ document/fees, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes).

title: Seminar on Generative Artificial Intelligence by Cloud Education-Delhi : (4/16/2024)
body: Dear Students, The Department of Innovation and Skill Development under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing in collaboration with Cloud Education-Delhi is offering a seminar on “Generative Artificial Intelligence for the students of Computer Sciences and Engineering. Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to a class of algorithms and models within the field of artificial intelligence that are designed to create new data or content, often mimicking the patterns and characteristics of a given dataset. Unlike discriminative models, which are primarily used for classification tasks (e.g., determining whether an image contains a cat or a dog), generative models focus on generating new data that is similar to the data they were trained on. title: Dainik Bhaskar - Ramesh Chandra Agarwal Journalism Fellowship Program : (4/12/2024)
body: Announcement Ref. No. - LPU/DII/IC/240412/001 Dainik Bhaskar has brought the third year of Ramesh Chandra Agarwal Journalism Fellowship Program in 2024 after successfully training multiple fellows in 2023. You will get 12 months of experience, learning on the job at DB. You will be placed in multiple newsrooms and will work alongside DB journalists to learn how to create and deliver high-quality, trusted content for our print and digital platforms. You will develop skills in data-driven journalism and multimedia storytelling to create content that's insightful as well as engaging. They want to help you and millions of other Indians grow by improving their understanding and knowledge of the world in the easiest, fastest way possible - by telling you what’s happening and helping you analyze what it means for you. You could be doing in-depth research on a particular story, compiling information for your team, brainstorming for special stories, doing an on-ground report, assisting in an interview, anchoring a video story or even writing a script… the list is endless. Towards the end of the fellowship, you will get the opportunity to train in the department of your choice to further your skills. By the end of the fellowship, you should have the skills and training to progress in your journalism career. Based on your performance and track record, you could also be eligible to earn a full-time position at DB. Last date to Apply: 15 April 2024 Eligibility: 1. You should have a hunger for news, current events, and the greatest happenings around the world 2. You should already be showing your interest in journalism through some platform. This could be through blogging, vlogging, writing for a student newspaper, freelancing for a content organization, creating content for social media, writing for a website, etc. 3. You should be creative to help us create stories that will resonate with DB readers and reach new audiences 4. You should be open-minded and flexible to learn new things at a fast pace 5. You should have a basic understanding of numbers, content analytics, and data tools. 6. You should have a graduate or postgraduate degree in Journalism/Communications/Media Studies or Language Studies 7. You should be fluent in Hindi, spoken, read, and written. 8. You should be 27 years of age or below at the start of the program Offerings for you: 1. A best-in-class learning opportunity to build a strong foundation for your journalism career 2. Hands-on research and writing experience on our print and digital platforms 3. Training sessions led by senior DB journalists 4. A mentor to guide you throughout the fellowship 5. An opportunity to earn a full-time position at DB after the fellowship 6. And a competitive stipend of 25,000 per month Application process: 1. You will complete an online application form which will consist of some written questions along with a video. 2. If you get selected, you will be asked to complete the second stage of the application process which will be an online assessment. 3. If you succeed, you will be invited for an online interview. 4. In the final stage, you will be invited for a panel interview before the final decision is made Registration Details: Link 1 : https://tinyurl.com/2dzhvy63 Link 2 : https://forms.gle/gWAXShsJeyLLVoFw5 (It is mandatory to register on both the links) For more details visit https://www.bhaskar.com/journalismfellowship For any query Contact- Dr. Tanuj Mishra at tanuj.12948@lpu.co.in

Though learning must be recognized as an end, it is important that professional education facilitates the process of career advancement of students. University has planned credited inputs, various internal/external training, 3rd party assessments, mock interviews, etc. to enhance your employability. title: Programming Test for Product Based Pathway [2nd year students] : (4/11/2024)
body: The School of Computer Science and Engineering will be offering a pathway called “Corporate – Product Based (Placement oriented track of Competitive Programming for product-based companies)” to the students currently in the second year of their study under CSE/IT programmes. Under this pathway, the following 03 courses based on competitive coding theme will be offered in the next two terms i.e. Term 5 and Term 6 besides the Engineering minor, Open Minor/Open Elective and other regular courses. PRELUDE TO COMPETITIVE CODING COMPETITIVE CODING APPROACHES-TECHNIQUES CODING PEARLS A maximum of 270 students will be registered for this pathway. The students will be selected on the basis of performance in online programming test and multiple-choice questions. Following are the details of the shortlisting process: A separate coding based diagnostic test of 70 marks shall be conducted on 04th May, 2024 (Saturday) on IamNeo/Hackerrank platform. The test will have 02 coding problems (each of 35 marks) to be solved in 01 hours. A section of 15 multiple choice questions on Database Management Systems, Operating Systems, Data Structures, Computer Networks (totalling 30 marks) to be solved in 15 minutes. Students who are willing to go for the Product based pathway must register themselves by 25th April 2024 on https://tinyurl.com/productBasedTest Students having a maximum of 01 E/F/G grade courses at the time of declaration of result are allowed to take this pathway. Seating plan for this diagnostic test will be shared with students shortly through a separate UMS announcement. The number of courses for the students in the coming semesters will remain the same as for all the other students in 3rd year. These courses will replace some of the courses. The students selected in the programming test will have to continue with the product-based pathway. There will not be any separate process to take options for product-based pathway. Students selected for product-based pathway will have to register for placement services of the University in the first phase of placement registration process. For any further queries regarding the same, the students can contact their respective section HoDs.

title: Invitation to Participate in UiPath App Academic Challenge 2024 : (4/9/2024)
body: Announcement No.- LPU/DII/IC/240408/001 "UiPath App Academic Challenge 2024" The UiPath Apps Academic Challenge 2024 is an exciting opportunity for university students to showcase their innovation and problem-solving skills using UiPath Apps, a low-code application development platform. This initiative is designed to inspire and challenge students to explore the capabilities of UiPath Apps and unleash their creativity to develop practical solutions in various domains such as education, healthcare, finance, sustainability, and more. The UiPath Apps Academic Challenge 2024 aims to inspire and empower the next generation of innovators, equipping them with the skills and knowledge to thrive in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. Participation Rules and Guidelines: 1. Eligibility: Participants must be currently enrolled as full-time university students. Teams can comprise individuals or groups, but each member must meet the eligibility criteria. 2.Original Work: Submissions must be the original work of the participants. Plagiarism or unauthorized use of others' work will result in disqualification. 3. Code of Conduct: Participants must adhere to a code of conduct, promoting respectful and ethical behaviour throughout the challenge. 4. Language: All submissions and communications must be in English. 5. Multiple Entries: Participants or teams may submit only one project for consideration. 6.Use of UiPath Apps: Projects must be developed using UiPath Apps. Integrations with other platforms or tools are allowed but must be clearly documented. 7. Legal Compliance: Submissions must comply with all applicable laws and regulations, including copyright and intellectual property rights. Project Requirements, Submission Format, and Judging Criteria: 1.Project Requirements: Projects must be developed using UiPath Apps and aligned with the theme of "Empowering Change through Automation." They should address a real-world problem and demonstrate innovative use of automation. 2.Submission Format: Submissions must include a project description, screenshots, a demonstration video, and any necessary documentation. Detailed submission guidelines will be provided closer to the submission deadline. 3. Judging Criteria: Projects will be evaluated based on creativity, technical proficiency, innovation, impact, and alignment with the theme. Judges will also consider the clarity of presentation and documentation. 4. Scoring: Each project will be scored based on predefined criteria, and the highest-scoring projects will advance to the final round. Timeline/Important Dates: 1. Last date to register- 13 April 2024 2. Students to complete the pre-requisite learning plan 15 April - 15 May 2024 3. Quiz - 20 May 2024 4. Conduct evaluation & nominate 5 team ( 4 members + 1 staff ) - 25 May 2024 5. Problem statement to be shared - Last week of May 2024 6. 24-Hour Innovation Challenge ( In Person ) at Bangalore - Tentatively in June 2024 Registration Details: Link 1 : https://tinyurl.com/4pjjvyjw Link 2 : https://forms.gle/4e9oNWoAQe8nvDqQ8 (Its mandatory to register on both the links) For more details visit https://ictacademy.in/uipathapps/ For any query Contact- Dr. Tanuj Mishra at tanuj.12948@lpu.co.in

title: Final Report Submission timelines for Project, Dissertation and similar courses for Spring Term 23242. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/240403/013) : (4/3/2024)
body: This is for the information of all faculty members supervising the students registered in project, dissertation and similar courses (Annexure-I) that in order to be eligible for the Final End Term Presentation (ETP) viva, each student registered in such courses need to fulfil the following points as per the specified timelines mentioned in Annexure-III (Attached). 1. Uploading of soft copy of final report All students need to prepare the final report of their research/ project work as per the guidelines attached (in Annexure-II) and upload the soft copy of the same in four parts i.e., PDF File-1, PDF File-2, PDF File-3 and PDF file-4 (details of pdf files are given in Table 1) via their UMS as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-III by visiting the following path: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details-->Upload Research Project Report/Internship Certificate --->Project/Dissertation Table 1- Contents of each PDF file (size should be less than 5 MBs) PDF File 1* PDF File 2 PDF File 3 PDF File 4 (Applicable only for final stage Master Dissertation) Students need to upload their Complete Project/ research Report as PDF File 1. Students need to upload "only Content Report" which is without any student identification Information (e.g. Student's Name, Registration Number or Title Page) as PDF File 2. Plagiarism Report is to be uploaded for Standalone Project(s), Capstone Project-II, Dissertation-II or Dissertation- III (As per Annexure-I). Allowed Plagiarism limit shall be as per the Policy which has been described under the following link available on UMS: https://www.lpu.in/academics/pdf/research-policy.pdf Student need to submit graphical abstract (refer announcement Regarding generation of Intellectual property rights (IPR) from Thesis/Dissertation work at Master's Level) Please ensure that PDF File 1 contains student as well as supervisor signatures on the declaration certificates before uploading the same on the UMS interface. Important Note- 1. It is advised that the student(s) must ensure timely uploading of their final report before the last date of submission so that the supervisors get sufficient time to approve or to get the modifications suggested by them incorporated in the final report before final submission of the hard copy of the report in the respective administrative officer (A.O.) office by the students. 2. In Extreme cases if the final report is not ready and requires more time, student can request for an extension of maximum 60 days with a fee of Rupees 1000/- in 30-310 by filling the hard copy Extension form. 3. The guidelines (Annexure-II) attached with this announcement for the preparation of the final reports are suggestive and can vary as per the nature and amount of the work done. 4. Respective supervisors must ensure that the reports submitted by the students get approved on or before the last date of submission as specified in Annexure-III. 2. Uploading the detail of the Research Publication/ Patent on UMS: It is mandatory for each student/ student group to have research publication (at least acceptance proof)/Patent (submission proof) for the courses as per Annexure-I to be eligible to appear in the final ETP viva. All students in a specific Project group need to fill the details of the Research Publications/Patent as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-III by visiting the following UMS path: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details--->Upload Research Project Publication/Patent details The above interface would require a log request ID which can be generated by respective Supervisor via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation-->Division of Research and Development-->Research and Academic Contributions--->Log Request Note- It is mandatory to have the research publication/Patent affiliated with Lovely Professional University otherwise the student would not be eligible for the Final ETP viva-voce. 3. Submission of hard copy of the final report in the respective administrative office (A.O. Office) Once the respective supervisors have recommended the soft copy of the report submitted by the students, two hard copies, either spiral or hard bound (As per Annexure-I) of the same duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor must be submitted by the students in respective A.O. office as per timelines specified in Annexure-III. While submitting the hardcopy of project report the AOs must write the E-Receipt Number, sign and put their UID along with the University stamp on hardcopies carried by the student. One Signed and stamped copy of the report should be returned to the student and the same must be carried by the student at the time of ETP viva. Important Points: 1. For students working in groups, any one member of the group can make the submission in AO office and it will be considered for all. Whereas, supervisor must recommend the uploaded soft-copy via UMS interface for all students in-order to enable hard-copy submission for the whole group. 2. In case a student fails to submit his/her final report as per the specified timelines, R grade shall be awarded. 3. Reports will be accepted in AO offices latest by 17:00 hrs. as per the last dates mentioned in Annexure-III. In case of any query, student may log an RMS request via the below mentioned path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Select Category: (Operational Issues) Select Sub Category: Training/ Dissertation/ OJT / Thesis / Seminar / Capstone & Viva

title: Registration invited for Short Term Course on Environmental and Social Impact Assessment : (4/3/2024)
body: Environmental and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA) is a methodical procedure employed to recognize, anticipate, assess and alleviate the ecological and societal outcomes of development projects, policies, programs or plans. This evaluation facilitates decision-makers, researchers and students to comprehend the reasonable effects of the actions on the environment, communities and social systems and enlightens them on how to handle and lessen these effects. In this context, the Human Resource Development Center in collaboration with the School of Liberal and Creative Arts proposes STC as per the details appended below: Title Short Term Course on Environmental and Social Impact Assessment Course Outcome After completion of the course, participants will be able to: 1. Learn about the legal frameworks, regulations and impact assessment guidelines 2. Illustrate the process of identifying, predicting and mitigating adverse impacts on the environment and society 3. Evaluate the potential effects of development projects on the environment and local communities. 4. Address the need for social impact assessment for the holistic development of society 5. Understand role of participatory rural appraisal methods for understanding social impact assessment Gain research skills in conducting field surveys, data collection, and analysis to assess environmental factors such as ecosystem services and land use For Course Content: Please refer to the attached Brochure Resource Persons 1. title: Information regarding TCS IN.8266.2024.42953 : (4/2/2024)
body: This is for the information of all the concerned that the process of TCS IN.8266.2024.42953 is as follows: Registration Link: https://www.tcs.com/careers/india/tcs-fresher-hiring-nqt-2024 NOTE: Its mandatory for the students to register. Application Process: ** Step 1. Logon to the TCS NextStep Portal here Opens in new tab ** Step 2. Register and Apply for the Drive Scenario A. If you are a registered user under TCS NextStep Portal, 'IT’ category, kindly login with your TCS Reference ID (CT / DT reference number) and proceed to complete the application form. Upon submission, kindly click on ‘Apply For Drive’ Scenario B. If you are a new user, kindly click on Register Now, choose category as “IT” and proceed to fill your details. Submit your application form and click on 'Apply For Drive' ** Step 3. Select your mode of test (In-Centre) and choose your preferred test centre & then click on Apply. ** Step 4. To confirm your status, check "Track Your Application". The status should reflect as "Applied for Drive". IMPORTANT NOTE: ** Please note that this is an In-Center test, and center allotment would be on first come first serve basis. ** You must have all your original academic documents till date, to be produced at the time of interview (if test shortlisted) ** Communication related to the test will be informed to you by our test partner, TCS iON. ** TCS does not send job offers / any hiring related communication from unofficial email ids like Gmail, Rediffmail, Yahoo Mail, Hotmail etc. ** TCS does not ask candidates to deposit any money for employment offer. ** TCS is not associated with any external agency / company to conduct any interviews or make offers of employment on its behalf. ** Kindly note that we have a stringent eligibility criterion and a robust selection process. Your eligibility as per the defined criteria will be checked at various stages of the selection process. At any point of time if you are found ineligible, or data shared by you is found discrepant, your candidature will be disqualified. Eligibility: ** Percentage: Minimum 60% or 6 CGPA throughout academics including the highest qualification, till the latest semester for which results have been declared at the time of appearing for the test process. If selected, the offer will be valid only if the degree / provisional degree certificate clearly states that the candidate has cleared Engineering in 'First Class' after completion of the course, at the time of joining. ** Highest Qualification: TCS NQT is exclusively open for candidates from the batch of 2024 with the following academic degrees: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) / Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) / Master of Technology (M.Tech.) / Master of Engineering (M.E.) / Master of Computer Applications (M.C.A.) / Master of Science (M.Sc. / M.S.) in any specialization offered by AICTE / UGC recognized universities / colleges. ** Backlogs / Arrears / ATKT: The candidates should not have any pending or active backlog / arrear / ATKT at the time of appearing for the TCS Selection process. If selected, no pending backlogs / arrears / ATKT will be permitted at the time of joining TCS. All pending backlogs / arrears / ATKT should be cleared within the course duration stipulated by the University. ** Extended Education: No extended education allowed. Candidates should have completed the course in the stipulated course duration. ** Gap / Break in Education: It is mandatory to declare gaps in education, if any. Overall academic gap should not exceed 24 months until highest qualification. Relevant documentation, as applicable, will be checked for gaps in education. ** Course Types: Only full-time courses will be considered (Part-time / Correspondence courses will not be considered). ** Open Schooling: Candidates who have completed their Secondary and / or Senior Secondary course from NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling) are also eligible to apply if the graduation and post-graduation (if applicable) courses are done full-time. ** Work Experience: Candidates with prior work experience of up to 2 years are eligible to apply for this hiring process (Applicable only for post graduate students). ** Age: Candidates should be between 18 to 28 years to participate in this hiring event.

title: Hurry Up !! Last Date to register for Ph.D. Programme at LPU with Application Fee waiver is 31st March 2024 -Opportunity for Post Graduate Students to enroll for Ph.D. Programme at Lovely Professional University. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/240328/001) : (3/28/2024)
body: Recent trends in the job market have revealed the desire of the corporate sector as well as government undertaking institutions to hire candidates for various job positions who have research background through pursuance of Doctoral Degree. Looking into this context of new job opportunities which are not only well paid off but also very high in demand, Lovely Professional University (LPU) has brought an excellent opportunity for the final year Post Graduate students to register for Ph.D. programme for the upcoming August 2024 session. Ph.D. at LPU Ph.D. at LPU entitles you to a host of world class opportunities and facilitations in the form of research publication incentives, international travel grants, state-of-the-art central instrumentation facility (CIF) at highly subsidized rates, research contingency grant and various annual research fellowships. Important Points : 1. Application Fee Exemption: As a special gesture, final year PG students enrolling for the entrance test will have special chance to avail LPUNEST application form fee exemption. 2. Selection Process: The student needs to appear for LPUNEST on 19th April 2024 (Friday) followed by research proposal discussion with the technical committee. 3. Programme Fee and Scholarship: The term fee for the Ph.D. programme is Rs. 50,000/- with a minimum 20% scholarship as part of Alumni benefit. However, higher scholarships of up to 50% can also be availed based on the performance in the LPUNEST. Scholarship Slab Scholarship Amount Fee applicable per semester 50% Rs 25,000/- Rs 25,000/- 40% Rs 20,000/- Rs 30,000/- 30% Rs 15,000/- Rs 35,000/- How to Apply ? The final year post graduate students can register for LPUNEST through their UMS. The students can register by visiting the following link. UMS Navigation ---> Research and Development ---> PhD Discipline Preference. The detailed steps to apply for LPUNEST is attached with the announcement. For further information about the benefits and opportunities, please visit Centre of Research Degree Programme (CRDP) in Block 38-202 or reach us out through the following RMS path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request--->Message Type-- > Category Type -- > Department (Ph.D. [Centre for Research Degree Programmes]) -- > Category -- > Sub Category -- > Contact No. -- > Description

body: of data analytics using the R programming language. This program equips researchers with the essential skills and knowledge required to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data effectively. title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (3/28/2024)
body: Dear Aspirants Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. In order to join these Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 20th April, 2024. title: Registrations invited for Short Term Course on 3D Printing and Design : (3/28/2024)
body: 3D printing revolutionizes manufacturing by creating objects layer by layer from digital designs. Its versatility and ability to rapidly prototype designs find applications across industries like aerospace, automotive, healthcare, and consumer goods. Integrated with CAD software, it enables quick translation of ideas into physical prototypes, facilitating iterative design processes and reducing time-to-market. Registration is invited for Short Term Course on 3D printing and Design organized by School of Mechanical Engineering with Human Resource Development Center. Details of the course are appended below: Title Short Term Course on 3D Printing and Design Course Outcomes After attending the course the participants will be able to: 1. Apply design considerations for developing CAD model for 3D printing using online tools. 2. Prepare data (prepare error free. STL file, understand the effect of Orientation, Slicing) for 3D printing. 3. Understand the effect of process parameters on the printed part. 4. Understand the working principle of 3D printers and post-processing techniques to enhance the part quality. For Course Content: Please refer to the attached Brochure Resource Person Dr. Vishal Francis, Assistant Professor, School of Mechanical Engineering, LPU Who can Attend Faculty Members, Research scholars, technical staff and students of LPU, Other academic institutions and Industry Schedule April 01, 2024 to April 06, 2024 Time: 06:30 pm to 08:30 pm Platform https://myclass.lpu.in/ Registration Fee Rs. 1500/- Registration Link https://www.lpu.in/HRD/ Registration Closes March 31, 2024 Since there are limited seats, selection will be on a first-come-first-served basis. title: Mastering Non-verbal Communication: A Workshop for Interview Success : (3/26/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Mastering Non-verbal Communication: A Workshop for Interview Success.” In this interactive and insightful workshop, we would delve into the often-overlooked aspect of communication that can make or break your success in interviews: nonverbal cues. While what you say during an interview is crucial, how you say it and the signals you unconsciously send through your body language, facial expressions, and gestures can significantly impact the impression you make on your interviewer. This workshop is designed to empower the students with the knowledge and skills to harness the power of nonverbal communication to project confidence, professionalism, and authenticity, ultimately increasing their chances of acing the interview and landing your dream job. The main objectives of the event are: · To understand the importance of nonverbal communication in the interview process. · To learn to interpret and control your own body language and facial expressions effectively. · To develop strategies to project confidence, credibility, and engagement through nonverbal communication. · To enhance your ability to build rapport and establish a positive connection with interviewers using nonverbal techniques. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. title: Product Development and Management Association (PDMA) 2024 : (3/23/2024)
body: Product Development and Management Association (PDMA) 2024 Announcement Ref. No. - LPU/DII/IC/240323/002 PDMA is the leading association championing best practices in new product management and development. As such, we seek to ensure these methodologies are taught, learned, and practiced at the collegiate level so that graduates are effective contributors to product work teams upon entry in the workforce. Conversely, well-trained students provide a significant opportunity for organizations to inject the latest product development strategies into their workforce and improve their innovation culture. The richest academic environments are ones where the students can put theories and concepts into practice, and where students interact with practitioners from industry. The goal of the PDMA Student Innovation Challenge is to provide a platform, purpose and incentives to drive engagement and grow relationships between students, academia, and industry professionals. PDMA is using this university level competition to: 1.Leverage students’ passions to learn product development methodologies and frameworks through developing product solutions to real world problems 2.Promote best practices in product innovation 3.Partner with professors and industry professionals in the development of the next generation of highly skilled innovators and product leaders 4.The PDMA Student Innovation Challenge is unique in that it encourages and supports students developing novel, real-world offerings, that include products, software or services. Our goal is to build a community of innovators. We recognize Students, Professors, Mentors, and Companies as unique contributors to the program and attempt to create a symbiotic relationship so each can benefit from participation. Eligibility: 1.Submissions may come from team members currently enrolled in a university academic program at either the undergraduate or graduate level (at the time the work for the submission was developed). 2.Students are also encouraged to reach out to students at different schools within a university, e.g. business school and engineering school and to form cross functional teams. 3.Student teams must have an advising professor. Professors can be advisors for multiple student teams. 4.Submissions can be a part of coursework, to the extent allowed by the institution, or may be the products of extracurricular work. Awards: 1. title: Google – AI Assistants for Data Tasks with Gemma : (3/22/2024)
body: Announcement Reference Number:- LPU/DII/IC/240322/002 Overview: Google launched Gemma, a new family of open LLMs built from the same research and technology used to create their Gemini models. In this competition, you’re challenged to demonstrate how to use Gemma to accomplish one or more data science-oriented tasks. Description: Large Language Models (LLMs) have captured the world's attention and imagination. Often referred to as "foundation models", much of their potential lies in their ability to be adapted to accomplish specialized tasks for a seemingly unlimited number of use cases. As the technology rapidly develops, there’s a massive opportunity to uncover the best methods and approaches for adapting LLMs to new and specialized use cases. The goal of this competition is to create a notebook that demonstrates how to use the Gemma LLM to accomplish one of the following data science-oriented tasks: 1. Explain or teach basic data science concepts. 2. Answer common questions about the Python programming language. 3. Summarize Kaggle solution write-ups. 4. Explain or teach concepts from Kaggle competition solution write-ups. 5. Answer common questions about the Kaggle platform. By participating in this competition, you'll both be building a useful tool and contributing to the ML field's collective knowledge of how to best sharpen LLMs for real-world needs. Evaluation: 1. Eligibility Criteria: Compliant: The submission was consistent with the guidelines and instructions. [yes/no] Topical: The submission was relevant to one of the 5x topics. [yes/no] Open: The notebook and all of the underlying data sources were made public. [yes/no] 2. Evaluation Rubric: Technical: The approach made efficient use of strategies such as few-shot prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, and/or fine-tuning. [0-10pts] Descriptive: The code was well-documented, with markdown cells that both explained the code and provided context. [0-10pts] Useful: The approach produces outputs that are helpful or high quality. [0-10pts] Robust: The approach works well when tested with additional inputs. [0-10pts] Timeline: Entry Deadline – 14th April, 2024.You must accept the competition rules before this date to compete. Team Merger Deadline – 14th April 2024. This is the last day participants may join or merge teams. Final Submission Deadline- 14th April, 2024. All deadlines are at 11:59 PM UTC on the corresponding day unless otherwise noted. The competition organizers reserve the right to update the contest timeline if they deem it necessary. Submission Instructions: To participate in this competition, you must create and share a public Kaggle Notebook that demonstrates how to use the Gemma model to accomplish one of the 5x relevant tasks. Your Kaggle Notebook must be made public (along with any underlying data sources) and it should be attached to the official competition dataset. All team members must be listed as collaborators on the notebook, and the notebook must be submitted via the Google Form. All submissions will be assessed initially according to the eligibility criteria, and all eligible submissions will be scored according to the evaluation rubric. We will grade the most recent submission from your team (per competition, not per category). General Tips: 1. Follow the guidelines as closely as possible and avoid working outside of the guidelines. 2. Make it obvious what you did, why you did it, and what category you are submitting to. 3. Make it as easy as possible for the graders to understand what you are doing. 4. Make it as easy as possible for the graders to understand why you did a good job. Rewards: 1. There are 5x $10,000 USD prizes in total, with one prize per category. 2. Each prize will be awarded to the most helpful tutorial notebook that demonstrates how to use the Gemma model to accomplish one of the 5x relevant tasks. 3. In addition to the monetary prizes, we will also give away special Kaggle swag to recognize:5x public notebooks that get published in the first 5 weeks, and 25 Kagglers that upload well-documented Gemma model variations to Kaggle Models (and then make use of it within their submissions) Citation: Paul Mooney, Ashley Chow. (2024). Registration Links : 1. Link-1:- https://www.kaggle.com/kaggle-assistant-submissions 2. Link- 2:- https://forms.gle/DhK8zNuKF5fgKR7JA Note: It is mandatory to register on both the links. In case of any clarification, kindly contact Ms. Kaveri Sharma at 6283571198 (Call/Whatsapp)

title: Steel Plate Defect Prediction : (3/22/2024)
body: Announcement Reference Number:- LPU/DII/IC/240322/001 Overview: Welcome to the 2024 Kaggle Playground Series! We plan to continue in the spirit of previous playgrounds, providing interesting and approachable datasets for our community to practice their machine learning skills, and anticipate a competition each month. About the Tabular Playground Series: The goal of the Tabular Playground Series is to provide the Kaggle community with a variety of fairly lightweight challenges that can be used to learn and sharpen skills in different aspects of machine learning and data science. The duration of each competition will generally only last a few weeks, and may have longer or shorter durations depending on the challenge. The challenges will generally use fairly light-weight datasets that are synthetically generated from real-world data, and will provide an opportunity to quickly iterate through various model and feature engineering ideas, create visualizations, etc. Synthetically-Generated Datasets: Using synthetic data for Playground competitions allows us to strike a balance between having real-world data (with named features) and ensuring test labels are not publicly available. This allows us to host competitions with more interesting datasets than in the past. While there are still challenges with synthetic data generation, the state-of-the-art is much better now than when we started the Tabular Playground Series two years ago, and that goal is to produce datasets that have far fewer artifacts. Please feel free to give us feedback on the datasets for the different competitions so that we can continue to improve! Goal Predict the probability of various defects on steel plates. Good luck! Evaluation: Submissions are evaluated using the area under the ROC curve using the predicted probabilities and the ground truth targets. To calculate the final score, AUC is calculated for each of the 7 defect categories and then averaged. In other words, the score is the average of the individual AUC of each predicted column. Submission File Details: For each id in the test set, you must predict the probability for each of the 7 defect categories: Pastry, Z Scratch, K Scratch, Stains, Dirtiness, Bumps, and Other Faults. The file should contain a header and have the following format: 1. id,Pastry,Z_Scratch,K_Scatch,Stains,Dirtiness,Bumps,Other_Faults 2. 19219,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5 3. 19220,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5 4. 19221,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5 etc. Timeline: Start Date - 1st March 2024 Entry Deadline - Same as the Final Submission Deadline Team Merger Deadline - Same as the Final Submission Deadline Final Submission Deadline - 31st March 2024 All deadlines are at 11:59 PM UTC on the corresponding day unless otherwise noted. The competition organizers reserve the right to update the contest timeline if they deem it necessary. Rewards: 1st Place - Choice of Kaggle merchandise 2nd Place - Choice of Kaggle merchandise 3rd Place - Choice of Kaggle merchandise Please note: To encourage more participation from beginners, Kaggle merchandise will only be awarded once per person in this series. If a person has previously won, we'll skip to the next team. Citation: Walter Reade, Ashley Chow. (2024). Steel Plate Defect Prediction. Kaggle. Registration Details: 1. The workshop dedicated to mastering the art of solving blood relations problems within the domain of analytical skills. Understanding blood relations is crucial for logical reasoning and problem-solving. In this workshop, we'll explore strategies and techniques to tackle complex familial puzzles effectively. By sharpening our analytical abilities, we aim to navigate through intricate family trees with clarity and precision. Join us as we embark on a journey to decode relationships, unravel mysteries, and enhance our problem-solving skills in the realm of blood relations. Let's unlock the secrets together! The main objectives of the event are: · To introduce participants to the basic concepts and terminology associated with blood relations, such as parentage, sibling relationships, and extended family connections. · To provide participants with opportunities to practice solving a variety of problems involving blood relations, ranging from simple to complex scenarios, in order to improve their problem-solving skills. · To offer participants practical strategies, tips, and tricks for effectively approaching and solving problems related to blood relations, empowering them to tackle similar challenges with confidence in the future. Target audience: The students of Apartments 41 A-B will participate in the event. Date: 28th March, 2024 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Apartments 41 A-B Resource Person: Mr. Prince Kumar Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/UnravelingFamilyTies1

title: Suggest a Tagline for the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) : (3/21/2024)
body: Suggest a Tagline for the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) Announcement Ref. No. - LPU/DII/IC/240321/009 Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation in collaboration with MyGov is conducting a Tagline Competition where citizens are invited nationwide to unleash their linguistic brilliance to craft a compelling tagline in English/ Hindi or Sanskrit that encapsulates the essence of the Ministry's pivotal role. The tagline should resonate with the Ministry's core values, narrative and impact in shaping our nation's future. Everyone is encouraged to participate in this tagline competition to display their creative brilliance and write a tagline that becomes the voice of the Ministry. Last Date To Participate: 15th April 2024 at 23:45 PM IST (GMT +5.30 Hrs) Eligibility: 1. Participants should only upload the Tagline in JPEG / PNG / SVG / PDF format. 2. File should be of high resolution – at least 300 pixels per inch at 100% size. 3. File should look clean (not pixilated or bit-mapped) when viewed on screen at 100%. 4. Entries should not be submitted in compressed or self-extracting formats. Evaluation Criteria: 1. All the entries received by the stipulated date and found in order would be assessed by a committee of judges for selecting the entries. The decision of the Committee shall be final and binding. The Committee will shortlist the entries and will decide the winner if an entry is found suitable. 2. Entries would be judged on the basis of elements of creativity, originality, composition, technical excellence, simplicity, artistic merit and visual impact and how well they communicate the vision of MoSPI. The winners will be declared via the Winner announcement blog (blog.mygov.in). There will be no notification to participants not selected as winners. 3. MoSPI may add/remove any relevant criteria for evaluating the Tagline received in response to this competition at its sole discretion and determination. 4. The decision of MoSPI in respect of evaluation methodology and short listing of Tagline will be final; no clarifications would be issued to any participants or on any decision of the Selection Committee. 5. MoSPI reserves the right to accept or reject any or all the Tagline without assigning any reason thereof. 6. There will be only one winner for the Tagline competition. 7. Winner shall be required to provide the original open source file of the designed tagline. Awards: 1. The finally selected winner of Tagline will get a prize of Rs. 10,000/-. 2. Winners will be invited at the Statistics day 2024 for felicitation and receiving a Prize. title: Logo Design Contest for the GOV.IN AppStore : (3/21/2024)
body: Logo Design Contest for the GOV.IN AppStore Announcement Ref. No. - LPU/DII/IC/240321/007 GOV.IN AppStore (www.apps.mgov.gov.in) is India’s first indigenously developed AppStore by C-DAC Mumbai under the guidance of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) that is available for hosting citizen-centric mobile apps. This is a secure and trusted ecosystem for mobile apps developed by Indian mobile app developers. The In-house testing process is reliable and makes developers aware of the security glitches in the app. The entire process of testing and hosting apps is free of cost. C-DAC Mumbai, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), in collaboration with MyGov, is inviting citizens to design a logo that communicates the essence and spirit of the National mSeva AppStore. Last Date To Participate: 05th April 2024 at 23:45 PM IST (GMT +5.30 Hrs) Eligibility: 1. Participants should upload the logo in JPEG/ JPG/ PNG format only. The logo should be designed on a digital platform. 2. The winner of the competition shall be required to submit the design in an editable and open file format. 3. Participants should ensure that the original designs are submitted. 4. Each entry should submit the detailed logic and explanation of rational and creative thoughts (not more than 100 words) on designed logo in a soft copy. Logo should be designed in a colored format. The size of the logo may vary from 5cm*5cm to 30cm*30cm in either portrait or landscape mode. 5. The logo should be usable on the website/ social media such as Twitter/Facebook, press releases and on printable such as stationery, signage, labels etc., magazines, commercials, holdings, standees, brochures, leaflets, pamphlets, souvenirs and other publicity and marketing material for promotion of GOV.IN AppStore. 6. The logo image should be in high resolution with minimum 300 DPI. 7. Logo should look clean (not pixilated or bit-mapped) when viewed on screen at 100%. 8. Entries should not be submitted in compressed or self-extracting formats. 9. The logo design should not be imprinted or watermarked. Evaluation Criteria: 1. All the entries received would be assessed for awards by a Screening Committee for an initial evaluation. After such screening, all approved entries would be assessed by a Selection Committee for the final evaluation. 2. The entries will be judged and will be selected on the basis following criteria: Alignment to Name and overall theme of GOV.IN AppStore a. Creativity b. Originality c. Simplicity d. Inspirational element 3. In case of more than the required winners in any category, further selection shall be done with the help of Draw. 4. The decision of the Selection Committee would be final and binding on all the contestants and no clarifications would be issued to any participants or any decision of the Selection Committee. Awards: The best entry will be rewarded with a prize worth Rs. 25000 and a Certificate.
