title: Information Regarding Summer Training / Internship for 2026 Graduating Batch of B.Tech CSE/ IT : (3/21/2024)
body: As per the Scheme of CSE/IT, all second-year students (2026 Graduating Batch) will have to undergo mandatory 4–6-week training/internship this coming summer after the completion of 4th semester (2nd year of B. Tech degree). All the students eligible for this training/internship will be divided into 2 categories : Niche Technologies: A student falling in this category will have to complete its 4-6 weeks of summer training/internship in any technology other than the programming domain such as Database, Networks, Cyber security, Data Science, Machine learning, AI, Gen-AI, Cloud Computing, FSD etc. Programming Language: A student falling in this category will have to complete its 4-6 Weeks summer training/internship in one of the programming languages only as it is essential for computer science students to be well versed with one programming language. Furthermore, the students who fall in Niche category, can appear for an internship also during this period. However, in such case, they will have to take due approval from the career counselling cell. Summer PEP: Due to the change in the hiring model / hiring process of the companies, top tech companies have now started evaluating students during their 5th semester and have started offering internships post their 6th semester. Hence, to be ready and grab opportunities which will come during the 5th semester, a set of students (Out of Placement Registered Students) shall undergo summer PEP inputs. These inputs shall be in offline mode for the selected set of students (shortlisted for PEP). Therefore, they will have to stay in campus during the summer vacations. Note: Categorization (Niche/Programming) of training shall be based on the grades of courses from 1st to 3rd semester and for Lateral Entry Students, grades of 1st semester, the same shall be informed separately. Secondly, the list of students who will appear for PEP shall also be informed separately. You are also advised to keep checking all the communication mediums to get all the updates.

title: Registration invited for Short Term Course on English Phonetics and Phonology : (3/19/2024)
body: English Phonetics and Phonology study the sounds of the English language. Phonetics focuses on the physical production and acoustic properties of speech sounds, examining articulation and sound waves. It categorizes sounds into vowels, consonants, and their variations. Phonology, on the other hand, explores the systematic organization and patterns of sounds within a language, including the study of phonemes and their distribution. Understanding the relationship between phonetics and phonology is crucial for grasping pronunciation nuances and language variation. Both disciplines play a fundamental role in language acquisition, linguistic analysis, and improving communication skills in English. In this context, the Department of English, School of Liberal and Creative Arts (Social Sciences and Languages) in collaboration with the Human Resource Development Center, Lovely Professional University is organizing STC as per the details appended below: Title Short Term Course on English Phonetics and Phonology Course Outcome The participants will be able to: 1. Infer the production of speech sounds 2. Understand long vowels, diphthongs, and triphthongs 3. Analyze the vowels and consonants 4. Examine the English phoneme and phonology 5. Adapt the aspects of connected speech, stress, intonation, and syllables For Course Content: Please refer to the attached Brochure Resource Persons Dr. Ajoy Batta, Professor and Head, Department of English, LPU Dr. Sanjay Prasad Pandey, Professor, Department of English, LPU Schedule April 22, 2024 to April 27, 2024 Time: 07:00 pm to 09:00 pm Registration Link https://www.lpu.in/HRD/ Registration Fee and Participant LPU Associates Rs. 850/- Externals: Rs. 1000/- Online Payment or Cash to be deposited in Accounts Department Registration Closes April 18, 2024 Platform https://myclass.lpu.in/ Since there are limited seats, selection will be on a first-come-first-served basis. Looking forward to your active participation

title: ALLOTMENT OF RESIDENTIAL FACILITIES FOR ACADEMIC SESSION 2024-2025 (3/16/2024)
body: Online Allotment Process for Residential Facilities i.e. Residence, Mess, Gym, and Laundry for existing students with Active Academic Status (Admission Batch 2023 or earlier) is going to start from 12th March 2024 for session 2024-25. Students can book the residential facility with Early Decision Benefit (upto Rs. 10,000/-) till 30th Apr. 2024. Allotment of residential facilities will be done in 2 Phases as mentioned below: Phases Process Start Date End Date Eligibility Phase-1 Allotment of Residential Services (Without Token Amount) Round -I At 05:30 PM on 12th March 2024 At 11:59 PM on 31st March 2024 Students Having CGPA 08 or Above (For both Boys & Girls) Round –II At 05:30 PM on 13th March 2024 For all Girls Round –III At 05:30 PM on 14th March 2024 For all Boys Phase-2 Allotment of Residential Services (With Token Amount of Rs. 10000/-) At 12:00 AM on 01st April 2024 NA All Students (For Both Boys & Girls) Payment of Residential Charges Token Amount Students who booked the residential facility in Phase-1 (Till 31st March 2024) will have to pay the minimum token amount of Rs. 10000/- by 07th April 2024 to secure EDB and booked hostel seat. In case of failure to make the payment the hostel seat of students may be cancelled as per refund guidelines. 50% of Residential Charges All the students (Phase-I & Phase-II) will have to pay 50% residential charges on or before 15 June 2024 to secure EDB on residential facilities. Students who are unable to pay 50% of residential charges till 15 June 2024 will have to pay that amount by 30th June 2024. In case of failure to make the payment the hostel seat of students may be cancelled as per refund guidelines. 100% Residential Charges Students have to pay complete residential charges on or before reporting in the hostel. Booking can be done through “Hostel Booking” option available on UMS Dashboard or by visiting: UMS Navigation >>> Residential Services >>> Residential Facilities Booking >>> Hostel Booking There are 3 options available on this interface that a student can choose: 1. INDIVIDUAL BOOKING: This option is applicable for those students who want to book the hostel seat for their own. 2. GROUP BOOKING: This option is applicable for those students who want to book the hostel seat along with their friends. Student can choose his/her roommates by selecting group booking option (Validation of group members has to be done using the OTP sent to individual group member’s “My message” on UMS). 3. WAITLIST: This option is applicable for the situation if student is unable to book the desired hostel/seater. EDB benefits will not be applicable on Waitlist request, rather these benefits will be applicable according the date of actual booking the residential services. Waitlist request can be submitted under following scenarios: a. Waitlist (Hostel Not Booked):- In case student have not booked the hostel due to non-availability of preferred hostel/ seater, then student can submit the request for desired hostel/ seater. Student will be notified about the availability of requested hostel/ room type as soon as it is available for booking. b. Waitlist (Hostel Already Booked):- In case student have already booked the hostel seat but still want to change the booked seat and the desired hostel/ seater is not available, then student can submit the request for desired hostel/ seater. Student will be notified about the availability of requested hostel/ room type as soon as it is available for booking. Allotment for Residential Scholarship Holder:- Allotment will be separately managed by OMC-DRS (Block 29-301) (based on the details provided by the concerned departments i.e Sports or Cultural) for students awarded hostel charges waiver under any scholarship scheme (like Sports, Cultural, Board topper etc.), such students need not to participate in the Allotment Process of Residential Facilities. Changes in the booked residential facilities:- Option to change booked hostel seat will be provided to students after 01st April 2024. Students can change their booked hostel seat without any shifting charges once in a complete academic session. Second time onwards each request for the change of hostel/ room will be processed with a shifting charges of Rs. 1000/-. Students may upgrade their booked seat by paying the difference of amount between both room types and without shifting charges any time during the complete academic session, whereas down-gradation of hostel seat will be permitted before reporting in hostel only and with shifting charges (As applicable). Important Point:- 1. Students who are not opting for the residential facility will be required to submit their PG/Rented/Private Accommodation details as per guidelines of UGC, Police and other local authorities. 2. Residential Facilities will be provided till the end of the regular academic session including regular exams or 10 months from the start of the session, whichever is earlier. Students can come and join 02 days prior to the start of academic session and will be required to vacate residential room/apartment within 02 days after completion of stay period. Students may check the complete process of booking through demo video as mentioned in following link: https://youtube/AmvWn-8DJlA Students must go through the attachments for rest other details i.e. Residential Charges, Refund Guidelines or Step by Step Booking Process. Attachments: 1.Residential Facilities Charges 2024-25 2.Refund Policy 2024-2025 3.Steps To Book Residential Facility For any query students may visit Residential Query Window: Block 32 Basement, Window No. 03, or lodge RMS on UMS under UMS Navigation >> Relationship Management System (RMS) >> Log Request >> Academic & Administrative Issues >> Select Message Type “Grievance” >> Search by category “Residential Services (Hostel Allotment/ Transfer) : Hostel Allotment” category.

title: Registration invited for Short Term Course on Archaeology and Epigraphy Prospect and Challenges : (3/15/2024)
body: Archaeology and epigraphy stand as twin pillars illuminating our past, yet each confronts distinct prospects and challenges. Archaeology unearths tangible remnants, offering glimpses into ancient civilizations, but faces the peril of irreversible decay and looting. Meanwhile, epigraphy deciphers inscriptions, unlocking forgotten languages and narratives, yet wrestles with decipherment hurdles and fading artifacts. Together, they forge a narrative tapestry, but their journey is marked by the constant battle against time and the persistent quest for preservation and understanding. In this context, the Department of History, School of Liberal and Creative Arts in collaboration with the Human Resource Development Center (HRDC), LPU is organizing STC as per the details appended below: Title Short Term Course on Archaeology and Epigraphy Prospect and Challenges Course Outcome The program aims at: 1. Providing an in-depth understanding of the methodologies and key findings in marine archaeology in India. 2. Examining the evolution of prehistoric cultures in India. 3. Exploring the significance of intangible cultural heritage in India, including oral traditions, performing arts, rituals, and traditional knowledge systems, and their preservation challenges. 4. Investigating the principles and practices of epigraphy, focusing on deciphering inscriptions, understanding their historical context, and interpreting their contributions to Indian history and culture. For Course Content: Please refer to the attached Brochure Resource Persons Prof. Alok Tripathi, Additional Director General, Archaeological Survey of India, New Delhi Dr. Ranbeer Singh Rajput, Additional Director-Admin, Bihar Museum, Patna Dr. T.S. Ravishshankar Srinivasan, Director, Epigraphy Branch, Archaeological Survey of India, Mysuru Dr. Munmun Mondal, Assistant Professor, Department of History, LPU Schedule April 01, 2024 to April 06, 2024 Time: 07:00 pm to 09:00 pm Platform https://myclass.lpu.in/ Registration Fee and Participant LPU Students: Rs. 500/- LPU Faculty Members/Research Scholar: Rs. 1000/- Externals: Rs. 1000/- Online Payment or Cash to be deposited in Accounts Department Registration Link https://www.lpu.in/HRD/ Registration Closes March 29, 2024 Since there are limited seats, selection will be on a first-come-first-served basis. Looking forward to your active participation

title: Enroll into Self-Empowerment through Meditation Course : (3/13/2024)
body: Dear Students, Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to learn Meditation for your physical as well as mental well-being. Self-Empowering Meditation is a form of meditation that is accessible to people of all backgrounds. It is a meditation without rituals or mantras and can be practiced anywhere at any time. Meditation is practiced with 'open eyes', which makes this method of meditation versatile, simple and easy to practice. Spiritual awareness gives us the power to choose good and positive thoughts over those which are negative and wasteful. We start to respond to situations, rather than just reacting to them. We begin to live with harmony and positivity. In order to join this Self-Empowerment through Meditation course, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 25th March 2024. Classes will start from 1st April, 2024 and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in/Details/424/SelfEmpowermentthroughMeditation Last date for the registration: 25th March, 2024

title: Enroll into JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE offered by Centre for Professional Enhancement : (3/12/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 17th March 2024. Classes will start from 18th March 2024 and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. title: Talkathon 2.0 - a competitive event on group discussion : (3/11/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Talkathon 2.0 - a competitive event on group discussion”. The event will emphasize on giving students a competitive platform to share their opinion on topic given. This event will help the students to develop their oral communication skills. They will learn how to articulate their thoughts, use appropriate language, and engage with an audience effectively. Group discussions offer students a valuable platform for learning and personal growth. Through active participation in group discussions, students can enhance their communication skills by articulating their thoughts and ideas effectively. They develop the ability to listen attentively to diverse perspectives, fostering empathy and understanding. Group discussions promote critical thinking as students engage in constructive debates, analyse various viewpoints, and learn to support their arguments with evidence. Furthermore, they gain insights into collaboration and teamwork, crucial skills for success in both academic and professional settings. These discussions also encourage students to expand their knowledge and broaden their horizons by exposing them to new ideas and different cultural viewpoints. In essence, group discussions provide a holistic learning experience that goes beyond textbooks, helping students develop essential skills for effective communication, critical thinking, and interpersonal relationships. The main objectives of the event are: · To improve student’s verbal communication skills by articulating their thoughts clearly and persuasively. · To make students analyse information, evaluate various viewpoints, and develop well-founded arguments and enhance critical thinking. · To learn to listen attentively to others, fostering empathy and the ability to understand different perspectives. · To understand collaboration and teamwork, which skills are essential for success in both academic and professional settings. title: Workshop on Research Methodology and Data Analysis Using SPSS for Social Sciences. : (3/6/2024)
body: Registration is invited for Workshop on Research Methodology and Data Analysis Using SPSS for Social Sciences. A nine-day workshop which focuses on various statistical tools relevant for the Social Sciences using SPSS. The course will cover all essential aspects of research methodology such as research design, questionnaire designing, validity, parametric and non-parametric test, exploratory factor analysis, high impact publications and references writing using Mendeley. In a world where information is abundant and challenges are complex, the ability to think critically, reason systematically, and solve intricate problems is more valuable than ever. This is your opportunity to sharpen your analytical edge, collaborate with like-minded thinkers, and push the boundaries of your logical prowess. title: Enroll into JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE offered by Centre for Professional Enhancement : (3/2/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 9th March 2024. Classes will start from 15th March 2024 and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. body: Dear Aspirants Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. title: Last date to Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (2/29/2024)
body: Dear Aspirants Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. In order to join this Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 29th February, 2024. Classes will start in March and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll: 29th February, 2024. title: Idiomatic Language: A deep dive workshop on the usage of Idioma : (2/28/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct a workshop on “Idiomatic Language: A deep dive workshop on the usage of Idioma". Students will get familiar with idiomatic language, it is also a parameter of speaking module. Students will learn idioms and will be able to use the same. title: Build India Scholorship- L&T : (2/25/2024)
body: Build India Scholorship- L&T Announcement Ref. No. - LPU/DII/IC/240225/001 Build India Scholarship(BIS) Scheme is an illustrious programme that has been in existence for more than 25 years. Through this program, L&T nurtures aspiring young talents from Civil / Electrical Engineering background into capable Project Management professionals, allowing them to be part of its tremendous growth story. Last Date To Participate: 06-Mar-24 Programme Details: Course Name: M.Tech in Construction Technology & Management Partner Institutes: IIT Madras / IIT Delhi / NITK Surathkal / NIT Tiruchirapalli Programme Highlights: 1) 02 years full-time M. Tech degree in Construction Technology & Management 2) Academic Partners: IIT Madras / IIT Delhi / NITK Surathkal / NIT Tiruchirapalli 3) Monthly stipend of Rs. 13,400 will be paid for 24 months (till the course completion) 4) Sponsorship fee & Tuition will be borne by L&T and will be paid directly to IITs / NITs 5) Summer Internship & Final Project will be carried out at L&T project sites during the programme 6) Regular interactions/Guest lectures/Knowledge-sharing sessions by L&T professionals 7) Employment will be offered at L&T upon successful completion of the Course Eligibility: 1) Applicants must be final-year students pursuing BE/B.Tech in core Civil/Electrical Engineering, expected to graduate in 2024 from a recognized Indian University/Institute, with an academic aggregate of 70% or a CGPA of 7.0 (out of 10) and above. 2) Please note that students from other engineering disciplines and those who graduated in 2023 or earlier are not eligible. How to apply: Applications are accepted only through online mode. Step 1: Click on 'Apply Now' to proceed to a new webpage. Here, enter your basic details and submit. You will receive an email containing your User ID and password for accessing the application portal. Upon registration, remember to log in using the provided credentials and complete the application form. Step 2: Log in to the application portal using the User ID and password provided to you. Click on 'Login' located at the top right-hand corner of the application portal to access and complete the application form. Step 3: Enter all the information sought and upload required documents in .pdf/jpg/jpeg formats, as required. Documents like certificates / mark sheets / valid photo identify proof / photograph / signature / CV etc need to be uploaded. Ensure that you merge all semester mark sheets into a single .pdf document before uploading. After submitting the application form and required documents, you will receive an acknowledgment email confirming the submission of your application. If shortlisted, you will be required to appear for a physical written test at one of their designated Test Centres. Registration Details: Link 1 : https://www.lntecc.com/build-india-scholarship/ Link 2 : https://forms.gle/1rBKnQWVgzpvYm8F6 (Its mandatory to registered on both the links) In Case of any query you may contact Dr. Tanuj Mishra at tanuj.12948@lpu.co.in

To encourage the students to take up online MOOCs or certifications, the university shall be providing academic benefits in the form of attendance, CA, MTT, and ETE, in the course(s) registered to the student in the current or upcoming term(s), which are most closely mapped to the content (and approved) of the MOOC or certification studied by the student. Also note that a duty leave of 10 lectures shall be given to the students appearing for the proctored exam of the registered MOOCs. Also, duty leave shall be provided for the day of the proctored examination. For further guidance regarding MOOCs, students may contact the concerned faculty member who is teaching that course. Students need to follow the UMS link UMS>LMS>MOOC Certification to get detailed information regarding the following: a) A suggestive list of already mapped and approved MOOCs and certifications for the courses studied by the student in his or her programme" b) A detailed process to understand how to apply for the academic benefit on completion of the MOOCs and certifications' is available as “A Step-by-Step Guideline to View the MOOCs and Apply for Academic Benefit. *Note: If student is having any valuable course which is not mentioned in the list (provided to the students in the interface), he or she is advised to visit course HoD for the course mapping and academic benefits. Once the course is approved by the HoS and HoD, it will get displayed at the Interface where he or she can register and upload the certificates. All students are suggested to follow the above-mentioned link and avail themselves of the academic benefit associated with successful completion of the MOOCs and certifications. title: Cyber Awareness Street Play Contest : (2/13/2024)
body: Announcement Reference No. : LPU/DII/IC/240213/002 The Ministry of Home Affairs has set up the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) under a Scheme to handle all the issues related to cybercrime in a comprehensive and coordinated manner. I4C has a National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (NCRP) i.e. www.cybercrime.gov.in wherein all the complaints pertaining to cybercrime are reported by the citizens. I4C also has a helpline number 1930, wherein the financial cyber fraud complaints are reported by the citizens. One of the main objectives of I4C is to create an ecosystem for prevention of cybercrime and to provide cyber safety tips to citizens for cyber hygiene. I4C, MHA and National School of Drama is organizing a Cyber Awareness Street Play Contest for all citizens in collaboration with MyGov on the theme – Cyber Safe India. All the participants, through the street play should aim to spread awareness about cybercrime and cyber hygiene. Through this contest, participants are encouraged: 1. To explore their creative instinct and produce a street play that promotes National Cybercrime Helpline No. 1930 and National Cybercrime Reporting Portal (NCRP) – www.cybercrime.gov.in 2. To spread awareness about the emerging types of cybercrime and ways to stay safe online. 3. To perform on any of the below themes: a) Investment (Part Time Job Scam) b) Illegal Loan Apps c) Illegal Gaming Apps d) Sextortion e) Parcel Scam f) Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AePS) based Scam g) Cybercrime related to Women & Children Eligibility Criteria: a) The street play video, as per the eligibility conditions, needs to be uploaded on YouTube as UNLISTED (it should not be available on search engines or available in public domain) or Google Drive (with access to anyone with the link). Only the YouTube/ Google Drive link needs to be submitted on www.mygov.in as the entry. b) The video must be shot horizontally in FHD (Full HD 1080p 16:9 1920X1080) resolution only. The picture and sound should be clearly understood, with no shaking/ blurry footage and minimal noise/static. c) Each entry shall be accompanied with acceptable formats for street play video link (containing MP4/MOV/H264, Full HD, Resolution 1920 x 1080 pixels, 24/25 fps) d) Street Play can have duration of maximum 15 minutes. Last Date to Register : 25th February,2024 - 11:45 PM Rewards : First Position – Memento & Certificate Second Position – Memento & Certificate Third Position – Memento & Certificate Consolation Prize for Two People – Memento & Certificate How to Register:- Link1 - http://tinyurl.com/cyberstreet Link2 - https://forms.gle/2Lwf7FjqhfXxYwUV8 Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest 2. The submissions received via the MyGov website will be considered for the competition. Contact person for any query - Mr. Hitesh Kumar Arora(hitesh.26482@lpu.co.in)

title: Walmart Global Tech India – Walmart CodeHers 2024 : (2/13/2024)
body: Announcement Reference No. : LPU/DII/IC/240213/001 At Walmart Global Tech, we work at the forefront of cutting-edge technologies inspired by the vision of transforming retail tech. As a people-led and tech-powered organization, we drive innovations that impact millions of lives globally. Our associates empower us with innovative solutions that power the world’s leading retailer, driving digital solutions that keep us resilient and future-ready. Walmart invites students who are graduating in 2024 and 2025 to take part in CodeHers, India’s biggest coding challenge, exclusively for women. CodeHers is your passport to join Walmart Global Tech India and innovate for the Fortune #1 company. Human-led and tech-empowered since 2002, we have created omnichannel shopping experiences for our customers and members across the globe to help them save money and live better. This challenge is an opportunity for young women from engineering colleges across India to land their dream job. Top coders will be shortlisted and interviewed virtually for full-time software development engineering roles and summer internships at Walmart Global Tech India. The roles offered will be based out of Bangalore or Chennai offices. Eligibility Criteria: CodeHers 2024 is open to female students across all engineering colleges in India who are pursuing the following degrees in circuit branches (ECE, EE, EEE, IT, CS): • BE/ B.Tech. full-time programs – Batch of 2024 and 2025 (1st and 2nd-year students are not eligible to apply) • Dual degree full-time program – Batch of 2024 and 2025 (1st/2nd/3rd-year students are not eligible to apply) • ME/ M.Tech. full-time programs – Batch of 2024 and 2025 (2025 graduating batch to be considered for summer internships this year) • Only candidates with a 7+ CGPA are eligible to apply. Any student not meeting this mark will be disqualified. • Participants using multiple IDs to participate will be eliminated from further processes. Last Date to Register : 18th February 2024 - 11:59 PM Rewards: 1. Top 15 students from each graduating batch (2024 and 2025) to get a cash prize of ?30,000. 2. Summer Internships Opportunities 2024 (May – June): • Top Coders from 2025 graduating batch will be offered direct summer internship opportunities at Walmart Global Tech India across our offices in Bangalore and Chennai with a monthly stipend of ?1-1.1 lakh. • Additional perks like your return airfare, two weeks of initial accommodation at the base job location city, additional office facilities and benefits, and an opportunity to learn, connect and collaborate with a talented team. 3. Software Engineering Full-Time Opportunities 2024: • Top Coders from 2024 graduating batch will be contacted by our campus recruitment team for Pre Placement Interviews against relevant opportunities for Software roles at Walmart Global Tech India. • Our software engineering salaries are in the range of ?18-21 lakhs with ?2-3.5 lakhs joining bonus and stock grants up to ?2.5 lakhs. Additional perks like one-way airfare for self and dependents, two weeks of initial accommodation at the base job location city, additional office facilities and benefits, and an opportunity to learn, connect and collaborate with a talented team. How to Register:- Link1 - http://tinyurl.com/Walmartglobal2024 Link2 - https://forms.gle/sGzrAhRsfRFWod3X7 Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest 2. The submissions received via the unstop website will be considered for the competition. Contact person for any query - Mr. Hitesh Kumar Arora(hitesh.26482@lpu.co.in)

title: ‘Dance Movement Therapy’ Workshop'. (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/240213/002) : (2/13/2024)
body: ‘’There are no limits to what you can accomplish, except the limits you place on your thinking ‘’ Brian Tracy Warm Greetings Under the aegis of the Division of Student Relationship – Department of Counselling and Happiness in collaboration with Mr. Avik Chakraborty, a trained classical dancer and a Movement Therapist as the resource person invites Students to participate in a Dance Movement therapy workshop. ‘Dance Movement Therapy’ Workshop This is not a dance class and you don't need to be a professional dancer. Based on the notion that motion and emotion are interconnected. Dance movement therapy is the psychotherapeutic use of movement for personality development. Through this workshop, you will learn that expressing yourself through creative movements can help connect the mind and body. The same endorphins that make you feel better when moving also help you concentrate and sleep better, have more energy, and can help you become more resilient when faced with the mental or emotional challenges of life. This creative expression can also help improve communication skills for better relationships and build confidence. This will also help you deal with feelings of · 1.Anxiety 2. Depression 3.Anger 4.Violence 5.Eating disorders 6.Isolation 7.Low self-esteem and stress You don‘t have to be a dancer to benefit from dance movement therapy. The body can be the key to unlocking profound levels of healing. So Don’t miss this golden opportunity Free Registration Hurry! Register today as seats are limited. Register on the link below! http://tinyurl.com/4e5zzxhf Day & Date: Friday and Saturday 16th & 17th February 2024. Time: 5:00 pm- 6:00 pm Venue: Block 13, Room no – 504 Resource person- Mr. Avik Chakraborty

In these classes, the students shall be extended academic guidance on all the important topics of the courses. The registration for courses for remedial classes offered in this term is available on UMS. The students are required to choose the courses for which remedial classes are required. In this regard the students are required to follow the below stated points:- 1. A student has to choose the course/courses on the interface using the link mentioned below: UMS Navigation ---- Examination System --- Exam Registration---- Recoup/Remedial Class Registration 2. Remedial classes for a course will be planned in a span of 10 Lectures before the scheduled reappear exam and fee per course code is Rs 300 which will be made due in student’s account subject to the availability of registered course for remedial classes. 3. Students are advised to ensure their participation in the registration process so that the remedial classes required by them can be made available for preparation for their pending “E” grades. 4. The interface shall remain available to students till 15th February, 2024. 5. Depending on the count of student registration, these classes shall be conducted in OFFLINE mode by the faculty according to a pre-informed schedule. Classes shall be conducted either from 8 to 9 am or from 5:00 to 6:00 pm. Note: Student has to complete the registration by paying the fee before the start of remedial classes. i. Once registered, fee for that course which will be available for remedial classes (depending on number of students registered) will be made due in your account. ii. Once registered, student will not be allowed to deregister from the remedial classes. body: This is for the information of all students who have been awarded with R grade in Capstone Projects, Dissertations, and similar courses (List attached as Attachment I) in Autumn Term 23241 that the interface for the registration in R grade is active now. The students can register for the R grade by following the below mentioned steps: Step-I- Filling of the Online Registration Form: All students having R grade in the list of courses attached are required to apply online for the registration in R grade and pay the R grade registration fee online via following UMS Path:- UMS Navigation----> Examination System------> Exam Registration------> R grade courses Registration The Last date for R grade registration and fee payment is 18th February (without any late fee) and 28th February 2024 (with late fee of Rs.2000/-). Important points- i) The detailed process (along with the screen shots) of registering and paying the R grade fee is also attached with this announcement as Attachment No- 2. ii) No request of R grade registration shall be entertained after 28th February 2024. Step-II- Uploading Soft Copy of Report After the online registration and paying the requisite fee for the R grade, the students shall be required to upload the soft copy of final report as per the requirement of the course (see attachment 1) by visiting the following UMS path :- UMS Navigation-->LMS-------> Upload Research Project/Internship certificate details->Upload Project Report/Internship certificate The last date to upload soft copies of the report on UMS is 28th February 2024. Step-III- Uploading of Publication details Students can upload their publications in either of SCOPUS/ SCI /WOS/NAAS (rating greater than 5) indexed journal for the courses as per Attachment-1. The publication details can be uploaded by visiting following UMS path :- UMS Navigation -->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details--->Upload Research Project Publication/Copyright details The last date to upload publication details on UMS is 28th February 2024. Important points i) It is expected that the students upload the soft copies of their final report as well as publication details well in advance so that the respective supervisors can recommend the same within the timelines. ii) Mere proof of submission of publication or publication without LPU affiliation will not be considered. iii) Only Published paper or proof of acceptance of the paper (with LPU affiliation) will be considered. ‘ Step-IV- Recommendation of the uploaded soft copy of reports and publication details through respective supervisors The students are also required to get their soft copies of the final reports/publication details recommended by their respective supervisors. The supervisors can visit the following UMS path for the recommendation of the soft copies of the final report and publication details uploaded by their respective students: UMS Navigation------>LMS-------> Project-------> Project file Recommendation The last date to recommend the soft copies of the reports is 29th February 2024. Important points- a) Registration for the R grade shall be considered only after completion of all the above-mentioned steps or else the registration shall be assumed incomplete and F grade shall be awarded. b) R Grade viva schedule shall be communicated to the students via UMS my messages at least 7 days in advance from the ETP viva date. c) In case a student does not register for R grade or misses the report submission as per UMS timelines then R grade viva shall not be conducted and grade would be converted to F grade. d) All the respective supervisors are required to ensure the timely uploading of the soft copies of the final reports/publication details by their students and recommendation of the same within the timelines In case of any query, student may log an RMS using the below mentioned path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request

title: Last date for registration of Additional Tutoring Classes has been extended. (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/240206/002) : (2/6/2024)
body: In an endeavour to help and support students who are facing some academic challenges, Division of Student Relationship makes continuous efforts to initiate support programs and classes. One such academic support initiative “Additional Tutoring” is being introduced for the students. These Classes aim to provide focused academic support to students who may be experiencing difficulties in understanding specific courses of current term or they wish to seek additional academic support for the courses studied by them in previous terms in order to improve their grades. These classes will consist of 40 hours of classes (on payment basis) and will be scheduled flexibly either on weekends or weekdays (between 5-7 PM or 8-9 AM) to accommodate both students and faculty members. Objectives of the model: a. To improve student success rates in topics/subjects that the student might find to be difficult. b. To ensure better understanding of the concepts for the subjects which are crucial for the students in their career pathways. c.To help the students in improving their already existing grades. Important Points: Fees: Students will be required to pay a Rs 1500 for registering in a particular course. Schedule of Classes: Following schedule shall be followed for classe. Last Date of registration Extended till 10th Feb. 2024 Start Date of classes 3rd Week of February, 2024 (tentatively) Course Duration 40 hours/course Class Duration Max. 01 hr on weekdays (between 5-7 PM or from 8-9 AM) and max 03 hrs on weekend/holidays Note: The decision to conduct these tutoring classes for a particular course will be based on the number of student registrations for that course. Students can register for Additional Tutoring classes of a course using path UMS Navigation--->Examination System --->Academic Support--->Additional Tutoring Classes Division of student Relationship (DSR) has already identified a list of courses for Additional Tutoring Classes based on feedback from students. Still if a student needs additional tutoring for a course which student has studied in his/her previous or current term and is currently not available for additional tutoring classes then he/she may submit a request for tutoring classes at the same interface. If a student will register for reappear exam in current semester and also register for tutoring classes then his reappear exam will be scheduled after the completion of additional tutoring classes. title: Submission of applications to the Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC) for conduct of research involving human subjects. : (2/6/2024)
body: This is to inform you that the Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC) meeting is tentatively scheduled for the first week of March 2024. If you are planning to undertake research involving human subjects, their biological fluids, blood/urine samples, or any questionnaire or survey-based studies, you are required to submit the necessary following documents in hard copy to the Administrative Office (Block 4, Room 203), School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Lovely Professional University by 12th Feb, 2024 (4:00 PM) List of documents to be submitted (Format attached in google drive below) 1. Cover letter 2. Application form 3. Short CV of supervisor 4. Informed consent form and patient information sheet 5. Research protocol 6. Questionnaire (if applicable) Additionally, you are required to submit the details of your research proposal through the following links: 1. https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Q3qoP0jepmPYWjC0pkUaarI7DqtH7dLRa25Nta5sMvs/edit?usp=sharing 2.https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScc7AO58ZYmqFt_ZhLWdOjh9D_ckxIr8pBzbi98C4_RSZbcYg/viewform?usp=sf_link A fee of Rs 100 has to be paid in AO office by each LPU Affiliated candidates along with hard copies of the documents before 12th of February. After 12th February 2024, an initial internal review of the submitted application will be done in presence of applicant and suggestions will be provided on spot. Then applicant must incorporate these suggestions in the document within two days and submit the corrected documents in 7 copies duly signed by the supervisor and forwarded by the respective head of the Department/Institution. Applicant also need to prepare and present a Power Point presentation describing the following points on the day of IEC meeting (tentatively scheduled in the first week of March 2024): 1. Title of the proposed work, 2. Brief introduction of the study, including novelty and rationale, 3. Objective, 4. Methodology, 5. Outcome measures, 6. Subjects’ selection, and the potential risk, 7. Patient informed consent form, and information sheet Format for documents to be presented for EC submission is available in following link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CccjTRDl_WDu-b5wBwGL_ZCaVmCXb-rs/view?usp=sharing For any query, please contact: Dr. Navneet Khurana, Member Secretary, Professor, School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Lovely Professional University, Punjab, India. E-mail: ms_ieclpu@lpu.co.in; Mobile: 9888599750 Dr. Kanav Khera, Alternate Member Secretary, Professor, School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Lovely Professional University, Punjab, India. E-mail: ms_ieclpu@lpu.co.in; Mobile: 7889271828

title: Conduct of Remedial Classes for students February-April, 2024 (Ref.No. LPU/DSR/IC/240206/001) : (2/6/2024)
body: In an endeavour to help and support students who are facing some academic challenges and were not able to perform well in their previous examinations, Division of Student Relationship makes continuous efforts to initiate support programs and classes. One such academic support initiative is being introduced for the students who were not able to score well in the end term exams due to any valid reason. They are now being given an opportunity to brush up their concepts and bridge the gap in learning through scheduled Remedial Classes. In these classes, the students shall be extended academic guidance on all the important topics of the courses. The registration for courses for remedial classes offered in this term is available on UMS. The students are required to choose the courses for which remedial classes are required. In this regard the students are required to follow the below stated points:- 1. A student has to choose the course/courses on the interface using the link mentioned below: UMS Navigation ---- Examination System --- Exam Registration ---- Recoup/Remedial Class Registration 2. Remedial classes for a course will be planned in a span of 10 Lectures before the scheduled reappear exam and fee per course code is Rs 300 which will be made due in student’s account subject to the availability of registered course for remedial classes. 3. Students are advised to ensure their participation in the registration process so that the remedial classes required by them can be made available for preparation for their pending “E” grades. 4. The interface shall remain available to students till 10th February, 2023. 5. Depending on the count of student registration, these classes shall be conducted in OFFLINE mode by the faculty according to a pre-informed schedule. Classes shall be conducted either from 8 to 9 am or from 5:00 to 6:00 pm. Note: Student has to complete the registration by paying the fee before the start of remedial classes. i. Once registered, fee for that course which will be available for remedial classes (depending on number of students registered) will be made due in your account. ii. Once registered, student will not be allowed to deregister from the remedial classes. In Case of any query, student may log RMS at UMS Navigation---- RMS--- Log Request--- Student Relationship (DSR) ---- Academic Support--- Recoup/Remedial classes or contact us at 01824-520150.

title: Enroll into JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE offered by Centre for Professional Enhancement : (2/5/2024)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by participating in Judiciary Exam Preparation Course for all those who aspire to become Hon'ble JUDGE. The Judiciary Exam in India is an entry-level exam for law graduates to be appointed as members of the subordinate judiciary. The members are appointed by the state government under the supervision of the respective high court based on the Judiciary exam. The exam is conducted by each state differently, and in total, 24 states in India conduct Judicial Service examinations nearly every year. Through this exam, law graduates can become Civil Judges/Judicial Magistrates in India. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination, Interview. In order to join this JUDICIARY EXAM PREPARATION COURSE, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 15th February 2024. Classes will start from 17th February 2024 and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. title: Registration for Re-appear / Improvement -Mode B (with a provision to improve CA component marks, Applicable from Term 23242). (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/240202/003) : (2/2/2024)
body: To facilitate the students to clear their E grade (Re-appear) courses or improve grade(s) of already cleared courses, an option is being introduced wherein a student shall be able to improve his/her CA component marks along with taking the Re-appear / Improvement ETE exam (having weightage of MTT and ETE components) in the registered courses. Guidelines for registration of Re-appear/improvement- Mode B: 1. For students registered in this mode, CA shall be allocated in form of two tasks for each course which can be in the pattern of test, assignment, project etc. depending on the nature of the course. 2. The best one CA out of two conducted CAs will be considered as final CA marks. 3. Weightage of marks for “Re-appear/improvement- Mode B” shall be: Component Weightage Continuous Assessment (CA) 30 Re-appear/Improvement Examination (ETE) 70 4. The highest grade that can be earned by student under this mode is Grade “A”. 5. Eligibility of courses for “Re-appear/improvement- Mode B”: a. Courses having only theory component can be registered. b. Courses having only practical component, only ETP component or only CA component are not eligible for registration. c. Eligibility of courses as per already existing grade: Already existing grade in course Permissibility for registration E Allowed B+, B, C and D Allowed* O, A+ and A Not applicable (As maximum grade that can be earned by student in this mode is “A”) *In case a student wants to register for improvement of a course, the same can be done within the time period of 2 years of studying the course in regular mode. 6. In case, the grade of student doesn’t improve, then the best existing grade shall prevail. 7. Courses registered in this mode shall be counted towards 5 chances of Re-appear available to the student. In case, a student fails to clear the course registered in this mode in the 5 chances provided to him/her, G grade shall be awarded in that course. 8. For the registered courses, a detailed schedule for CA evaluation and End Term Examination shall be made available to students via UMS seating plan. 9. It is mandatory for student to appear for atleast one of CA evaluations and End Term Examination. In case a student is absent in any evaluation, no option of re-conduct of evaluation shall be provided. 10. Fee for registration of “Re-appear/improvement- Mode B” is Rs. 3000/- per course. 11. Online Registration for “Re-appear/improvement- Mode B” shall be opened on 2nd Feb 2024 and the last date of registration is 20th Feb 2024 12. Students can register for “Re-appear/improvement- Mode B” through the following interface. UMS Navigation ---> Examination System ---> Exam Registration ---> Re-Appear Registration 13. A student can register maximum of 5 courses under this “Re-appear/improvement- Mode B”. Important Dates: Registration Start Date 2nd Feb. 2024 Last Date of registration 20th Feb. 2024 A student can refer the attachment for clarification about Re-appear/improvement with or without CA improvement options. In case of any query, student may log RMS in the mentioned category: Examination -- Reappear/Improvement Registration with CA improvement or student can reach us out at 01824-520150/520099 or visit us in DSR, Block- 32, Room-100.

title: Explore the World with a 100% Scholarship Opportunity! : (2/1/2024)
body: Dear student, Are you eager for an international exposure backed by a 100% scholarship benefit? Here is an incredible opportunity that promises an unmatched experience. At LPU, we are offering exceptional opportunities for students to obtain a 100% scholarship on tuition fees. Imagine a full semester abroad, a chance to get international exposure during your academic journey. Our extensive network spans more than 124 Universities across 41 countries, providing an array of options. Seize this opportunity to elevate your academic and personal growth while creating a standout profile for your future endeavours. This is a golden opportunity to experience, learn, and adjust to a foreign culture, acquire valuable cross-country communication skills, and demonstrate your ability to adapt to challenging environments. Some of the many benefits of the study abroad program: • Academic Enrichment: Exposing students to new areas of study, diverse teaching methodologies and research opportunities • International Transcript & Internationalized CV: Students who study at a foreign university receive an official transcript from the host university that can be used as an advantage in the Curriculum Vitae (CV). 100% scholarship on tuition fee: Students will receive a 100% scholarship on the tuition fee from the foreign University. • International Network and Exposure: The connections you establish during semester exchange will create a global network of professionals, and potential collaborators, enhancing your professional network. • Internship opportunities along with higher studies: Higher studies may lead to wonderful future internship opportunities with the partner University. • Better opportunities for future jobs abroad: Students with a prior international exposure are preferred both at home country or abroad. • Personal Growth: You’ll develop a global mindset, be more adaptive to global challenges, improve self-confidence, and interpersonal skills. • Cultural Immersion: Living and studying in a foreign country will allow you to embrace new customs, traditions, and language. Eligibility and other requirements: • CGPA above 6.5, no backlog or reappear • A valid passport with more than 6 months of expiry remaining • Good attendance record • English Proficiency test (if required) • Capacity to sustain himself/herself overseas while studying (Estimated budget 2.5 lakh to 5 lakh) Second Application deadline: 24th February 2024 To know more register here: https://forms.gle/3EVVEmAEwfvsmbS96 Only 300 seats are available. Register soon! For further information please contact the Division of International Affairs at Block 32-310 or email at study.abroad@lpu.co.in or call at 9501110446/9875928583.

title: AMCAT Diagnostic Assessment for Placement Registered students of 2025 Graduating batch : (1/30/2024)
body: Dear Aspirants, This is to inform you that the Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled AMCAT diagnostic assessment on 4th Feb 2024. This exam is applicable for all 2025 batch placement registered students of MBA /MCA programs and for B.Tech/M.Tech/HM/Pharmacy students who registered for placements services after 25th Oct 2023 or failed to participate in previous assessment conducted on 29th Oct 2023. This assessment is important for you in terms of placement perspective. Good performance in it will play a vital role in creating career opportunities for you. Therefore it is mandatory for all eligible students as per the attached list to participate in the assessment without failure. About AMCAT:AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates on the basis of their core skills which includes reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills. AMCAT is also known as an employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. The objective of the AMCAT exam is to grade the students based on their performance. For more information you can also visit on web link: https://www.myamcat.com. IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS :- AMCAT assessment will be conducted in University premises in offline mode. You are required to bring your laptop and Charger in order to appear in the assessment. :- Seating Plan of the assessment will be shared with you via UMS my messages two days prior to the commencement of assessment. :- Scores of these assessments will be shared with companies visiting for placement drives. Therefore participate in these assessments with full enthusiasm. :- Absence or non serious participation will lead you towards debarment from placement services. :- Assessments login credentials will be shared with you on the day of assessment at your assessment venue.

title: Registration invited for Short Term Course on Research Methodology for Mass Communication and Journalism : (1/30/2024)
body: Research Methodology in Mass Communication and Journalism is like a guide helping us find the truth in the world of media. It's more than just collecting data; it's like an art that helps us understand the stories in society. In this field, using strong methods is important to determine how media changes, how people behave, and how content affects us. Whether we're looking at how digital platforms affect the news we see or studying the cultural impact of choices journalists make, having a good research method is crucial. It helps media professionals navigate challenges and create stories that are trustworthy and meaningful in a world where information is vital for changing society. In this context, the School of Liberal & Creative Arts (Journalism and Mass Communication), in collaboration with HRDC Lovely Professional University is scheduling STC as per the details appended below: Title Short Term Course on Research Methodology for Mass Communication and Journalism Course Outcomes After completion of the course, participants will be able to: Understand the basic concepts and principles of media research and research design. Apply qualitative and quantitative research methods to various media-related issues and problems. Explore the potential and limitations of AI tools for media research, such as natural language processing, computer vision, and machine learning. Use data collection and analysis tools and software, such as SPSS, Excel, R, to conduct and report media research. Conduct a literature review and develop a theoretical framework for their own media research projects . Write and present media research reports and papers in a clear, concise, and professional manner, following the standards and guidelines of high impact journals. Resource Persons 1. Prof. Sisir Basu, Former Professor and Head- Department of Journalism and Mass Communication, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi (Uttar Pradesh) 2. Prof. Pradeep Krishnatray, Professor of Marketing, IFHE University, Hyderabad 3. Prof. Umesh Arya, Former Dean & Head, Faculty of Media Studies in Guru Jambheshwar University of Science & Technology, Hisar (Haryana) 4. Dr. Manvendra Singh- Associate Professor, School of Social Sciences & Languages, Lovely Professional University, Phagwara (Punjab) Program Date and Time 12, Feb (Monday), 2024 to 17 Feb (Saturday), 2024 07:00 pm to 09:00 pm Payment & Mode Rs. 1000/- Cash & Online Registration Link https://www.lpu.in/hrd/ Registration Closes February 09, 2024 (Friday) Since there are limited seats, selection will be on a first-come-first-served basis. Looking forward to your active participation

title: Registration for Additional Tutoring Classes. (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/240129/001) : (1/29/2024)
body: In an endeavor to help and support students who are facing some academic challenges, Division of Student Relationship makes continuous efforts to initiate support programs and classes. One such academic support initiative “Additional Tutoring” is being introduced for the students. These Classes aim to provide focused academic support to students who may be experiencing difficulties in understanding specific courses of current term or they wish to seek additional academic support for the courses studied by them in previous terms in order to imrove their grades. These classes will consist of 40 hours of classes (on payment basis) and will be scheduled flexibly either on weekends or weekdays (between 5-7 PM or 8-9 AM) to accommodate both students and faculty members. Objectives of the model: a. To improve student success rates in topics/subjects that the student might find to be difficult. b. To ensure better understanding of the concepts for the subjects which are crucial for the students in their career pathways. c. To help the students in improving their already existing grades. Important Points: Fees: Students will be required to pay a Rs 1500 for registering in a particular course. Schedule of Classes: Following schedule shall be followed for classes Last Date of registration 5 Feb. 2024 Start Date of classes 1st Week of February, 2024 (tentatively) Course Duration 40 hours/course Class Duration Max. 01 hr on weekdays (between 5-7 PM or from 8-9 AM) and max 03 hrs on weekend/holidays Note: The decision to conduct these tutoring classes for a particular course will be based on the number of student registrations for that course. Students can register for Additional Tutoring classes of a course using path UMS Navigation--->Examination System --->Academic Support--->Additional Tutoring Classes Division of student Relationship(DSR) has already identified a list of courses for Additional Tutoring Classes based on feedback from students. Still if a student needs additional tutoring for a course which student has studied in his/her previous or current term and is currently not available for additional tutoring classes then he/she may submit a request for tutoring classes at the same interface. If a student will register for reappear exam in current semester and also register for tutoring classes then his reappear exam will be scheduled after the completion of additional tutoring classes. In Case of any query, student may contact us at 01824-520150.

body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Picturesque- A Competitive Event on presentation based on photographs”. The event emphasizes on giving students a competitive platform to showcase their creativity and photographic skills with a focus on language. This event will help the students in sharpening their observation and interlacing skills as well as learn the importance of presentation on a public platform. title: Registration for Backlog Courses for Spring Term 2023-24. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/240125/013) : (1/25/2024)
body: To facilitate the students to clear their F/M/G/FAIL grade courses in the spring Term, Session 2023-24, the registration for backlog courses has been started. The classes for courses registered as backlog courses by the students shall be held along with the regular students in offline mode. The interface for Backlog registration shall remain active from 25th Jan 2024 till 05 Feb 2024. Important points regarding the Backlog Registration Process: 1. Link to be followed for registration of backlog courses: UMS Navigation→ Examination system→ Backlog Registration → Backlog Course Registration 2. Grade conversion will be applicable as per table 1 for those courses which have been offered in this Term 2023-24. Table 1 Permissibility of conversions of grades S. No. Existing grade Grade Change permissible Conversion 1. E G Allowed 2. E F Allowed 3. G F Allowed 3. Registration in an additional courses/courses not mapped/not studied by student: A student who is registering for additional courses/courses not mapped/not studied by the students due to Change of Program, Term off/Year off, Re-joining after gap or Migration is marked as “M” grade in result. Student will be required to register the course(s) as F grade. “M” Grade cannot be converted to G grade. 4. Conditions applicable for backlog registration: A. For Continuing students: In addition to the courses for the current regular term of the student, he/she shall be allowed to register in backlog courses if the student has minimum 2.5 CGPA or equivalent percentage (in case of marks based programme). i. If a student wants to register for only F/M/Fail grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of four F/M/Fail grade courses subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. ii. If a student wants to register only G grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of nine G grade courses. iii. A student wants to register both F/M/Fail and G grade courses, he/she can register maximum of nine courses of which maximum of four F/M/Fail grade courses can be registered subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. B. For Non-Promoted students: For student, who is registering only for backlog courses because of the non-promotion to the next year, the following points will be applicable: i. If a student wants to register for only F/M/Fail grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of nine F/M/Fail grade courses subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. ii. If a student wants to register only G grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of thirteen G grade courses. iii. A student wants to register both F/M/Fail and G grade courses, he/she can register maximum of thirteen courses of which maximum of nine F/M/Fail grade courses can be registered subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. iv. If a student has studied more than nine courses in a single term according to program scheme then student may apply for additional backlog courses by putting RMS. RMS link has been shared in the end of this notification. 5. Fee for backlog registration: The student Registration will be confirmed subject to payment of the backlog fee. The backlog fee shall be payable online through the fee payment gateway. i. For National Students including “Asia”: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee plus Rs.350/- as examination fee and should be paid at time of registration through online mode only. ii. For International Students: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee and USD 7 as examination fee and should be paid within 48 hours through University Website as per link: https://www.lpu.in/frmloginaccounts.aspx iii. For scholarship holders or students for whom the fee has been waived off (fully or partly) by the University, the backlog fee will be 1/10th of the standard tuition fee plus examination fee and not the fee after scholarship or waiver. iv. For students admitted to dual and / or integrated programmes, the backlog fee shall be charged after considering whether the course pertains to the lower degree or the higher degree. v. In case a student’s batch has graduated or passed out, the backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee of the programme plus examination fee. vi. For term off and non-promoted students: Backlog fee will be 1/10th of his/her fellow batch’s fee plus examination fee until his/her fellow batch student is studying that program. Backlog fee will be 1/10th of the last term fee plus examination fee paid by his/her fellow batch in case the batch has passed out. vii. Once student has paid the backlog courses fee, courses cannot be de-registered. 6. Attendance Marking: i. Attendance in backlog courses (excluding courses registered with G grade) will be included in the aggregate attendance of the student for the purpose of determining his/her eligibility for appearing in the ETE and for calculating the detention list. ii. Attendance will be counted from very next day of your registration confirmation i.e. after confirmation of your fee payment. 7. Equivalency of Courses: Students are required to ensure that the equivalent course allotted to them have not been previously studied by them. If equivalence course has already been studied by them, then they are required to report the same immediately through RMS using the link shared in the end of this notification. Also, for equivalent courses, the credits of the new course will be applicable. Note: 1. Ensure clash free registration as no change in time table shall be permissible later on. 2. If you're interested in enrolling in a course that is currently unavailable or if the section is at full capacity, please be informed that you can submit your course preferences. The "Preference Filling" tab is accessible on the backlog registration interface for your convenience. Submitted preference shall be considered subject to student strength and/or equivalent course availability. 3. Step by Step guide for using the interface for backlog registration is attached along with these guidelines. All the students are advised to go through the FAQs attached herewith. For further assistance, please: 1. Approach Academic Operations Help Window at 32-102 Window No: 05 (09-05 PM) 2. Log a request in the Relationship Management System (RMS) using the path: UMS Navigation ----> Relationship Management System (RMS) ----> Log Request Select Master Category: Academics Category: Academics Sub Category: Backlog / Summer term Registration

Grade conversion will be applicable as per table 1 for those courses which have been offered in this Term 2023-24. Table 1 Permissibility of conversions of grades S. No. Existing grade Grade Change permissible Conversion 1. E G Allowed 2. E F Allowed 3. G F Allowed 3. Registration in an additional courses/courses not mapped/not studied by student: A student who is registering for additional courses/courses not mapped/not studied by the students due to Change of Program, Term off/Year off, Re-joining after gap or Migration is marked as “M” grade in result. Student will be required to register the course(s) as F grade. “M” Grade cannot be converted to G grade. 4. Conditions applicable for backlog registration: A. For Continuing students: In addition to the courses for the current regular term of the student, he/she shall be allowed to register in backlog courses if the student has minimum 2.5 CGPA or equivalent percentage (in case of marks based programme). i. If a student wants to register for only F/M/Fail grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of four F/M/Fail grade courses subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. ii. If a student wants to register only G grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of nine G grade courses. iii. A student wants to register both F/M/Fail and G grade courses, he/she can register maximum of nine courses of which maximum of four F/M/Fail grade courses can be registered subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. B. For Non-Promoted students: For student, who is registering only for backlog courses because of the non-promotion to the next year, the following points will be applicable: i. If a student wants to register for only F/M/Fail grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of nine F/M/Fail grade courses subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. ii. If a student wants to register only G grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of thirteen G grade courses. iii. A student wants to register both F/M/Fail and G grade courses, he/she can register maximum of thirteen courses of which maximum of nine F/M/Fail grade courses can be registered subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. iv. If a student has studied more than nine courses in a single term according to program scheme then student may apply for additional backlog courses by putting RMS. RMS link has been shared in the end of this notification. 5. Fee for backlog registration: The student Registration will be confirmed subject to payment of the backlog fee. The backlog fee shall be payable online through the fee payment gateway. i. For National Students including “Asia”: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee plus Rs.350/- as examination fee and should be paid at time of registration through online mode only. ii. For International Students: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee and USD 7 as examination fee and should be paid within 48 hours through University Website as per link: https://www.lpu.in/frmloginaccounts.aspx iii. For scholarship holders or students for whom the fee has been waived off (fully or partly) by the University, the backlog fee will be 1/10th of the standard tuition fee plus examination fee and not the fee after scholarship or waiver. iv. For students admitted to dual and / or integrated programmes, the backlog fee shall be charged after considering whether the course pertains to the lower degree or the higher degree. v. In case a student’s batch has graduated or passed out, the backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee of the programme plus examination fee. vi. For term off and non-promoted students: Backlog fee will be 1/10th of his/her fellow batch’s fee plus examination fee until his/her fellow batch student is studying that program. Backlog fee will be 1/10th of the last term fee plus examination fee paid by his/her fellow batch in case the batch has passed out. vii. Once student has paid the backlog courses fee, courses cannot be de-registered. 6. Attendance Marking: i. Attendance in backlog courses (excluding courses registered with G grade) will be included in the aggregate attendance of the student for the purpose of determining his/her eligibility for appearing in the ETE and for calculating the detention list. ii. Attendance will be counted from very next day of your registration confirmation i.e. after confirmation of your fee payment. 7. Equivalency of Courses: Students are required to ensure that the equivalent course allotted to them have not been previously studied by them. If equivalence course has already been studied by them, then they are required to report the same immediately through RMS using the link shared in the end of this notification. Also, for equivalent courses, the credits of the new course will be applicable. Note: 1. Ensure clash free registration as no change in time table shall be permissible later on. 2. If you're interested in enrolling in a course that is currently unavailable or if the section is at full capacity, please be informed that you can submit your course preferences. The "Preference Filling" tab is accessible on the backlog registration interface for your convenience. Submitted preference shall be considered subject to student strength and/or equivalent course availability. 3. Step by Step guide for using the interface for backlog registration is attached along with these guidelines. All the students are advised to go through the FAQs attached herewith. For further assistance, please: 1. Approach Academic Operations Help Window at 32-102 Window No: 05 (09-05 PM) 2. Log a request in the Relationship Management System (RMS) using the path: UMS Navigation ----> Relationship Management System (RMS) ----> Log Request Select Master Category: Academics Category: Academics Sub Category: Backlog / Summer term Registration

title: Logo Design Competition for National Dam Safety Authority (NDSA) : (1/25/2024)
body: Logo Design Competition for National Dam Safety Authority (NDSA) Announcement Ref. No. - LPU/DII/IC/240125/001 National Dam Safety Authority a Department of Water Resources, RD & GR in collaboration with MyGov, invites citizens of India to design a suitable logo for the Authority that is commensurate with the mandate assigned to the Authority. The objective of the Logo Designing Competition is to reach out to the citizens of India through creative mediums and on a large scale public participation to create awareness about the National Dam Safety Authority. Last Date To Participate- FEB 14, 202423:45 PM IST (GMT +5.30 Hrs) Eligibility- 1. Preferred file format: jpg, png. 2. Maximum dimensions: 1000 x 1000 pixels 3. Should be designed on the digital platform. 4. Essential Editions: A full-color version and a black-and-white version. 5. Participants must provide open files/vector formats (AI, EPS, etc.) when requested. 6. The winner must provide the original open-source file of the designed logo. 7. The logo should appear clearly when viewed at 100% of the screen (not pixelated or bit-mapped). 8. Entries should not be submitted in compressed or self-extracting formats. 9. Logo designs should not be imprinted or watermarked. 10. All fonts should be converted to outline/curve. 11. The text used in the logo design should be in Hindi/English only. 12. Participants must attach a note explaining (in brief) the appropriateness of the designed logo in relation to the objective of the National Dam Safety Authority. Logo Theme- 1. The goal of a logo is to establish a powerful and recognizable visual identity. This should summarize the objective of the prestigious National Dam Safety Authority. 2. The logo should preferably depict the essence functions and objectives of NATIONAL DAM SAFETY AUTHORITY. 3. The logo should be versatile/attractive and scalable/realistic so that it can be used effectively to enhance the message and impact of the organization. 4. Logo should be usable on websites/social media such as Twitter/Facebook, press releases, and on printable such as stationery, signage, labels, etc., magazines, advertisements, holdings, standees, posters, brochures, leaflets, pamphlets, souvenirs and other promotional and marketing materials to promote the National Dam Safety Authority. Awards- 1) Rs 25,000/- (Rupees twenty-five thousand only) and a certificate from NDSA, Ministry of Jal Shakti, Department of Water Resources, RD &GR. Registration Details- Link 1 : https://www.mygov.in/task/logo-design-competition-national-dam-safety-authority-ndsa/ Link 2 : https://forms.gle/wh7Yc5rWiWFuHKh88 Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest 2. The submissions received via the MyGov website will be considered for the competition. 3. To understand more about NDSA and its functions, participants may go through the Dam Safety Act, 2021 available at https://jalshakti-dowr.gov.in/acts. For any query Call/Whatsapp- Ms. Nayan Pandey (7906160507)
