title: Today is the last date to Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (1/25/2024)
body: Dear Aspirants Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. title: Researcher's Toolkit: A Short-Term Course on LaTeX, Overleaf, Mendeley and Seaborn for Sustainable Research : (1/22/2024)
body: Registration is invited for Researcher's Toolkit: A Short Term Course on LaTeX, Overleaf, Mendeley and Seaborn for Sustainable Research. A six day workshop which provides a comprehensive overview of essential tools for efficient and professional academic research. The details of this workshop are appended below: Title Researcher's Toolkit: A Short-Term Course on LaTeX, Overleaf, Mendeley and Seaborn for Sustainable Research Course Outcome The Program aims at capacity building in: · 1. In LaTex, participants will gain, learn to create professional documents, including academic papers, thesis, reports, utilize LaTeX packages and templates for customization, formatting, and creating aesthetically pleasing documents. · 2. In Overleaf, participants will understand the Overleaf platform for collaborative LaTeX editing in real-time, suitable for both beginners and experts. · 3. In Mendeley, participants will understand a reference manager tool for organizing and citing research papers, articles, and other documents. 4. In Seaborn, participants will learn statistical data visualization library built on top of Matplotlib, focusing on creating informative and attractive visualizations. Resource Person(s) 1. title: Explore the World with a 100% Scholarship Opportunity! : (1/19/2024)
body: Dear student, Are you eager for an international exposure backed by a 100% scholarship benefit? Here is an incredible opportunity that promises an unmatched experience. At LPU, we are offering exceptional opportunities for students to obtain a 100% scholarship on tuition fees. Imagine a full semester abroad, a chance to get international exposure during your academic journey. Our extensive network spans more than 124 Universities across 41 countries, providing an array of options. Seize this opportunity to elevate your academicnd personal growth while creating a standout profile for your future endeavours. This is a golden opportunity to experience, learn, and adjust to a foreign culture, acquire valuable cross-country communication skills, and demonstrate your ability to adapt to challenging environments. Some of the many benefits of the study abroad program: · Academic Enrichment: Exposing students to new areas of study, diverse teaching methodologies and research opportunities · International Transcript & Internationalized CV: Students who study at a foreign university receive an official transcript from the host university that can be used as an advantage in the Curriculum Vitae (CV). 100% scholarship on tuition fee: Students will receive a 100% scholarship on the tuition fee from the foreign University. · International Network and Exposure: The connections you establish during semester exchange will create a global network of professionals, and potential collaborators, enhancing your professional network. · Internship opportunities along with higher studies: Higher studies may lead to wonderful future internship opportunities with the partner University. · Better opportunities for future jobs abroad: Students with a prior international exposure are preferred both at home country or abroad. · Personal Growth: You’ll develop a global mindset, be more adaptive to global challenges, improve self-confidence, and interpersonal skills. · Cultural Immersion: Living and studying in a foreign country will allow you to embrace new customs, traditions, and language. Eligibility and other requirements: · CGPA above 6.5, no backlog or reappear · A valid passport with more than 6 months of expiry remaining · Good attendance record · English Proficiency test (if required) · Capacity to sustain himself/herself overseas while studying (Estimated budget 2.5 lakh to 5 lakh) First Application deadline: 24th January 2024 To know more register here: https://forms.gle/3EVVEmAEwfvsmbS96 Only 300 seats are available. title: Supervisor Polling for Project/Dissertation Courses (Spring Term 2023-24) (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/240116/003 : (1/16/2024)
body: In the process of supervisor allocation, the first step i.e. online creation of student groups (Attachment I) for project courses of Spring term 23242 has been completed. The next step in this process involves interaction of students (group in capstone or individual in dissertation) with the supervisor according to their research interest. To facilitate this process, following interfaces have been activated. a) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) b) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) a) Capstone/Dissertation Supervisor Information: All students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date which will help to choose the supervisor judiciously. The students are required to visit the following UMS path to check the details of available supervisors as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information Students are required to start interacting with their prospective supervisors for group formulation and get online consent up to 18th January 2024. Important Points- 1) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of supervisors and contact them via LPU live app/phone/ email or any suitable medium timely so as to select the supervisor of required specialization. 2) The students must approach the supervisors in groups, as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. 3) The student in groups can approach different supervisors till they get the supervisor of their desired specialization. In case the selected supervisor has already taken the maximum groups then students should approach another supervisor until the finalization of supervisor. 4) If a group has not approached any of the available supervisors till the activity deadline, then the random allocation of supervisors shall be done as per the availability. b) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is mutual agreement between the students and the supervisor, then the supervisors can take groups (in case of capstone projects) or can take student individually (in case of dissertations) by entering the registration number of student(s) through their UMS. The stepwise process to add student/group is given attachment II The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 20th January 2024. title: Tiny House 2023 Architecture Competition : (1/10/2024)
body: Announcement Reference No. - LPU/DII/IC/240110/001 Tiny House 2023 Architecture Competition: Volume Zero invites each one of you to participate in the 22nd edition of our architectural competitions and the 4th edition of Tiny House Architecture Competition. This year’s Tiny House aims to celebrate individuality, reimagine sustainability and to exalt simple, innovative yet resourceful living. The Tiny House Movement is also a platform that not only explores the avenues of ‘mobile’ or ‘Off the Grid’ Living spaces but also the freedom and independence they would offer. Come be a part of this movement; join a new wave of habitat designers! Eligibility Criteria : Participants are to design a Tiny House for 2 people that would provide a comfortable living space. The design of the Tiny House should be innovative and creative with a sustainable edge. The area of the proposed Tiny House should not exceed 300 sq. ft., where mobility is a vital factor. The house need not have the ability to transfer itself from place to place; it could be treated as a unit or an assembly of units that can be towed/moved easily by a car or a pickup truck. However, the participants can avoid the issue of mobility altogether by choosing a permanent site and providing a strong justification for the same. The relation between the exterior surroundings and the interior spaces must be taken into consideration in cases of both fixed and changeable sites. The proposed design should be well-conceptualized and is required to be off the grid as much as possible. This Competition is open to everyone. Instructions: The Interior Spaces should include the following: • Living Area • Toilet space • Sleeping Area for 2 • Workspace • Cooking and Dining Area • Recreational spaces • Any other function that the participant wishes to add to habitat SITE: The participants can choose a site according to their design proposals. The location can be either an urban or a rural area anywhere across the world. The design should be integrated well with the selected site and the selected site must strongly justify the design proposal. Last Date to Register: 24-01-2024 – 11:59 pm Rewards: Prizes of total USD 4500 broken down as follows: · 1st Prize: USD 2000 · 2nd Prize: USD 1200 · 3rd Prize: USD 800 · Student Award: USD 500 Registration Details : How to Register:- Link 1 - https://volumezerocompetitions.com/ Link 2:- studentscompetitions.com/competitions-for-students/ Link 3:- https://forms.gle/xyT4vQxwzzmnRWFeA Note:- 1. title: Important Instructions for examination. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/240105/002) : (1/5/2024)
body: All students appearing in the ETE (Term 2) of MBA Modular program are strictly instructed to adhere to the following instructions for the upcoming examination. 1. All students must carry a clearly legible University ID Card. If the ID card is not clear (i.e. photograph or details are not visible clearly), then the student must have the examination admit card and keep the same ready for inspection (Before the exam) 2. No student should carry any electronic gadget such as mobile phone, wired or wireless earphones/headphones, or smart-watches. Anyone carrying the same will be asked to leave the examination center, and a UMC case will be registered for the same. Note: - No additional time or any other form of relaxation or benefit shall be given to such students to manage their device's safe-keeping. Students must not indulge in any form of argument with the staff on duty. Violating the code of conduct of examination shall invite disciplinary action. 3. Please remove all written materials and belongings like (bags, mobile phones, smart watches, books, written material, notes, and any other electronic gadgets, etc.) and check your pockets thoroughly to remove any paper-related materials to avoid UMC (Unfair means cases). Only stationery materials, University ID cards, and Examination Admit Card are allowed. 4. DO NOT write anything on the question paper except the registration number. Writing on any surface, such as skin or clothes, is prohibited and shall invite disciplinary action and an Unfair means case (UMC). 5. CHECK THE COURSE CODE AND PAPER CODE THOROUGHLY BEFORE THE START OF EXAMINATION:- Please ensure the question paper given to you is of the correct course code. For OMR-based paper, please make sure that the paper code on the question paper matches the OMR sheet. If you attempt the wrong question paper code or incorrect course code, the paper will not be evaluated, and no second chance will be given. Also no replacement of question paper will be made after the start of exam. 6. If you have a contagious infection that can impact the health of students and staff, please inform the examination staff before-hand. In this case, you are not allowed to appear for the examination. You will be given another chance to appear for the same on submission of a valid medical certificate in 32-101A (Examination Window). 7. All students are required to strictly adhere to the gate opening and closing times as mentioned in the table below. Gate Opening Time of block/ Entry start 08:30am Gate closing time of block /Entry close 09:15am All Students must reach in the exam room as per reporting time mentioned in the seating plan tab of students ums LOGIN. IMPORTANT NOTE: Further, all students are hereby informed that if anyone is found involved in any act that amounts to an "Unfair Means Case", then his/her university scholarship shall stand canceled for the rest of the programme duration along with a penal action as per the university regulations. Note: - All students should note that in case they fail to abide by the above-mentioned instructions, then disciplinary action may be initiated against them.

title: National Commission for Women (NCW) Logo Competition. : (1/3/2024)
body: Description Announcement Ref. No. - LPU/DII/IC/240103/001 National Commission for Women (NCW) in collaboration with MyGov is excited to invite creative minds and design enthusiasts to participate in this competition and to design a fresh and impactful that will serve a visual identity for NCW, symbolizing its commitment to promoting gender equality and championing the rights of women across diverse backgrounds. Last Date To Participate 22-Jan-2024 Registration Details Link 1 : https://www.mygov.in/task/ncw-logo-competition/ Link 2 : http://tinyurl.com/4t3yfhdp (Its mandatory to registered on both the links) Eligibility Technical Parameter: 1) The participant should submit a high-resolution (600 dpi) image of the logo in JPEG, PNG, BMP, or TIFF SVG formats only. 2) The logo should be distinctive and scalable. The logo should be usable on the website/ social media such as Twitter/ Facebook, press releases, and on printable such as stationery, signage, labels, etc., magazines, commercials, holdings, standees, posters, brochures, leaflets, pamphlets, souvenirs, and other publicity and marketing material for the creating awareness of NCW working. 3) The winner shall be required to provide the original open-source file of the designed logo. 4) The logo should look clean (not pixelated or bit-mapped) when viewed on-screen at 100%. 5) Entries should not be submitted in compressed or self-extracting formats. 6) The logo design should not be imprinted or watermarked. 7) All fonts should be converted to Outlines/Curves. 8) Texts used in the logo design should be bilingual (Hindi & English). 9) The logo should be aligned with NCW’s existing official logo and the design should include the artistic elements/expression of Women's Empowerment. Awards The Best Entry will be rewarded with a Cash prize of Rs. 50,000 and a certificate of appreciation. For any query please contact Mr. Mohit Dhawan at 9878315193 (Call/Whatsapp)

title: Commencement of one-hour weekly interaction slots for the Spring term 2324-2. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/231229/001) : (12/29/2023)
body: This is for the information of all the Ph.D. Scholars that the Spring Term 2324-2 (Jan-Jul 2024) for all continuing batches of Ph.D. Programmes shall commence from 10th January 2024. In this context, we advise Ph.D. Scholars to coordinate with their respective supervisors for fixation of one-hour weekly interaction slots that mutually suits both of them. In this regard portal has been opened for your supervisors to fix the interaction slots until January 5th, 2024. Please ensure that your interaction slots are fixed on or before January 5th, 2024. Attendance for all scholars shall be counted from the 10thJanuary 2024 and therefore it is important for all Ph.D. scholars that interaction slots must not be missed as it will lead to their academic loss which in turn may prohibit them from appearing in the upcoming evaluations. Following points are for your consideration. 1. For all Full-Time Ph.D. research scholars, the interaction time slot will be once every week and will be conducted offline at the LPU campus as per their timetable. 2. Interaction slots for full-time scholars who are collaborating with their co-supervisor outside of LPU will be conducted in online mode through LPU-MyClass interface. 3. For all Part-Time Ph.D. research scholars, the interaction time slot will be conducted online on the LPU-MyClass platform as per their timetable, which will be scheduled twice a month. 4. For all Part-Time Ph.D. research scholars, the attendance will be recorded by the LPU-MyClass based on the duration for which the supervisor and scholar are present throughout the interaction time slot. Therefore, we suggest the Ph.D. scholars to be present throughout the interaction time slot and ensure the high speed internet connectivity. 5. Interaction slots for part-time Ph.D. scholars, who are also employed as faculty or staff at LPU, will be conducted in-person (offline) mode. 6. If any Full-time Ph.D. scholar is on sanctioned duty leave exceeding 30 days, their Interaction slots will be conducted online through the LPU-MyClass interface. In case of any query please log an RMS using the below mentioned UMS path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Department: Centre for Research Degree Programme Category : Supervisor Related queries

body: CRDP is thrilled to announce a remarkable opportunity for our Ph.D. scholars in the International Co-Supervision Program, in collaboration with University of Huddersfield, United Kingdom. Collaborator Profile: Our collaborator, based at University of Huddersfield, United Kingdom, is an esteemed professional with an impressive academic record. With over 2,375 Scopus-indexed citations and an impressive h-index of 25, he brings a wealth of knowledge and experience to the table. His contributions to research and academia have made a significant impact, and we are fortunate to have him as part of this collaboration. Opportunity Details: We are specifically seeking Ph.D. scholars from the inorganic chemistry, coordination chemistry, ligand design and optical spectroscopy (uv-vis, luminescence) background to participate in this unique program. This is a fantastic chance to engage with a distinguished collaborator and gain valuable insights into your research. How to Apply: Interested scholars are invited to express their interest by January 4th, 2024. To apply, please ensure you submit the complete application via UMS→Navigation→Research and Development→International Research Program Kindly find the attached Research profile of the collaborator and steps of application. title: The Eurodec Paints Award for Excellence in Research 2023 (for Ph.D. Scholars) (Ref. No. LPU/CRDP/IC/231220/001) : (12/20/2023)
body: We are excited to introduce The Eurodec Paints Award for Excellence in Research 2023 (for Ph.D. Scholars) at Lovely Professional University (LPU), sponsored by Eurodec Paints, a leading industry. This award aims to recognize and reward outstanding scholars who have made significant contributions in their respective fields of study. Award Details: The award will grant three prizes, with each recipient receiving INR 50,000 and a certificate. Eligibility Criteria: i.Scholars who are pursuing Ph.D. on a full-time basis, who are currently registered in the program and have received a recommendation for at least one End Term Presentation. ii.For Individuals who have completed their Ph.D. within the timeframe spanning from August 1st, 2022 to November 30th, 2023 in full-time mode are also eligible to submit their applications. iii.This award is open to scholars from the following disciplines meeting the eligibility criteria specified in clauses (i) or (ii): a.Chemistry and Chemical Engineering Domain from School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences b.School of Bio-Engineering and Bio-Sciences Note: Previous winners of Tynor Award for Excellence in Research are not eligible to apply. Selection Process: Scholars will be evaluated based on the specified criteria outlined in the attached Annexure-I as part of the application process. These criteria encompass a range of factors, such as impactful publications, patent submissions, citation metrics, research accolades, industry engagement, and addressing societal concerns. Application Process and Deadline: i.All the interested scholars can email the completely filled application form (Annexures-II to VII) attached in the announcement to oriza.28891@lpu.co.in ii.Last date of the application is 31st Dec 2023. For further query, Ph.D. research scholars may log an RMS at link mentioned below: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request---> Department [Ph.D. (Centre for Research Degree Programmes)] -- > Category [International Research Exchange Program/International Co-Supervision Program]

title: Session on Women Empowerment by SERVICENOW (12/20/2023)
body: Division of Career Services, LPU is going to organize a “Session on Women Empowerment by SERVICENOW”. People's lives in the workplace are improved by ServiceNow. IT used to assist the business, but today the business is all about digital transformation. With its headquarters in Santa Clara, California, ServiceNow, Inc. is an American software firm that creates cloud computing platforms that assist businesses in managing digital processes for enterprise operations. Fred Luddy founded ServiceNow in 2003. It is a component of the Russell 1000 Index and S&P 500 Index and is listed on the New York Stock Exchange. It was ranked first on Forbes magazine's list of the most innovative businesses in the world in 2018. The main objectives of the event are: To build the capacities of women and young girls on the peace-building process, leadership, skill improvement. To engage the students and develop strategic networks and opportunities for collaborative women’ working in tech world. To empower the abilities and status of women in society. title: Post-PhD Research Opportunity in U.S. Industries (Ref. No. LPU/CRDP/IC/231218/002) : (12/18/2023)
body: We are thrilled to present a unique and promising opportunity at a research organization in U.S.A for the Ph.D. scholars working in the field of Forensic Sciences, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Zoology, Bioinformatics, Molecular Biology and Genetic Engineering, and Biotechnology. This position not only offers an exceptional compensation package but also provides a unique chance to contribute to cutting-edge research within a dynamic and forward-thinking organization. Position Details:- ·Eligibility: Scholars who have completed the pre-submission of their thesis or are intending to submit their thesis by the year 2024 are eligible to apply. ·Field: Forensic Sciences, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Zoology, Bioinformatics, Molecular Biology and Genetic Engineering, and Biotechnology. ·Location: United States of America ·Compensation: Competitive and commensurate with experience. Application Instructions To be considered for this position, kindly submit the following documents: 1.Resume/Curriculum Vitae (CV): Present a comprehensive overview of your academic and professional background, encompassing research experience, skills, and publications. 2.Research Proposal: Submit a proposal on the topic/domain you wish to explore. Ensure that your research proposal is endorsed by your supervisor before submission. Keep plagiarism levels below 10%. Please have your supervisor forward an email containing both documents to Dr. Oriza Kamboj (UID 28891) via LPU-eMail Dashboard no later than 25th December, 2023. These documents are crucial in evaluating your qualifications and suitability for the position. We appreciate your attention to detail and adherence to the specified guidelines during the application process. For further query, Ph.D. research scholars may log an RMS at link mentioned below: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request---> Department [Ph.D. (Centre for Research Degree Programmes)] -- > Category [International Research Exchange Program/International Co-Supervision Program]

title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (12/18/2023)
body: Dear Aspirants Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. title: LPU Global: Start your application under the credit transfer (2+2) option : (12/16/2023)
body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for students who want to get an international degree by getting transferred to partner foreign Universities in USA, Canada, Australia, UK, New Zealand, Latvia, Lithuania & Dubai under the credit transfer program. Under the credit transfer program, the students will be doing part of their studies at LPU and the rest of their studies at a foreign university. After successful completion of the program in the foreign University the student will eventually get a degree from the foreign partner university. Benefits: 1. Cost Effective- Students can save 50% of the money as they would be paying 2 years’ fees only rather than 4 years’ fees 2. Opportunity to be a global citizen 3. Students may be allowed to work 20 hours per week while studying as per the different country regulations. 4. Students can easily cover their living expenses with earnings from a part-time job. 5. Students may get PSWR (Post Study Work Rights) after successful completion of the program at a foreign University Eligibility: 1. 6.5 CGPA and above with no backlogs and reappearances at the time of application. 2. No pending cases of indiscipline 3. IELTS score of 6.5 band overall not less than 6 in each module (Possibility of Waiver in UK Universities). 4. Enough funds to sustain yourself at the foreign University. 5. Students of the 2022 Batch in the case of Bachelor and 2023 batch in the case of Master. Interested students must fill out the form: https://forms.gle/Wa2LcYRW4ntZ6hng7 For further information please contact the Division of International Affairs at 32-310 or email at studyabroad@lpu.co.in or call at +91-9780036427 or +91-9814222337

body: Dear Aspirants Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by attending CDS and AFCAT Comprehensive Preparation Course. title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (12/15/2023)
body: Dear Aspirants Centre for Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. The LPU Literary Society warmly invites you for the registrations of the prestigious Bharatiya Chatra Sansad going to be held at MIT-WPU Campus, Pune, commencing on 10th, 11th & 12th January 2024 respectively. STUDENT SELECTION PROCESS In every session of 13th BCS, student speakers will get an opportunity to present their views through a 3 minutes' speech. Following is a selection process: 1) Register for 13th BCS 2) Record your 3 minutes' speech on any one of the given topics 3) Email your recorded speech to sog@mitwpu.edu.in before 15th December 2023. 4) Shortlisted students will be called for an audition to Pune on 8th/9th January 2024 5) Final List of selected student speakers will be declared on the evening of 9th January 2024. For detailed information and registrations, visit : https://registration.bharatiyachhatrasansad.org/ Google Form Registrations - https://tinyurl.com/lpubcs-2024 LAST DATE OF REGISTRATIONS - 13th December, 2023 It is therefore mandatory to fill in the google form after registrations. Entries Open to All! For further queries- Ms. Vaishali Kalra: +91 70097 47963 Ms. Arokiya Philo: +91 6374417814 We eagerly anticipate your participation and the demonstration of your knowledge. body: This is for the information of all students that the registration process for the Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles has been started on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2023- 24. The Last date to apply for the scholarship is 31st December 2023. The students can apply for the above scholarship scheme on the NSP scholarship portal from the link mentioned below:- Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in A brief summary of the eligibility criteria for applying to PMSS is given below. For full eligibility criteria, please refer the UMS path UMS Navigation ---> Scholarship Management System ---> Scholarship Policies ---> Session 2023-24 ---> Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles. 1. Wards/widows of deceased CAPFs & AR personnel died in harness/election duty, wards of personnel disabled due to causes attributable to Government service and Wards of Ex-CAPFs & AR personnel in receipt of Gallantry Awards. 2. Wards/widows of retired and serving CAPFs & AR Personnel (Personnel below Officer Rank) pursuing first professional degree programme in the field of Engineering, BBA, BCA, B. Pharma, B.SC (Agriculture etc.), MBA and MCA etc. (For details related to the programme, the enclosed guidelines may be referred). 3. Having minimum 60% marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 10+2/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent in case of new applicant. Students admitted in 2nd year of technical/professional Bachelor Degree Course (BE / B. Tech. etc.) through lateral entry after completion of Diploma courses are eligible. 5. Students availing benefits of other scholarship scheme/ getting stipend and financial assistance are not eligible. 3. Students already availed scholarship under PMSS scheme are not eligible. title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (12/5/2023)
body: Dear Aspirants Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. title: Oratory Odyssey - A Debate Competition to showcase rational thinking and effective communication : (12/2/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Oratory Odyssey - A Debate Competition to showcase rational thinking and effective communication”. The event aims to promote critical thinking and the ability to articulate and defend ideas. Debate will enhance communication and public speaking skills of students. Confidence will be boosted, time management will be mastered, and the ability to persuade and negotiate effectively will be developed. Participants will enhance their research skills including information gathering and source evaluation. The main objectives of the event are: · To build critical thinking by encouraging participants to analyse information and construct well-reasoned arguments. · To enhance research skills, empowering participants to conduct thorough investigations and apply evidence effectively in support of their positions. · To provide a comprehensive learning experience, preparing participants for academic, professional, and personal challenges. · To improve confidence as public speaking can be intimidating and debate provides an environment to participants to overcome their fear of speaking in front of large audience. Target audience: The students of all the schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 7th December, 2023 Time: 04:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 28-208 Resource Person: Mr. Ujjwal Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/OratoryodysseyCompetition

body: Center for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct "Bilingual Blend - A workshop on active listening ". It suggests an approach that incorporates the use of two languages. The event will introduce the concept of active listening and its importance in effective communication. The workshop will explore the positive outcomes of active listening such as improved relationships, better problem-solving and increased empathy. The workshop aims to encourage participants to reflect on what they have learned and create action plans for incorporating active listening into their daily lives, considering the bilingual context. The main objectives of the event are: · To improve speaking, gain confidence, and boost creativity. · To enhance communication and public speaking skills. · To develop confidence and critical thinking abilities. title: Registration invited for Short Term Course on Research Methodology and Statistical Design of Experiments : (11/30/2023)
body: Registration is invited for Short Term Course on Research Methodology and Statistical Design of Experiments by School of Bioengineering and Biosciences and Human Resource Development Center, LPU. The Goal of this Professional Development Program is to understand the statistical design of scientific experiments. The primary focus will be on data generated through research will be explored, analyzed and discussed. Fundamental concepts of experimental design will be used to write unique statistical models describing the scientific experiments. Title Short Term Course on Research Methodology and Statistical Design of Experiments Course Outcome Upon completion of the professional development course, the participants will be able to: * define research problem, develop an approach to research problem and selection of suitable research design * impart capabilities for formulation and testing of hypothesis based on the nature of research * comprehend appropriateness of statistical software packages for analyzing research data * common statistical designs used in research Resource Persons Dr. Chander K. Shahi is Dean, Faculty of Graduate Studies Professor, Faculty of Natural Resources Management at Lake Head University, Canada Date December 18 to December 23, 2023 (Mon-Sat) Time 02:00 - 05:00 P.M. Registration Fee per Participant LPU Research Scholar / Faculty / Alumni- Rs. 1050/- External Participants- Rs. 1500/- Registration Link https://www.lpu.in/hrd/ Registration Closes December 16, 2023 Venue Block 32 Room No 413 Since there are limited seats, selection will be on a first-come-first-served basis. Looking forward to your active participation

title: Think Beyond Jobs: A Webinar on developing entrepreneur mindset and thinking beyond jobs : (11/30/2023)
body: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, Club “The Code Breakers” is going to conduct an online workshop on “Think Beyond Jobs: A Webinar on developing entrepreneur mindset and thinking beyond jobs”. The workshop will help the students learn to think beyond just getting jobs and look at the bigger picture. In addition, students will get to know how to think like an entrepreneur and how to bring their innovative ideas to life. Moreover, in the webinar students will gain an understanding of how one becomes a successful businessman without having any business background or high-level contacts to help them. This will result the students to gain confidence and come up with their own creative ideas. Also, it will help them clear their doubts and confusion about the business world and have a more independent approach towards their careers. The webinar will be hosted by sir Pritam Prasun, who will share his experience with the students. The main objectives of the event are: · To motivate students to identify their skills, interests, and values to explore alternative career options. · To help students learn about the tools and resources available to navigate the gig economy and freelancing. · To encourage students to develop a personalized career plan that aligns with their passions and aspirations. Target audience: The students of Computer Science Engineering & Computer Application will participate in the event. Date: 4th December, 2023 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Online Resource Person: Ms. Arohi Khajuria Register at link: https://tinyurl.com/ThinksBeyondJobsWebinar

title: Change of program for the Fresher Students (Batch-2023) (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/231129/001) : (11/29/2023)
body: This is to notify all Fresher students that they can now apply for a Change of Program using the online interface available at the following link: UMS Navigation -->Change of Program--> Request for Change of Program. However, the students should meticulously go through the guidelines (attached with this communication) before applying for the same. Timelines for change of Program:- Phase Processing Fee From To I Rs.1000/- 30th November, 2023 31st December, 2023 II Rs.3000/- 1st January, 2024 21st January, 2024 III Rs.5000/- 22nd January, 2024 8th February, 2024 No program change option will be allowed after the last date i.e. 8th February, 2024 under any circumstances. Important Note:- 1. All students who apply for change of program shall be required to pay the “processing fee” online after submitting their request (Screenshot attached) along with the parent’s consent letter/undertaking form for PhD which shall be duly signed by them. (Note: - The processing fee is non-refundable even if the change of program request of student is not approved by competent authorities) 2. The program of the student shall be changed for the notified students (approved cases) after the payment of change of program fee (Rs 4000/-) within the given timelines and the final approval of the competent authorities. 3. In case student fails to pay the fee as per timelines, the approval for the Change of Program shall stand cancelled and he/she would be required continue in the ongoing program only. 4. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old program after approval of Change of Program. 5. Due to course mapping if student is allocated additional courses to study to complete the requirements of the new program he/she will have to register the courses as backlog by paying the 1/10th of the tuition fee (per course) without any scholarship. 6. Only one chance is given to the students for change of program during the entire program duration, hence the students are advised to be very careful while availing this chance. 7. No benefit of missed CA or Attendance will be given to the student applying for change of program after start of classes. To avoid this, students are strongly advised to apply for the change of program before the start of the term. 8. The attendance shall be calculated from the date of registration of student in new program. Any queries from students can directly login an RMS following the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS)---->Log Reques Master category: Academics Category: Academics Sub Category: Change of Program

title: Introduce and Impress - A workshop on self - introduction : (11/29/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Introduce and Impress - A workshop on self - introduction”. The workshop will emphasize giving students a platform to learn how to introduce themselves to new people and how to be confident and comfortable in social situations. This event will help student’s learning experiences, social interactions, and social-emotional learning. It will enhance engagement, and connection, contributing to a positive and enriching educational journey. They will increase self-confidence and much-needed social skills. It will also help in their language and vocabulary skills. By following the tips and steps of self-introduction, students can improve their presentation skills and also leave a powerful impression in their first introduction. Participating in the event will encourage them to share personal information, making it easier for them to connect with their peers. Talking about oneself can be challenging, mostly because you do not know where to focus, which characteristics to highlight, and what exactly makes a so-called, impressive self -introduction, so all those tips and tricks to make an impressive self-introduction can be learned and acknowledged by students through this event. The main objectives of the event are: · To help the students to strengthen their ability to introduce themselves. · To enhance student's communication skills and sharpen their presentation skills. · To increase the confidence levels in the students and encourage them to build a favourable and impactful impression on the people. title: A Workshop on Introduction to Paraphrasing and its Application in Academic Writing : (11/23/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “A Workshop on Introduction to Paraphrasing and its Application in Academic Writing”.The workshop emphasizes on giving students training about the Paraphrasing - the process of rephrasing a text in its own words while retaining the original meaning and steps that can be followed to paraphrase effectively and its application in academic writing. This workshop will help the students in strengthening their writing skills. This will increase their confidence to write specific content and by using synonyms, converting voices and citation. The workshop will also give hands-on experience about paraphrasing where students will learn and know its implementation. The main objectives of the event are: · To develop a clear understanding of what paraphrasing is and its importance in academic and professional writing. · To emphasize the importance of paraphrasing as a tool for avoiding plagiarism and maintaining academic and professional integrity. · To provide strategies for varying sentence structures to create paraphrased content that is distinct from the original. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 30th November, 2023 Time: 01:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 55A-501 Resource Person: Dr.Sadaf Jan Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/WorkshopOnParaphrasing

title: Logo design for the National mSeva AppStore : (11/22/2023)
body: Announcement Reference No.- LPU/DII/IC/231122/002 mSeva AppStore (www.apps.mgov.gov.in) is India’s first indigenously developed AppStore by C-DAC Mumbai under the guidance of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) that is available for hosting citizen-centric mobile apps Under the vision of Our Hon’ble PM’s ‘Atmanirbhar Bharat Mission’ mSeva AppStore has been developed by Indian mobile app developers. This is a secure and trusted ecosystem for mobile apps. The In-house testing process is reliable and makes the developer aware of the security glitches in the app. Participation Guidelines: 1. Participants should upload the logo in JPEG/ JPG/ PNG format only. The logo should be designed on a digital platform. 2. The winner of the competition shall be required to submit the design in an editable and open file format. 3. Participants should ensure that the original designs are submitted. 4. Each entry should submit a detailed logic and explanation of rational and creative thoughts (not more than 100 words) on the designed logo in a soft copy. The logo should be designed in a colored format. The size of the logo may vary from 5cm*5cm to 30cm*30cm in either portrait or landscape mode. 5. The logo should be usable on the website/ social media such as Twitter/Facebook, press releases, and on printable such as stationery, signage, labels, etc., magazines, commercials, holdings, standees, brochures, leaflets, pamphlets, souvenirs, and other publicity and marketing material for the promotion of mSeva AppStore. 6. The logo image should be in high resolution with a minimum of 300 DPI. 7. The logo should look clean (not pixilated or bit-mapped) when viewed on-screen at 100%. 8. Entries should not be submitted in compressed or self-extracting formats. 9. The logo design should not be imprinted or watermarked. Evaluation Criteria : 1. All the entries received would be assessed for awards by a Screening Committee for an initial evaluation. After such screening, all approved entries would be assessed by a Selection Committee for the final evaluation. 2. The entries will be judged will be selected on the basis following criteria: Alignment to Name and overall theme of mSeva AppStore: Creativity, Originality, Simplicity, Inspirational element. 3. In case of more than the required winners in any category, further selection shall be done with the help of Draw. 4. The decision of the Selection Committee would be final and binding on all the contestants and no clarifications would be issued to any participants or any decision of the Selection Committee. Last Date to Register : 30-Nov-23 - 11:45 pm Rewards : The best entry will be rewarded with a prize worth Rs. 25,000 and a Certificate. How to Register:- Link 1 - https://www.mygov.in/task/logo-design-national-mseva-appstore/ Link 2 - https://tinyurl.com/msevaform Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest. 2. The submissions received via MyGov official portal will be considered for the competition. Contact person for any query - Mr. Hitesh Kumar Arora Call/Whatsapp - 9807598070

title: Design a logo for Global Biofuel Alliance : (11/22/2023)
body: Announcement Reference No. - LPU/DII/IC/231122/001 Global Biofuels Alliance was launched during the G20 leadership summit in September’23 in Delhi, India by the Hon’ble Prime Minister alongside 8 countries and with the support of 19 countries and 12 International Organizations. GBA aims to serve as a catalytic platform, fostering global collaboration for the advancement and widespread adoption of biofuels. Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas in collaboration with MyGov is hosting a Design of a logo for the Global Biofuel Alliance. You are invited to show your creative brilliance in designing a vibrant logo, that can be easily relatable to the concept of this important global initiative and reinforce the message of biofuels as a decarbonization pathway. Theme of Logo:- 1. The logo aims to establish a powerful and recognizable visual identity. It should succinctly convey the GBA’s mission of increasing biofuels adoption. 2. Additionally, the logo should be versatile and scalable, ensuring it can be effectively used across various media and promotional materials, further amplifying the organization’s message and impact. 3. The Logo designing competition is aimed at reaching the citizens in member/observer countries through creative means and involvement of the public at large for creating awareness about GBA with support from member countries. Format and process guidelines:- 1. Participant needs to register themselves on the www.mygov.in portal to participate in the contest. 2. Preferred file format: jpg, png 3. Maximum dimensions: 1000 x 1000 pixels 4. Should be designed on a digital platform 5. Versions required: A full-color version and a black-and-white version. 6. Participants will have to provide open files/ vector formats (AI, EPS, etc.) if requested 7. All submissions will be collated centrally and entries from each country will be shared with that country’s POC. 8. Payment to the winner will be made through electronic mode for which the necessary bank details will be taken after the declaration of the winner. Evaluation Criteria : 1. The entries will be judged based on elements of creativity, originality, composition, technical excellence, simplicity, artistic merit, and visual impact and how well communicated is the theme of Global Biofuel Alliance 2. Adaptability/ Practicality: The logo will be used for the project on different mediums and sources (websites, emails, knowledge products, banners, brochures, etc.) 3. Scalability: Readability and impact at variable sizes are important criteria. 4. Innovativeness: What are the creative elements of the design and how well has the artist been able to use creativity and originality in design? 5. Relevance to the theme: The design should deliver a message relevant to the alliance’s objectives. Last Date to Register : 27-Nov-23 - 11:45 pm Rewards : 1. The winning entry will be awarded a cash prize of USD 1000/- 2. Top 5 entries will be awarded a special mention How to Register:- Link 1 - https://www.mygov.in/task/design-logo-global-biofuel-alliance/ Link 2 - https://tinyurl.com/globalbiofuelform Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest. 2. The submissions received via MyGov official portal will be considered for the competition. Contact person for any query - Mr. Hitesh Kumar Arora Call/Whatsapp - 9807598070

title: Regarding instructions for End term Examination of course code of PEL132/134/136. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/231120/003) : (11/20/2023)
body: This is for the information of all students registered in PEL132/134/136 that the End Term Examination (ETE) of these courses is scheduled in online mode From 21st Nov to 29th Nov, 2023.The seating plan for the same is updated in students UMS logins. Students can check their seating plan through the following path:- UMS Navigation ------> Examination System -----> Exam Seating Plan All students are instructed to strictly adhere to the following guidelines/instructions for the online exam. . Students must bring working Laptop, computers with a charger and Headphones in order to appear in the Exam. . Exam link will be shared with students at the assessment venue only. . During the login the test, students should mention the same email ID that is provided by them to the university. (Same will be shared with you through UMS my messages). . There will be no negative marking. The following are the section-wise instructions for the examination. Instructions for Section A: Speaking Skill In this section, a student shall be presented with 15 audio clips. You will have to listen and record the content of audio clips. Total time to complete the recordings shall 10 min. All questions will be mandatory. IMPORTANT NOTE-: · Do not mute the MIC or alter the MIC settings. MIC settings are already calibrated before the start of the test. . Room should be quiet and free of background noise from talking, honking, and ringing of mobile phone. Instructions for Section B: Speaking Skill In this section, Students will be given 2 topics on which they have to speak for 60 seconds each. For every topic, a student can think for 90 seconds before starting the recording. All questions will be mandatory. IMPORTANT NOTE-: · Do not mute the MIC or alter the MIC settings. MIC settings are already calibrated before the start of the test. · Room should be quiet and free of background noise from talking, honking, ringing mobile phone. Instructions for Section C: Writing Skills:- In this section, you will be assessed on your Writing Skills. You must read the questions carefully and write an essay on the given topics. You shall be given 30 minutes to attempt this section. Please note the following while writing the essays: - Write in short paragraphs so that the essay is more readable. Ensure that the sentences are simple and grammatically correct. - Please use proper punctuation marks while writing the essay. - Keep the introduction short and focus more on the topic and write points that are important and relevant to the topic. - Completely avoid using bullet points and writing lengthy sentences.. Keep your sentences short and simple. - Make the essay as descriptive as possible. However, please keep the essay within 200 words as going beyond the word limit would have a negative impact on your score. - Avoid using brand names. Please use the time given judiciously and stick to the word limit given in the question. Instructions for Section D: Reading Comprehension:- This section will have 10 questions. The students shall be given 15 minutes to attempt this section. You must read the questions carefully before answering. Please use the time given judiciously. Troubleshooting Steps: During the test, if any candidates face any system related issues, they may follow the below steps: 1. Check, if the updated/latest version of Operating System is available. 2. The Anti-Virus should be disabled. 3. Kindly use the latest/updated version of the browser to take the test. 4. If the browser is already of an updated version, then clear the history, cache and cookies of the browser. Please re-start the system once 5. Check that the Microphone is in working condition, use the below-mentioned link to check Microphone status. https://www.onlinemictest.com/ 6. title: Regarding instructions for End term Examination of course code of PEL132/134/136. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/231120/003) : (11/20/2023)
body: This is for the information of all students registered in PEL132/134/136 that the End Term Examination (ETE) of these courses is scheduled in online mode From 21st Nov to 29th Nov, 2023.The seating plan for the same is updated in students UMS logins. Students can check their seating plan through the following path:- UMS Navigation ------> Examination System -----> Exam Seating Plan All students are instructed to strictly adhere to the following guidelines/instructions for the online exam. . Students must bring working Laptop, computers with a charger and Headphones in order to appear in the Exam. . Exam link will be shared with students at the assessment venue only. . During the login the test, students should mention the same email ID that is provided by them to the university. (Same will be shared with you through UMS my messages). . There will be no negative marking. The following are the section-wise instructions for the examination. Instructions for Section A: Speaking Skill In this section, a student shall be presented with 15 audio clips. You will have to listen and record the content of audio clips. Total time to complete the recordings shall 10 min. All questions will be mandatory. IMPORTANT NOTE-: · . Do not mute the MIC or alter the MIC settings. MIC settings are already calibrated before the start of the test. Room should be quiet and free of background noise from talking, honking, and ringing of mobile phone. Instructions for Section B: Speaking Skill In this section, Students will be given 2 topics on which they have to speak for 60 seconds each. For every topic, a student can think for 90 seconds before starting the recording. All questions will be mandatory. IMPORTANT NOTE-: · . Do not mute the MIC or alter the MIC settings. MIC settings are already calibrated before the start of the test. · Room should be quiet and free of background noise from talking, honking, ringing mobile phone. Instructions for Section C: Writing Skills:- In this section, you will be assessed on your Writing Skills. You must read the questions carefully and write an essay on the given topics. You shall be given 30 minutes to attempt this section. Please note the following while writing the essays: - Write in short paragraphs so that the essay is more readable. Ensure that the sentences are simple and grammatically correct. - Please use proper punctuation marks while writing the essay. - Keep the introduction short and focus more on the topic and write points that are important and relevant to the topic. - Completely avoid using bullet points and writing lengthy sentences.. Keep your sentences short and simple. - Make the essay as descriptive as possible. However, please keep the essay within 200 words as going beyond the word limit would have a negative impact on your score. - Avoid using brand names. Please use the time given judiciously and stick to the word limit given in the question. Instructions for Section D: Reading Comprehension:- This section will have 10 questions. The students shall be given 15 minutes to attempt this section. You must read the questions carefully before answering. Please use the time given judiciously. Troubleshooting Steps: During the test, if any candidates face any system related issues, they may follow the below steps: 1. Check, if the updated/latest version of Operating System is available. 2. The Anti-Virus should be disabled. 3. Kindly use the latest/updated version of the browser to take the test. 4. If the browser is already of an updated version, then clear the history, cache and cookies of the browser. Please re-start the system once. 5. Check that the Microphone is in working condition, use the below-mentioned link to check Microphone status. https://www.onlinemictest.com/ 6. Kindly check the status of your camera on the below-mentioned website: https://www.onlinemictest.com/webcam-test/ Note: Click on the play button which is available in the black box to check the Webcam Status. body: Dear Students, Placements in the industry and alignment of career with role, brand and package are regarded as critical goals of professional education. University has planned credited inputs, various internal/external training, 3rd party assessments, mock interviews, etc. to enhance your employability. title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/231116/004) : (11/16/2023)
body: This is for the information of all PhD scholars and their supervisors that the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) will be conducted tentatively from January 2024 onwards. The key points of SAS evaluation include finalization of: a) Title of the proposed research work. b) Objectives of the proposed research work. c) Research methodology of the proposed research work. I. The research scholars must take the following three steps to become eligible for appearing in SAS. 1. Registration for SAS: Before registration please go through the UMS announcement (Ref. No. LPU/ASW/IC/230918/001) regarding your eligibility criteria (see the attachment-Instructions for SAS registration) UMS Navigation ---> Examination system ----> Research Degree Evaluation ----> Registration for upcoming activity ----> SAS Note: (a) The interface for registration will remain active from 15th Nov 2023 to 20th Dec 2023. (b) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt their correct domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. (c )The SAS evaluation shall be tentatively scheduled in Jan 2024 and the research scholars appearing for the SAS must have the recommendation of the same from their concerned Supervisor/Co-supervisor/administrative supervisor. 2. Uploading of synopsis: After registration, the research scholar must upload the synopsis of their research work which shall be evaluated by a panel of experts. The UMS path to upload the synopsis of SAS along with the other relevant documents is as follows: UMS Navigation ----> Examination system----> Research Degree Evaluation ----> Registration for upcoming activity ---->SAS Note: (a) The link to upload synopsis will remain active from 15th Nov 2023 to 20th Dec 2023 (b) The research scholars are strongly advised that a single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I as per the attached Instructions must be uploaded only after the thorough discussion with the Supervisor. Same should be defended during the presentation on the day of SAS evaluation. For preparing the presentation the research scholar should refer to the format for SAS presentation (Attachment) c) The research scholar shall not be eligible for uploading any synopsis report without completing the registration process. d) Read the attached Instructions very carefully before preparing your synopsis. 3. Recommendation of the synopsis by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded the synopsis for the SAS evaluation, the same must be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor through the following the UMS path: UMS navigation ---> Division of Examination ----> Research Degree Evaluation ---> Ph.D. Seminar File Verification ----> SAS ----> Reg. No. ----> Download Note: The last date for the recommendation of the synopsis by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 26thDec 2023. Important Points: a) Research scholars having pending dues/documents are not eligible to register for the SAS evaluation. Therefore, research scholars are requested to clear the pending dues/documents and get registered for the SAS evaluation before the last date. b) In case a scholar registers for the SAS evaluation and upload the synopsis but fails to meet the prescribed attendance criteria will not be allowed to appear in the SAS evaluation. c) No request for change in domain shall be entertained once the scholar registers for the SAS evaluation. d) No extension in the timelines as mentioned in the announcements will be allowed. e) The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so (no later than 20th Dec 2023 ) via RMS at the following path UMS Navigation ---> Relationship Management System (RMS) ---> Log Request Select the following: Category Type- Academic and Administrative Issues Department- Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell Category- Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell Subcategory- SAS f) If a research scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation or does not deregister before 20th Dec 2023 then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from June 2024 onwards) only after the clearance of all pending dues. g) All the research scholars must upload single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I as per the attached guidelines or else, their SAS registration may be cancelled. h) All research scholars who have the last chance to appear in the SAS evaluation in Jan 2024 are advised strongly to register for the same. i) It is mandatory for all research scholars to clear SAS within two years from the date of registration otherwise their admission may be deemed as cancelled.All the scholars who have already completed two years from date of registration are required to get the extension through CRDP via RMS by following the below mentioned path. UMS Navigation ----> Relationship Management System ---> Log Request Select the following: Category Type- Academic and Administrative Issues Department- Ph.D. - Centre for Research Degree Programmes Category- Any other Subcategory- Any other Ph. D Queries j)Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using SAS registration interface) before registering and uploading the synopsis at the interface. k) The research scholar must upload the synopsis well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. In case of any query regarding the SAS registration and evaluation, please submit your RMS request through the following path: UMS Navigation ---> Relationship Management System (RMS) ---> Log Request Select the following: CategoryType- Academic and Administrative Issues Department- Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell Category- Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell Subcategory- SAS

title: Regarding preference polling of Open Elective for Spring Term 2023-24. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/231110/009) : (11/10/2023)
body: The polling for seeking preferences from the students who have chosen to study Open Elective course(s) shall be activated in the student UMS login from 10th November 2023 (11:00 AM onwards) till 15th November 2023 (Midnight). The student will be required to fill 5 preferences for the Open Elective in the provided interface. A Merit List shall be generated according to the CGPA. Details of the allocation can be further referred in the attachment Allocation Criterion. In the currently activated Open Elective polling, student will be required to choose the courses (as per programme scheme) to study in the next term i.e., 23242 as Open Electives. To facilitate the students for choosing the Open Elective, a School wise folder of list of Open Electives offered to the students is available at following UMS path: Important Links ---> Policies, Rules, Instructions, Guidelines and Formats ---> Examination Instructions and Guidelines ---> Open Elective Folder To enhance your understanding about the Open Electives, click on the following link of the video describing the details of Open Electives. https://youtu.be/74_cNx8DZio The UMS path to participate in preference polling is given below- UMS Home- UMS Navigation > Learning Management System > Open Elective Course Preference. Or through LPU TOUCH app at the link “Open Elective Course Preference” Refer Video link- https://youtu.be/3QCAZKHrD9E or the attached User Manual for information regarding “How to Use the Open Elective Course Preference Interface.” It is for your information that the allocation of Open Elective for session 2023-24 will NOT be done on First Come First Serve basis. Allocation shall only be done based on CGPA based Merit List. For any issue/query, please contact your school Academic Operations Coordinator (AOC) as per list attached below as Help Files along with User Manual for using polling interface. or login an RMS following the below mentioned path: UMS Navigation----> Relationship Management System (RMS)----> Log Request Select Category type: Academic and Administrative Issues Message type: Enquiry From the dropdown, Master Category: Academics Category: Academics Subcategory: Elective Polling The polling is only applicable to the students for the Program and Batch details as per the attached file. Important Notes: 1. Students who are already studying Open Minor area will not be allowed to participate in the preference polling of Open Elective. 2. The allocation of OEs through polling shall be done according to allocation criteria mentioned in the interface. 3. The polling process is just for recording preferences. Polling for a particular OE does not guarantee its allocation to the students. 4. All the students are required to poll for their Open elective course within the stipulated timelines. If any student does not poll for the Open elective course, then, the course would be assigned to the student by default from the available courses and student will be required to study the course assigned to him/her. The Course assigned by default shall not be changed later.

body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “MTI Dilemma-A workshop on neutralizing the accent”. This workshop emphasizes on overcoming MTI (Mother Tongue Influence) and explores strategies to neutralize it, to enhance spoken English skills and foster effective communication skills. title: QR code scanning is mandatory for having meals in the hostel mess : (11/7/2023)
body: This is for the information of all the students who have opted for residential mess facility that a new system of QR code scanning is being introduced in the hostel mess which shall help in reducing queues at meal times and ensure a streamlined process for mess entry. This system shall be operational in Cafe above creche GH5, cafe near BH3 and Cafe near BH2 and date from 8th Nov 2023 on trial basis. However soon this system shall be extended to all hostel mess. The following guidelines need to be followed by the hostelers while entering mess at meal times (breakfast, lunch, dinner, tea): 1. Carry your mobile phone along with you while entering mess at meal time. 2. Open LPU touch app, login with your own Registration number and Password and go to the menu "Mess food scanner" 3. Scan the QR code displayed at the mess entry. 4. Select the type of meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner or tea) . 5. You will get a meal coupon with a display message of "Meal approved" with an active animation. 6. Show the meal coupon to the mess officials deputed at the mess entry. The screenshots detailing the process have been attached herewith. Note: 1. A student can scan and avail a particular meal type i.e. breakfast, lunch, dinner or tea ONLY ONCE. 2. Sharing of meal coupon is strictly prohibited as to share meal coupon a student will have to share his/her UMS password which is strictly against the University rules. Strict disciplinary action will be taken against student indulging in such acts. 3. Meal coupons will be generated according to the Meal timings

title: Regarding registration for 109th Indian Science Congress. (Ref. No. LPU/ASW/IC/231102/001) : (11/2/2023)
body: Dear Students Lovely Professional University is hosting the prestigious Indian Science Congress from 3rd January – 5th January 2024. It is highly desired that all students make most of the opportunity to participate in the sessions of highly knowledgeable guests and esteemed dignitaries of various fields. Hence, students are encouraged to register themselves as ‘Students Delegate’ and became eligible for the following benefits: (i) Certificate of participation (will enhance the CV of the students) (ii) Conference kit (iii) Award in continues assessment (CA) (a) 25% academic benefit in CA marks of each course (b) 25% additional weighted marks in CA component of Research Dissertation course. (iv) Consideration towards a 2-credit course to be completed by student during summer Break. (v) A “Best Poster” shall be declared in each conference. The winner of “Best Poster” shall be considered for “O” grade in One relevant course of upcoming term. For the conference registration, the students are advised to follow the below-mentioned steps. 1. Visit the link https://isc109.org/registration-guidelines.php 2. For registration of conference, membership of Indian Science Congress Association (ISCA) is mandatory. 3. In case you are a member of ISCA, then enter your membership details and proceed with conference registration. 4. In case you are not a member of ISCA, proceed with Provisional Registration. Your conference as well as membership registration shall be carried out through this online interface only. 5. After filling Personal Contact and Address details select Category of Participation as “Student”. 6. Select “Yes” as a response to “Are you a student of LPU?”. Enter your registration number. Note that your registration number and date of birth should be exactly as per LPU database record, otherwise you will not be able to proceed with the registration. 7. You can register for the conference without availing food facility with fee Rs. 800/-. 8. Since to register for the conference, the students are mandatorily required to have membership of Indian Science Congress Association (ISCA); in the next step, you shall be now required to select the category of your membership. The available categories of membership are given below: Category Applicable for Fee Student Member Students pursuing bachelor’s degree/UG Program/Diploma (Post-graduate and Ph.D. students are not eligible for this category) Rs. 100 Annual Membership (Bachelor’s degree is mandatory) Students enrolled in post-graduate and Ph.D. programmes Rs. 250 Life Member (Bachelor’s degree is mandatory) Students enrolled in post-graduate and Ph.D. programmes Rs. 2000 The students can choose their desired membership category and proceed to next step. 9. Select the conference/session category for which you wish to enrol yourself as a participant or a paper presenter. You can select multiple conferences as a “Paper Presenter”, however as a “Participant” you can select only one conference/session. Note: You shall be auto-allocated certain compulsory sessions to attend in the 109th Indian Science Congress, in addition to your selected conference/sessions. Attendance benefit shall be given to you only if you attend all your allocated sessions. 10. Proceed with payment after completion of filling of all student information and details. The step-by -step process manual for registration of conference as well as ISCA membership has been attached below. Important : a. After payment of Registration and membership fee, you shall be mandatorily required to take a printout of the ISCA membership form (attached below) and submit the duly filled form at Window No.2, Building No. 32, Room no. 101 A. b. Attach a copy of the following documents with the membership form: i. Your last marksheet. Download the same from your UMS via link: UMS Navigation --- Examination System --- Certificate Request. ii. Payment proof/slip iii. Any Govt. Approved ID card iv. University ID card c. LPU students do not need to fill any Demand Draft detail (as your payment is being done in the online mode). d. Your registration process shall be completed only after successful submission of the duly filled form as mentioned above. e. The membership number shall be auto-updated in your profile as and when received from ISCA. Also, you shall be informed your membership number via UMS “My Messages”. For details of guidelines regarding Paper Presentation, students are required to refer the link: https://www.sciencecongress.nic.in/paper_presentations.php Guidelines regarding paper presentation have also been attached below. For any query, you can submit your request via Relationship Management System (RMS) by following the UMS path: UMS Navigation --- Relationship Management system --- Log Request --- Select Category “Indian Science Congress”.

title: Recruitment Drive by the Student Organisation GEOGRAPHIA : (10/31/2023)
body: Hello Vertos!! Explore the World with us, the GEOGRAPHIA : Join the First-Ever Geographical Student Organization at Lovely Professional University under the aegis of Division of Youth Affairs! ??Are you passionate about the world around you? title: Registration invited for Workshop on IPR Concepts to Filing Procedures: Navigating Intellectual Property Rights w.e.f. November 04 to November 09, 2023 : (10/27/2023)
body: The six-day Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) training program offers a deep dive into the world of intellectual property, catering to professionals, entrepreneurs, and innovation enthusiasts. Participants will explore the fundamental concepts and relevance of IPR, dissect its various components such as copyrights, trademarks, and patents, and scrutinize patentability criteria through engaging case studies. The program also delves into the pivotal role of IPR in technological development and provides practical guidance on patent and copyright filing procedures, including prior-art searches. Through interactive sessions, group discussions, and hands-on exercises, attendees will gain valuable insights into harnessing IPR for innovation and protection. This training will provide a comprehensive understanding of IPR concepts, components, patentability criteria, patent and copyright filing procedures, and their relevance in technological development. Do not miss this opportunity to maximize your agricultural output! The details of program appended below: Title Workshop on IPR Concepts to Filing Procedures: Navigating Intellectual Property Rights Course Outcome The Program aims at capacity building in: - · Understanding IPR Fundamentals · Exploring IPR Components · Analyzing Patentability Criteria · Mastering Filing Procedures and Prior-Art Searches Resource Person (s) Dr. Suhel Mehandi, Assistant Professor (Genetics & Plant Breeding), School of Agriculture, LPU Dr. Nilesh Talekar, Assistant Professor (Genetics & Plant Breeding), School of Agriculture, LPU Program Schedule Refer Brochure Attached Participants * Research Scholars and Students * Faculty Members and Scientists * Professionals & Person from Industry Date November 04-09,2023 Time 06:30PM -08:30 PM Registration Link https://www.lpu.in/hrd/ Program Mode Online : LPU My Class Payment & Mode LPU Faculty, Research scholar: 1000/- External Faculty & Scientist: 1500/- Professionals & Person from Industry: 2000/- Online Payment or Cash to be deposited in Accounts Department Last Date of Registration October 30, 2023 Since there are limited seats, selection will be on a first come first served basis Looking forward to your active participation
