title: Preference polling of Engineering Minors for Spring Term 2023-24. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/231026/005) : (10/26/2023)
body: 1. Objective and Importance: The Engineering Minors (EM) have been tailored to assist the students in acquiring skills beyond the horizons of their discipline of study and attain structured knowledge of the concepts which interest them at their personal level as well. Ever increasing demand for skilled graduates who can be employed to work on projects with super and cross-specialization facets has necessitated the need of complimenting the academic framework with specific inputs in the form of courses called Engineering Minors (EM). In this mechanism, the students are free to choose an EM from the options provided by their own school as well as by other engineering schools. In simpler terms, a student studying mechanical engineering may opt for EM offered by his own school or he/she may opt for an EM offered by any other School, say for example, course on Internet of Things by School of Electronics and Electrical Engineering. Super-specialization, cross-specialization and multi-disciplinary knowledge are the hallmarks of Engineering Minor framework. 2. Structure of Engineering Minors: Each Engineering Minor area offered by different engineering schools will have a bundle of six pre-defined courses grouped under it. Once the student has selected a particular Engineering Minor area, all the corresponding six courses grouped under that Engineer Minor will be automatically offered to the student, in each of the next academic terms with the first course being offered in the fourth term. 3. Eligibility: All students currently in the third academic term of the engineering programmes mentioned in the excel sheet “Applicable Program List for Engineering Minor Preference Polling- 23242” attached below will be mandatorily required to select an Engineering Minor area of their choice in an online polling process. 4. Engineering Minor Options: To facilitate the students in making an informed decision while polling their choice for Engineering Minor, School wise options of Engineering Minors can be viewed from the following UMS path: Important Links ---> Policies, Rules, Instructions, Guidelines and Formats ---> Examination Instructions and Guidelines ---> Engineering Minor Folder 5. Polling for Engineering Minors: The Engineering Minors will be offered through an online polling process conducted via UMS in which the students will be mandatorily required to list their preference from the available Engineering Minor options. The UMS path to participate in the polling is: UMS Home---> UMS Navigation---> Learning Management System---> Engineering Minor Area Preference Alternatively, UMS Dashboard-Academics ---> Learning Management System---> Engineering Minor Area Preference OR, Use LPU Touch app and click on the link “EM Area Preference.” 6. Timelines: The preference polling shall begin on 27th October 2023 at 11:00 AM and will close on 31st October 2023 Midnight. The polling preferences must be strictly submitted within the stipulated timelines and through the designated interface only. No other mode of communication like email/RMS/hard copy letters etc. in this regard should be allowed. To enhance your understanding about the Engineering Minor Area preference polling process, click on the following link to see an explanatory video- https://youtu.be/FiZQD5eJ43M 7. Whom to Contact: In case of any issues or queries, the students can consult the Academic Operation Coordinator (AOC) of the school offering the EM area through email, the details of which have been attached herewith in the folder named “Help files Folder”. Also, provided in this folder is the user manual for students which contains details related to the participation and process of Engineering Minor allocation. 8. For any Issue/query, you can login an RMS following the below mentioned path: UMS Navigation----> Relationship Management System (RMS)----> Log Request Select Category type: Academic and Administrative Issues Message type: Enquiry From the dropdown, Master Category: Academics Category: Academics Sub Category: Elective Polling 9. Important Notes: a) Participation in the polling to submit Engineering Minor preferences is mandatory and non-participation may lead to allocation of default Engineering Minor to which student cannot make any claim thereafter. b) Based on polling preferences received from the students, the allocation of Engineering Minor will be done through pre-defined criteria, the details of which are mentioned on the polling interface itself [refer attachment]. c) Please remember that mere submission of preferences during the polling does not guarantee the allocation of the same Engineering Minor Area. d) There is NO FIRST COME FIRST SERVE BASIS criteria followed during the Engineering Minor allocation. e) Fill your preferences very carefully and accurately as preferences once submitted cannot be changed thereafter. f) Engineering Minor allocation will be notified through My message within 2 weeks of polling.

For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone /Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone /Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone/ Dissertation Supervisor Information- Attachment-I contains the details of all student groups for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS path to check the details of available supervisors as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information Points to remember: - a) Students can view the complete research profile of supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date which will help to choose the supervisor judiciously. Capstone/ Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is mutual agreement between the students and the supervisor, the supervisor need to submit the details of all students from their UMS latest by 10th November 2023: The last date for closing of Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 10th November 2023. title: Final Report Submission for Project, Dissertation and similar courses and related timelines for Autumn Term 23241. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/231026/002) : (10/26/2023)
body: This is for the information of all students registered in project, dissertation and similar courses (Annexure-I) that in order to be eligible for the Final End Term Presentation (ETP) viva, each student registered in such courses need to fulfil the following points as per the specified timelines mentioned in Annexure-III (Attached). 1. Uploading of soft copy of final report All students need to prepare the final report of their research/ project work as per the guidelines attached (in Annexure-II) and upload the soft copy of the same in four parts i.e., PDF File-1, PDF File-2, PDF File-3 and PDF file-4 (details of pdf files are given in Table 1) via their UMS interface as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-III by visiting the following UMS path: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details-->Upload Research Project Report/Internship Certificate --->Project/Dissertation Table 1- Contents of each PDF file (size should be less than 5 MBs) PDF File 1* PDF File 2 PDF File 3 PDF File 4 (Applicable only for final stage Master Dissertation) Students need to upload their Complete Project/ research Report as PDF File 1. Students need to upload "only Content Report" which is without any student identification Information (e.g. Student's Name, Registration Number or Title Page) as PDF File 2. Plagiarism Report is to be uploaded for Standalone Project(s), Capstone Project-II, Dissertation-II or Dissertation- III (As per Annexure-I). Allowed Plagiarism limit shall be as per the Policy which has been described under the following link available on UMS: https://www.lpu.in/academics/pdf/research-policy.pdf Student need to submit graphical abstract (refer announcement Regarding generation of Intellectual property rights (IPR) from Thesis/Dissertation work at Master's Level) Please ensure that PDF File 1 contains student as well as supervisor signature on the declaration certificates before uploading the same on the UMS interface. Important Note- 1. It is advised that the respective supervisors must ensure the timely uploading of the final report of their students before the last date of submission so that the supervisors get sufficient time to approve or to get the modifications suggested by them incorporated in the final report before final submission of the hard copy of the report in the respective administrative officer (A.O.) office by the students. 2. In Extreme cases if the final report is not ready and requires more time, student can request for an extension of maximum 60 days with a fee of Rupees 1000/- in 30-310 by filling the hard copy Extension form. 3. The guidelines (Annexure-II) attached with this announcement for the preparation of the final reports are suggestive and can vary as per the nature and amount of the work done. 4. Respective supervisors must ensure that the reports submitted by the students get approved on or before the last date of submission as specified in Annexure-III. 2. Uploading the detail of the Research Publication/ Patent on UMS: It is mandatory for each student/ student group to have research publication/Patent for the courses as per Annexure-I to be eligible to appear in the final ETP viva. All students in a specific Project group need to fill the details of the Research Publications/Patent as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-III by visiting the following UMS path: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details--->Upload Research Project Publication/Patent details The above interface would require a log request ID which can be generated by respective Supervisor via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation-->Division of Research and Development-->Research and Academic Contributions--->Log Request Note- It is mandatory to have the research publication/Patent affiliated with Lovely Professional University otherwise the student would not be eligible for the Final ETP viva-voce. Students must ensure that the report/publication details uploaded on UMS are duly verified from their respective before final submission in the A.O office. 3. Submission of hard copy of the final report in the respective administrative office (A.O. Office) Once the respective supervisors have recommended the soft copy of the report submitted by the students, two hard copies, either spiral or hard bound (As per Annexure-I) of the same duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor must be submitted by the students in respective A.O. office as per timelines specified in Annexure-III. While taking the submission of hardcopy of project report the AOs must write the E-Receipt Number, sign and put their UID along with the University stamp on hardcopies carried by the student. One Signed and stamped copy of the report should be returned to the student and the same is to be carried by the student at the time of ETP viva. Respective School AO’s can generate an online report submission number via UMS Navigation-- >Administrative Task-->Report Submission Important Points: 1. For students working in groups, any one member of the group can make the submission in AO office and it will be considered for all. Whereas, supervisor needs to recommend the uploaded soft-copy via UMS interface for all the students in-order to enable hard-copy submission for the whole group. 2. In case a student fails to submit his/her final report as per the specified timelines, R grade shall be awarded. 3. Reports will be accepted in AO offices latest by 17:00 hrs. as per the last dates mentioned in Annexure-III. In case of any query, students may log an RMS request via the below mentioned path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational Issues) Sub-Category: Training/ Dissertation/ OJT / Thesis / Seminar / Capstone & Viva

title: QR code scanning is mandatory for having meals in the hostel mess : (10/23/2023)
body: This is for the information of all the students who have opted for residential mess facility that a new system of QR code scanning is being introduced in the hostel mess which shall help in reducing queues at meal times and ensure a streamlined process for mess entry. This system shall be operational in Centralized Mess1, Centralized Mess2, Apartment Mess and Centralized Mess between BH5/6 from 24th October 2023 on trial basis. However soon this system shall be extended to all hostel mess. The following guidelines need to be followed by the hostelers while entering mess at meal times (breakfast, lunch, dinner, tea): 1. Carry your mobile phone along with you while entering mess at meal time. 2. Open LPU touch app, login with your own Registration number and Password and go to the menu "Mess food scanner" 3. Scan the QR code displayed at the mess entry. 4. Select the type of meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner or tea) . 5. You will get a meal coupon with a display message of "Meal approved" with an active animation. 6. Show the meal coupon to the mess officials deputed at the mess entry. The screenshots detailing the process have been attached herewith. Note: 1. A student can scan and avail a particular meal type i.e. breakfast, lunch, dinner or tea ONLY ONCE. 2. Sharing of meal coupon is strictly prohibited as to share meal coupon a student will have to share his/her UMS password which is strictly against the University rules. Strict disciplinary action will be taken against student indulging in such acts. 3. Meal coupons will be generated according to the Meal timings

To mark this occasion, we are organizing a cooking competition based on Millet under Yuva Pratibha. If you aspire to be New India's emerging chef, then participate in the ‘YUVA Pratibha - Culinary Talent Hunt’ and show your culinary skills. The purpose of this is to bring out the lost recipes and promote the culinary talents of young and aspiring chefs and home cooks. The fusion of millets in this competition provides a unique opportunity for participants to showcase their creativity and innovation in cooking with healthy and sustainable ingredients, promoting awareness about their versatility. title: Khadi Mahotsav Jingle Contest : (10/20/2023)
body: Announcement Reference No. - LPU/DII/IC/231020/003 Khadi is the fabric of freedom struggle and the Father of the nation. Mahatma Gandhi developed the concept of Khadi as a means to provide employment to the unemployed rural population. Gandhiji promoted the use of Swadeshi products and urged boycotting foreign goods. Very soon, khadi became popular as the fabric of nationalism, and was said to be woven with ‘the threads of Swaraj’. As the idea of spinning khadi spread across India, Mahatma Gandhi hoped for unity among all classes through this common occupation by diluting the gap that existed between the people. Thus, the Khadi movement was established for social and economic reasons. The essence of this movement lies in Gandhiji’s understanding of the fabric as something that could uplift the masses. Khadi, therefore, became the national fabric of India and a central icon of India’s freedom struggle. Our Hon’ble PM has given the mantra of ‘Khadi for Nation, Khadi for Fashion’ and Khadi is now seen as a fashion statement. It is now used in denim, jackets, shirts, dress material, stoles, home furnishings, and apparel accessories like handbags.With an objective of promoting Khadi and Village Industries, Handloom and handicraft products, ODOP products and products of various traditional and cottage industries manufactured locally or by SHGs and to further promote the idea of “Vocal for Local” campaign and ‘AtmaNirbhar Bharat Abhiyan’ envisioned by the Hon’ble Prime Minister, Govt. of India has initiated a special campaign “Khadi Mahotsav”. Jingles on subject/ theme related to the Atmanirbhar Bharat / Vocal for Local /Khadi for Nation Khadi for Fashion are invited to participate in this competition. The participants, through their jingle, should aim to spread awareness about Khadi Mahotsav and to promote the idea of a ‘vocal for local’ campaign and ‘AtmaNirbhar Bharat Abhiyan’ envisaged by the Hon’ble Prime Minister. The participants are encouraged to explore their creative instincts and produce an audio clip and script of a jingle that promotes Khadi and other local products like handloom and handicraft products, products under the ODOP program, or local products of self-help groups. It should attract the younger population towards the use of local products for creating a self-reliant India. It should motivate them on a higher level to contribute towards Atmanirbhar Bharat by using Khadi and other local products. Last Date to Register : 31-Oct-23 - 12:30 pm A. The Top three winners at National level, will be awarded KVIC e-coupon* worth: 1st Prize- e-coupon* worth 25,000/- 2nd Prize- e-coupon* worth 20,000/- 3rd Prize- e-coupon* worth 15,000/- B.One jingle in each language category will be awarded a KVIC e-coupon* worth Rs. 15,000/- each. The rewards will be given in the form of a KVIC e-coupon which will be redeemable on the KVIC e-commerce platform www.khadiindia.gov.in subject to the condition that the winner has to purchase Khadi and V.I. products worth a minimum of Rs.100/- from www.khadiindia.gov.in and further the winner has to declare a list of 5 to 10 items, which he/she would replace with local products, in the KVIC e-commerce-platform viz. www.khadiindia.gov.in. How to Register:- Link 1 - https://tinyurl.com/khadimahotsav Link 2 - https://forms.gle/M8266YtgfHyx3Lwx8 Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the contest. 2. The submissions received via MyGov official portal will be considered for the competition. Contact person for any query - Mr. Hitesh Kumar Arora Call/Whatsapp - 9807598070

title: Khadi Mahotsav Street Play Contest (for UG&PG Students) : (10/20/2023)
body: Announcement Reference No. - LPU/DII/IC/231020/002 Khadi is the fabric of freedom struggle and Father of nation. Mahatma Gandhi developed the concept of Khadi as a means to provide employment to the unemployed rural population and make them self-reliant. Our Hon’ble PM has given the mantra of ‘Khadi for Nation, Khadi for Fashion’ and Khadi is now seen as a fashion statement. It is now used in denims, jackets, shirts, dress material, stoles, home furnishings and apparel accessories like handbags. The campaign is to sensitise the youth towards Khadi, ‘Vocal for Local’ and make them aware about benefits of these to our economy, ecology & women empowerment and to encourage the public at large & youth in particular to buy Khadi & local products and inculcate in them pride for local products. KVIC and National School of Drama, New Delhi is organising a Street Play Contest for the Indian students of UG/PG in India (or abroad) in collaboration with MyGov on the theme – Khadi for Nation Khadi for Fashion/Vocal for Local/ Atmanirbhar Bharat. All the participants, through their streetplay should aim to spread awareness about Khadi Mahotsav and to promote the idea of ‘vocal for local’campaign and ‘AtmaNirbhar Bharat Abhiyan’ envisaged by the Hon’ble Prime Minister. Through this contest, participants are encouraged: 1. To explore their creative instinct and produce a street play that promotes Khadi and local products.2. To attract the younger population towards use of local produce for creating a self-reliant India.3. To motivate them on a higher level to contribute towards Atmanirbhar Bharat by using Khadi and local products. Eligibility Criteria : 'a. The street play video should be in any of the following Indian languages: 1. English; 2. Hindi; 3. Assamese; 4. Bengali; 5. Gujarati; 6. Kannada; 7. Malayalam; 8. Marathi; 9. Odia; 10. Punjabi; 11. Tamil; and 12. Telugu. b. The street play video, as per the eligibility conditions, needs to be uploaded on to Youtube as UNLISTED (it should not be available on search engines or available in public domain). Only the YouTube link needs to be submitted on www.mygov.in as the entry. c. The video must be shot horizontally in FHD (Full HD 1080p 16:9 1920X1080) resolution only. The picture and sound should be clearly understood, with no shaking/ blurry footage and minimal noise/static. d. Each entry shall be accompanied with acceptable formats for street play videos – Youtube – UNLISTED link (containing MP4/MOV/H264, Full HD, Resolution 1920 x 1080 pixels, 24/25 fps) Last Date to Register : 31-Oct-23 - 12:30 pm Rewards : A. title: Ambassador’s Scholarship for Bhutan Students for the session 2023-24. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/231019/005) : (10/19/2023)
body: Registration process for applying for Ambassador’s Scholarship for the session 2023-24 for Bhutan students has been opened for students pursuing undergraduate and Post Graduate courses in India. Last date for the scholarship is 15th November 2023. The link for Ambassador’s Scholarship is as under: Link: https://indembthimphu.gov.in/amb_scholarship_2023-2024.php Students have to fill all the details mentioned in the scholarship application form and have to upload all necessary documents as mentioned below:- 1. Bhutan Citizenship ID card (both front and back side). 2. Passport size Photograph. 3. Last year Mark sheet -Link to download the Provisional Academic Transcript is as under: UMS Navigation ---> Examination ---> Certificate Request ---> Apply Certificate. 4. Fee receipts of academic year 2023-24 must be attested from the Accounts Department (Block No. 32, Room No. 103, Window No. 11) - Link to download the Fee Receipts is as under: UMS Navigation ---> Finance ----> Fee Receipts 5. Certificate from College or University / Institute (Copy enclosed). 6. First page of the Bank Passbook. 7. Scholarship form (enclosed) (It is mandatory to fill this form and submit the same along with the above mentioned documents at Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No.4 for verification). A) In Details of College / Institute option students have to fill below mentioned details:- 1. Name and Address of College /Institute : Lovely Professional University Jalandhar Delhi GT Road Phagwara Punjab District Kapurthala 144411. 2. Name and Telephone No. of College/ Institute official dealing with foreign students: Mr. Anil Dhawan, 8146100818. 3. Tick on option No in Online classes from University Option. 3. E-mail id of College/ Institute official dealing with foreign students: anil.11928@lpu.co.in B) In Education Details option students have to fill below mentioned details:- 1. Name of course for which scholarship sought:- Students have to enter course in which he/she is studying. 2. Duration of the course in Years: - Students have to enter full course duration. 3. Date of Joining the Institute: - Students have to enter 01.08._____ (Students have to fill the year of their admission (e.g. if student admitted in 2019, the date of Admission will be 01-08-2019). 4. Year/ Semester in which studying last year: - Students have to select year option from drop down. 5. Year/ Semester in which studying present year: - Students have to select present year option from drop down. Important Instructions 1. Bhutanese students who are already in receipt of some other Government of India scholarship or Royal Government of Bhutan scholarship such as the India Bhutan Friendship scholarship, Nehru Wangchuck Scholarship, ICCR Scholarship, Nalanda University scholarship, SAARC scholarship, Undergraduate scholarship etc. are not eligible to apply for the Ambassador’s scholarship. 2. The bank account should be in a Bhutanese bank only and in the name of applicant. Bank account in the name of mother, father, brother, sister or any other relatives or friend’s account will not be accepted. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students:- Link: - UMS Navigation ---> Scholarship Management System ---> Scholarship Policies ----> Session 2023-24 ---> Bhutan Ambassador Scholarship. All the eligible students have to submit the above mentioned documents at Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No. 4 on or before 04.11.2023. In case of any query, call at 01824-444519 and 01824-444378. ­­The students are advised to submit the latest mobile number & email id for proper communication. Note: Students can collect the Bonafide Certificate / Certificate From Institute for Bhutanese Students after 3 days of the submission of the aforesaid documents for verification at Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No. 4 In case of any grievances, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV Cell on RMS link : UMS Navigation – RMS –Division of Examination - Academic (Operational issues) – State Scholarship Information & Verification – External Agency State Scholarship (Govt./Pvt.)

title: Session on Post Covid World by Amagi Corporation and Kimbarley Clark (10/19/2023)
body: Division of Career Services, LPU is going to organize a Session on Post Covid World by Amagi Corporation and Kimbarley Clark. Kimberly-Clark is a multinational corporation with a global footprint and a rich legacy in the consumer goods industry. Founded in 1872, the company is a leader in the production of personal care and hygiene products. Renowned for iconic brands such as Kleenex, Huggies, and Scott, Kimberly-Clark has maintained a commitment to innovation and sustainability. With a focus on improving the well-being of people around the world, the company has consistently delivered quality products that enhance everyday life. Kimberly-Clark's diverse portfolio, combined with a dedication to environmental responsibility and community engagement, positions it as a trusted and influential player in the global consumer goods market. The main objectives of the event are: To enlighten the students with the current process followed by the companies to identify and recruit top talent with the requisite skills for post-COVID work environments. To make them aware the streamline hiring processes to adapt to the evolving needs of the post-pandemic world. To enhance diversity and inclusion initiatives within the recruitment strategy. To utilize technology for efficient remote hiring and on boarding practices. To foster a positive candidate experience to attract and retain top-tier professionals Target audience: The students of the Mittal School of Business. title: QR code scanning is mandatory for having meals in the hostel mess : (10/17/2023)
body: This is for the information of all the students who have opted for residential mess facility that a new system of QR code scanning is being introduced in the hostel mess which shall help in reducing queues at meal times and ensure a streamlined process for mess entry. This system shall be operational in GH3, GH4 and BH3 from 18th October 2023 on trial basis. However soon this system shall be extended to all hostel mess. The following guidelines need to be followed by the hostelers while entering mess at meal times (breakfast, lunch, dinner, tea): 1. Carry your mobile phone along with you while entering mess at meal time. 2. Open LPU touch app, login with your own Registration number and Password and go to the menu "Mess food scanner" 3. Scan the QR code displayed at the mess entry. 4. Select the type of meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner or tea) . 5. You will get a meal coupon with a display message of "Meal approved" with an active animation. 6. Show the meal coupon to the mess officials deputed at the mess entry. The screenshots detailing the process have been attached herewith. Note: 1. A student can scan and avail a particular meal type i.e. breakfast, lunch, dinner or tea ONLY ONCE. 2. Sharing of meal coupon is strictly prohibited as to share meal coupon a student will have to share his/her UMS password which is strictly against the University rules. Strict disciplinary action will be taken against student indulging in such acts. 3. Meal coupons will be generated according to the Meal timings.

title: LPU Global: Opportunity for Master's in France with Scholarship Option : (10/17/2023)
body: Division of International Affairs brings an Opportunity for LPU Students to achieve the dream of pursuing Masters in France with various Scholarship Options. Those students who are interested can grab this opportunity. Network N+I, is a single online portal for making a single application to 50+ elite engineering institutes in France. The Network trains highly qualified, multilingual engineers who can lead effectively on international projects in a multicultural environment. Benefits: * 90% of N+I students get a job offer, even before they graduate. * The average salary for the first job in France for a junior engineer is € 36,000 gross per year (+ 15 to 20 % for international experience). * The «n+i» Network offers three “Success Packages” for international students in France. For more details of Success Packages: https://www.nplusi.com/public/en/different-integration-packages Eligibility: This opportunity is only for final year undergraduate students. Some significant points to study Masters in Engineering with Network N+I: 1) Two-year master’s degree in engineering (after B.Tech) 2) Choice of 150 specialized masters in all domains of engineering. 3) 3 packages of adaptation: linguistic, cultural, and methodological. 4) GRE/TOEFL/ IELTS not required at the time of admission. 5) A single online application portal for admission and scholarships for all the 50+ Engineering institutes. 6) No prior knowledge of French is required. body: Subject Khadi Mahotsav Slogan Contest - 2023 Description Announcement Ref.No. - LPU/DII/IC/231016/001 The Khadi and Village Industries Commission, in collaboration with MyGov is hosting a Slogan Competition, to sensitize the youth towards Khadi, ‘Vocal for Local’ and make them aware of the benefits of these to our economy, ecology & women’s empowerment and to catalyze the public at large & youth in particular to buy Khadi & local products and inculcate in them pride for local products. It allows students to focus on what they do best, build upon their natural abilities, and make meaningful contributions in their own life as well as the lives of the others. Identifying ones strengths allows to gain a deeper understanding of oneself, including our abilities, talents, and unique qualities. This increased self-awareness can lead to better decision-making and improved self-confidence. title: QR code scanning is mandatory for having meals in the hostel mess : (10/13/2023)
body: This is for the information of all the students who have opted for residential mess facility that a new system of QR code scanning is being introduced in the hostel mess which shall help in reducing queues at meal times and ensure a streamlined process for mess entry. This system shall be operational in Boys Hostel - 5 and 6 from 14th October 2023 on trial basis. However soon this system shall be extended to all hostel mess. The following guidelines need to be followed by the hostelers while entering mess at meal times (breakfast, lunch, dinner, tea): 1. Carry your mobile phone along with you while entering mess at meal time. 2. Open LPU touch app, login with your own Registration number and Password and go to the menu "Mess food scanner" 3. Scan the QR code displayed at the mess entry. 4. Select the type of meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner or tea) . 5. You will get a meal coupon with a display message of "Meal approved" with an active animation. 6. Show the meal coupon to the mess officials deputed at the mess entry. The screenshots detailing the process have been attached herewith. Note: 1. A student can scan and avail a particular meal type i.e. breakfast, lunch, dinner or tea ONLY ONCE. 2. Sharing of meal coupon is strictly prohibited as to share meal coupon a student will have to share his/her UMS password which is strictly against the University rules. Strict disciplinary action will be taken against student indulging in such acts. 3. Meal coupons will be generated according to the Meal timings.

title: Part-time openings of Alumni Relations Coordinator for Division of Alumni Relations : (10/12/2023)
body: Division of Alumni Relations, Department of Alumni Relations is looking for students who have following qualities:- 01. Excellent Communication Skills: Effective communication is key in this role. You should be able to convey information clearly and professionally through various channels, including email, social media, and in-person meetings. 02.Empathy: Understanding the needs and concerns of both alumni and current students is crucial. Being empathetic helps you relate to their experiences and build stronger connections. 03. Networking Abilities: A coordinator should be skilled at building and maintaining relationships. This involves networking with alumni, students, faculty, and other stakeholders to foster a sense of community. 04. Organizational Skills: Coordinators often manage events, databases, and schedules. Strong organizational skills are essential to keep track of alumni data, events, and student engagement activities. 05. Tech-Savvy: In today's digital age, familiarity with various communication and event management tools, as well as social media platforms, is an advantage. 06.Passion and Enthusiasm: A genuine passion for connecting alumni with current students and a strong enthusiasm for the university can be infectious and inspire others to get involved. 07.Time Management: Balancing multiple tasks and responsibilities requires effective time management to ensure that nothing falls through the cracks. 08. Ethical and Professional Conduct: Upholding a high standard of ethical behaviour and professionalism is essential when representing university. All interested candidates with CGPA greater than 6, must register through the Navigation, UMS Navigation >> Division of student welfare >> Part time job Module >> Student Registration

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (10/12/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: KHADI MAHOTSAV 2023 - SHORT FILM MAKING COMPETITION : (10/11/2023)
body: Subject KHADI MAHOTSAV 2023 - SHORT FILM MAKING COMPETITION Description Announcement Ref.No. - LPU/DII/IC/231011/001 Short Films produced in India on a subject/ theme related to the Khadi for Nation Khadi for Fashion/Vocal for Local/ Atmanirbhar Bharat are to be invited to participate in this competition.The participants, through their short film, should aim to spread awareness about Khadi Mahotsav and to promote the idea of the ‘vocal for local’ campaign and ‘AtmaNirbhar Bharat Abhiyan’ envisaged by the Hon’ble Prime Minister. The participants are encouraged to explore their creative instincts and produce a short film that promotes Khadi and local products. It should attract the younger population towards the use of local produce for creating a self-reliant India. It should motivate them on a higher level to contribute towards Atmanirbhar Bharat by using Khadi and local products. Last Date To Register 31st October 2023 till 18:15 PM IST Registration Details Link 1 : https://www.mygov.in/task/short-film-making-competition/ Link 2 : https://tinyurl.com/ym88t6m3 (Its mandatory to register on both the links) Eligibility a) The competition will be open to all Indian citizens b) Short Films must catch the essence and message of Khadi Mahotsav as elaborated in the theme mentioned above. The participants are encouraged to explore their creative instincts and produce a short film that promotes Khadi and local products. It should attract the younger population towards the use of local produce for creating a self-reliant India. It should motivate them on a higher level to contribute towards Atmanirbhar Bharat by using Khadi and local products. c) Films (Animation Films, Mobile Films, or any other Films produced with broadcast quality) can be shot on a smartphone or a video camera. d) The film will need to be shot in 1920x1080p (Full HD) e) The film needs to be uploaded on to YouTube as UNLISTED (it should not be available on search engines or available in public domain). The YouTube link needs to be submitted on MyGov.in as the entry f) Length of short Film- Screen Duration up to 180 Seconds (Including Credits) & minimum 60 seconds will only be eligible. Rewards The best film in each language category will be awarded a KVIC e-coupon* worth Rs. 15,000/- each. Additionally, at the National level, the top Three winners will be awarded a KVIC e-coupon* worth: 1st Prize- KVIC e-coupon worth 25,000/- 2nd Prize- KVIC e-coupon worth 20,000/- 3rd Prize- KVIC e-coupon worth 15,000/- In case of any query you may contact Mr.Mohit Dhawan at 9878315193 (Call/Whatsapp)

title: The Implementation of QR code scanning is mandatory for the meals in hostel mess : (10/10/2023)
body: This is for the information of all the students who have opted for residential mess facility that a new system of QR code scanning is being introduced in the hostel mess which shall help in reducing queues at meal times and ensure a streamlined process for mess entry. This system shall be operational in Boys Hostel - 2 and Girls hostel 5 & 6 from 11th October 2023 on trial basis. However soon this system shall be extended to all hostel mess. The following guidelines need to be followed by the hostellers while entering mess at meal times (breakfast, lunch, dinner , tea): 1. Carry your mobile phone along with you while entering mess at meal time. 2. Open LPU touch app, login with your own Registration number and Password and go to the menu "Mess food scanner" 3. Scan the QR code displayed at the mess entry. 4. Select the type of meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner or tea) . 5. You will get a meal coupon with a display message of "Meal approved" with an active animation. 6. Show the meal coupon to the mess officials deputed at the mess entry. The screenshots detailing the process have been attached herewith. Note: 1. A student can scan and avail a particular meal type i.e. breakfast, lunch, dinner or tea ONLY ONCE. 2. Sharing of meal coupon is strictly prohibited as to share meal coupon a student will have to share his/her UMS password which is strictly against the University rules. Strict disciplinary action will be taken against student indulging in such acts. 3. Meal coupons will be generated according to the Meal timings.

title: Important advisory for students. (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/231010/001) : (10/10/2023)
body: Dear students Recently, alarming reports have emerged about certain individuals fraudulently offering the University students duty leave privileges, attendance benefits and even academic benefits in exchange for money. No such illegal activity/invasions are possible in the University systems. If any University student is found offering or accepting such false offers then strict action shall be taken against him/her which will involve disciplinary actions, even leading to rustication from the University. Additionally, students should be mindful of sharing personal information or UMS passwords online or with strangers, as scammers can exploit such details for deceitful purposes. In case any student encounters such suspicious activities or offers or gets any information regarding any such ongoing practice, they should promptly report the same to university authorities. You can report anonymously (without revealing your identity) by using suggestion boxes available at various locations throughout University campus or you can report the same telephonically to Division of Student Relationship at 01824-520150. Let’s maintain the integrity of the academic environment of the University and uphold the values of integrity and excellence that our University stands for.

title: New Mess Student's Representative Committee (MSRC) Policy and Hiring : (10/7/2023)
body: Dear Students, We are excited to announce the implementation of our new Mess Student's Representative Committee (MSRC) Policy, along with an opportunity for you to join the MSRC team through a hiring process. This policy is designed to enhance your dining experience, empower student representatives, and ensure the highest quality of food and services in our university mess. Why is the Mess Student's Representative Committee (MSRC) Important? Food is not just sustenance; it's a crucial aspect of our lives that shapes cultures, traditions, and identities Mess committee (MSRC) is a representative structure through which students can participate in the Mess and dinning related activities partnership with University Management and Staff for the benefit of the University and its students.The MSRC will play a vital role in fulfilling the dietary needs of the students and making dining experience more enjoyable. Key Highlights of the MSRC Policy: 1. Structured Representation: The MSRC will have a structured hierarchy, ensuring effective representation for all hostels on campus. 2. Selection Process: MSRC members will be selected based on their academic performance, social involvement, and previous experience, ensuring that the most qualified students lead the committee. 3. Empowered Committees: MSRC members will be responsible for monitoring the mess facilities, organizing events, generating ideas for improvement, and collecting feedback from you. 4. Support from VCMC Staff: Our Vendor and Contractor Management (VCMC) staff will mentor and guide MSRC members, ensuring they have the necessary support to execute their roles effectively. 5. Exciting Activities: MSRC will organize various activities throughout the academic year, including awareness programs, cleanliness initiatives, food distribution to nearby areas, and food festivals. 6. Performance Evaluation: MSRC members will be evaluated based on several criteria, and awards and benefits will be given to recognize their outstanding performance. 7. Regular Meetings: There will be regular meetings at both the mess and intra-committee levels to discuss concerns, plans, and improvements. title: Session on Role of HR in these Changing Times by XPERI (10/5/2023)
body: Division of Career Services, LPU is going to organize a “Session on Role of HR in these Changing Times”. In the wake of global shifts, one company that stands out for its innovative HR practices is Xperi Corporation. Xperi, a leading technology company, has set new standards in talent management and workplace culture. With a commitment to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment, Xperi exemplifies how HR strategies can adapt to the demands of the contemporary workforce. The event shall provide a holistic exploration of the evolving role of HR in the contemporary business landscape. By drawing inspiration from industry leaders like Xperi, participants would gain valuable insights into adaptive HR strategies, diversity and inclusion, talent management, technological advancements, and employee well-being. This event will not only illuminate the present state of HR but will also equip attendees with knowledge and perspectives to navigate the future of human resources in these dynamic times. The main objectives of the event are: To examine how HR practices at Xperi and similar companies adapt to the rapidly changing business and technological landscape. To understand the role of HR in promoting diversity and inclusion within the workplace, with real-world examples from Xperi. To analyze how HR professionals tackle talent management challenges, ensuring the right individuals are in the right roles. To investigate how HR leverages technology, such as AI and analytics, to streamline processes and enhance decision-making. title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for End Term Presentation. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/231003/001) : (10/3/2023)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from November 2023 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs after July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after every 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. The main aim of the End Term Presentation is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present the work done or progress made since the last evaluation I. The research scholars must take the following three steps to become eligible for appearing in ETP. 1. Registration of ETP reports All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation ---> Examination System----> Research Degree Evaluation ----> Registration of Upcoming Activity----> ETP Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 3rd October 2023 to 23rd October 2023. 2. Uploading of ETP reports All registered research scholars are required to upload their files (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation ---> Examination System----> Research Degree Evaluation ----> Registration of Upcoming Activity----> upload synopsis Note: The link for uploading of synopsis will remain active from 3rd October 2023 to 23rd October 2023. 3. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation ---> Division of Examination ---> Research Degree Evaluation ---> Ph.D. Seminar File Verification ---> ETP If the supervisor does not verify the report of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the ETP evaluation. Note: The last date for the recommendation of the ETP report by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 25th October 2023. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of ETP report: a) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who were either absent or not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such research scholars who have either missed or have been awarded “Unsatisfactory” in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the ETP evaluation. b) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. c) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. d) The ETP report must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. e) Research scholars are also required to submit a hard copy of the report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation. Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of ETP report will not be considered. It is mandatory to submit the hard copy of ETP report, as the result will be shared only after the submission of hard copy of ETP report. f) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. g) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the ETP registration interface) before registration and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. h) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who are eligible for ETP evaluation as per the attached list but do not complete the registration process will be marked absent for the ETP evaluation, and the result of the evaluation will stand as "Unsatisfactory". i) In case the research scholar has registered for the ETP evaluation and he/she does not appear for the same, then he/ she will be marked absent and the result shall stand as 'Unsatisfactory' j) The research scholars who are not able to register for the ETP evaluation due to pending fees/dues are advised to clear the same and register for the ETP evaluation as per the timelines failing which their ETP result will stand as "Unsatisfactory". k) In case the research scholar has any pending documents related to admissions, they are advised to submit the same before their last date of the scheduled evaluation, or else they may not be allowed to appear in the ETP Evaluation. l) The ETP evaluation will be scheduled in offline mode only. Thus, if the scholar fails to appear in the offline mode, he/she will be considered as absent and the result will be declared as “Unsatisfactory”. No request for online mode will be entertained. m) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI &VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of the End Term Presentation Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. 2. Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of ETP report, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) -->Sub Category: ETP. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor / Extension / Term off/ documents, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes). 3. For Pending admission related documents submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Division of Admissions) --> Pending Documents (New Admissions).

body: Description Announcement Ref No. - LPU/DII/IC/231003/001 Manohar Parrikar Yuva Scientist Award (MPYSA) is an award introduced by the Government of Goa through the Department of Science & Technology & Waste Management (DS&T & WM). It is an award to encourage, identity and recognize Indian Scientist who has achieved excellence in the field of Science and Technology and Innovations. The MPYSA will be awarded annually to a Scientist, in memory of Late Chief Minister of Goa and Defence Minister of India, Shri Manohar Parrikar, who himself was a Technocrat and had love for Science and Technology. Each application will be acknowledged by email. Eligibility Must be below the age of 35 as on 31st December 2022 Quality research output in Science, Technology & Innovation. body: LPU Literary Society is extremely privileged to announce “THE RBI POLICY CHALLENGE - 2023”: A National Level Competition exclusively for Undergraduate/Postgraduate students. A great opportunity for students to enroll themselves to showcase their expertise organized by the Reserve Bank of India. And the best part about this competition is that it is a group competition consisting of 3 to 4 participants. Participants have the opportunity to win exciting cash prizes worth more than 2.5 lakhs and also the winning team members gets the opportunity to secure internships with the Reserve Bank Of India for a period of upto 3 months in a department of their choice. The competition is based on Three Tiers tests including essay writing, problem solving and presentation skills of the participants (Regional, Zonal and National Levels) respectively. body: We are excited to extend an invitation to all enthusiastic and motivated individuals to join our esteemed Student Organization - OJASWI. Ojaswi is not just a club; it is a platform for personal growth, skill development, and community engagement. Sh. M. S. Swaminathan Ji, born on 7th August 1925, was a visionary whose pioneering work in agriculture, particularly in the Green Revolution, has left an indelible mark on our nation. As we remember his extraordinary contributions to the field of agriculture, we would like to gather as a community to honor his legacy by conducting a Plantation Drive. title: Credit Transfer Option for studying abroad. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/230927/001) : (9/27/2023)
body: Dear Students, Lovely Professional University (LPU) offers a great opportunity for its students to get an international exposure that can be a life-changing experience for them. LPU believes that this initiative will further expand the academic horizons of our students. It will not only enhance the global network of our students, but also let you experience a new culture and boost your career immensely. What is Credit Transfer Option? If a student chooses to opt for Credit Transfer for studying abroad, then he/she will study initial part of his/her programme at LPU and the remaining part of the programme at the foreign University. Eligibility Criteria: i. For continuing students: A student should have a minimum 6.5 CGPA with no backlog(s)/reappear(s) and should have no indiscipline case (initiated or action taken) against him/her during his/her stay at LPU. ii. For Freshmen: 65% marks in lower qualifying exam in case of freshmen where credit transfer option is offered Please Note: i. In case of freshmen, the option for taking Credit Transfer may be taken in advance; but the student will be sent to the foreign University after the completion of at least one year in LPU. ii. The students who opt for Credit Transfer in Autumn Term (Term-I), 2021 shall be sent to foreign Universities in the upcoming semesters subject to the fulfillment of the conditions as mentioned in the attached guidelines of this announcement titled “Guidelines for taking Credit Transfer as an Option.” iii. Students must take consent from their parents/guardians before opting for Credit Transfer. iv. The eligible students who are interested to opt for Credit Transfer must fill the ONLINE UNDERTAKING available on the UMS as per the following link: UMS Home Page-> UMS Navigation -> Learning Management System (LMS) -> Undertaking for Credit Transfer Option The interface of filling the ONLINE UNDERTAKING is open now. The interface will be closed at 5:00 pm on Saturday, 30th December 2023. The guidelines have been attached for your reference. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation -- > Relationship Management System (RMS) -- > Log Request Master Category: Academics Category: Academics Sub category: Semester Abroad/ Study Abroad

title: Enunciation - A Workshop on Accent and Pronunciation : (9/27/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Enunciation - A Workshop on Accent and Pronunciation”. The workshop will emphasize familiarising students with the concept of accent, the importance of neutral accent and correct pronunciation. The session will focus on the basics of pronunciation and the importance of accent neutralization. It will enhance the student’s ability to communicate clearly and effectively. It will cover sounds, contractions, and the impact of mispronounced words on the overall meaning. The students will apply the basics learnt in activities during the session. Overall, it will enrich and boost the students’ confidence to convey their thoughts and ideas clearly and convincingly. The main objectives of the event are: · To assist students in the development of Voice and Accent. · To prepare them for future Placement drives and other public speaking platforms. · To enhance the Clarity of Speech. · To enable them to become confident and articulate speakers. Target audience: The students of all the Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. title: Retraction Watch Hijacked Or Cloned Journals Checker : (9/26/2023)
body: Hijacked/ Cloned journals mimic legitimate journals by adopting their titles, ISSNs, and other metadata.Usually, hijacked journals mirror legitimate journals without permission from the original journal. Scholars can be duped into publishing in hijacked journals – many of which require fees – by offers of fast publication and indexing in databases such as Scopus; being indexed in such databases is viewed by many universities and governments as a mark of legitimacy.Tracking these journals is no mean feat but knowing which journals may have been hijacked is vital to the world of publishing integrity. List of cloned or hijacked Journal: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ak985WGOgGbJRJbZFanoktAN_UFeExpE/edit#gid=5255084 This list of cloned/hijacked journal is dynamic; more journals will be added as their hijacked status are uncovered.

title: GUIDELINES REGARDING PARTICIPATION IN 109TH INDIAN SCIENCE CONGRESS. (Ref. No. LPU/ASW/IC/230925/001) : (9/25/2023)
body: It is a matter of great pride to announce that Lovely Professional University shall be hosting the 109th Indian Science Congress, scheduled to be held from January 3rd to January 7th, 2024. The Indian Science Congress is organised in collaboration with Indian Science Congress Association (ISCA). In this event about 30,000 scientists from diverse domains as members, meet annually in the first week of January. This prestigious occasion shall be graced by the Honourable Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi as the Chief Guest of this magnanimous event. The Focal Theme for 109th Indian Science Congress is “The Global Perspective on Science and Technology for Sustainable Future” Participation in an event of this stature shall leave an indelible mark on the future academic career of the students. As students of LPU you shall be getting this rare and special opportunity wherein you shall . Get an opportunity to listen and interact with highly accomplished personalities having remarkable achievements of highest calibre in their respective fields. . Meet and interact with globally renowned scientists even Nobel laureates. During the 106th Indian Science Congress held at LPU the students got a chance to interact with 3 Nobel laureates. . Participate in sessions of Esteemed Guests and Dignitaries. The Indian Science Congress shall be held in the form of 14 conferences on diverse topics with several sessions in each conference. In addition, there shall also be several exhibitions, competitions etc. Thus, through these sessions the students shall get an opportunity to gain knowledge about the latest technological advancements and recent development in the Science and Technology sector. To ensure that the students can attend the Indian Science Congress and learn about the latest trends in science and technology, certain modifications have been made in the Academic Calendar of the students. The University students are required to participate in this event as per the categories described as below: The category in which the student shall be required to participate has been intimated individually to all the students through their “My Messages” tab (kindly refer to the same) Category Description Associated Academic Rewards Highlights of modifications in Academic Calendar Compulsory Student Participant (Special provision created for students of Batch 2023 and PG students of specific programmes through a special approval granted by Indian Science Congress Association) Academic Rewards towards: 1. CA in courses registered to student in the upcoming Spring Term. 2. Attendance in the upcoming Spring Term. Details provided in Table 1 For 1st year students: 1. Spring Term will start from Jan 2nd, 2024. 2. Winter Vacation from Jan 8th to Jan 19th 2024. 3. End Term Examination as per the datesheet From PG students of specific programmes selected as participant: 1. End Term Examination and Winter vacation will also be preponed facilitating the students to attend 109 ISC from 3-7 Jan 2024. 2. Spring Term will start from Jan 10th , 2024. Optional Student Delegate Academic Rewards towards: 1. CA in courses registered to student in the upcoming Spring Term. 2. Attendance in the upcoming term 3. Consideration towards a 2 credit course to be completed by the student during Summer Break. (Details provided below). Students getting the award of “Best Paper” or “Best Poster” shall be considered for “O” grade in one relevant course of the upcoming term All university students can register as student delegate. For details regarding winter vacation dates and start date of Spring Term refer Student My Message. Please Note: The Datesheet for the End Term Examination for Autumn Term shall be released shortly and students are required to make travel plans accordingly. The students intimated to register as “Student Participant” in lieu of the same are encouraged to also register as “Student Delegate” as there shall be additional advantages associated with it described below: 1. Certificate of Participation (issued through ISCA) in the selected Conference. Thus, leading to an enriched CV. 2. Conference Kit to be provided by ISCA. 3. Food Coupons. 4. Chance to present Paper/Poster in a highly valued event. “O” grade in a course in case Paper/Poster gets selected as Best Paper/Poster. 5. Concession on Conference registration fee. 6. Consideration towards a 2 credit course to be completed by the student during Summer Break. 7. Opportunity to meet dignitaries and well-known scientists (including Nobel laureates) from India and Abroad. TABLE 1: ACADEMIC REWARDS Student Delegate Student Participant Award in Continuous Assessment (CA) (i) 5 weighted marks in the Continuous Assessment (CA) component (out of total weighted CA marks of 20) in all the courses registered to him/her in the Spring Term-Session 2023-24, i.e. an academic reward of 25% marks in Continuous Assessment (CA) component of each course. e.g., suppose in a course “Z” of Spring Term-Session 2023-24, at the end of term, a student has scored 12 marks out of 20 in Continuous Assessment (CA) component, and he/she had attended all the allocated sessions of ISC 2024, then 5 additional marks shall be awarded to him leading to his final CA score being 17/20 (subject to condition that maximum limit of total CA marks that can be earned by student is 20). AND (ii) 25% additional weighted marks in the Continuous Assessment (CA) component in Research Dissertation Course registered in the Spring Term-Session 2023-24, in addition to 25% weighted marks already mentioned in point no.(i) above) i.e. an academic reward of total 50% marks in Continuous Assessment (CA) component of Research Dissertation course. e.g., suppose in a Dissertation course “C” of Spring Term-Session 2023-24, at the end of term, a student has scored 20 marks out of 50 in Continuous Assessment (CA) component of Research Dissertation course, and he/she had attended all the allocated sessions of ISC 2024 and presented his/her research work then 25 additional marks shall be awarded to him leading to his final CA score being 45/50 in that course (subject to condition that maximum limit of total CA marks that can be earned by student is 50). (i) 5 weighted marks in the Continuous Assessment (CA) component (out of total weighted CA marks of 20) in all the courses registered to him/her in the Spring Term-Session 2023-24, i.e. an academic reward of 25% marks in Continuous Assessment (CA) component of each course. e.g., suppose in a course “Z” of Spring Term-Session 2023-24, at the end of term, a student has scored 12 marks out of 20 in Continuous Assessment (CA) component, and he/she had attended all the allocated sessions of ISC 2024, then 5 additional marks shall be awarded to him leading to his final CA score being 17/20 (subject to condition that maximum limit of total CA marks that can be earned by student is 20). (ii) Not eligible Grade Updation Students getting the award of “Best Paper” or “Best Poster” shall be considered for “O” grade in one relevant course of the upcoming term. Not eligible Consideration towards a 2 credit course to be completed by the student during Summer Break) On the basis of, sessions attended by the students (of batch 2023), the student shall be required to prepare a report on the topic “Recent advances in science and technology and their impact on society” which shall be considered towards his/her submission for the course Community Development Project. Not eligible Certificate of Participation Eligible Not eligible Conference Kit Eligible Not eligible Food Coupons Eligible Not eligible Concession in Conference registration fee Eligible (details shall be communicated later via a separate UMS announcement) Not Applicable Note: 1. Mandatory requirement for gaining academic reward:100% attendance in all sessions allocated to a student. 2. In case, a student is absent in any session, he/she shall lose the entitlement to the mentioned academic reward. 3. In case in any research dissertation course, Continuous Assessment (CA) component is not applicable, the same rewards shall be extended in End Term Practical (ETP component). Important guidelines for attending the 109th ISC conferences/sessions: Attendance in the Indian Science Congress Category Sessions to be allocated Student Delegate All sessions of the selected conference. Students can book their seats in their preferred event/conference through an online interface on first-come-first basis. Details shall be notified soon. Student Participant All allocated sessions (details of the sessions allocated shall be provided later) Faculty allocated in the sessions shall mark attendance of the students. The students shall be required to adhere to the following guidelines for attending the Conferences/sessions: Attendance benefits and associated requirements: 1. Each student will be required to attend multiple sessions in the Indian Science Congress 2024. 2. On attending all allocated sessions, the student shall get attendance equivalent to no. of weekly scheduled lectures according to programme scheme of 2nd term. 3. E.g., In case a student has 25 weekly lectures according to programme scheme of 2nd term and if he/she attends all allocated ISC sessions from 3-7 Jan. 2024, will receive attendance credit for 25 lectures as the first week's attendance and an additional 25 lectures as a first-week bonus for the Spring Term 2023-24, i.e. he/she shall earn attendance of total -50 lectures by attending all ISC sessions.. In case, if a student doesn’t attend the allocated sessions, his/her 1st week attendance will be 0/25 and he/she will not be entitled for 1st week bonus of Spring Term, 2023-24. Moreover, at the end of term, during calculation of final attendance percentage, these 25 lectures shall be added to the denominator (i.e. total no. of lectures delivered) but this student shall not get any attendance out of 25 in numerator (i.e. total no. of attended lectures). E.g. in case a student has “X” number of attended lectures at the end of term and “Y” number of total delivered lectures. His attendance percentage at the end of term shall be calculated by formula (X*100)/Y. Case 1: A student has attended all ISC sessions. Then his/her attendance percentage will be calculated as (X+50) *100)/(Y+25) Case 2: A student has not attended all ISC sessions. Then his/her attendance percentage will be calculated as ((X+0)*100)/(Y+25). 4. It is reiterated that it is compulsory for the registered and selected students to attend ALL THE Indian Science Congress sessions/conferences allocated to him/her. Allocated faculty members in the sessions shall mark attendance of student delegates and student participants 5. Attendance of these sessions shall be considered in the attendance of Spring Term-Session 2023-24. Absence in any session shall lead to equivalent absenteeism in attendance record of Spring Term-Session 2023-24. Important: Since this event is of high grandiose and eminent personalities shall be gracing this event with their presence, hence high security shall be maintained during the event. Students will need an online generated "Entry Pass" to attend the event. To generate the Entry Pass, compulsory online authentication of student credentials will be required to be done by all students for which a separate communication shall follow. Your presence at this grand event would add immense value to this historic occasion. Let’s come together and ensure the resounding success of this event! In case of any query, you can submit your request via Relationship Management System (RMS) by following the UMS path: UMS Navigation -- > Relationship Management System -- > Log Request -- > Select Category “Indian Science Congress”

title: Career Orientation Session 2 - 2025 Passing out Batch (9/25/2023)
body: Division of Career Services, LPU is going to organize a “Career Orientation Session 2 - 2025 Passing out Batch” Situated in the lively city of Jalandhar, Lovely Professional University (LPU) shines as a symbol of academic distinction. Boasting cutting-edge facilities, a dedication to comprehensive education, and a global perspective, LPU creates a nurturing atmosphere for students to flourish academically and personally. The Career Services Orientation at Lovely Professional University is poised to be a pivotal occasion, laying the groundwork for students to actively connect with their future professional paths. Through a mix of informative sessions, interactive workshops, and practical insights, this event aims to provide a platform where students not only envision their career trajectories but also take tangible steps toward realizing their professional aspirations. The main objectives of the event are: To empower students with the knowledge and resources to make informed career choices. To familiarize students with the range of services offered by the Career Services Department at Lovely Professional University. title: AI vs. Human Intelligence: A workshop on the importance of knowing language in the AI era : (9/23/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “AI vs. Human Intelligence: A workshop on the importance of knowing language in the AI era”. In the age where artificial intelligence is making significant strides, it’s crucial for students to recognize the unique strengths of human intelligence, particularly in the realm of language. This workshop, tailored for students, delves into the dynamic between AI and human intelligence in the context of language. It aims to equip students with a deeper understanding of why language is essential for their personal growth and professional success, cautioning against overreliance on AI for linguistic tasks. The students will learn why human intelligence remains irreplaceable in certain aspects of communication and problem-solving. The workshop emphasizes on the idea that while AI can assist, human intelligence remains essential for creative and critical thinking; effective communication and writing skills. The main objectives of the event are: · To understand the role of AI as a complementary tool rather than a replacement of human linguistic capabilities. · To attain good command over language. · To enrich the capacity to write or communicate in more creative way. Target audience: The students of all the Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 27th September, 2023 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 34-213 Resource Person: Ms. Shikha Bhatti Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/AIVsHumanIntelligenceWorkshop

It provides financial assistance to enable them to work independently anywhere in India. title: Shree Maheshwari Foundation Scholarships 2023-24- reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230922/001) : (9/22/2023)
body: Shree Maheshwari Foundation offers three Scholarships for Higher Education named as under: (i) Shri B.C. Maheshwari (H.E.) Memorial Scholarship (for Boys Only) (ii) Smt. Sugan Devi Maheshwari (H.E.) Memorial Scholarship (for Girls Only) (iii) Mrs. Rukmani Maheshwari (H.E.) Memorial Scholarship. Reserved for children of all Army/Police Personnel, killed in action while performing their duties. The amount of Scholarship is ? 5,000/- per semester for a university student. The Scholarships would be conferred upon meritorious and economically weak students. The beneficiaries of the scholarship shall be selected from the applicants, by a Committee comprising of eminent persons and total three students would be selected from B.Com./BBA and MBA Course. The following criteria shall be used to select the candidates: 1. The students Family Gross Income should not exceed ? 5,00,000 per annum. 2. Students should have successfully completed their previous semester/year of B.A., B. Com, BBA and MBA (as may be relevant) Examinations from a recognized University and cleared in the First Attempt. 3. Application shall be submitted by students seeking the scholarship on the enclosed prescribed form. The form requires accurate Academic and Financial Information from the student. 4. The Awards Committee follows a Graded Score System for evaluating both Overall Academic Performance and Overall Financial Status of the Students. 5. The Committee shall identify the student’s with the highest score for the concerned scholarship. 6. The selected students’s shall appear for an interview, if desired, with the Chairman of the Foundation, at the final stage. The following clear documents are required for the verification purpose : 1. Completely filled application form. 2. Attested copies of the mark sheets of class X, class XII previous semester/year BA/BBA/ B. Com. and MBA. 3. Copy of last fee receipts deposited in the University. 4. If the student is apply for Mrs. Rukmani Maheshwari (H.E.) Memorial Scholarship then a certificate from relevant Competent Army/Police Authorities that the applicant is eligible for the reserved category Scholarship in case one applies for that category. 5. Income Certificate from the competent authority as mentioned in the documents required Para 1. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students:- UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2023-24 --------> Shree Maheshwari Foundation Scholarships 2023-24 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 102(A), Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be collected by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS –External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378

title: 75 Creative Minds of Tomorrow’ - (CMOT - 2023) : (9/21/2023)
body: Announcement No. : LPU/DII/IC/230921/001 Description The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting invites entries for ‘75 Creative Minds of Tomorrow’. The segment is an annual platform at the International Film Festival of India held in Goa, to identify, encourage and nurture young creative talents from across various aspects of filmmaking. The 75 creative minds will be shortlisted and selected on the basis of their submissions by an eminent jury, under the aegis of the National Film Development Corporation ahead of the 53rd edition of International Film Festival of India. This program identifies young budding film makers and provides them a platform to interact and learn from national as well as international film makers during the period of IFFI, Goa. Last Date To Register 23rd September 2023 Registration Details *Link1: https://www.iffigoa.org/creative-minds-of-tomorrow.php *Link2: https://tinyurl.com/47m59vdx *Note: Its mandatory to register on both the links Each applicant can apply for ONLY ONE of the above-mentioned categories which best represents their core competencies and/ or expertise. The same short film can be submitted across multiple categories provided it is submitted by different applicants within the same category or different categories. In the event the submitted short film is produced by a production house, it must not have been sponsored by a renowned production house and/or a production house other than one's own. The decision of the Jury will be final and binding and no appeal or correspondence regarding their decisions shall be entertained. Eligibility The applicant should be an Indian Citizen. Applicant must be born on or after July 1, 1988. The total running time of the film/ showreel/ audio track to be submitted should not be more than 10 minutes. The Entry accredited to the applicant should be completed after June 30, 2022. Regional films to be submitted in the categories of acting, script writing and, direction must be subtitled in English. Participants selected in the earlier edition of the ‘75 Creative Minds of Tomorrow’ are not eligible to apply in the current edition of the programme. For any query kindly contact Mr. Mohit Dhawan at mohit.30780@lpu.co.in
