title: UPDATED ATTENDANCE GUIDELINES FOR Ph.D. SCHOLARS. (Ref. No. LPU/ASW/IC/230918/001) : (9/18/2023)
body: This is for the information of all the concerned that following guidelines shall be applicable for all the full time and part time Ph.D. research scholars from August 2023 (2324-1) term and onwards. Some of the key highlights of attendance guidelines are as follows: I. Attendance criteria for weekly interaction time slots 1. All full time Ph.D. research scholars are required to be present for a minimum of 12 interaction slots out of 16 compulsory interaction slots to become eligible for appearing in next applicable evaluation 2. All part time Ph.D. research scholars are required to be present for a minimum of 6 online interaction slots out of 8 compulsory online interaction slots to become eligible for appearing in the next applicable evaluation. II. Attendance criteria for biometric attendance(for full time scholars only) 1. All full time Ph.D. scholars need to mark their biometric attendance in the University. The biometric attendance of a scholar shall be counted only if scholar is present for minimum 5 hours a day and maximum attendance hours that shall be counted for one day shall be 8 hours per day. The time period in which the scholar can be present in the University is from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. 2. A full time Ph.D. scholar is advised to maintain biometric attendance of 240 hours per term. However minimum of 180 hours of biometric attendance is required in a term to become eligible for appearing in the next applicable evaluation. 3. No biometric attendance is applicable for part time Ph.D. scholars. Although the interaction sessions are online, it shall be compulsory for the scholar to be physically present in the University as and when called by the Supervisor and also he/she should be physically present for all offline evaluations. The detailed attendance guidelines applicable to full time and part time Ph.D. scholars are attached herewith for reference. All supervisors are advised to brief their respective Ph.D. research scholars in upcoming interaction slot about the new attendance guidelines. For further query, Ph.D. research scholars may log an RMS at link mentioned below: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request---> Department [Ph.D. (Centre for Research Degree Programmes)] -- > Category [Supervisor Related]-- > Sub Category [Supervisor Interaction Slots]

title: Opportunity for International Co-Supervision for Ph.D. Scholars of Biosciences and Pharmacy at Memorial University of Newfoundland, Canada. (Ref. No. LPU/CRDP/IC/230918/001) : (9/18/2023)
body: We are privileged to collaborate with distinguished professor, from Memorial University of Newfoundland, Canada as part of our International Co-Supervision Program (ICSP). In this program, the scholar will get the opportunity to be co-supervised by the professor from Memorial University of Newfoundland, Canada. With an impressive record of over 90 research works, 2500 citations and an h-index of 29, the research focus of the collaborator includes: a.Intricate regulation of metabolic pathways by dietary fats and fatty acids, with a particular emphasis on preventing cardiovascular disease, obesity/diabetes, and promoting brain health, b.Investigating the impact of maternal dietary fats during pregnancy on offspring metabolism and collaborating with clinicians and industry partners on translational research and nutraceutical development. To be considered for this opportunity, please submit the following documents no later than September 22, 2023 (Friday): a. A concise research proposal (template attached) b.Your CV, including a list of publications c.Your supervisor's CV, including Scopus h-index, citation count, ScopusID, and a link to their Google Scholar profile. Please ensure your supervisor is copied on the email and that your proposal has their approval before submission. Kindly send all three required documents to crdp.planning@lpu.co.in. Shortlisted candidates will have the privilege of interviewing with our expert panel. We encourage you to seize this exceptional opportunity and submit your proposal promptly. title: LPU GLOBAL: CHARPAK FRENCH SCHOLARSHIP for Semester Exchange Program : (9/16/2023)
body: The Division of International Affairs is excited to present an exceptional opportunity for LPU students, both at the Bachelor's and Master's levels. This opportunity allows them to enroll in a semester at our esteemed French partner universities with full tuition fee waivers. Additionally, students have the potential to receive a Monthly Grant of 860 Euros (approximately Rs. 77,000) through the CHARPAK FRENCH SCHOLARSHIP. Under this program, students are only responsible for the tuition fees applicable at LPU. They can seize the chance to study for a semester at one of our international partner universities. It's important to note that all formalities and expenses related to visas, travel, accommodation, food, and any other fees associated with the partner foreign university will be the responsibility of the student. Eligibility Criteria: - A minimum of 8.5 CGPA - Valid for: 1st, 2nd & 3rd year students only - A valid PASSPORT - Good Attendance record - Active participant in extra co-curricular activities - Excellent communication skills - English proficiency test as per the requirement of the partner university Highlights: - Students who are selected will get a monthly grant of 860 Euros (Rs 77000 Approx.) till the completion of their semester. - VISA expenses are waived off. Seats: Limited availability of seats. Apply as soon as you can. Participating Institutions: - EPF, France - ESIGELEC, France - ESME, School of Engineering, France - IMT Nord Europe, France - ISEP, France - ONIRIS, France - Sup Biotech, France - Institut Polytechnique UniLaSalle, France Last date to apply: 30th September 2023 Link to register: https://forms.gle/VoLWhXTEVWVVUgug7 For further information, please visit Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310), call 9501110446 or email at study.abroad@lpu.co.in

title: Make an impact- A discussion competition based on Model United Nations (MUN) : (9/16/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Make an impact-A discussion competition based on Model United Nations”. A MUN is a simulation of an actual United Nations conference, where students will be tasked with solving a global issue through research, drafting, lobbying and debate to pass a suitable ‘resolution’. This event will help students practice research, enhance their public speaking skills, teamwork, negotiation, and writing skills in a safe and structured environment. Interacting with unfamiliar faces and expressing views in self-assured manner will escalate their confidence and leadership skills. Participants will be assigned to be in a certain committee of the UN representing a nation as a delegate. They will carry out a discussion on the topic assigned to them followed by which they will vote in favour or against the motion. The main objectives of the event are: · To develop skills in the students to solve issues and manage negotiations. · To educate students about the working process of the United Nations. · To enhance professional skills, communication skills and global acumen. Target audience: The students of School of Computer Science and Engineering, School of Computer Applications, School of Electronics and Electrical Engineering and School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences will participate in the event. Date: 18th September, 2023 Time: 03:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 14-404 Resource Person: Ms. Pawandeep Kaur Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/ModelUnitedNations-CPE

title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships 2023-24- reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230916/001) : (9/16/2023)
body: Reliance has been providing scholarships to meritorious students for over 25 years. The aim of this scholarship is to nurture and empower meritorious students and work together to generate robust, vibrant and engaged alumni networks, enabling scholars to pursue higher education, emerge as young professionals, and drive India’s growth. The Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships aim to support up to 5,000 meritorious students based on a merit-cum-means criteria. The detailed criteria may be checked from the following link: Link: - https://www.buddy4study.com/page/reliance-foundation-scholarships The Last date for the scholarship is 15th October 2023. Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Students pursuing 1st year undergraduate degree courses of any stream are eligible. 2. The students must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in Classes 12 examinations. 3. Total Family Income from all sources should not exceed Rs.15,00,000/- (Fifteen Lakh) per year (preference given to income less than Rs. 2.5 Lakhs) 4. Students who have passed the Diploma after 10th Standard are not eligible. 5. Aptitude Test is mandatory. 6. Open for Indian nationals only. Benefits: Up to INR 2,00,000 over the duration of the degree programme. NOTE: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship will go beyond financial support by providing students with network opportunities through a strong alumni network. The following clear self-attested documents are required for the verification purpose : · Mark sheet of previous qualifying examination i.e. 10th and 12th. · Passport size photograph. · Aadhaar card of the applicant. · Family income proof issued by Gram Panchayat/Ward Counsellor/Sarpanch/Income Proof issued by SDM / DM / CO / Tehsildar. · Bonafide Certificate. · College fee receipt/demand receipt issued by the college. · Official Disability Certificate issued by relevant Government authority (if applicable) Note: · The applicant will be required to upload all the self-attested documents. · If student already in receipt of any other scholarship or financial assistance from any organization at any stage, then scholarship stands cancelled. If the students would like to apply for any other scholarship scheme for the session 2023-2024 then the students should not apply for this scholarship scheme. · Students have to take screenshot of details filled in online application form before final submission of application and submit the copy of application form along with above mentioned documents at Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No. 4. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students:- UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2023-24 --------> Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships 2023-24. All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 102(A), Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be collected by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS –External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378

title: Session on Key Operations at Radio Station and potential career opportunities by Punjabi Fever FM (9/16/2023)
body: Division of Career Services, LPU is going to organize a “Session on Key Operations at Radio Station and potential career opportunities by Punjabi Fever FM”. Fever FM is the fastest growing Contemporary Bollywood Station in the country and the destination station for youth with listenership of over 16 million. Since launch, Fever FM has introduced content across various genres (music and non-music). The station is the pioneer in repackaging great epics like Mahabharata, Ramayana, Gandhi, Bose over the years. Fever FM has also powered the sports and IPL revolution in the country with partnerships with the biggest franchises across the country. The session covers the common skills required for radio jobs, such as communication, technical, research, creativity and teamwork skills, and how to showcase them in a portfolio and resume. Moreover, it covers the process of finding and applying for radio positions, as well as preparing and interviewing for the role. The topic aims to provide information and guidance for people who are interested in working in the radio industry. The main objectives of the event are: To brief students about the skillset and expertise required to build a career in the Radio industry. To inform students about the scope and demand of Radio industry in the world. To acquaint the students with the operations and happenings of the Radio industry. Target audience: The students of the School of Journalism. Date: 19th September, 2023 Time: 12:00 PM - 02:00 PM Venue: Block 19-101 Resource Person: Mr. Vishesh Head Division of Career Services

title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (9/15/2023)
body: Dear Student Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. To know more, you can participate in a polling for a skill development counselling session organized by the Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE). The session will be offline and duty leaves will be provided. To participate in the polling, please fill out the registration link given below. Don’t miss this opportunity to learn new skills and get ready for your dream career. Last Date to Enroll: 25th September 2023. title: Session on The Art of Advocacy by JAGGI, JAGGJI and JAGGI (9/14/2023)
body: Division of Career Services, LPU is going to organize “Session on The Art of Advocacy by JAGGI, JAGGJI and JAGGI”. The participants will come to know that Advocacy isn’t merely about raising voice; it's an art form—a strategic, nuanced approach to championing causes, igniting change, and making a meaningful impact in our society. The event will emphasize the fact that the firm advises both domestic and international clients in all aspects of Indian Business and Commercial Law, Insurance Law, Corporate Finance, Taxation, Entertainment, Intellectual Property, and Business Immigration. Also, it will talk about the role of Greenfield projects in setting up sales and distribution operations in India as well as on gaining access to Indian Project Finance. The event will enlighten participants about the essence of advocacy—unveiling its intricacies, discovering its power, and uncovering the techniques to marshal facts, identify issues, and present the law. These aspects will enable them to become more effective advocates. The main objectives of the event are: To educate attendees about the fundamental principles, strategies, and techniques of effective advocacy, fostering a deeper understanding of its significance and impact. To cultivate empathy and broaden perspectives, helping participants understand diverse viewpoints and develop inclusive advocacy approaches that consider various societal needs and perspectives. To provide practical tools and skills necessary for successful advocacy, including effective communication, storytelling, networking, coalition-building, and mobilizing support for causes. Target audience: The students of the School of Law. Date: 16th September, 2023 Time: 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM Venue: Block 20-204 Resource Person: Mr. Navin Kumar Jaggi Head Division of Career Services

title: Activation of Interface for students to view the available MOOCs/Certifications in their respective programs and apply for Academic Benefit. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/230913/001) : (9/13/2023)
body: MOOCs (Massive Open Online Courses) are an excellent way to broaden your horizons and gain expertise in diverse subjects. They are offered by various private and government organizations, as well as global educational platforms, and come with a multitude of benefits: 1. To encourage you to take up MOOCs or certifications, the University is offering academic benefits in the form of evaluation components (CA, MTT, ETE) for the course(s) most closely aligned with the content of the MOOC/certification. 2. Additionally, students appearing for the proctored exam of registered MOOCs will be granted duty leave equivalent to 10% of the total lectures delivered for the course. For detailed information on MOOCs and certifications, please follow the steps below: i. Suggestive List: Visit the UMS link (UMS > LMS MOOCs/Certifications) to access a suggestive list of already mapped and approved MOOCs/Certifications for your program. ii. Application Process: To understand how to apply for academic benefits upon completion of MOOCs/Certifications, refer to the "Step-by-Step Guideline to View the MOOCs and Apply for Academic Benefit." Note: Any certification, if found fake or forged, shall be considered as UMC (Unfair Means Case). The certificate will be verified only when the details (e.g., Name on certificate should be as per university records etc.) are correct otherwise it will be rejected. All students are advised to follow the above-mentioned link and avail themselves of the academic benefit associated with successful completion of the MOOCs/Certifications.

title: Spatialist-A workshop on spatial reasoning : (9/12/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Spatialist-A workshop on spatial reasoning”. The event emphasizes on the ability to understand objects in both two and three-dimensional terms and draw conclusions about them with limited information. Although being able to visualise, rotate or disassemble objects into alternate formats sounds challenging, this is a skill that can be improved with practice. Spatial perception - this is the ability to understand how and where a person or object fits within a larger area and can be used to visualize measurements, features and position. Mental rotation - this is the skill of being able to rotate a 2D or 3D object. Essentially, it enables you to see an object from a different angle, even when you don’t have a 360-degree image. The main objectives of the event are: · To enhance creative skills and logical skills among students. · To raise student’s confidence in placement exams through workshop. · To improves concentration and memory of the students. Target audience: The students of School of Computer Science and Engineering and School of Computer Application will participate in the event. Date: 14th September, 2023 Time: 01:00 PM-02:00 PM Venue: Block 34-413 Resource Person: Mr. Ashish Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/SpatialistOnSpatialReasoning

title: Session on AI & ML in Healthcare & Life Sciences by QUANTIPH (9/12/2023)
body: Division of Career Services, LPU will organize a “Session on AI & ML in Healthcare & Life Sciences by QUANTIPHI”, an award-winning AI-first digital engineering company driven by the desire to reimagine and realize transformational opportunities at the heart of the business. Since its inception in 2013, Quantiphi has solved the toughest and most complex business problems by combining deep industry experience, disciplined cloud, and data-engineering practices, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence research to achieve accelerated and quantifiable business results. The event aims to discuss the emerging role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in the field of Healthcare and Life Sciences. As technology is evolving, the overall healthcare ecosystem has grown drastically bringing a positive impact on patient outcomes. The session will guide the students to create a balance between innovation and ethical use of AI in healthcare which remains a critical focus for the industry. The main objectives of the event are: To inform students about the opportunities available in the relevant field To explore artificial intelligence research to achieve accelerated and quantifiable business results To bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world applications in corporate To help students align their academic pursuits with the evolving demands of the industry Target audience: The students of the School of Computer Science Engineering (B.Tech), School of Electrical and Electronics Engineering and School of Computer Applications Date: 14th September, 2023 Time: 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM Venue: Block 32-313 Resource Person: Dr. Sakshi Rastogi Head Division of Career Services

title: Recurrence- A workshop based on interest problems : (9/11/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Recurrence- A workshop based on interest problems.” The entire economic world is based on one principle that is - the value of money is not constant but keeps changing with time, also known as the concept of ‘time value money’. In simple words the value that a rupee holds today will not be equal to the value of a rupee by tomorrow. Therefore, a rupee borrowed today cannot be repaid by a rupee tomorrow which leads to the basic concept of interest. Interest is calculated on the investment or loan taken. The two ways to calculate interest are simple interest (SI) and compound interest (CI). The main objectives of the event are: · To build up the understanding of Simple Interest and Compound Interest. · To practice solving questions on percentage calculation. · To study various standard statements and situations relating to calculation of Interest. Target audience: The students of School of Computer Science and Engineering will participate in the event. Date: 12th September, 2023 Time: 03:00 PM Onwards Venue: Block 34-413 Resource Person: Mr. Amjad Ali Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/RecurrenceAWorkshop

title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (9/8/2023)
body: Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. To know more, you can participate in a polling for a skill development counselling session organized by the Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE). title: Raman Kant Munjal Scholarship 2023-24 - reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230908/003) : (9/8/2023)
body: Raman Kant Munjal Scholarships 2023 is an initiative by the Raman Kant Munjal Foundation supported by Hero FinCorp that aims to support students pursuing finance-related courses. Students studying in the 1st-year of BBA, B.Com. (H, E), Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS), BA (Economics), Bachelors in Business Studies (BBS), Bachelors in Banking and Insurance (BBI), Bachelors in Accounting and Finance (BAF) and B.Sc. (Statistics) or any other finance related degree courses will be entitled to receive a financial assistance of up to INR 5,00,000 per year for a period of 3 years to complete their education. Link: - https://www.buddy4study.com/page/raman-kant-munjal-scholarships The Last date for the scholarship is 15th September 2023. Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Students pursuing 1st year of BBA, B.Com. (H, E), Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS), Integrated Program in Management (IPM), B.A. (Economics), Bachelors in Business Studies (BBS), Bachelors in Banking and Insurance (BBI), Bachelors in Accounting and Finance (BAF) and B.Sc. (Statistics) or any other finance-related degree courses are eligible. 2. The Students must have secured a minimum of 80% marks in Classes 10 & 12 examinations. 3. Total Family Income from all sources should not exceed Rs.4,00,000/- (Four Lakh) per year. 4. Children of employees/contract employees of Hero FinCorp, Raman Kant Munjal Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. 5. Open for Indian nationals only. Benefits: Scholarship ranging from INR 40,000 to INR 5,00,000 per year will be awarded to each scholar for a period of 3 years for completing their education. The following clear self-attested documents are required for the verification purpose :- · Mark sheet of previous qualifying examination i.e. 10th and 12th. · Passport size photograph. · Aadhaar card of the applicant. · Pan card and Aadhaar card of the parents. · Income proof [ITR (all 7 pages reflecting all account)/Income Certificate/Salary slip of salaried parents]. · Bank account statements of applicant’s parents. · Current year (session 2023-2024 – 1st Year) admission proof (Collect Bonafide Certificate or Admission Base Certificate from 32-101, Window No. 2). · College fee receipt/demand receipt issued by the college. · Affidavit (stating that all the documents provided by the applicants are true to their knowledge). Note: · The applicant will be required to upload all the self-attested documents. · If student already in receipt of any other scholarship or financial assistance from any organization at any stage, then scholarship stands cancelled. If the students would like to apply for any other scholarship scheme for the session 2023-2024 then the students should not apply for this scholarship scheme. · Students have to take screenshot of details filled in online application form before final submission of application and submit the copy of application form along with above mentioned documents at Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No. 4. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students:- UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2023-24 --------> Raman Kant Munjal Scholarship 2023-24. All the eligible students have to submit their above mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 102(A) , Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be collected only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS –External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378

The details of the workshop are as follows: Date: 11 Sept 2023 Day: Monday Time: 5:00 PM - 6:30 PM Venue: 14-301L Note: Certificates will be provided to the attendees. The workshop will be led by Mr. Suman Sourabh, a professional graphic designer. Mr. Sourabh will discuss the different meanings and associations of colors, and how they can be used to create effective graphic designs. He will also share tips on how to choose the right colors for your project, and how to use color psychology to influence the emotions and behavior of your audience. title: Registration invited for Short Term Course on Scale Development by using AMOS : (9/5/2023)
body: New strides are made on regular basis in the field of scale validation due to availability of robust standard and free softwares, which are making it feasible to apply complex statistical techniques on the data and gain novel insights on the same. The STC on Scale Development by using AMOS tries to expose the participants to some of intricacies in this vital statistical technique of factor structure validation. In this context, here is an opportunity to get exposed to these recent developments in the psychological tool testing through this Short Term Course as per details mentioned below: Title Short Term Course on Scale Development by using AMOS Course Outcome The participants will be able to: 1. Explore the SPSS AMOS Ver. 23.0 interface for factor structure validation 2. Justify the retention and deletion of items during confirmatory factor analysis 3. Analyze results of confirmatory factor analysis technique on real time data 4. Employ equivalence testing on the validated factor structure 5. Apply measurement invariance testing on the validated factor structure 6. title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (9/4/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Important guidelines for scholars availing government fellowships (NET JRF/NET SRF/NFSC/MANF/NFST) (Ref. No. LPU/CRDP/IC/230901/001) : (9/1/2023)
body: As we mark the beginning of academic term, Autumn Term, 2023-24, all PhD scholars availing any of the government fellowship schemes like NET JRF/NET SRF/NFSC/MANF/NFST etc, are hereby requested to ensure timely compliance of following mentioned points so as to ensure hassle free data updation on government portal by CRDP Document/Certificate Type Submission Deadlines Remarks Continuation Certificate (i) Third Day of Every Month for NET-JRF/SRF (ii) Seventh Day of every Month for NFSC/MANF (iii) Third Day after every three Months for NFST (i) Biometric record for the month must be attached with the Attendance sheet (ii) All documents must be signed by the scholar and approved by the respective supervisor and concerned HOD. HRA Certificate (i) Third Day of Every Month for NET-JRF/SRF (ii) Seventh Day of every Month for NFSC/MANF (iii) Third Day after every three Months for NFST (i) Biometric record for the month must be attached with the Attendance sheet (ii) All documents must be signed by the scholar and approved by the respective supervisor and concerned HOD. Attendance Sheet (i) Third Day of Every Month for NET-JRF/SRF (ii) Seventh Day of every Month for NFSC/MANF (iii) Third Day after every three Months for NFST (i) Biometric record for the month must be attached with the Attendance sheet (ii) All documents must be signed by the scholar and approved by the respective supervisor and concerned HOD. Contingency Certificate Every Three Months (i) Original Bills signed by scholar and approved by Supervisor Half Yearly Report 30th June and 30th December (i) Two half yearly reports to be submitted by scholar approved by the supervisor Post Visit Report (PVR) Immediately after completion of sanctioned duty leave period (i) Only applicable to scholars on sanctioned duty leave and Post visit report (PVR) Important Points: 1.Documents must be submitted as per the formats attached herewith and deviation in this regard may lead to delays in completing online applications and subsequently amount disbursement as well. 2.Documents must be submitted to the Centre for Research Degree Programmes (CRDP) strictly as per the above-mentioned deadlines. 3.Any information provided by the scholar which is found to be false/misinterpreted/concealed at point of time may lead to disciplinary actions as per the University/regulatory body regulations. 4.All Scholars availing government fellowships are required to mark their biometric attendance on all University working days. 5.Every scholar will be entitled to leaves as prescribed by the regulatory body (30 days). 6.Leaves may be availed by the scholar after due approval from the supervisor. In case of emergencies wherein the prior approval is not possible in such cases, email may be forwarded to the supervisor for availing the leave. 7.In the attendance sheet the scholar must mark the attendance of the day as either Present (P) or Leave (L), no other label/acronym will be accepted. 8.For Scholars availing duty leaves, the PVR must be duly sanctioned in order to be eligible for fellowship disbursement for the said period of duty leave. For further query, Ph.D. research scholars can visit 27-207 or may log an RMS at link mentioned below: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request--->Message Type-- > Category Type -- > Department [Ph.D. (Centre for Research Degree Programmes)] -- > Category -- > Contact No. -- > Description

title: Master Orator- A competition on Art of unscripted oration : (9/1/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct an event “Master Orator- A competition on Art of unscripted oration”. title: Captivate and Connect - A workshop on enhancing students' presentation skills : (8/31/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Captivate and Connect - A workshop on enhancing students' presentation skills”. In today’s competitive world, strong presentation skills are crucial for successful communication as a well-structured presentation keeps the audience attentive and enhances the speaker's reputation as a knowledgeable professional. It is also observed that public speaking has become complex for most of students and becoming compelling and charismatic presenter requires confidence and self-esteem. Therefore, the workshop is designed to provide students practical experience through interactive activities to elevate their presentation skills. This workshop will benefit their academic pursuits and also prepare them for future careers, public speaking engagements, and everyday communication. In this workshop, students will be participating in interactive activities, group discussions, and impromptu speaking exercises to foster a dynamic learning experience to become ardent speakers. . The main objectives of the event are: · To provide strategies for managing nervousness and maintaining composure. · To equip students with the techniques for engaging and maintaining the audience's attention. · To foster the ability to manage time effectively during presentations. · To assist students in becoming skillful and effectual presenters by boosting their confidence and self-esteem. Target audience: The Students of Girls’ Hostel 5 will participate in this event. Date: 2nd September, 2023 Time: 05:30 PM Onwards Venue: GH-5 Ground Area Resource Person: 1) Ms. Poonam Bala 2) Ms. Nisha Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/CaptivateandConnectAWorkshop

title: Enroll into Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT) Preparation course offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement . : (8/30/2023)
body: Dear Students After getting requests regarding the reopening of registration for Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT) Preparation course. we have again opened the registration till 31st August 2023.The commencement of classes for enrolled students will start in first week of September 2023. Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) brings a great opportunity to strengthen your skills and to make your dreams come true by attending AFCAT preparatory course for Indian Air Force aspirants. The Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT) is a defence exam conducted by the Indian Air force for the selection of Class-1 Gazetted Officers in Flying branch and Ground Duties (Technical and Non-Technical) branch. For all entries other than NDA and CDSE and for all branches, candidates have to undergo the AFCAT. The test is conducted twice a year in February and August. Invitation to AFCAT applications is open in June and December. The test is conducted all across India by the Indian Air Force. In this course, all modules of AFCAT exam i.e. General Awareness, Verbal Ability in English, Numerical Ability and Reasoning and Military Aptitude will be covered in detail along with MOCK TESTS. In order to join this AFCAT preparatory course, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below 31st August 2023. Classes will start from the first week of September 2023 and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Note: You can enroll into one competitive exam course only. For more details check the following link. Enrollment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in Last Date to Enroll: 31st August 2023. For queries: Dr. Amandeep Singh. body: HDFC Bank Parivartan's ECSS Programme 2023-24 is an initiative of HDFC Bank that aims to support meritorious and needy students belonging to underprivileged sections of society Link: - https://www.buddy4study.com/page/hdfc-bank-parivartans-ecss-programme The Last date for the scholarship is 30th September 2023. body: Kotak Kanya Scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in the field of professional graduation courses after Class 12 i.e. Engineering, MBBS, Architecture, Design, integrated LLB, etc. from university of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of Rs. 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses till the completion of their graduation (degree). Link: - https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship The Last date for the scholarship is 30th September 2023. Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open for girl students across India. 2. Student must have scored 85% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examination. 3. Total Family Income from all sources should not exceed Rs.6, 00,000/- (Six Lakh) per year. 4. Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation & Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2023. Benefits: Scholarship amount of Rs. 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2023 should be utilized to cover academic expenses, including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptop, books and stationery. The following clear self-attested documents are required for the verification purpose :- · Mark sheet of previous qualifying examination (Class 12) · Income proof of parents/guardians · ITR of parents for FY 2022-23 (if available) · Fee structure (for academic year 2023-24) · Bonafide student certificate/letter from college (Collect from 32-101 A, Window No. 3) · College seat / Admission base allocation document (Collect from 32-101 A, Window No. 3) · College entrance examination score card (Collect from 32-101 A, Window No. 3) · Aadhaar card · Bank passbook · A passport-size photograph · Disability certificate (if applicable) · Death certificate of parent (for single parent/orphan candidates) Note: · If student already in receipt of any other scholarship or financial assistance from any organization at any stage, then scholarship stands cancelled. · Students have to take screenshot of details filled in online application form before final submission of application and submit the copy of application form along with above mentioned documents at Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No. 4. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students:- UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2023-24 --------> Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2023 Scholarship. All the eligible students have to submit their above mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 102(A) , Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be collected only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS –External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (8/28/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Legrand Empowering Scholarship for the session 2023-2024 - reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230825/003) : (8/25/2023)
body: Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program is an initiative by Legrand under its CSR initiative to provide financial support to meritorious girl students, differently-abled girl students and transgender students to help them pursue their higher education. Link: - https://www.buddy4study.com/page/legrand-empowering-scholarship-program. The Last date for the scholarship is 31st August 2023. Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open for girl students across India. 2. Students must have secured a minimum of 70% and above marks in Class 10 and 12 examinations. 3. Students who have taken admission in B.Tech/B.Arch./other graduation (Finance or Science) - BSC/BCOM/BBA/etc are eligible to apply for this scholarship. 4. Total Family Income from all sources should not exceed Rs.5, 00,000/- (Five Lakh) per year. Benefits: · 60% of annual course fees up to INR 60,000 per year (whichever is less) till the completion of the course will be provided to girl students based on their academic performance. · 80% of annual course fees up to INR 1,00,000 per year (whichever is less) till the completion of the course will be awarded to the special category* students based on academic performance. · Job opportunities can also be provided to students from the special category* at the end of their graduation who qualify all basic job requirements for a particular role. *Special category: Students with single parents/students who lost their parents due to COVID. The following clear self-attested documents are required for the verification purpose :- · Photo ID card. · Age proof (Birth Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Passport, Class 10 School leaving certificate). · Aadhaar Card (if Aadhaar Card is not available, an equivalent document for proof of address). · Class 10 Marksheet. · Class 12 Marksheet. · Family income certificate or Form 16 of parents/ bank statements of last 6 months. · Passport-size photograph of the applicant. · Proof of admission or college/university fee receipt of the current academic year. Note: · If student already in receipt of any other scholarship or financial assistance from any organization at any stage, then scholarship stands cancelled. · Preference will be given to students from the special category. *Special category: Students with single parents/students who lost their parents due to COVID. · Students have to take screenshot of details filled in online application form before final submission of application and submit the copy of application form along with the above mentioned documents at Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No. 4. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students:- UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------- Scholarship Policies -------- Session 2023-24 -------- Legrand Empowering Scholarship for the session 2023-2024. All the eligible students have to submit their above mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 102(A) , Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be collected only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS –External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (8/24/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label. title: Retraction Watch Hijacked Or Cloned Journals Checker : (8/23/2023)
body: Hijacked/ Cloned journals mimic legitimate journals by adopting their titles, ISSNs, and other metadata. Usually, hijacked journals mirror legitimate journals without permission from the original journal. Scholars can be duped into publishing in hijacked journals – many of which require fees – by offers of fast publication and indexing in databases such as Scopus; being indexed in such databases is viewed by many universities and governments as a mark of legitimacy. Tracking these journals is no mean feat but knowing which journals may have been hijacked is vital to the world of publishing integrity. List of cloned or hijacked Journal: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ak985WGOgGbJRJbZFanoktAN_UFeExpE/edit#gid=5255084 This list of cloned/hijacked journal is dynamic; more journals will be added as their hijacked status are uncovered.

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (8/23/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council Scholarship for the session 2023-2024 - reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230821/002) : (8/21/2023)
body: Any student (any category) who can read & write in Punjabi language can apply for Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council Scholarship for the session 2023-2024. The Registration process has been started for the session 2023-2024. The students can download the scholarship application form from the following link:- Link: - https://nishkam.org/ The last date for submission of scholarship form at Nishkam Office has been extended till 31-08-2023. Eligibility Criteria for Fresh and Renewal of Scholarship 1. Total Family Income from all sources should not exceed Rs.3, 00,000/- (Three Lakh) per year. 2. Minimum 60 % marks in previous two examinations. 3. The applicant must maintain an active e-mail account for correspondence with Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council. Students must mention a Mobile and alternative telephone number for easy communication. Important Instructions 1. Candidates will be required to appear in a written test in General Knowledge and Punjabi Language. 2. If the applicant has received financial assistance (either on account of SC/ST/OBC/ Any other category OR from any other institute / source) during previous years or has applied or is expecting for this year, then complete information must be provided in the Application Form. 3. Only deserving and meritorious students may apply for this scholarship. 4. Students pursuing their studies through correspondence mode are NOT eligible for this scholarship. 5. The complete application form with all enclosures should be sent to “Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council, Nishkam Bhawan, B-Block, Tilak Vihar, New Delhi-110018 by Speed Post marking “ SHDF Scholarship -2023” on the top of the envelope and must reach the Nishkam office latest by 31st August 2023 (1700 Hrs.) 6. The advertisement published by Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council (REGD.), scholarship guidelines & application for new applicants and scholarship guidelines & application for old applicants are enclosed and also be checked from the following UMS path:- UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2023-24 --------> Nishkam SHDF Scholarship. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230805/001) The last date of registration is 29th Aug, 2023. No Re-appear / Improvement registration shall be allowed after the due date. For any lecture falling in the same time slot as that of the examination scheduled time, duty leave shall be given to the student for those lectures only (particularly in the time slot of exam). In addition, duty leave shall also be given to the student for classes scheduled one hour prior and one hour after the time of examination. The date sheet and details of the examination shall be displayed in the UMS login of the student as per the dates mentioned below Important dates: - Registration start date 19th Aug, 2023 Last date of registration 29th Aug, 2023 Display of date sheet in UMS login (Tentative) 01st Sep, 2023 Note: For any further query, students can also log RMS via the following UMS path UMS Navigation --- >Relationship Management System (RMS) ---->Log Request ------>Examination -----> Reappear Registration / Re-evaluation / Scrutiny The detailed procedure for registration is attached for reference

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (8/19/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

body: In an endeavour to help and support students who are facing some academic challenges and were not able to perform well in their previous examinations, Division of Student Relationship makes continuous efforts to initiate support programs and classes. One such academic support initiative is being introduced for the students who were not able to score well in the end term exams due to any valid reason. title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (8/16/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: 1st International Conference on Sustainable Development Goals (ICSDGS-2023) to be held on 29th and 30th September, 2023 : (8/11/2023)
body: We are delighted to announce the 1st International Conference on Sustainable Development Goals (ICSDGS-2023) to be held on 29th and 30th September, 2023 in the campus of Lovely Professional University, Punjab. This 1st series of ICSDGS-2023 aims to provide a leading forum for sharing original research/ review papers on the theme of Sustainable Development Goals. All accepted papers (presented in the conference) will be considered for publish in E3S Web of Conferences (SCOPUS Indexed; SJR:0.18). Paper Template and Guidelines: All authors must prepare the manuscript as per the E3S Web of Conferences guidelines. Please follow the given template. (https://www.e3s-conferences.org/for-authors ) A few selected papers will be published in the Special issues of Journals. The following special issues from different journals have been accepted for consideration- · Special issue themed “3D Printing, Additive, and Advanced Manufacturing Technologies for Processing Biomaterials” in “Innovation and Emerging Technologies” (An International Journal on Innovative Applied Sciences, Engineering and Biomedical Research). Journal indexed in ESCI and Scopus. Link: https://www.worldscientific.com/page/iet/callforpapers04 · Special issue themed “Water pollution, air pollution, soil pollution, and Noise Pollution” in Indian Journal of Environmental Protection (ISSN 0253–7141). Journal indexed in Scopus. · Special issue "Gold Nanoparticles in Thermo-plasmonics: Innovation, Opportunities and Challenges (GNPT)" in Applied Surface Science Advances (Impact Factor 6.2, Q1 & SCI-indexed). https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/applied-surface-science-advances · Edited Book "Functionalized Cellulose Materials - Sustainable Manufacturing and Applications" in Book Series "Springer Series in Materials Science'. [SCOPUS and SC imago Indexed]. https://lnkd.in/dr8yjt9a. · Edited Book "Sustainable Development Goals Towards Environmental Toxicity and Green Chemistry- Environment and Sustainability" in Book Series "World Sustainability Series'. [SCOPUS and SCImago]. https://lnkd.in/drCq55tf. · Submissions are also open to publish in the Edited book volumes of Book Series “Sustainable Manufacturing Technologies: Additive, Subtractive, and Hybrid”. Please go through the link for more detail information- https://www.routledge.com/Sustainable-Manufacturing-Technologies/book-series/CRCSMTASH All related details regarding submission guidelines and important dates are available: https://conferences.lpu.in/icsdgs/index.php Paper Submission via Email: icsdg@lpu.co.in For any kind of queries, please write us on given Email: icsdg@lpu.co.in Best Regards, ICSDGS-2023

body: Dear Aspirants, This is for your information that University has scheduled a Career Suggestor Assessment for you on MERCER METTL platform. A career suggestor assessment is an important scientific tool that helps to diagnose the interest, personality and aptitude of the candidate and suggest suitable career options. The results of this assessment are useful for aligning an individual's career according to his talents and personal goals. It is crucial for getting started on the right career path. It also helps assess the natural inclinations of students, providing insights into their preferences and strengths. This information can be valuable for further studies, specialization choices, and skill development. IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS: :- Assessment is live now and will remain live till 13th August (5 PM). You can appear in the assessment anytime within the given time frame. :- It is mandatory for all the students as per the attached list to participate in this assessment. :- Once you start your assessment, make sure you finish it in one go. don't take a break in between. :- Assessment will be conducted in online mode. You can appear in the assessment from your own venue. :- Assessment will be auto proctored. Your assessment will be submitted automatically in case you use any unfair means during assessment. :- Reattempt is not allowed. Therefore carefully follow the instructions while attempting the test. title: Session on Leadership Lessons and Navigating Careers in the Automotive Sector by NXP Semiconductors (8/9/2023)
body: Division of Career Services, LPU is going to organize a “Session on Leadership Lessons and Navigating Careers in the Automotive Sector by NXP Semiconductors”. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NXP) is a semiconductor company based in Eindhoven, Netherlands, known for its Dutch origin. The company has a global presence, employing around 31,000 individuals across more than 30 countries. In the year 2021, it reported a total revenue of $11.06 billion. It specializes in delivering advanced technology solutions tailored for various markets, including automotive, industrial, IoT (Internet of Things), mobile, and communication infrastructure. With an extensive intellectual property portfolio, the company holds ownership of over 9,500 patent families. Notably, it played a co-inventor role in developing near field communication (NFC) technology in collaboration with Sony and Inside Secure. It supplies NFC chipsets that enable mobile phones to facilitate secure payments and the storage and exchange of data. Additionally, it manufactures chips designed for eGovernment applications such as electronic passports, RFID tags, labels, and transport and access management solutions. The MIFARE chip set and contactless card developed by NXP are widely used in major public transit systems worldwide. It also prioritizes cybersecurity by providing gateways to automotive manufacturers, safeguarding against potential hackers and ensuring independent network communication within vehicles. The main objectives of the event are: To offer students a roadmap for establishing a career in the automotive sector. To explain the steps involved in career development, which can significantly affect their career planning. To highlight current automotive industry trends. Target audience: The students of the School of School of Computer Science and Engineering and Electronics and Electrical Engineering Date: 11th August, 2023 Time: 11:00 AM – 12:00 PM Venue: Online Resource Person: Mr. Hitesh Garg Head Division of Career Services

The students can register for the R grade by following the below mentioned steps: Step-I- Filling of the Online Registration Form: All students having R grade in the list of courses attached are required to apply online for the registration in R grade and pay the R grade registration fee online via following UMS path:- UMS Navigation----> Examination System------> Exam Registration------> R grade courses Registration The Last date for R grade registration and fee payment is 17th August (without any late fee) and 24th August 2023 (with late fee of Rs.2000/-). Important points- i) The detailed process (along with the screen shots) of registering and paying the R grade fee is also attached with this announcement as Attachment No- 2. ii) No request of R grade registration shall be entertained after 24th August 2023. Step-II- Uploading Soft Copy of Report After the online registration and paying the requisite fee for the R grade, the students shall be required to upload the soft copy of final report as per the requirement of the course (see attachment 1) by visiting the following UMS path:- UMS Navigation-->LMS-------> Upload Research Project/Internship certificate details->Upload Project Report/Internship certificate The last date to upload soft copies of the report on UMS is 26th August 2023. Step-III- Uploading of Publication details Students can upload their publications in either of SCOPUS/ SCI /WOS/NAAS (rating greater than 5) indexed journal for the courses as per Attachment-1. The publication details can be uploaded by visiting following UMS path:- UMS Navigation -->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details--->Upload Research Project Publication/Copyright details The last date to upload publication details on UMS is 26th August 2023. We cordially invite you to visit the bluehawks Exhibition Booth at the upcoming Freshmen Induction Carnival. Remember, this is just the beginning of the incredible ride you're about to embark upon. We can't wait to meet you and be a part of your exciting journey at Lovely Professional University!See you at the Freshmen Induction Carnival! Best regards,Team bluehawks www.bluehawks.in

title: Counselling session for skill development and competitive exams : (8/7/2023)
body: Dear Students, Do you want to improve your skills and prepare for your future? If yes, then you are invited to participate in a polling for a skill development and competitive exam counselling session organized by the Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) of Lovely Professional University. The session will cover topics such as: * How to identify your strengths and interests. * How to choose the right course for your career. * How to develop your skills and competencies. * How to prepare for competitive exams such as IELTS, TOEFL, GRE, GMAT, CDS, AFCAT, SSC etc. *How to ace interviews and group discussions. * How to write an effective resume. The session will be conducted to guide you and answer your queries. The session will be offline and duty leaves will be provided. The date and time of the session will be decided based on the polling results. Your session date, time and venue of session will be informed to you by UMS Mymessages. Poll now and spread the word among your friends and classmates. We look forward to seeing you at the session. title: Registration for Backlog Courses for Autumn Term 2023-24. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230807/006) : (8/7/2023)
body: To facilitate the students to clear their F/M/G/FAIL grade courses in the Autumn Term, Session 2023-24, the registration for backlog courses has been started. The classes for courses registered as backlog courses by the students shall be held along with the regular students in offline mode. The interface for Backlog registration shall remain active from 08th August 2023 till 21st August 2023. Guidelines for the Backlog Registration Process: 1. Link to be followed for registration of backlog courses: UMS Navigation→ Examination system→ Backlog Registration → Backlog Course Registration 2. Grade conversion will be applicable as per table 1 for those courses which have been offered in this Term 2023-24. Table 1 Permissibility of conversions of grades S. No. Existing grade Grade Change permissible Conversion 1. E G Allowed 2. E F Allowed 3. G F Allowed 1. Conditions applicable for backlog registration: A. For Continuing students: In addition to the courses for the current regular term , the student, shall be allowed to register in backlog courses if the he/she has minimum 2.5 CGPA or equivalent percentage (in case of marks based programme). i. In case of only F/M/Fail grade courses, then student can register for maximum of four F/M/Fail grade courses subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. ii. If a student wants to register for only G grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of nine G grade courses. iii. If a student wants to register for both F/M/Fail and G grade courses, he/she can register maximum of nine courses subject to maximum of four F/M/Fail grade courses and availability of clash-free time table schedule. B. For Non-Promoted students: A student, who is registering only for backlog courses due to the non-promotion to the next year, the student can register for F/M/Fail/G grade courses subject to course availability. i. If a student wants to register for only F/M/Fail grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of nine F/M/Fail grade courses subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. ii. If a student wants to register only G grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of thirteen G grade courses. iii. If a student wants to register for both F/M/Fail and G grade courses, he/she can register maximum of thirteen courses subject to maximum of nine F/M/Fail grade courses and availability of clash-free time table schedule. iv. If a student has studied more than nine courses in a single term according to program scheme then student may apply for additional backlog courses by putting RMS. RMS link has been shared at the end of this notification. C. Registration in a course for additional courses/courses not mapped/not studied by student: A student who is registering for additional courses/courses not mapped/not studied due to Change of Program, Term off/Year off, Re-joining after gap or Migration is marked as “M” grade in result. Student will be required to register the course(s) as F grade. “M” Grade cannot be converted to G grade. 4. Fee for backlog registration: The student Registration will be confirmed after payment of the backlog fee. The backlog fee shall be payable online through the fee payment gateway. i. For National and International (Only Asian) Students: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee plus Rs.350/- as examination fee and should be paid at time of registration through online mode only. ii. For all other International Students: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee and USD 7 as examination fee and should be paid within 48 hours through University Website as per link: https://www.lpu.in/frmloginaccounts.aspx iii. For scholarship holders or students for whom the fee has been waived off (fully or partly) by the University, the backlog fee will be 1/10th of the actual or standard tuition fee of the term and not the fee after scholarship or waiver. iv. For students admitted to dual and / or integrated programmes, the backlog fee shall be charged after considering whether the course pertains to the lower degree or the higher degree. v. In case a student’s batch has graduated or passed out, the backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee of the programme plus Rs.350/- as examination fee. vi. For term off and non-promoted students: Backlog fee will be 1/10th of his/her fellow batch’s fee until his/her fellow batch student is studying that program. However, backlog fee will be 1/10th of the last term fee paid by his/her fellow batch in case the batch has passed out. vii. Once student has paid the backlog courses fee, courses cannot be De-registered. 5. Attendance Marking: i. Attendance in backlog courses (excluding G grade) will be included in the aggregate attendance of the student for the purpose of determining his/her eligibility for appearing in the ETE and for calculating the detention list. ii. Attendance will be counted from very next day of confirmation of registration i.e. after confirmation of fee payment. 6. Equivalency of Courses: Students are required to ensure that the equivalent course allotted to them have not been previously studied by them. If equivalence course has already been studied by them, then they are required to report the same immediately through RMS using the link. Also, for equivalent courses, the credits of the new course will be applicable. Note: 1. The backlog registration for 1st term courses as per program scheme of the student, shall begin shortly, tentatively from 16th August 2023. Hence, students are advised to wait for registering their 1st term courses. However, they can register their backlog courses from 2nd term onwards. List of courses for which backlog registration will be conducted from 16 august is attached in the notification. 2. Ensure clash free registration as no change in time table shall be permissible later on. 3. The Preference filling tab is available on the backlog registration interface if a student wishes to register for a course that is not currently offered or whose section strength is full. 4. Step by Step guide for using the interface for backlog registration is attached along with these guidelines. All the students are advised to go through the FAQs, still if there is any assistance need on backlog registration, the students can approach 1. Academic Operations Help Window at 32-102 Window No: 05 (09-05 PM) 2. Backlog Help Desk at 56-203 (03-05 PM) 3. You can put your request on Relationship Management System (RMS) using the link: UMS Navigation----Relationship Management System (RMS)----Log Request From the dropdown, Select- Message type: Enquiry Category type: Academic and Administrative Issues Select Department: Academics Category: Academics Sub-Category: Backlog/Summer term Registration

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (8/7/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

We understand the importance of providing you with a wholesome and nourishing dining experience while you pursue your academic journey. The packed meals will be prepared fresh daily, ensuring quality and taste and delivered at your Academic block. You need to purchase your Tiffin Box and put details on it (Name, Registration ID, Hostel and Your Academic Block) with a permanent marker and submit it at your mess. Support for Sick Students: For students who may be unwell and require special attention, we have dedicated facilities to provide them with appropriate meals. Our team will ensure that sick students receive nourishing food that aids in their recovery and helps them regain their strength. You can avail of this facility through your UMS while following the below path: Path: UMS Navigation - Residential Services - Hostel Related Services -Special Food Request in case of sickness

title: Registration for Re-appear / Improvement courses with a provision to improve CA component marks. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230805/001) : (8/5/2023)
body: To facilitate the students to clear their E grade (Re-appear) courses or improve grade(s) of already cleared courses, an option is being introduced wherein a student shall be able to improve his/her CA component marks along with taking the Re-appear / Improvement ETE exam (having weightage of MTT and ETE components) in the registered courses. A student who wishes to improve the above-mentioned option can register for the mode – “Re-appear/improvement with CA improvement” subject to the conditions as given below. Guidelines for registration of re-appear/improvement with CA improvement mode 1. For students registered in this mode, CA shall be allocated in form of two tasks for each course which can be in the pattern of test, assignment, project etc. depending on the nature of the course. 2. It shall be mandatory for the student to appear for both the CA tasks for each registered course. 3. The final CA marks shall be calculated based on student’s performance in both the allocated CA components. 4. Weightage of marks for mode – “Re-appear/improvement with CA improvement” shall be: Component Weightage Continuous Assessment (CA) 30 Re-appear/Improvement Examination (ETE) 70 5. The students are advised to register the courses running in the current term under this mode for re-appear/improvement as they shall get an opportunity to attend classes of the registered course and clear doubts, if any. However, in case if a student feels well-prepared and does not require guidance of classes or any doubt clearance, then he/she may register course(s) not running in current term. 6. It is strongly advised that student attend classes of the registered courses to ensure concept clarity and for doubt clearance, which shall aid them to perform better in the course evaluations. However, attendance is not compulsory; but it is mandatory for the student to submit all CA tasks allocated to him/her. 7. The highest grade that can be earned by student under this mode is Grade “A”. 8. In case a student wants to aim for a higher-grade improvement (O or A+), he/she should register the course as a backlog course as per existing backlog registration policy. Registration for backlog courses shall start from 5th August,2023 and related guidelines shall be available via a separate UMS announcement shortly. 9. Eligibility of courses for re-appear/improvement registration in mode – “Re-appear/improvement with CA improvement”: a. Courses having theory component can be registered. b. Courses having only practical component, only ETP component or only CA component are not eligible for registration. c. Eligibility of courses as per already existing grade: Already existing grade in course Permissibility for registration E Allowed B+, B, C and D Allowed* O, A+ and A Not applicable (As maximum grade that can be earned by student in this mode is “A”) *In case a student wants to register for improvement of a course, the same can be done within the time period of 2 years of studying the course in regular mode. However, as a special one-time provision, for current term, students can register re-appear/improvement with CA improvement for all eligible courses studied till date. 10. In case, the grade of student doesn’t improve, then the best existing grade shall prevail. 11. Courses registered in this mode shall be counted towards 5 chances of Re-appear available to the student. In case, a student fails to clear the course registered in this mode in the 5 chances provided to him/her, G grade shall be awarded in that course. 12. For the registered courses, a detailed schedule for CA evaluation and End Term Examination shall be made available to students via UMS seating plan. 13. It is mandatory for student to appear for all CA evaluations and End Term Examination. In case a student is absent in any evaluation, no option of re-conduct of evaluation shall be provided. 14. Fee for registration of Re-appear/Improvement with CA improvement (with availability of an option to attend classes) is Rs. 3000/- per course. 15. Online Registration for Re-appear/Improvement with CA improvement shall be opened on 5th August 2023 and the last date of registration is 15th August,2023. 16. Students can register for re-appear / Improvement with CA improvement through the following interface. UMS Navigation ---> Examination System ---> Exam Registration ---> Re-Appear Registration 17. For further clarity on Re-appear/Improvement registration students are advised to refer to below mentioned table: Mode Attendance Marks CA Marks MTT marks ETE marks Registration start date Fee (in Rs.)
