title: Personality assessment for 2023 freshmen : (8/4/2023)
body: Dear students, Welcome to Lovely Professional University!! We are all unique and have several patterns of thoughts, emotions, behaviours, and characteristics that make us distinctive from one another. These patterns play a crucial role in shaping how we perceive and respond to various situations and experiences. Personality influences various aspects of life, including relationships, career choices, coping mechanisms, and overall well-being. Understanding one's personality can be beneficial for personal growth, self-awareness, and developing strategies to navigate life's challenges effectively. It's important to recognize that personality is diverse and dynamic, thus capturing the richness and complexity of an individual's character can be done through Personality Assessment Tests. Personality Assessment Test assists in understanding the facets of one's personality which would further help to gauge the behaviours and patterns based on strengths and competencies. These tests are crucial in understanding oneself however it is not limited to that alone, it leads to understanding one’s choices in career, life and relations. The industry today values it and also conducts the same at times to understand one's competencies and match them with the job profile to understand the cultural fitment in the organization. We at CPE, have taken up this unique initiative to help you take Personality Assessment Test so as to help you understand yourself better and help you chart the career pathway and choices. Test is live now. You can take the test with a single touch through your UMS by the following pathway: UMS -> UNS Navigation -> Learning Management System (LMS) -> Personality Assessment Test We are sure, you will be amazed at the results and would capitalize on the same to chart your progress at LPU. For ease of understanding, we are sharing a video for you crafted for your comprehension:- https://youtu.be/dT2HEsQZTUw

title: Invitation for Meditation & Psychoneurobics Session. : (8/4/2023)
body: Hello Vertos ! Student Organization Spade in collaboration with Student Organization Undiscovered Path under the aegis of Division of Youth Affairs, Student Welfare Wing, Lovely Professional University cordially invites to to join the Meditation & Psychoneurobics Session to be delivered by the most experienced coaches of the same. Meditation is a powerful tool for spiritual growth, and is essentially a process to take one beyond the limitations of body and mind. It is practiced to train attention and awareness, and achieve a mentally clear and emotionally calm and stable state. title: Commencement of one-hour weekly interaction slots for the autumn term 2324-1. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230802/001) : (8/2/2023)
body: This is for the information of all the Ph.D. Scholars that the Autumn Term 2324-1 (August- December 2023) for all continuing batches of Ph.D. Programmes shall commence from 23rd August 2023. In order to promote a smooth research progress, we advise Ph.D. Scholars to coordinate with their respective supervisors for fixation of one-hour weekly interaction slots at a time that mutually suits both of them. A portal has been opened for your supervisors to fix the interaction slots until August 16, 2023. Please ensure that your interaction slots are fixed on or before August 16, 2023, as changes will not be allowed once the interaction slots are fixed. Attendance for all scholars shall be counted from the 23rd August 2023 and therefore it is important for all Ph.D. scholars that interaction slots must not be missed as it will lead to their academic loss which in turn may prohibit them from appearing in the upcoming evaluations. Following points are for your consideration. 1. For all Full-Time Ph.D. research scholars, the interaction time slot is to be conducted offline at the LPU campus as per their timetable. 2. Interaction slots for full-time scholars who are collaborating with their co-supervisor outside of LPU will be conducted in online mode in Myclass interface. 3. For all Part-Time Ph.D. research scholars, the interaction time slot is to be conducted online on the MyClass platform as per their timetable, which will be scheduled twice a month. 4. For all Part-Time Ph.D. research scholars, the attendance will be recorded by the system based on the duration for which the supervisor and scholar are present throughout the interaction time slot. Therefore, we suggest the Ph.D. scholars to be present throughout the interaction time slot and ensure the good internet connection. 5. Interaction slots for part-time Ph.D. scholars, who are also employed as faculty or staff at LPU, will be conducted in-person (offline) mode. 6. Interaction slots for part-time Ph.D. scholars, who are also employed as faculty or staff at LPU, will be conducted in-person (offline) mode. 7. Full-time scholars who are currently working outside the LPU with their co-supervisor will be required to interact with their supervisors at LPU through online mode i.e. MyClass. 8. If any Full-time Ph.D. scholar is on sanctioned duty leave exceeding 60 days, their Interaction slots will be conducted online through the MyClass interface. In case of any query please log an RMS using the below mentioned UMS path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Department: Centre for Research Degree Programme Category : Supervisor Related queries Sub-Category: Interaction slots issues

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (8/2/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230801/009) : (8/1/2023)
body: This is for the information of all PhD scholars and their supervisors that the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) will be conducted tentatively from September 2023 onwards. The key points of SAS evaluation includes finalization of: a) Title of the proposed research work. b) Objectives of the proposed research work. c) Research methodology of the proposed research work. I. The research scholars must take the following three steps to become eligible for appearing in SAS. 1. Registration for SAS: Research scholars who have successfully completed their course work or are exempted from the course work (due to M.Phil.), can register for the SAS through the following UMS path. UMS Navigation ---> Examination system ---> Research Degree Evaluation ---> Registration for upcoming activity ---> SAS Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 1st August 2023 to 22nd August 2023. The SAS evaluation shall be tentatively scheduled in September 2023 and the research scholars appearing for the SAS must have the recommendation of the same from their concerned Supervisor/Co-supervisor/administrative supervisor. 2. Uploading of synopsis: After registration, the research scholar must upload the synopsis of their research work which shall be evaluated by a panel of experts. The UMS path to upload the synopsis of SAS along with the other relevant documents is as follows: UMS Navigation ---> Examination system--->Research Degree Evaluation ---> Registration for upcoming activity ---> SAS Note: The link to upload synopsis will remain active from 1st August 2023 to 22nd August 2023 3. Recommendation of the synopsis by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded the synopsis for the SAS evaluation, the same must be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor through the following the UMS path: UMS navigation ---> Division of Examination ---> Research Degree Evaluation ---> Ph.D. Seminar File Verification ---> SAS ---> Reg. No.---> Download Note: The last date for the recommendation of the synopsis by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 26th August 2023. Important Note: For Registration: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension in the timelines as mentioned in the announcements will be allowed. c) The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so through a request application forwarded to RDEC duly recommended by supervisor no later than 22nd August 2023, failing which the scholar will be marked absent during the SAS evaluation and will have to pay INR 5000/- as fee for registering in the next SAS d) Research scholars having pending dues/documents are not eligible to register for the SAS evaluation. Therefore, research scholars are requested to clear the pending dues/documents and get registered for the SAS evaluation before the last date. e) If a research scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from December 2023 onwards) only after the clearance of all pending dues. f) All research scholars who have the last chance to appear in the SAS evaluation in September 2023 are advised strongly to register for the same. g) It is mandatory for all research scholars to clear SAS within two years from the date of registration otherwise their admission may be deemed as cancelled. All the scholars who have already completed two years from date of registration are required to get the extension through CRDP via RMS by following the below mentioned path. UMS Navigation ---> Relationship Management System ---> Log Request Select the following: Category Type- Academic and Administrative Issues Department- Ph.D. - Centre for Research Degree Programmes Category- Any other Subcategory- Any other Ph. D Queries For Uploading Synopsis: a) The research scholar shall not be eligible for uploading any synopsis report without completing the registration process. b) The research scholars are strongly advised that the synopsis file must be uploaded only after the thorough discussion with the Supervisor. Same should be defended during the presentation on the day of SAS evaluation. For preparing the presentation the research scholar should refer to the format for SAS presentation (Attachment) c) No extension shall be given for uploading synopsis report beyond the last date. d) Read the attached guidelines very carefully before uploading the synopsis. e) All the research scholars must upload single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I as per the attached guidelines or else, their SAS registration may be cancelled. Upon cancellation, he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation (with fee of Rs. 5000/-). No second chance shall be given to upload the synopsis. f) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using SAS registration interface) before registering and uploading the synopsis at the interface. g) The research scholar must upload the synopsis well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. In case of any query regarding the SAS registration and evaluation, please submit your RMS request through the following path: UMS Navigation ---> Relationship Management System (RMS)---> Log Request Select the following: Category Type- Academic and Administrative Issues Department- Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell Category- Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell Subcategory- SAS

title: EYE FLU::CONJUNCTIVITIS : (8/1/2023)
body: Viral and bacterial conjunctivitis (pink eye) are very contagious. They can spread easily from person to person. You can greatly reduce the risk of getting conjunctivitis or spreading it to someone else by following some simple steps for good hygiene : - Wash your hands often with soap and warm water for at least 20 seconds. Wash them especially well before and after cleaning, or applying eye drops or ointment to, your infected eye. - Avoid touching your eyes with unwashed hands - Touch your eyes with tissue paper and dispose it safely - DON'T shake hands - Consult your Eyes Specialist. For any query, please contact at Reception of Uni Health Centre phone Nos. 01824 -444079 & 501227

body: Division of Career Services, LPU is going to organize a “Session on Campus to Corporate by SERVICENOW”. ServiceNow, Inc. is a California-based software firm established in 2003 by Fred Luddy. The company specializes in crafting a cloud-based platform aimed at assisting businesses in overseeing digital workflows for their enterprise operations. ServiceNow is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange and is included in both the Russell 1000 Index and S&P 500 Index. In 2018, Forbes magazine recognized it as the top-ranked company in its list of the most innovative companies globally. It’s objective is to facilitate companies in reaching their digital transformation objectives by harmonizing IT and business initiatives through various areas such as IT Operations Management, Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), IT Business Management, and Software Asset Management (SAM). ServiceNow plays a pivotal role in driving strategic business advancement throughout an organization. The main objectives of the event are: To equip students for the shift from campus life to corporate world. To provide career-focused practical knowledge and conveying corporate expectations. To assist with resume writing, interview preparation and corporate etiquettes. Target audience: The students of the School of Computer Science and Engineering, School of Computer Application, Mittal School of Business Date: 1st August, 2023 Time: 09:00 AM – 11:00 AM Venue: Shanti Devi Mittal Auditorium Resource Person: Mr. Gokulakannan Narasimhan Head Division of Career Services

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for Autumn Term 23241. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230728/001) : (7/28/2023)
body: This is in continuation to the announcement “Regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of Autumn term 23241” (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230714/003) (7/14/2023). All registered students are now required to select the supervisor of their own choice, one supervisor shall be allocated to each group. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone /Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone /Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone/ Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I contains the details of all student groups for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS path to check the details of available supervisors as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All groups are required to start interaction with available supervisors and should finalize their supervisor with a consent latest by 29th July 2023. Points to remember: - a) All students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date which will help to choose the supervisor judiciously. (Refer the above-mentioned UMS path for details) b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of supervisors and contact them via LPU live app/phone/ email or any suitable medium as soon as possible so as to select the supervisor of required specialization. c) The students must approach the supervisors in groups, as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student in groups can approach number of different supervisors until or unless they get the supervisor of their desired specialization. In case the selected supervisor has already taken the maximum groups then student have to approach another supervisor until the finalization of supervisor. e) If a group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 29th July 2023, then the random allocation of supervisors shall be done as per the availability. 2. Capstone/ Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is mutual agreement between the students and the supervisor then the supervisor has to enter the details of all students on the following UMS path latest by 31st July 2023: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project-->Capstone/Dissertation Polling Interface The last date for closing of Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 31st July 2023. Important note 1. The stepwise procedure regarding the use of interface is explained in the attachment -2 with the help of screenshots. 2. School AOC are hereby informed that the Polling interface is applicable only for courses where weightage of CA is greater than zero and where the exam pattern of the course is X7RA, X7RB, X7RC, X7RD, X7RE, X8RA, X8RC, X8RD & X8RE. In case any course requires supervisor, allocation and is not having any of the above-mentioned exam pattern, the respective school head is requested to correct the exam pattern immediately so that the process of supervisor allocation started through department of projects and internships (DPI). 3. In case any faculty wants to work on the project in a domain which is different from his/her parent domain, the faculty member should take consent from respective HOS of his/her school and provide the same to the AOC of the other School where the faculty wants to carry out the project work. The AOC shall finally punch the load of the faculty and will ensure that the faculty profile is visible to the students of that school. In case of any query, faculty member may log an RMS using the below mentioned UMS path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (7/28/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: EYE FLU::CONJUNCTIVITIS : (7/25/2023)
body: Viral and bacterial conjunctivitis (pink eye) are very contagious. They can spread easily from person to person. You can greatly reduce the risk of getting conjunctivitis or spreading it to someone else by following some simple steps for good hygiene : - Wash your hands often with soap and warm water for at least 20 seconds. Wash them especially well before and after cleaning, or applying eye drops or ointment to, your infected eye. - Avoid touching your eyes with unwashed hands - Touch your eyes with tissue paper and dispose it safely - DON'T shake hands - Consult your Eyes Specialist For any query, please contact at Reception of Uni Health Centre phone Nos. 01824 -444079 & 501227

body: Registration is invited for Workshop on Econometric Applications in Social Sciences Using E-views. An eight day workshop which integrates conceptual econometrics and empirical data to offer insight into the dynamics of economic theories. The workshop aimed to impart knowledge of econometric models and techniques that facilitate empirical research in the social sciences. The workshop will cover a vast repertoire of econometric topics, which allowed the participants to understand how to analyze economic and financial data and how to derive policy conclusions using different methods. The details of this workshop are appended below: Title Workshop on Econometric Applications in Social Sciences Using E-views Course Outcome The Program aims at capacity building in: · 1. To provide comprehensive knowledge of basic and advanced econometric techniques useful in social sciences. · 2. To provides empirical validity of abstract economic theory and application of economic theories in other social sciences 3. To measure economic relationship. Using economic data and applying mathematical and statistical tools. Resource Person(s) 1. Dr. Arif Billah Dar, School of Economics , Shri Mata Vaishno Devi University, Katra 2. Dr. Tawheed Nabi, Assistant Professor, Mittal School of Business, LPU 3. title: LPU Global: Amazing opportunity for B. Design (Fashion) students in UK : (7/24/2023)
body: The Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for the students of B. Design (Fashion) to get international degrees from the Manchester Metropolitan University, UK. Through this exciting opportunity, eligible student will study 3 years at LPU and 2 years at foreign university and will eventually after successful completion of program will get their Bachelors and Master degrees, both from Manchester Metropolitan University, UK. Benefits: 1. Under this program eligible students will study 3 years at Lovely Professional University and 2 Years at foreign university and in span of 2 years will get international degree of Bachelors and Masters both. 2. Cost effective program for getting 2 degrees from international university. 3. An opportunity to become a global citizen by immersing in a diverse and multicultural learning environment. 4. Students may cover their living expenses by working part-time by utilizing the opportunity to work up to 20 hours per week in accordance with the regulations of the respective country. 5. Upon successfully completing the program at a foreign university, students may be eligible for post-study work rights, providing further career opportunities. Eligibility Criteria: To be eligible for the International Credit Transfer Program, applicants must meet the following criteria: 1. Students from the 2021 batch are eligible for this program. 2. A minimum CGPA of 6.5 or above with no backlogs or reappearances at the time of application. 3. Portfolio. 4. No pending cases of indiscipline. 5. An overall IELTS score of 6.5 bands, with a minimum of 6 in each module. 6. Sufficient funds to demonstrate ability to sustain yourself financially during your studies at the foreign university. If you are interested in this exciting opportunity, please fill out the application form at the following link: https://forms.gle/2JRNzhsi1129NPn18 Don't miss out on the incredible opportunity to embark on a global educational journey and earn an international degree. Apply now! For further information and assistance, please feel free to contact the Division of International Affairs at 32-310, email us at studyabroad@lpu.co.in, or call us at +91-9780036427, +91-9814222337, +91- 9875915867

For all entries other than NDA and CDSE and for all branches, candidates have to undergo the AFCAT. The test is conducted twice a year in February and August. Invitation to AFCAT applications is open in June and December. The test is conducted all across India by the Indian Air Force. In this course, all modules of AFCAT exam i.e. General Awareness, Verbal Ability in English, Numerical Ability and Reasoning and Military Aptitude will be covered in detail along with MOCK TESTS. In order to join this AFCAT preparatory course, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below 15th August 2023. Classes will start from the first week of September 2023 and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Note: You can enroll into one competitive exam course only. title: EYE FLU::CONJUNCTIVITIS : (7/22/2023)
body: Viral and bacterial conjunctivitis (pink eye) are very contagious. They can spread easily from person to person. You can greatly reduce the risk of getting conjunctivitis or spreading it to someone else by following some simple steps for good hygiene : - Wash your hands often with soap and warm water for at least 20 seconds. Wash them especially well before and after cleaning, or applying eye drops or ointment to, your infected eye. - Avoid touching your eyes with unwashed hands - Touch your eyes with tissue paper and dispose it safely - DON'T shake hands - Consult your Eyes Specialist For any query, please contact at Reception of Uni Health Centre phone Nos. 01824 -444079 & 501227

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (7/20/2023)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for LPU students of various program (mentioned below) to attend a fully tuition fee waived semester at international partner university i.e. students have to pay only tuition fees applicable at LPU and they get opportunity to study for one semester at international partner University without paying tuition fees to the partner university. All formalities and fees relating to VISA, travel, accommodation, food and any other fees of the partner foreign University has to be borne by the student. Details of available institutions are available in the attachment. Eligibility: · A valid passport · Minimum CGPA 6.5 with no backlogs and reappearances · Good Attendance record · Active Participant in extracurricular activities · Excellent communication skills · Capacity to Sustain himself/herself overseas while studying (Estimated budget 2.5 Lakh to 5 lakh) · English proficiency test as per the requirement of the partner university No. of Seats: 50 students would be considered for the 2nd batch. So, apply at the earliest as the seats would be filled on first come, first serve basis. Please Note · Selection would be based on multi-level interviews · Student can apply only to one university at a time, for second university please fill the form again · Seats would be filled on first in-first out basis and are fully at the discretion of selection committee at LPU & partner University Please fill the form https://forms.gle/7NxWPt2gn6jKDm2o7 For further information please contact Division of International Affairs at Block 32-310 or email at study.abroad@lpu.co.in or call at 9501110446/75081838520

title: Enroll into Skill Development Courses offered by the Centre for Professional Enhancement : (7/15/2023)
body: Dear Student Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. title: Molecules 2023 Best PhD Thesis Award : (7/14/2023)
body: The journal Molecules is inviting applications for the 2023 Best PhD Thesis Award. This prize will be awarded to two PhD students or recently qualified PhDs who have produced highly anticipated theses with great academic potential. Applications will be assessed by an evaluation committee. Eligibility and Requirements: – The candidate must be a PhD student or recently qualified PhD who has produced a highly anticipated thesis with great academic potential; – The PhD thesis must be their original work; – The PhD thesis must be defended between 1 September 2022 and 31 August 2023. Required Application Documents: – An executive summary of the PhD thesis in English of around 3000 words; – A letter from the PhD supervisor recommending the candidate for consideration for this award; – The candidate’s CV, including a list of publications connected with the thesis; – An electronic copy of the PhD thesis; – A scanned copy of the PhD diploma (or certificate of studying at a school or research institute as a PhD student due to graduate or participate in graduation thesis defenses). Choice Norms: – Quality of resume and publications; – Relevance of the candidate and research description; – Novelty of the candidate’s PhD thesis; – Strength of the recommendation letter; – Anticipated academic potential; – Originality and impact of the research. Prizes: – Bonus (CHF 800); --An electronic certificate; – Offer to publish one paper free of charge in Molecules after peer review before the end of 2024. The award application deadline is 15 September 2023. The winners will be announced on the Molecules website in December 2023. Application Weblink: https://www.mdpi.com/journal/molecules/awards/submit/2266 Molecules Award Team Email: molecules-marketing@mdpi.com

body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “An Event Based on Learning Language Through Literature”. The event emphasizes on giving students a learning platform to showcase their creativity and presentation skills with a focus on learning language through literary studies. This event will help the students in sharpening their observation and learning and speaking English on different platforms. This will increase their confidence to perceive, write and express their viewpoints in the group with elaboration as well as enhance their confidence and presentation skills. The event will be presentation-based where students will be taught how to acquire language skills through reading books, fiction, plays and short stories. title: Postdoctoral Fellowship opportunity in Collaboration with Southern Federal University, Russia and Lovely Professional University, India : (7/12/2023)
body: This is for the information of all faculty members and PhD scholars (PhD awarded/ completed) that Southern Federal University is offering fellowships for postdoctoral research (PostDocs) to facilitate the researchers to participate in futuristic research being carried out in labs at SfedU. Applications are invited to support research on following topics/themes corresponding to the strategic projects implemented under SFedU Development Programme: - full-cycle technologies for express development of functional materials under artificial intelligence control. - intelligent control and information processing technologies for advanced robotic complexes and hybrid systems. - soil management and agroclimatology. - social programming of the coherent environment of the future. Eligibility criteria Applicants must: - be under the age of 35 years and hold a PhD, which was awarded no more than three years ago - have not studied or worked at SFedU - have hands-on research experience- have at least 3 publications in scientific journals indexed in Scopus and Web of Science databases - B2 (upper-intermediate) level of English Competition for Lot 1 is held to invite foreign specialists from non-CIS and near abroad countries to conduct scientific research for a period of 1 to 3 years.Salary: not less than 90.000 rubles per month. Competition for Lot 2 is held to invite foreign specialists from non-CIS and near abroad countries to form a scientific team of young scientists, postgraduate students, master's students of SFedU consisting of at least 5 people to conduct research for a period of 2 to 4 years.Salary: not less than 130.000 rubles per month. Terms and circumstances: - The Postdoc and his/her closest family members (spouse, children) are provided with the possibility of living in an apartment-type SFedU guest house for the duration of the research (accommodation costs are covered from the Postdoc's personal funds). - The winners of the competition undertake obligations to ensure the growth of research performance on topics corresponding to the themes of strategic projects, fulfilment of the indicators of the Research Leadership block. Application Proposal: - · Submit application in the attached Proforma latest by 17th July 2023 in the following link: https://forms.gle/6J2xcCBo9EM9mnQR6 Applications will be shortlisted by committee and recommended for further consideration to program. Contact Detail: - if any query, contact to: · Prof. Lovi Raj Gupta, Pro-Vice Chancellor, Lovely Professional University, Phagwara, India · Prof. Chander Prakash, Dean, Research & Development Cell, Lovely Professional University, Phagwara, India

title: LPU Global: Start your international degree journey through Credit Transfer for the January Intake : (7/10/2023)
body: The Division of International Affairs at LPU provides an excellent opportunity for students who aspire to earn an international degree by transferring to partner universities in the USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Latvia, Lithuania, and Dubai through the International Credit Transfer Program (ICTP). Under this program, students will complete part of their studies at LPU and the remaining portion at a foreign university. Upon successful completion of the program at the foreign partner university, students will be awarded a degree from that foreign institution. Benefits of the International Credit Transfer Program: 1. Cost-effective: By participating in the ICTP, students can save up to 50% of their tuition fees as they would only need to pay for two years of study instead of four years. 2. Sufficient time to prepare: Through this program, students have ample time to arrange finances and become more mature to go to a foreign land. 3. Global citizenship: Embrace the opportunity to become a global citizen by immersing yourself in a diverse and multicultural learning environment. 4. Financial independence: Students may cover their living expenses by working part-time, utilizing the opportunity to work up to 20 hours per week in accordance with the regulations of the respective country. 5. Post Study Work Rights (PSWR): Upon successfully completing the program at a foreign university, students may be eligible for post-study work rights, providing further career opportunities. Eligibility Criteria: To be eligible for the International Credit Transfer Program, applicants must meet the following criteria: 1. Batch eligibility: For Bachelor's programs, students from the 2021 batch are eligible, and for Master's programs, students from the 2022 batch are eligible. 2. Academic qualifications: A minimum CGPA of 6.5 or above with no backlogs or reappearances at the time of application. 3. Disciplinary record: No pending cases of indiscipline. 4. Language proficiency: An overall IELTS score of 6.5 bands, with a minimum of 6 in each module. 5. Sufficient funds: Demonstrated ability to sustain yourself financially during your studies at the foreign university. If you are interested in this exciting opportunity, please fill out the application form at the following link: https://forms.gle/HQhxPquo5yASRmvz9 This is your last chance to seize this incredible opportunity and embark on a global educational journey. Don't miss out on the chance to earn an international degree while saving costs and expanding your horizons. Apply now! For further information and assistance, please feel free to contact the Division of International Affairs at 32-310, email us at studyabroad@lpu.co.in, or call us at +91-9780036427 or +91-9814222337.

title: Registration invited for Short Term Course on Confirmatory Factor Analysis : (7/5/2023)
body: New strides are made on regular basis in the field of scale validation due to availability of robust standard and free softwares, which are making it feasible to apply complex statistical techniques on the data and gain novel insights on the same. The STC on Confirmatory Factor Analysis tries to expose the participants to some of intricacies in this vital statistical technique of factor structure validation. In this context, here is an opportunity to get exposed to these recent developments in the psychological tool testing through this Short Term Course as per details mentioned below: Title Short Term Course on Confirmatory Factor Analysis Course Outcome The participants will be able to: 1. Analyze results of confirmatory factor analysis technique on real time data 4. Employ equivalence testing on the validated factor structure 5. Apply measurement invariance testing on the validated factor structure Report the results of confirmatory factor analysis and measurement invariance techniques during academic writing For details refer brochure Resource Persons Dr. Vijay Kumar Chechi, Professor and Deputy Dean, Department of Education, LPU Dr. Rajib Chakraborty, Associate Professor, Department of Education, LPU Program Schedule August 21 (Monday), 2023 to August 26 (Saturday), 2023 Time: 6:30 AM to 08:30 PM Platform https://myclass.lpu.in/ Registration Fee Rs. 1500/- Registration Link http://www.lpu.in/hrd/ Registration Closes August 18, 2023 (Friday) Since there are limited seats, selection will be on a first-come-first-served basis. title: Communication Breakthrough - A role play based event on speaking skills : (6/30/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “Communication Breakthrough - A role play based event on speaking skills”. The event emphasizes on giving students a platform to showcase their creativity and presentation skills, with a focus on language. The event will prepare students for an extraordinary journey of imagination and creativity. It will help the students sharpen their observation skills as well as learn the importance of presenting on a public platform. This will boost their self-assurance and presentation skills, as well as their ability to understand, articulate, and write their opinions in the group. The event will be role-play-based, which is designed to engage and challenge students skills in an immersive and interactive environment. In this role play, students will be divided into different teams, and each team will be assigned a unique topic to perform. On the basis of given topics, students will prepare role plays that will help them step into a richly crafted world where they will assume the role of a unique character and encounter challenges, mysteries, and opportunities to make impactful choices. In order to promote healthy discussion, students will also have the opportunity to interact with other like-minded classmates. The main objectives of the event are: ? To assist students in group conversation so that they can improve their communication abilities. ? To help students in developing valuable skills such as leadership, decision -making and adaptability. Push the boundaries of creativity and learn to think outside the box.? To attain good command over presentation skills. ? To aid students to experience the practical applications of their academic knowledge in adynamic and immersive setting. Gain insights into how their skills can be utilized in various professional fields, preparing them for future career opportunities. Target audience: The students of School of Computer Science and Engineering, Computer Applications, Electronics and Electrical Engineering and Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences will participate in the event. title: Exciting Opportunity to attend Summer School Online with almost 90% Scholarship : (6/27/2023)
body: The Division of International Affairs at LPU brings you an incredible and exciting opportunity for students to enroll in the course “Challenges of Digital Governance”, held online from July 3 to July 12, 2023. The course is organized within the framework of the International HSE Saint Petersburg Summer School. The course introduces the key topics of digital governance (e-government, e-participation) implementation from the perspective of Political Science. During this course students will learn the key models and theories, useful for digital governance researchers and practitioners. They will also discuss successful and unsuccessful cases of e-government and e-participation project implementation. At the end of the course, students will present their own projects, related to digital transformations in the public sector. Participants will receive an official transcript with credits (3 ECTS), as well as a certificate of participation, which gives additional points when applying for the HSE master’s programs. REGISTRATION AND KEY DATA The link for registration: https://www.hse.ru/en/polls/624026447.html Deadline for Registration: July 1st, 2023 Language: English Mode: Online 32 Contact Hours – 3 ECTS For more information about the course, please visit: https://spb.hse.ru/en/io/sumsch/challenges Note: HSE, our partner university, will provide an almost 90% discount on course fees exclusively for LPU students. The fee to participate in the course is 3000 rubles (Approx 3000 INR), instead of 39000 rubles. "All interested participants must register through the given registration link and email the International Affairs department at LPU (rahul.28243@lpu.co.in) by uploading a screenshot of the recorded response to confirm their participation." For Queries/Concerns, Kindly Contact Mr. Rahul Chhabra, Division of International Affairs, Block 32-310 Ph.no: +91 7814300843 rahul.28243@lpu.co.in

title: Registration for Re-appear / Improvement examination to be conducted in the month of July, 2023. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230626/003) : (6/26/2023)
body: The interface for the registration of Re-appear / Improvement examination to be conducted in the month of July, 2023 in the offline mode has been opened for all students. Students having ‘E’ grade in any course code(s) can register for re-appear / Improvement through the following interface. UMS Navigation ---> Examination System ---> Exam Registration ---> Re-Appear Registration The fee for Re-appear / Improvement exam registration is Rs. 350/- per course code and the last date of registration with this fee is 07th July, 2023. No Re-appear / Improvement registration shall be allowed after the due date. However, if the result is still pending, then the student should register the Re-appear / Improvement course only after declaration of the result. In case, the result is declared after the last date of of Re-appear / Improvement registration i.e. 07th July, 2023, then due consideration shall be given to the student for registering the Re-appear / Improvement exam. For any lecture falling in the same time slot as that of the examination scheduled time, duty leave shall be given to the student for those lectures only (particularly in the time slot of exam). In addition, duty leave shall also be given to the student for classes scheduled one hour prior and one hour after the time of examination. The date sheet and details of the examination shall be displayed in the UMS login of the student as per the dates mentioned below. Important dates: - Registration start date 26th June, 2023 Last date of registration 07th July, 2023 Display of date sheet in UMS login (Tentative) 10th July, 2023 The detailed procedure for registration is attached for reference.

body: The Division of International Affairs at LPU brings you an incredible and exciting opportunity for students to enroll in a certified online speaking course in Russian Language provided by HSE University in Russia. This Russian Language & Culture Online course is specifically designed to enhance your proficiency in Russian as a foreign language while providing insights into Russian culture, prominent figures, landmarks, the city of Moscow, and HSE University itself. Through this course, you will develop your communicative skills and better understand Russian customs and traditions before potentially experiencing them firsthand. The course is completely free of charge and offers flexible attendance options. It will run on a weekly basis from June to December 2023, totaling 93 academic hours. The course will be conducted in the form of an online speaking club, allowing you to engage in conversations and practice your Russian language skills actively. It is important to note that this course does not award any credits or degrees upon completion. However, all participants will receive an e-certificate of attendance to acknowledge their participation. Over the course, you will… 1) Boost your proficiency level in the spoken Russian language 2) Learn more about the diverse Russian culture and customs 3) Meet HSE University – one of the best world universities! REGISTRATION AND KEY DATA The applications are accepted till June 30th, 2023, via a registration form at https://admissions.hse.ru/rlc_online/polls/838686049.html. a) Before applying for the course, attendees may take a brief proficiency test to check their level. The proficiency test is available at - https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScyLiTc63dEhPioz2rgwovJpHg173Y5a-qCCFjSpJTShJog6A/viewform. b) Selected attendees will be notified about the schedule and given a link to join the classes. The classes will be given via Zoom. More about the course, its minimal requirements and suggested topics can be found at admissions.hse.ru/rlc_online/ For Queries/Concerns, Kindly Contact Mr. Rahul Chhabra, Division of International Affairs, Block 32-310. Ph.no: +91 7814300843 rahul.28243@lpu.co.in

title: A workshop on oral presentation : (6/23/2023)
body: Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct “A workshop on oral presentation.” The event emphasizes on giving students a platform to showcase their presentation skills with a focus on language. It will help the students in sharpening their observation and speaking skills as well as in learning the importance of presentation on a public platform. title: Registration Invited for Short Term Course on Communication Network Management by using CISCO Packet Tracer : (6/15/2023)
body: Computer networks have become extremely significant in our present-day society. A majority of companies depend on the proper functioning of their networks for communication, administration, automation, e-business solutions,etc. A simulation tool offers a way to predict the impact on the network of a hardware upgrade, a change in topology, an increase in traffic load or the use of a new application. Cisco Packet Tracer (CPT) is a multi-tasking network simulation software that can be used to perform and analyze various network activities. title: Retraction Watch Hijacked Or Cloned Journals Checker : (6/9/2023)
body: Hijacked journals mimic legitimate journals by adopting their titles, ISSNs, and other metadata. Usually, hijacked journals mirror legitimate journals without permission from the original journal. Scholars can be duped into publishing in hijacked journals – many of which require fees – by offers of fast publication and indexing in databases such as Scopus; being indexed in such databases is viewed by many universities and governments as a mark of legitimacy. Tracking these journals is no mean feat but knowing which journals may have been hijacked is vital to the world of publishing integrity. List of cloned or hijacked Journal: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ak985WGOgGbJRJbZFanoktAN_UFeExpE/edit#gid=5255084 This list of cloned/hijacked journal is dynamic; more journals will be added as their hijacked status are uncovered.

title: Anti-Plagiarism Policy : (6/6/2023)
body: Based on the UGC notification on ACADEMIC INTEGRITY AND PREVENTION OF PLAGIARISM IN HIGHER EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS) REGULATIONS, 2018 DATED 23RD JULY, 2018, all the students, faculty, researchers, or staff who are corresponding authors of research papers, and chapters in books; editors in full-fledged books and any other similar work, submitted for publication in print or electronic media and the students/ scholars submitting a thesis, dissertation, etc. for assessment/opinion leading to the award of master and research level degrees must conduct Similarity checks for exclusion from Plagiarism. The similarity checks for plagiarism shall exclude the following: · All quoted work reproduced with all necessary permission and/or attribution · All references, bibliography, table of content, preface, and acknowledgments generic terms, laws, standard symbols, and standards equations · Any other, as per changes recommended by regulatory bodies from time to time · The research work shall be based on original ideas, which shall include an abstract, summary, hypothesis, observations, results, conclusions, recommendations, and policy only. It shall exclude common knowledge or coincidental terms, up to fourteen (14) consecutive words. · A Unique Component of 90% or more only shall be acceptable. · For all the final drafts of the manuscripts that are accepted by the publishers, the Similarity Index reports must be submitted at the interface when the first communication is done to the journal. This is also applicable for the students/scholar’s submitting thesis, dissertation, etc. which has assessment/opinion leading to the award of master’s and research-level degrees.

title: Important information regarding Community Development Project (CDP) (Autumn Term-23241). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230601/004) : (6/1/2023)
body: University promotes community development for its students and thus it is a core course in third term as per the program scheme. The main objective of Community Development Project (CDP) is to identify the issues related to community development and to find solutions for their improvement. But It has come to notice that certain unethical practices are being followed by some students related to Community Development Project (CDP) work, thus all Schools have been advised to closely monitor the student progress during Community Development Project (CDP). Regular follow ups shall be taken during Community Development Project (CDP) duration wherein students shall be asked to report the progress of Community Development Project (CDP) work. Student are advised to refrain from the following practices as this shall lead to disciplinary action in terms of Unfair Means Case (UMC) and further action shall also be applicable including cancellation of scholarship, awarding F grades in all courses of that term, suspension etc. * Joining Fake NGO’s (NGO shall be closely scrutinised by university) * Getting certificates in lieu of Money * Bogus certificates submitted by students * Improper/Inappropriate Geo Tagged pictures submitted by students (as they shall be closely monitored during ETP viva) As per the request received from student(s) the last date for each student to provide details of their selected NGO for CDP has been extended till 15th June 2023 to facilitate appropriate conduct of Community Development Project (CDP). The updated CDP guidelines having are also attached with this announcement for reference. title: Enrollment into Career Services - 2026 graduating batch students (Revised 01-Jun-2023) : (5/31/2023)
body: Kind attention: Students expected to graduate in 2026. This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the students graduating in 2026 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2026. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs Registration Deadline (revised): Career Services Registration with immediate access to applicable campus placement/internship opportunities is open from 01-Jun-2023 31-Jul-2023.Registration Process: * Pathway: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Career Services Registration. * Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: ** Process Step-I: Initial Consent for enrollment into Career Services ** Process Step-II: Profile Update and PEP Fee payment ** Process Step-I: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Process Step-I will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5 (or equivalent). Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Career Services Registration. ** Process Step-II: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-I. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. At this step itself, the students will be required to make online payment of the Professional Enhancement Program (PEP) Fee as it will be guided by the interface. PEP Fee shall be paid online (in full or part) through Placement Registration interface itself. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. Student will not be allowed to avail Career Services/PEP activities without paying the PEP fee. The registration is considered complete only after Process Step-II is successfully completed with applicable PEP fee payment (in full or part). Students registering with pat payment of PEP Fee as per the registration timeline mention above through the following interface : UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal. UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Pay Balance PEP Fee. Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. In case of any queries 1) Students may contact their respective school Training and Placement Coordinators (TPCs) contact details of TPC’s can be found at UMS Navigation-----Placement Services-----Placement Portal (home page) 2) Or log an RMS in category "Division of Career Services --- Placement --- Career Services Policy Registration".

This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the students graduating in 2025 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2025. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs Registration Timeline (Revised): Career Services Registration with access to applicable campus placement/internship opportunities w.e.f 1-Jan-2024 is open from 01-Jun-2023 to 31-Jul-2023. Registration Process: * Pathway: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Career Services Registration. * Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: ** Process Step-I: Initial Consent for enrollment into Career Services ** Process Step-II: Profile Update and PEP Fee payment ** Process Step-I: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Career Services Registration. Process Step-I will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). ** Process Step-II: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-I. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. At this step itself, the students will be required to make online payment of the Professional Enhancement Program (PEP) Fee as it will be guided by the interface. PEP Fee shall be paid online (in full or part) through Placement Registration interface itself. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. Student will not be allowed to avail Career Services/PEP activities without paying the PEP fee. The registration is considered complete only after Process Step-II is successfully completed with applicable PEP fee payment (in full or part). Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. In case of any queries 1) Students may contact their respective school Training and Placement Coordinators (TPCs) contact details of TPC’s can be found at UMS Navigation-----Placement Services-----Placement Portal (home page) 2) Or log an RMS in category "Division of Career Services --- Placement --- Career Services Policy Registration".

title: Exciting Opportunity to Participate in European Summer School 2023 for Free! : (5/30/2023)
body: Division of International Affairs brings an Excellent Opportunity for LPU Students to attend the International Summer School "Modern Features of Human Rights Protection in The Countries of Three Seas". ELFA summer school has been recognized as European Law Faculties Association (ELFA) Summer Course. It is jointly presented by the Baltic International Academy (BIA) and the Faculty of Law of the University of Bialystok. Experts from five universities in Latvia, Poland, Bulgaria, Georgia, and Ukraine will introduce participants to various aspects of implementing human rights in the EU. The lectures aim to provide diverse perspectives on human rights protection, nationally and internationally. Participants will gain an understanding of contemporary methods and tools, insight into implementation challenges, and fundamental skills for effective action in the field. The classes and modules are designed for acquiring different perspectives, modern methods, and tools for human rights protection at national and international levels. This program is intended for: 1) Law students and graduates from other countries 2) Professional who possesses a law degree 3) Professional interested in Human rights or a related subject area KEY DATA Program date: June 26th - June 30th, 2023 Length: 1 Week Program Scope - 32 Academic hours Language: English Form of Participation: online ZOOM Registration Form: https://forms.gle/8ap4iQKGJDKb6DZr7 Application Deadline: June 16, 2023 PARTICIPATION FEE Participant, normal fee: Free For participants who wish to receive a Certificate – 20 EUR "All interested participants must register through the given registration form and email the International Affairs department at LPU (rahul.28243@lpu.co.in) by uploading a screenshot of the recorded response to confirm their participation." For any Queries, Kindly Contact Mr. Rahul Chhabra, Division of International Affairs. Block 32-310. Email: rahul.28243@lpu.co.in Ph.no: +91 7814300843

title: Registration for the Annual Seminar Evaluation of Ph.D. Scholars. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230529/007) : (5/29/2023)
body: This is with reference to the Ph.D. Annual Seminar evaluation tentatively scheduled from June 2023 onwards. All Ph.D. scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs before July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for the Annual Seminar every year after the date of successful completion of SAS. Note: - The research scholars who have completed their maximum Ph.D. tenure (6 years), are required to seek an extension of the same from the Center for Research Degree Programs (CRDP) before applying for the annual seminar registration. The main aim of the annual seminar is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the suggestions given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. Justification remarks in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present the amount of work done or progress made since the previous evaluation. The scholars are required to take the following 2 steps for appearing in the annual seminar: 1. Registration and uploading of the annual seminar report Scholars who have successfully received their candidacy letter and have cleared at least one End Term Report (ETR) are eligible to register for Annual seminar through the following UMS interface path: UMS Navigation -->Examination system --> Research Degree Evaluation --> Registration for upcoming activity --> Annual Seminar The interface for registration of the annual seminar will remain active till 20th June, 2023. Once the scholar has registered for the annual seminar, he/she needs to upload the annual progress report for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC). The scholar should visit the following UMS path for uploading the annual progress report. UMS Navigation -->Examination system --> Research Degree Evaluation --> Registration for upcoming activity --> Annual Seminar The guidelines for preparing the report and the presentation along with their respective formats are attached with this announcement. The last date for uploading the annual seminar report is 20th June, 2023. All eligible scholars as per the attached list (List of Eligible Scholars for Annual seminar) are required to register for Annual Seminar Evaluation and Upload their files. 2. Recommendation of the Annual Seminar Report by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor Once the scholars have registered for the Annual Seminar and uploaded their Annual seminar report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the path: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination -->Research Degree Evaluation --> PhD Seminar File Verification --> Annual Seminar -->Registration number- -> Download The last date for recommendation of the Report is 23rd June, 2023. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of annual seminar report: a. The scholars need to register for the evaluation and upload the annual report strictly as per the guidelines for completion of registration process or else their registration shall be deemed cancelled and they will be marked absent for the evaluation. b. As per the current guidelines, the scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such scholars who have either missed or are Not Recommended in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the Annual Seminar evaluation. c. The scholars must upload a single PDF file for Annual seminar report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for Annual Seminar) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be canceled. d. Scholars are required to submit one hard copy of the report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/co-supervisor/administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the venue during the scheduled evaluation. e. File containing a PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. f. No extension shall be given for uploading the report beyond the last date. h. Scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using Annual registration interface) before registering and uploading the Annual seminar report at the interface. g. In case a research scholar has registered for the Annual seminar evaluation but does not upload the annual report or he/she does not appear for the same, then he/ she will be marked absent and the result shall stand as 'Not Recommended' h. The research scholars who are unable to register for the Annual seminar evaluation due to pending fee/ dues are advised to clear the same and register for the Annual seminar evaluation as per the timelines failing which their Annual seminar result will stand as "Not recommended". i. In case a research scholar has any pending documents related to admissions, they are advised to submit the same before their last date of the scheduled evaluation, or else they may not be allowed to appear in the Annual seminar Evaluation. NOTE: The Ph.D. Annual Seminar evaluation will be conducted in the offline mode only. For Recommendation of the annual seminar report The scholar must upload the Annual seminar report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, they may submit an RMS request per the details mentioned below. 1. For Registration/Uploading of report/not in the eligible list, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell). 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor / Extension / Fee, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programs). 3. For Pending Documents: Submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Division of Admissions) --> Pending Documents.

title: Registration Invited for Short Term Course on Academic and Creative Writing for Research Publication : (5/29/2023)
body: Academic writing is writing which communicates ideas, information and research to the wider academic community. Academic writing is arguably the most important skill in academic contexts, since writing is the main method of academic communication. It is also the most difficult skill to master. At some point in our academic career, we all need to write an academic paper, whether it’s a report, an essay, a dissertation or a thesis. When it’s time to write that paper, we may feel stress about writing it properly. In this context a Short Term course is scheduled by Department of Verbal Ability in collaboration with HRDC, LPU as per details appended below: Title Short Term Course on Academic and Creative Writing for Research Publication Course Outcomes After completion of the course, participants will be able to: 1. Create novel piece of writing 2. Enhance writing skills 3. Become more proficient in writing 4. Formulate articles for publication For Course Content: Please refer to the attached Brochure Resource Persons 1. Dr. Nandini Sahu, Professor and former Director, School of Foreign Languages, Indira Gandhi National Open University, Delhi. Amazon’s Best selling author of 2022. 2. Dr. Ajit Mishra, Professor, IIT (BHU) Varanasi 3. Dr. Ajoy Batta, Professor and Head, Department of English, Lovely Professional University 4. Dr. Sanjay Prasad Pandey, Professor, Department of English, Lovely Professional University 5. Dr. Simran Preet Kaur, Assistant Professor, Poona College of Arts, Science and Commerce. Visiting Faculty at Armed Forces Medical College. Adjunct Faculty at Bhartiya Vidyapeeth University.Renowned, Columnist at Times of India. title: Registration invited for Faculty Induction Program (FIP) 2023 : (5/29/2023)
body: The faculty induction program on the theme bibliometric analysis, systematic literature review, and meta-analysis is imperative for equipping faculty members with essential research skills and fostering a culture of evidence-based research. Collaboration is a crucial aspect of academic research, and the topics of bibliometric analysis, systematic literature review, and meta-analysis facilitate interdisciplinary collaboration. By organizing an induction program, faculty members will have the opportunity to engage in discussions, share experiences, and explore potential collaborative opportunities across different disciplines. This cross-pollination of ideas and expertise will lead to innovative research outcomes. In this context, Faculty Induction Program (FIP) 2023 is scheduled as per details appended below: Title Faculty Induction Program (FIP) 2023 Date June 05, 2023 to July 12, 2023 Time S1 - 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM SII - 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM Mode Face to Face: Block 32, Room No. 413 Online : https://myclass.lpu.in/ Mode: Hybrid-Face to Face and Online Course Objectives The course is crafted to achieve the following outcomes:: 1. To equip participants with the necessary skills and knowledge to conduct bibliometric analysis, systematic literature reviews, and meta-analyses. 2. To guide participants in the selection and application of suitable software tools and databases for bibliometric analysis, systematic literature review (SLR), and meta-analysis. 3. To enhance participants' ability to synthesize and interpret research findings derived from bibliometric analysis, Systematic Literature Review (SLR), and meta-analysis. 4. To provide practical guidance on manuscript structure, organization, and adherence to scientific writing standards. 5. To facilitate peer review and feedback sessions to improve participants' manuscript writing skills. 6. To enable participants to effectively communicate their research findings through high-quality manuscript writing. For Course Content and Resource panel Refer Brochure Registration Fee LPU Faculty Members: Sponsored by University LPU Research Scholars : Rs. 3000/- (Online Payment or Cash to be deposited in Accounts Department) Register at https://www.lpu.in/hrd/ Registration Closes June 03, 2023 (Saturday) Since there are limited seats, selection will be on a first-come first-served basis. Looking forward to your active participation.

The outcome of the program is to help the businesses grow quickly and attained self-sustenance. During the Cohort participants will be mentored and guided by experienced entrepreneurs, access to ideation labs and co-working spaces, networking opportunities with angel investors and other resources to accelerate the growth curve. No equity will be taken for the entire program, whereas a nominal fee for participation will be charged to maintain the seriousness towards the ultimate goal. This day serves as a testament to their hard work, dedication, and perseverance, while also a day to reflect upon the late-night study sessions, and the friendships that were made along the way. On this special day, we extend a warm welcome to all our international students who have travelled from different corners of the world to pursue their dreams of higher education with us that has also fostered cultural diversity, understanding, and global connections. We are looking forward to see all of you on the Graduation day, a ceremonial culmination of the golden moments of your educational journey at LPU and the beginning of a new and exciting chapter in your lives. We hope that all the students are encouraged to further embrace their passions, follow their dreams, and make meaningful contributions to society. We extend our greetings on your graduation day and may your future be filled with joy, fulfilment, and endless opportunities. title: CHANGE OF PROGRAM FOR THE CONTINUING STUDENT (INCLUDING Ph.D.). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/230527/001) : (5/27/2023)
body: This is to notify all continuing students that they can now apply for a Change of Program using the online interface available at the following link: UMS Navigation -->Change of Program--> Request for Change of Program. However, the students should meticulously go through the guidelines (attached with this communication) before applying for the same. Timelines for change of Program:- Phase Processing Fee From To I Rs.1000/- 26th May, 2023 26thJune, 2023 II Rs.3000/- 27th June, 2023 27th July, 2023 III Rs.5000/- 28th July, 2023 1st September 2023 No program change option will be allowed after the last date i.e. 1st September 2023 under any circumstances. Important Note:- 1. All students who apply for change of program shall be required to pay the “processing fee” as per the phase applicable online after submitting their request (Screenshot attached) along with the parent’s consent letter/undertaking form for PhD which shall be duly signed by them. (Note: - The processing fee is non-refundable even if the change of program request of student is not approved by competent authorities) 2. The program of the student shall be changed for the notified students (approved cases) after the payment of change of program fee (Rs 4000/-) within the given timelines and the final approval of the competent authorities. 3. In case student fails to pay the fee as per timelines, the approval for the Change of Program shall stand cancelled and he/she would be required continue in the ongoing program only. 4. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old program after approval of Change of Program. 5. Due to course mapping if student is allocated additional courses to study to complete the requirements of the new program he/she will have to register the courses as backlog by paying the 1/10th of the tuition fee (per course) without any scholarship. 6. If the term fee for the current program is more than that of the new program, the cumulative fee difference (between current program and new program) for all the future terms is to be paid by the student at the time of depositing the “Change of Program Fee” and fee of the new program shall be applicable (for all future terms) to such students in their new program. Tuition fee refund of any kind shall not be applicable. 7. Only one chance is given to the students for change of program during the entire program duration, hence the students are advised to be very careful while availing this chance. 8. No benefit of missed CA or Attendance will be given to the student applying for change of program after start of classes. To avoid this, students are strongly advised to apply for the change of program before the start of the term. 9. The attendance will be calculated from the date of start of classes of the new program in which the student has sought change and not from the date the student gets registered in the course of the new program. Any queries from students can be clarified by sending e-mail directed to academic.aac@lpu.co.in or can directly login an RMS following the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS)---->Log Request Master category: Academics Category: Academics Sub Category: Change of Program

title: Join bluehawks Live PTE Prep, India’s only PTE Prep course with score guarantee. : (5/26/2023)
body: Dear Students, Students preparing for the PTE (Pearson Test of English) often face several challenges. Here are some common challenges faced by PTE test takers: 1. Familiarity with the test format: PTE has a unique format that includes different sections such as speaking, writing, reading, and listening. Students may find it challenging to understand and adapt to this format. 2. Time management: PTE is a time-bound test, and managing time effectively within each section can be difficult. Students may struggle to complete all the tasks within the allocated time. 3. Language proficiency: PTE assesses English language skills, including vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and comprehension. Students who are not native English speakers may face challenges in achieving the required level of proficiency. 4. Test anxiety: Test anxiety can affect performance and lead to decreased confidence. Students may feel nervous or stressed during the test, impacting their ability to perform at their best. 5. Limited practice materials: Finding reliable and sufficient practice materials for PTE preparation can be challenging. Students may struggle to access authentic resources that accurately reflect the test format and difficulty level. bluehawks PTE online Prep aims to address these challenges and help students prepare effectively for the PTE. Here's how bluehawks PTE online Prep can assist: A. Comprehensive course content: bluehawks PTE online Prep provides a comprehensive course curriculum that covers all sections of the PTE test. It helps students understand the test format, learn strategies, and develop the necessary skills for each section. B. Practice tests and materials: bluehawks offers a range of practice tests and materials designed to simulate the actual PTE test. These resources help students become familiar with the test format, improve time management, and identify areas for improvement. C. Personalized learning: bluehawks PTE online Prep offers personalized learning experiences. It assesses students' strengths and weaknesses and provides tailored recommendations and feedback to help them focus on areas that require improvement. D. Expert guidance: bluehawks PTE online Prep provides guidance from experienced tutors who are well-versed in the PTE test. They offer tips, strategies, and feedback to help students enhance their performance and confidence. E. Flexibility and convenience: bluehawks PTE online Prep is an online platform, allowing students to access the course materials and practice tests at their own convenience. This flexibility enables students to study and practice whenever and wherever they want. By addressing the challenges faced by PTE test takers and providing comprehensive resources and support, bluehawks PTE online Prep aims to enhance students' preparation and increase their chances of success in the PTE test.
